khyer krig bstan gyi pha rol na paṇ+ḍi ta rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs nas 'gro ba ri mang po'i don mdzad/ slob dpon shes rab byang chub/ ro bo bya rkang bi zhol du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo brgyad nas rab tu byung ste/ deng sang sgrub pa mdzad/ slob dpon shes rab rdo rje/ 'phan yul rong du sku 'khrungs/ bka' gdams pa bsta na nas sgrub pa mdzad/ slob nga pon 'phags pa ston chos/ de bal yul pham mthing du rnal 'byor pa zhig tu sku 'khrungs nas phyag rgya ma gcig dang ldom bu byed ces sogs skye brgyud mang po gsungs/ yang chos rje dwags po rin po che'i 'das mchod cig gi dus su bla ma lha rje'i slo ba ma bzhis sems can kyi don rlabs po che byed pa gzigs nas bzhad mo zhig shor/ dge bshes shes rab 'bum gyis de ci yin dri ba zhus pa la/ nub phyogs na gser sgom ye shes snying po dang / ya zi sngon mo shar gyi phyogs na byang chub sems pa'i spyod pa byed pa gcig tu skyes 'dug gsungs/ shar phyogs na sgom pa zhi mdzes dang dwags po phag sgom pa bzhi po des sems can mang po'i don byed bzhin 'dug gsungs/ yang bla ma lha rje rin po che'i slob ma snga shos dge tshul zhig da lta lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten rgyal bu bde spyod bzang po'i grong khyer na byang chub sems pa'i spyod pa byed pa gcig tu skyes 'dug gsungs/ yang bla ma rin po che'i rizhal nas/ smon lam bla ma khyod 'di nas tshe 'phos te nub phyogs pad+ma can du mkhan po mnga' ris pa tshe'i rigs 'dzin thob pa de'i mkhan bur 'gyur/ sngon yang skye ba bzhi la pad ma can du mkhan slob kyi 'brel ba thob/ da lta 'di dang khyod skye ba lngar bar ma chad par rab tu byung gsungs/47

༄༅ / /na rma nga/ sku phreng dang po dus sa sum mkhyen pa'i mdzad rnam zhib bkod bzhugs so//wa wa yang gzhu'i gru bzhi dgon du bzhugs pa'i dus slob ma sgom chen gcig shi ba la rin po ches/ sgom pa de mdo khams smad 'dzam yul gyi sa char skyes ‘'dug gsungs/ phyis 'dzam yul du byon pa'i tshe khrom chen po'i gseb tu byis pa ga 'an las spobs pa che ba la dad pa dang ldan pa zhig byung ste/ sngar gyi sgom pa de'i skye ba 'di yin gsungs/ phyis sgom chen bzang po zhig byung ba la 'dzam skye ba gsum pa zhes grags so/ /yang khams su bzhugs pa'i tshe zhal snga ra btsun pa zhig shi ba de gtsang rong du rab ston dar ma grags kyi bur skyes 'dug gsungs/ cang ma nam mkha' grags kyi nu bo shi ba bye/bye /| wa wa bye/ | ༷ wa wa wa bye hūṃ skre wa ༷ bye wa ji 4 / rdo /shā ༵ // /ma ༷la rdo du rje zu ga dang rdo ༷༷ dī dī zlo/dī ༷༷ byi/ the tso'a~X ༵/ba ba ༷༷ sbyan kyi me/nga de du ra /mab sbyo/ /ga la su 'a // zlong ༷sa te pa ma/lha ༵ //sdu /// t+t+waṃ/ /༷ bye byeX byeX mu ༷ /ga/ tai bye spyo bye tre bye bye/ ༷/ ṭ+wāṃ ma ༷shī ༷༷ wa ༷༷ bye// tre /༷ /rdo //bye ༷ two /'i ༵ tre bye / / /bye ༷༷ bye gas/no// ༷ two hūṃ hūṃ gi 48

༄༅/ /nam pa sku phreng dang po dus gsu/ma mkhyen pa'i mdzad rnam zhib bkod bzhugs so//tshe rgyal po dmag gi dpung mang po dang bcas te phyin pa'i lam du sdig spyod kyi rgyal bo brdzis nas/ bsad/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan pa dang rgyal po ngan song du 'gro ba las bzlog te dge la bkod/ rgyal po de ni da lta'i yon bdag dgon pa 'di yin gsungs/ yang rgya gar shar phyogs ka liṅka'i rgyal khams su sku 'khrungs te/ rgyal po zla bas rnam par gnon pa zhes bya bar gyur/ bla'o lha rje rin po che nu ngas rgyas ye shes zhabs zhes bya bar gyur nas bla ma mdzad/ de'i slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen a ba dhū ti pa yin te/ da lta rje btsun mi lar grags/ de'i tshe rgyal po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten skor ba la byon pas lam du nam mkha' nas sgra grag pa/ khyod da dung dngos grub mi thob ste rang gi gnas su song la 'dus byas kyi dge ba grub tshad kyis shig bya ba gsungs/ der rgyal pos dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzug pa la sogs pa'i dge rtsa dpag tu med pa mdzad/ slar mchod rten la skor ba mdzad pas thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob/ khyi gnyis rjes su 'brangs pa la yang thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa da lta spyon gyi mkha' 'gro ma gzhan las sdug rtsub che ba gnyis su gyur yod/ de dus kyi rgyal po'i 'khor la sogs pa'i ka liṅka'i mi mang po zhig sa smad 'dir skyes yod de/ ston pa sangs rgyas dang / dge bshes rin chen rgyal mtshan gnyis la de dus thun mong gi dngos grub mang po yod pa la da lta med pa 'di de dus bsgrubs shing da lta ma sgrub pas par 'dug de'i tshe khyod btsu gyis kho bo la gso'/ ba thebs pa te/ ston pa sangs rgyas/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ yon tan 'od/ yon tan bla ma/ da se 'dun grags/ smon lam bla ma rnams dbus na yod la gcig tre na yod gsungs/ yang nub phyogs spyon du rje btsun ti lo pa'i slob ma nus pa mchog tu gyur pa'i rnal 'byor pa shī 'a/ da rnye zhes bya sa ra sku 'khrungs/ tshal dang nags khrod 'ba' zhig tu bzhugs te sems can gyi don mdzad/ de dus kho bos dbang bskur ba'i slob ma bzhi da lta 'dir yod de/ rdo rje 'bum/ sgom sngon/ shākya shes rab/ chos dpal rnams yin gsungs/ yang 'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i byang gi mtha' zad pa'i byang shar mtshams na/ chu klung me tog pad+mas brgyan pa zhes bya bar 'khrungs te/ dge slong rda me khri rte zhes bya/ mkhan po ni bram ze sa dzñā na zhes bya ba yin/ des dus kyi mkhan bu bzhi 49

༄༅ / /na rma pa sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mdzad rnam zhib bkod bzhugs so//da lta yang 'dir dge bshes brtson 'grus shes rab dang rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mdog mkhas pa/ ming dge jo sras rnams yin gsu ngas/ dbe bshes phya pa 'di paṇ+ḍi ta chung ngu zhig yin pa la kho bos slo/ba dpon zhus/ dbe bshes sdo rje seng be 'di de dus phya pa'i slob ma yin pa la/ da dung yang khong gi drung du skye bar 'dug gsungs/ de'i dus su slob dpon chen po ḍom+bhi nga/ la ri bo bya skyibs/ su gsol ba thebs pa'i yin gsungs/ yang shar lus 'phags kyi gling du yab rgyal po dge ba bzang po dang / yum shes rab ma'i sras mo shes rab bzang mo zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs/ gsang mtshan mtsho skyes byang chub zhes bya/ rgyal bur skyes na rgyal srid 'dzin dgos pas sdig pa ngang sis 'phel ba la 'jigs nas sras mor skye ba bzung / yab yum dge ba'i lam la bkod/ de'i ci dus su bla ma lha rje 'di dge slong rdarma si rnyi zhes bya bar bzhugs pa la sdom pa blangs/ /yo byad mang po yod pa thams cad bla ma la phul nas shin tu mnyes par byas/ chos kyang ci zhus zhus bla mas gnang ba yin gsungs/ de dus kyi kho bo'i grogs da lta ca byu'adir/ dge 'dun 'od/ shes rab bla ma/ smon lam bla ma/la yon tan 'od/ ye shes 'od zer gzhan zhig dang bdun pha dge ba grags dang / ma dge ba bzang mo'i bu spun du gyur pa yin gsungs/ yang shar lus 'phags gling dang / lho 'dzam bu'i gling gi bar na/ gling g.yog yongs su grags snapa'i ming la rat+na pha la zhes bya bar grong khyer ra dza pha la'am rdarma pha la zhes par yab rje'u rigs rdarma sba sa pa dang / yum pu ma ti'i sras su pa bīrti zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs/ rab tu byung ba'i mtshan rat+na shī la zhes bya/ de'i dus su bla ma lha rje 'di dpal gyi sbas pa zhes bya bar bzhugs pa la/ ma hwa ma ya dang / sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang rdo rje sems pa'i sgrub thabs zhus/ de dus kho bo spyod pa nus pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin te/ lo brgya dang drug cu rtsa bzhi thub/ de dus kyi kho bo'i slob ma da lta 'dir/ yon tan 'od/ dge 'dun 'od/ ye shes bla ma/ smon lam bla ma/ 'byung gnas bla ma/ rgyal mtshan bla ma/ gtsang ston tshul seng / tre'i dbe bshes dkon mchog dpal/ rdo rje shes rab/ bka' gdams pa gcig dang bcu la sgrol ma dang / dbang gi rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba'i chos bshad/ kho bos bla ma lha rje la tshogs 'khor zhig zhus pa'i tshe da lta'i slob ma khyed nyi 50

༄cu / /kurma pa sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mdzad rnam 'ib bkod bzhugs so// shu tsam yod pa ste/ dge bshes bka' gdams pa/ slob dpon rin chen rgyal mchan/ ston pa sangs rgyas/ nye gnas gnyis/ dpon dge 'dun grags/ smon lam bla ma rdo rje shes rab/ dge bshes dkon mchog dpal/ sto na pa tshul steng rnams dang / btsun pa gnyis kyang yod pa las/— spre tho gcig da dung 'di nyid la yod lu/ gcig dbus su skyes/ yon bdag dgon pa ba 'di khyim bdag phyug po zhig gi bu yin pas de dus yon bdag byas/ skye ba 'dir yang byas shi nge / phyi man yung byed/ mkhan po ka brag pas kho bo'i mkhan po skye ba gnyis su mdzad/ dge bshes sa nag pa dang /yu kha bar pa dang / gzhan zhig dang gsum la skyabs 'gro dang 'jug pa /sems bskyed bshad/ gcig gis bslab bya ma bsrungs pas da lta de nyid du skyes yod/ gcig mkhas pa chen po paṇ+ḍi ta gcig yin pas byang chub sems pa'i sdom pa nyi shu pa bshad/ dge bshes bla ma 'od ni mdo smad du che tshang du skyes/ rgya nag gi 'gram yin te de na kho bo'i skye ba snga ma'i slob dpon zhig yod/ grub thob zer nyan pa gcig yod gsungs/ yang bla ma rin po ches nyid kyi ma 'ongs pa'i rnam par thar pa yang mang du gsungs ste/ rgya gar gyi nub phyogs skyon nas nyin lam bcu gnyis kyi byang shar na bti ma'i grong khyer zhes bya ba na/ yab rdarma si di dang / yum ma hā pra ta'i sras pra dzña shī la zhes pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig tu skye/ bla ma lha rje yang grong khyer pad+ma can na mngal skyes pa'i mtshan zhi ba'i go cha zhes par skye/ de'i mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta zhig gi shes bya'i bdag po byas/ bla ma lha rjes shes bya'i bdag po byas nas rtsod pas bla ma rgyal ba byung nas myu stegs pa de nang pa sangs rgyas par bcud nas ming da rma ra dza bya bar btags/ mu stegs kyi rgyal po de'i ming ma hā dzi na yin/ grong khyer ma rti ka na paṇ+ḍi ta bu dhi ba dza zhes pa nang na yon tan bzang po yod pa cig 'ongs/ bla ma lha rje dang / dge slong sgom pa dang / zhi mdzes dang / gar ston dang / ser kong ye shes snying po dang / zom shi ye shes snying po dang / ya zi sngon mo dang / rgya che chung gnyis dang / grags mdzes dang / nyag sde ston pa dang / rog sgom dang / yon tan snying po ste rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa nus pa drug yod pas/ mu stegs kyi rgyal po de rtog med kyi sgo nas btul ba dang /yul cho ma'i rgyal po paṇ+ḍi tas btul ba gong du gsal ba gnyis dus gcig yin/ bla ma lha rje 51

༄༅ / /kurma pa sku phreng dang ngo/ dus gsum ji pa'i mdzad rnam zhib bkod bzhugs so//———————— ——dang / nang nga/'i paṇ+ḍi ta dang // mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang gsum ka rgyal po chen ngo/ de'i mchod gnas yin/ grong khyer pa/spo can dang /྅ kārti ka gnyis kyi bar na grong brdal zhig yod/ yul phyogs de tham/sa cad mu stegs pa yin pa la/ ma lus pa nang pa sangs rgyas pa byed par 'gyur/ grong khyer de gnyis kyi mtshams na nyin lam gnyis tsam yod/ skabs der nga dang bla ma lha rje yang mjal/ yon bdag dgon pa/ ba de yang der blon po zhig gi bur skyes nas rab byung byed/ khyed 'ga' yang grong khyer kuṇ+ḍa par skye ste/ yon tan 'od dang / dbe 'dun 'od dang / smon lam bla ma dang / ye tsho shes 'od dang / ston pa tshul seng dang / dge 'dun grags/ ma khyed bdun lhan cig tu rje'u rigs su skye/ grong khyer de gsum yang phyogs //tsho ka sto /ba /so/ diX/ da/rdo wa dī ༵ rdol byu phyo /rdo de dī kya she dīX/ /dī che/ /rdzu sngong // /nga /rdo // zlo/ ༵ sdoX da /da ba /she/ ༵ /sa bya /na chu sdong grags ci dbang phyug grags dang / mu dmo zer bla 4 dang / yon tan bla ma dang / das ma seng ge dang / rdo rje btsun 'grus ci dang / byang pa lha bzo dang bcas pa khyed mang po bla ma lha rje dang mjal rgyu yin pa la ma mjal te/ skye ba phyi ma mjal nas 'ong gsungs/ —de'i rjes su bod yul dbus lho —bag // hūṃ ༵ // ༵ /du/ /sna dro ༵༵ //'a ma 'a /ga ma // ga rdo snro / dhi ༵ dī ༷/ /ra de sdi skyes /phyogaXd de 'a sna ༵ bye dī rdo ༷ dī spya ༵ ༷ ༵ /sdo zlo/ /bad/ khu ’ rgya dgon pa ba rgyal por skyes nas lam rnal ma la der tshud/ khyed rnams dang yang der nga dang mjal nas da gzod nga mi dgos pa mang po yang 'byung /'gro ba gzhan mang po la phan par yang 'dug gsungs/ yang slob dpon dkon mchog seng ge la sogs pas/ bla ma rin po che mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pa'i dus 'khor gyi dang po gang dang gang lags zhus pas/ rgya gar lho phyogs lo ka bi ha ra'i gtsug lag khang na rnal 'byor pa mi tra jo ki zhes bya ba gcig yod pa de dang / yang mnga' ris stod na sems can gyi don mang ngo mdzad pa'i dge slong dge ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba zhis yod 52

༄༅/ /ma rma pa sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mdzad rnam zhib bkod bzhugs so/ /'a sha pa de dang / yang sri nyag chos kyi rgyal po'i bla ma rgya be bum ring po zhes kyang zer/ rgya byang chub sems pa zhes bya ba de dang / dbe bshes dkon mchog seng ge khyod dang bzhi yin gsungs/ skabs 'dir sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan mi gsung yang / bla ma zhang rin po ches 'phrang po'i sbrag 'phrang po bragagi gter las shog dril ser po zhig byung bar/ bla ma dus gsum mkhyen pa ni/ /mtshan ni rdarma shīrti yin/ /byams pa'i bstan pa'i rjes bogs su/ /sangs rgyas seng ge zhes bya bar/ /bstan pa rab tu rgyas par 'gyur/ /rdarma ṅgā rte nyid yin no/ /'di nas tshe 'phos phyi ma la//kārti ka yi rgyal khams su/ /khri phrag drug dang stong tsho drug /the tshom med par shes par gyis/ zhes lung bstan no/ /yang mtshur phur bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rnal lam du rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i zhol/ shing sna tshogs kyi tshal gtsug las khang mang po yod pa'i sar byon pas/ bla ma dngul chu be+e ro'i sprul pa gsum dang 'jal/ bar do dang rmi lam gyi man ngag shin tu zab pa gnang / gdams ngag gi dri thug mdzad cing bka' stsal bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon no/ /yang mtshur phur dbang bskur zhig mdzad pa'i tshe/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma gtso 'khor lnga'i zhal gzigs/ yang gnas der dpal 'khor lo bde phyogs lha tshogs drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor zhal gzigs / yang mtshur phur rje btsun pa'i mchod pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ de nyid du zhes gzigs/ yang mtshur phur bzhugs dus/ shar phyogs 'jig rten gyi khams shig tu byon pas/ sa gzhi thams cad me tog dkar pos khengs pa 'ja' tshon gyi gur phub pa'i dbus na bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po bzhugs pa dang 'jal/ sman gyi ril bu gnang ste 'di kun gzhan la byin na phan par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa gzigs/ yang mtshur phur dpal bde myo/chog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa 'al gzigs/ yang mtshur phur sngags mchod cig mdzad pa'i dus/ su bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba ('dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal gzigs/ yang mtshur phur rje btsun pa'i mchod pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ de nyid du zhal gzigs/ yang mtshur phur dpa la gshin rje'i gshed thod pa bzhi dang ldan pa zhal gzigs te de'i thugs dam gyi thang sku yang bris/ yang mtshur phur nub gcig bi rnal la ma du/ lho nub kyi mtshams na 'ur sgra chen po zhig grag 5 3

ci༄༅ / /kurma nga sku phreng dang ngo dus gsum mkhyen nga 'i mdzad rnam zhib bkod bzhugs so//ste gzigs pas/ 'od phung gi nang du bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa rus pa'i rgyan can/ phyag na ḍa ma/ ru thogs pa zhig na re/ kho bo mi tra pa yin gsudas/ de'i zhal nas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gnyis su 'dug/ de nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dang / lhan skyes kyi yid gnyi sa yin/ nyon mongs pa can yang lhan cig skyes pa'i yed du 'dus so/ zhis gsungs nas 'ja' yal ba bzhin du song ngo / /yang zla ba de'i nyi shu bdun gyi nub mo'i rnal lam du/ sgam por byon te 'ja' tshon gyi snam bu zhig 'dus pa rje bcun nyid kyis phyag gis brtog gin byon pas/2dge 'phrang du bla ma lha rje rin cho che dang mjal/ rang ri dag snang thar tshul rnams zhus pas/ bu chos thams cad rmi lam dang 'ja' tshon lta bur shes par gyis shig gsungs nas 'ja' bzhin du yal lo/ /yang sbrul zla'i hor zla gnyis nga nyi shu gsum gyi nub mo rnal lam na 'od phung zhig bi nang du rnal 'byor pa phyag g.yas pas mda' 'dzin pa/ bya byed thams cad g.yon gyis byed pa zhig gi zhal nas/ nga ni su yin ma shes na/ nga ne sa ra ha par grags/ zhes gsungs/ gdams ngag zhus pas/ mtha' dang bral ba lta ba yin/ /yongs ba med pa sgom pa yin/ /nga gag sgrub med na spyod pa yin/ /spang thob med na 'bras bu yin/ gsungs te 'ja' bzhin du yal lo/ /yang re zhig bla ma stag del bas zhus pa/ rje btsun rin po che khyed sprul pa mang pos dus gcig tu 'gro don mdzad par gda' ba/ da lta 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir ci tsam yod zhus pas/ spyir nges pa med mod kyi/ 'on kyang shin tu gsal ba bzhi tsam yod pa 'dra gsu ngas/ de rnams gang lags zhus tsa/ mnga' ris kyi pha rol// kha che'i 'a/ dwags kha che yin pa 'dra tshur rol spu rangs zhes bya ba na/ dge slong dbe ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba gtsug lag khang mang po bzhengs shing / sngar gyi slob ma btsun chung gcig shi ba de dang sems can mang po'i don mdzad pa cig yod gsungs/ yang bal bod kyi mtshams na lan dhe zhes bya bar bla ma be+e ro'i dngul chu bai ro dgon pa yod de/ de na dge bsnyen chos kyi grags nga/ chos brda'i tshul du gsung ba zhig yod/ yang rgya gar lho phyogs na rten rnal 'byor par grags pa zhig yod de/ snang ba dag pa rnams kyis thugs rje chen po kho nar mthong / sa 'dir bzhugs 'dir byon gyi nges pa med pa zhig bzhugs/541

༄༅ / /ma rma pa sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mdzad rnam zhib bkod bzhugs so//yang shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten khams shig tu grub thob rgyal po'i cha byad can mtshan grags pa mtha' yas zhes bya ba rgyal khams de rgyal po min pas mi thul bas/ rgyal po'i cha lugs su mdzad de 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad/ gzhan yang du ma yod pa 'dra gsungs/ de ltar rang dang gzhan gyi dus gsum gyi gnas dpag par dka' ba dpag tu med pa mkhyen cing —/ thar thor tsam gdul bya skal ldan dag la'ang gsung bar mdzad pas/ rje btsun bla ma'i mtshan du yang dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa zhes nyi zla ltar grags shing rtsod pa med par gyur ba yin la/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan nag kyang / dpal rdo rje gdan pas sngon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis rdo rje gdan gyi tshogs dung du bud par mdzad pa'i rdo rje gdan gyi tshogs dung de bskur te/ da lta sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dngos gzhi bod yul du yod cing / bstan pa'i bdag po shrī rdarma khri ti yin pa/sa khong la phul zhig ces gdams nas 'bul du btang ba rje dus mkhyen gyi phyag tu phul/ phyis mtshur phu'i ga rjo la'i mchod bshoms la bzhugs pa 'gro ba mang pos mngon sum du mjal rgyu yod do/ /rje btsun 'di'i khyad par 'phags pa'i gdams ngag ni/ phag mo zhal bzhi ma dang rdo rje phag mo dngos su zhal gzigs nas sgrub thabs kha tshar dang bcas pa thengs gsum gnang bas shin tu bka' gnyen pa yin rnam bzhi rgyud grol byin rlabs nus 'don gyi gdams ngag shin tu zab mo in+d+ra bu rdis dngos su gnang ba 'o/ /rmi lam 'brel gsum ldan/ lha 'dre stong gi sgrib shing sogs sngo na ma/ grags pa'i zab gnas mtha' yas pa das snang la gsan zhing mnga' ba dang sgrub thabs phyag len dang bcas pa nyid kyis mdzad pa yang yod/ gzhan yang ma/tshur phur bzhugs ring du yang sde mchos dgyes rdor/phyag rdor/ rta mgrin gsang 'dus ma hā mā ya/ bdag med ma/ thugs rje chen po/ sgro la ma/ mi g.yo ba/ rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa rgyud sde bzhi'i yi dam gyi lha zhal dang / ston pa shākya thub pa dang gu ru pad+ma sam bha/ dang la sa ra ha/ mi tri pa/ rje mi la sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal yang yang dngos su gzigs pa ni brjod kyis mi langs/ dge 'dun gyi skyong bran dang bstan nga 'i bdag rkyen gdul bya sems can rnams gang la gang 'dul gyi 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas smin cing grol bar mdzad pa sogs sems can dpag tu med pa thar lam du bkod/ de ltar skye ba de nyid 55

༄༅/ /mcho/ pa sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mdzad rnam zhib bkod bzhugs so//kyi don gnyis mthar phyin gdul bya 'gro don gyi mtha' rdzogs par gzigs te/ mya ngan 'da' ba'i snga rol zla ba gsum tsam nas nam mkha' la 'ja' dang / sar rab tu g.yo ba/ 'ur thug gi sgra la sogs pa ltas chen po rgyun ma chad par byung ste/ sngon khams su 'byon khar bde gshegs phag mo gru par dbang bskur dang rab gnas byas kyang ma byas kyang brgyad cu rtsa bzhi rje btsun mi la'i sku tshe tsam zhig 'tsho zhes gsungs pa dang de rjes sku bsnyun pa la nye gnas bu slob rnams kyis brtan bzhugs dang rim gro sgrub par sa nang ba zhu skabs kyang song ltar brgyad cu rtsa bzhi zhal gyis bzhes te da len mi 'chi gsungs pa ltar rje btsun dam pa dgung bgrang brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ rab byung gsum pa'i chu mo glang rabs lo 5188/ phug lugs 2074/ phyi lo 1193/lo'i stag zla tshes gcig gi nyin par/ dge bshes gsang ba dpon g.yog dang / dpon 'dul ba dang / dpon grags dang / grags rin dang / dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang / na bun pa la sogs pa grwa bgres 'ga' zhig la zhal ta byon par/ kho bo la bdag tu bzung ba lus gang 'di dang / zhib 'thag pa'i rang 'thag 'di las med/ gzhan yo byad thams cad dbe 'dun byings la dbang ba yin te/ gser sung brgya dang lha shu rtsa gnyis/ dngul dang / g.yu dang / dar zab/ mdzo rta la sogs pa mang du yod pa 'di rnams khyed mi lngas bdag po gyis la/ sgrubs grwa rnams la khyed kho bo 'das pa'i shul 'dir lo gcig gnyis sdod gsungs/ dpon grags pa seng shes sdod pa rang 'ong ngam zhus pas/mkhas pa 'i dga' ston du sgang lo tsā ba nam ring du yod pa de yin par gsungs sku yar bzhengs spyan hur mdzad nas ma tha yang dbyar dgun gnyis tsam sdod pa'ang min nam gsungs/ yang gzhon nu khyod lo gcig gnyis 'dir sdod la kho bo'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams las yi ge gcig kyang ma mthor ba gyis/ngas kyang chos skyong srung ma la bka' bsgo zhing gnyer du gtad yod pa yin gsungs/ tshe gcis nas gnyis su 'gro ba'i nub mo sa g.yos gcig rjes su gcig breng ma chad pa dang / yang dgon gyi steng du 'ja' tshon gyi gdugs 'khrigs pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs mang pos ḍa ma ru'i sgra sgrogs pa la sogs pa'i ltas dpag tu med pa byung / de nas tshes gsum gyi nyin par grwa pa thams cad la zhal bstan pa dang / gdams pa bstan pa 56

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mdzad rnam zhib bkod bzhugs so// ——wa wa so/rdo ༵༷ga ngo ma ༷༷ /sdu/ ///sa nge/ ༵ dgo// ༵ rdzogarnga ga /ra byed gsu ༷༷ ༷na snang bdun byen ga /zlog bya da //ga pa grib // ༵ ༷dī ga spya/ ༵ ༵ /dri sdi snyiX/ de 'khor dang bcas pa la nged kyi phan 'dog pa 'ongs gsungs pa sogs slar sprul pa'i sku 'byon par yang don gyis lung bstan te/ sku drangs por bsrang nas nam mkha' la lta stangs yun ring du mdzad/ nyi ma phyi dro zad pa'i dus la bab pa'i tshe rtag 'dzin can ri gdul bya rnams yang dag pa'i lam la bskul ba'i phyir sprul pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor yongs su bsdus te/ zhing khams gzhan du bde bar gshegs so/ /lo 'dir 4rka kai skyo ston rgyal gyi gdan sar phebs pa dang / dge bshes glang lung pa dang / bla ma zhang sku gshegs pa bcas dus mtshungs pa yin no/ /de nas tshes bcu la gdung bzhu ba'i tshe/ der 'tshogs pa rnams kyi snang ba la nyi ma sngar bas nyis 'gyur gyis ring ba dang / la la nyi ma bdun dang brgyad dang bcu gsum sogs nyi ma'i tshogs 'dus shing gyes par mthong ba dang / nyi ma'i 'od zer rma bya'i gdugs 'dra ba dang / dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rus pa'i rgyan can gyis nam mkha'i khams gang ba dang / dgun zla bcu gcig pa la me tog gi char rgyun mi chad pa dang / pur khang gi gdugs kyi steng na rin po che dang / 'ja' tshon gyi gdugs brtsegs mang po 'dug pa dang / 'os gzung med pa'i sgra snyan sna tshogs grags pa/ du ba 'ja' tshon du gyur ba'i nang du bla ma rin po che sku dngos su bzhugs pa mthong ba dang / ri dwags rnams 'dus nas gdung khang la bskor ba byed pa dang / nam mkha' na bya tshogs rigs mi 'dra ba gdung khang gi klad du 'dus nas skor ba byed pa dang skad snyan pos ca co 'byin pa/ sngar dge sbyor med pa rnams la dge sbyor skyes pa dang / dge sbyor ldan pa rnam sa bogs thon pa/ ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyud la skye ba la sogs ngo mtshar brjod kyis mi langs pa byung ngo / /de nas pur khang zhal dbye ba'i tshe sems can rnams la shin tu brtse ba'i phyir thugs dang / zab mo'i chos ston pa'i ljags dang /bya rnga chub kyi sems rab tu brtan pas ring bsrel kha dog sna lnge dkar po shas che ba dang / bskyed pa'i rim pa brtan pas sa bon phyag mtshan lha sku 57

༄༅ / /ma rma pa sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mdzad rnam zhib bkod bzhugs so//ci la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas/ gdul bya thams cad yang dag pa'i lam la nges pa'i shes pa brtan pa solas mtha' ma'i mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab par bstan to/ /de nas dge 'dun la la zhig gis rje btsun bla ma bka' drin gsum ldan de nyid ni zhing khams gzhan du gshegs shor/ mtshur phu na dgon pa 'dzin pa ni dka' zhing / ra yul gyi snying po yin pas der dbon pa spo bar kha 'chams/ gdung rten dang sku 'bum yang der bzhengs par byas/ mchod khang gi rmang yang der bting ngo / /de'i tshe slob dpon shes rin gyi gsung gis/ mtshur phu'i dgon pa 'di chos kyi rje rin po che ke po gnas nang nas 'dir thugs gtad de byon/ dgon pa'ang btab/ tshogs pa dpag tu med pa'ang 'dus/ thugs dgongs kyang mtha' phyin/ zhal chems su yang phog sku yang 'dir 'das/ gdung yang 'dir bzhugs/ thugs dam gyi lha mang po'i zhal yang 'dir gzigs /ga~X ༵༵ hūṃ sdu/sdu ༵༵ sbya sna sdo bye rdo/ / // /zlo ༵ /༷ paX dīX hā/ ༵ nga sa ༵ sdu ༵ zlo // zlo ༷༷ / ༵ // // sa rdzu dī ༵ rdo/sa ༵༵ sa sbyi ri na cho po che'i sku tshad ji lta ba'i 'dra sku rin po che bzhengs pa bzhugs/ sangs rgyas ring bsrel/ rje nyid kyi sku gdung ring bsrel dang nyer dpyad/ dpal sa ra ha'i dug sbrul gyi sgom thag rje dwags po rin ngo/ che'i thugs dang / snam sbyar/ gsol lhung so/gas bka' rgyud gong ma rnams kyi gdung ring bsrel/ dbu skra/ phyag sen/ na bza' la sogs pa du ma bzhugs shing / phyi rabs pa rnams kyi mos pa'i rten du rje nyid kyi gzims mal rang na bzhugs so/ /gzims mal ni lho rong chos 'byung las rjes dus mkhyen dgung lo don lnga nas/ gya bzhi bar dgon phug rang na bzhugs zhes gsal ba ltar ri mchod khang gong gi shar lho'i 'og shod du dus mkhyen lha khang du grags pa de la dbon phug ces gzims khang ngo ma de yin par sna nga la 'dra sku rin po che yang der bzhugs pa yin no//sngar mig lam du gyur pa'i mtshur pu'i rten gsum dkar chag ltar na/ 'dra sku rin po che 'di ni rje nyid kyi thugs sras sgang lo tsā ba'i phyas bzo yin par bshad la/ sku tshad zhal khyim sogs shin tu byon legs pa gsung 'byon la khad/ sku dngos bzhugs pa dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i ye shes sems pa dngos su bzhugs shing / sku drod rta rnga tsam rgyun chad med pa/ gang zag mjal ba ngo so sor dge mi dge'i rtags spyan gnyis bar snang dang / sa/ bzhi la sa zigs stangs dang / zhal gyi rnam 'gyur ci rigs su ston par 58

༄༅ / /na rma pa sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mdzad rnam zhib bkod bzhugs so//tsā mdzad/ yul lung spyi'i dam yams kyi nad dang / lhag par mdze nad dang / 'brum nad sogs nyid kyis dngos su ba 'as te 'al khyim la shu 'thor la sogs pa 'khrungs pa dang yal ba ni dngos su mjal rgyu yod cing / sngar skal ldan gyi sku gnyer zhig la chos drug gi gdams ngag dngos su gsu ngas ba sogs sngon rjes su gsung len gsum byon pa'i lo rgyus yod pa bcas byin rlabs shin tu che ba yin no/de nas bu chen rnams kyis sku 'bum zhig bzhengs par dgongs nas// rgya bar dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten bkod pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi lha bzo ba zhig la paṇ+ḍi ta nyi ma'i snying pos bzhengs bcug pa'i thang ka chen ngo zhig paṇ+ḍi ta nyid kyis bod du bsnams phebs te/ slob ma ston pa gnyis la gnang ba da lta dge bshes glan gyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug las khang na bzhugs zer ba thob pas dge bshes glan 'di rab byung gsum pa'i sa mo bya lo la 'phan yul rgyal gyi gdan sar phebs te lo gsum bzhugs nas gshegs/ de rjes lo sa sum pa'i thog la yin pas/ rgyal gyi gtsug lag khang de yin na snyams/ dge bshes rnam 'bar ba'i dbon ston lha sar byon pa la 'grogs nas thang ka de las dpe blangs/ rnam 'bar ba'i slob ma rgya gar du len go nyis phyin pa'i bal po lo tsā ba la mchod rten gyi dkar zhal dang / cha tshad bslabs te sngar rin po che nyid kyi gsung bis yang/dgon gyi yang dgon zhes pa ni/mchod khang gong ma tshang gsham du rgya bskyed kyis bzhengs par mdzad pa la yang dgon/ phyag btab pa'i rjes su 'dus tshogs rgya che bas yang cig 'du khang sogs dgon zhes pa da lta'i sgar pa bla brang lte bar gyur ba 'di la zer ba snang/ ba'i rgyab 'dir dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten gcig bzhengs la bskor ba bya'o gsung ba'i zhal lung yod pas/ sha dung bzhu ba'i sa de nyid du mchod rten gyi rmang btsugs pa'i cho sa mdzad pa na/ kha ba chen po bab pa'i rjes la nam mkha' yongs su dag pa las 'ja' tshon gdugs dang dkyil 'khor 'dra ba mang po byung / de'i phyi nyin nas bzung ste mchod rten ma tshar gyi bar du 'ja' tshon dang che tog gi char rgyun ma chad par byung / yun ring ma thogs par legs par grub te bzo bsod rmi sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis rgya gar lho phyogs d+ma na ka ḍa ga'i 'bras srungs kyi mchod rten du rigs ldan zla ba bzang po la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud gsungs pa'i gnas de'i bskad pa can/ gdung 'bum bkris 'od 'bar du grags pa sku tshad thos brtsegs ma/ —de'i nang bzhugs su de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel dang / de bzhin gshegs pa glang po'i gdung nyer gcig dang / byang chub shing gi lo 'bras/gnas chen brgya di kyi sa sna/ li yul las byon pa'i dpal kha sar pa ṇi'i sku gcig 'di sngon li yu la du sangs rgyas 'od srung gis bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad skabs 59

—༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mdzad rnam zhib bkod bzhugs so//sangs rgyas nyid kyi rab gnas 'phogs pa'i gras/gis sna drangs pa'i sku rten khyad par can bcu gcig gser gyi tsogs bam gsum la sogs pa gsung gi rten gang po dang / chos rje rin po che nyid kyi dbu lo dang / sku gdung / ring bsrel/ phyag zhabs kyi se mo/ na bza'/ nyer dpyad/ bzhugs gdan/ zhabs rjes/ bka' rgyud gong ma rnams kyi sku gdung la sogs pa 'jig rten na dkon pa'i ngo mtshar gyi rten dpag tu med pa bzhugs shing / chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa bcu gsum/ gdugs/ char khebs/ tog dang bcas pas mdzes pa'i logs la/ rin po che nyid kyi sku 'od kyi rnam par rang byung du byon yas thams cad ngo mtshur du gyur te/ de'i rjes su rin po che'i thugs ljags logs su bzhugs pa'i gdung khang sgom chen ras pa bzhis mdzade 'di zla ba chu shel du sgom chen ras pas gzhi mdzad ces gsal yang / rten gsum dkar chag dang / mkhas pa'i dga' ston/ deb sngon bcas su sgom chen ras pa bzhis mdzod ces phyogs mthun pas de ltar yin par snang la/ phyis dgon phug gi 'dra sku rin po che'i g.yas su bzhugs pa de yin/de rjes rin po che'i dngos slob dge bshes gtsang po pas dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten de la gser gyi na bza' bzang po cha rkyen dang bcas pa mi nyag bi yul nas brdzangs te byung ba la thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir/ nang gzhal yas khang dang / phyi mchod rten du yod pa'i 'bum khang rgyar 'doms brgyad la chu zheng gab pa/ sgo bzhi las —mkhan dang bcas pa/ bang rim rgyal po'i khang pa dang bcas par gser gyi na bza' legs par bsgrubs pa dang /dkar chag 'thor bu zhig sngar mthong ba la gser srang gsum khri lhag pa song lugs bkod 'jug pa dang lho rong chos 'byung las gtsang pa bkra shis spi mi nyag 'ga'i rgyal po'i dbu'i bla mchod mdzad/ mtshan gtsang paṇa ti ༷ du grags ces gsal ba la stod thang chung pa dge bshes gtsang po pa 'di yin par nges/ sngon ma nas rje nyid kyis mi nyal na rgyal khams su ri bo ha la shan du bsgom dang de la ḍi ki ma gser gyi mcheb can zhes bya ba zhig yod pa des khyod kyi 'phrin las thams cad bsgrub par 'gyur/ zhes dge bshes gtsang sor ma 'ongs lung bstan gnang ba'i phyir/de nas bal po'i yul nas spyan drangs pa'i gser gyi gan ji ra klad du btsugs pas dgon gnas 'od dang ldan par byas te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnas kyi bar du 'gro ba thams cad kyi phyag dang mchod pa'i gnas bsod nams kyi zhing dam par gyur ba/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don ji ltar bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bur gyur pa yin no/ gzhan yang nye gnas 'od bzhis so sor bzhengs par mdzad — ()()

༄ / /kurma pa sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mdzad rnam zhib bkod bzhugs so//— — pa'i thub dbang gi sku bzhi la sogs4 pa gsung las ci skyes pa thams cad kyis chos rje rin po che'i thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs ldes rdzogs pa'i phyir rten ske gsum byin rlabs can mang du bzhengs par mdzad do/ /rje de la bu chen byon tshul ni/ ldom bu'i rnal 'byor sangs rgyas dar pos mdzad pa'i bka' /waX // // ༵ // // ma//gaX ༵ // // /sbya pa/ ༷ /rje/rdo rnyi ༷༷ ༷dzi sa ༵༵ /rdo ༵ nga /ba/ se~X dī yi /sa pa — / bye gro /go ༵ // ༵ ༵/ra grugs so/ /khra shod spom brag tu dgon pa ༷zung / 'gro mgon chos brtson/ lde chung sangs rgyas/ 'ba' tsha stag del/ nam mkha' 'od/ tshul khrims 'od/ yon tan 'od/ ltar sgom kha 'byung ba lnga la rang dbang thob pa dge bshes shākya/ la rmeng dge lju sras bca sa spang rtogs yon tan kyi ci dbyed ma marnyis pa rang dang 'dra ba'i bu chen bcu gsum/ zhes pa dang / rnam thar gser gling ma sogs la gsal bar mi snang yang / rje dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas rnam thu ra khungs ma gzhan dag mang go gzigs ngor chub pa la 'di ltar snang ste/ mngon shes kyi bka' babs lde chung sangs rgyas rin chen rngu sa dmar pa ba yon po'i dgon pa btab/ 4yi 'phrul gyi bka' babs 'ba' tsha stag del stag dang mtshi'u sogs la brdzus nus pa/ sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod la gshegs rnam thar gyi bka' babs grwa pa bka' gdams ru yon po do' dbon pa bzung /rtogs pa'i bka' babs dbra da se chos brtson dbu re khe chu rgyud pa/mgro mgon chos brtson 'gro don gyi bka' babs 'gro mgon ras chen yar lung nya mo gzhung khu rje snying por 'khrungs/ gdung gru gu dwags po sgom chung shes rab byang chub kyi sku skyer grags la sngon ma sngags 'chang / rjes su bka' gdams kyi mkhan po khrom pa las dgung lo sum cu rtsa bdun la chis rdzogs mdzad/ mtshan bsod nams grags su bcags/ lo rgyus yis cha la lar sangs rgyas grags zhu/ mdo khams su mgon po'i sgrub sde ste sngags grwa bco brgyad btsugs pa dang / dmar khams su da rgan pa phyag btab/te bka' babs spyo/ bu lnga'i gras yin/ rgya pa gangs pa gangs dkar rin chen 'od sdor te yul shang pa/ rus khyung po/ phur pa lha nag gi grub thob rgyud pa/ yangs can dang 'od yug bar gya bar 'brong bu'i dgon pa btab/ rang byung sangs —rgyas stod lung grams pa ba ldo la yas/ pa'i rjes su mtshur phu'i gdan sa lo drug 'dzin skyong gnang /gtsang po 61

༄༅ / /ma rma pa sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mdzad rnam zhib bkod bzhugs so//dkon mchog seng ge la stod thang chung pa/ rje'i lung bzhin mi nyag tu byon/ mi nyas rgyal po'i dbu bla mdzad/ rje zhing du gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su mtshur phur gser 'bum chen mo la sogs pa'i khyad 'phags bcu gsum gyi mchod rdzas phul / 'gro mgon ras chen sangs rgyas grags bsnam pas rgyud 'dzin gyi bu chen bzhi'i gras yin/ nam mkha' 'od rgyal ba zhwa dmar gyi skye phreng ba'i pa gra 'jad pa sangs rgyas ras pa yang zhu/ mtshur phu'i phug mo'i che'i nang la'ang bzhugs/ri slob ma bdun cu tsam 'dus/ nam mkhar bya ltar 'phur nus pa yod/ 6 sgom ye shes 'ad 'di zhing du gshegs rjes bka' rgyud gser phreng na bzhugs/ yon tan 'od/ dge 'dun 'od ste nye gnas 'od bzhi/ deb sngon las mtha' ma tshul khrims 'od/ nam mkha' 'od/ sme'u —byang chub 'od/ rgya sgom ye shes 'od ste 'od bzhi dang /zhang rin po che g.yu grags pa'ang bu chen du bgrangs so/ye shes bla ma/ smon lam bla ma/ ca 'byung gnas bla ma/ rgyal mtshan bla ma steg bla ma bzhi/ dge slong brtson 'grub shes rab/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mdog mkhas pa/ rmeng dge jo sras te snga tshar bu bzhi/ gtsang ston tshul seng / tre bo dkon mchog dpas/ rdo rje shes rab/ sgang cho tsā ba mtshur gyi sgang bu dgon par byung ba/ sna mkhar sgang rgyud dbon shul da lta mi khyim chags pa de min nam/ rje 'di'i rnam thur gser gling ma le'u bco brgyad brtsams pa po/ ma dus mkhyen gyi 'dra sku mthong grol rin po che yang 'di'i phyag bzor grags pa ste phyi tshar bu bzhi la sogs te/ yo ngas grags kyi bu chen rang nyid kho nas smin grol du mdzad pa rnams dang / lho la yag pa byang chub dngos grub dang / dwags po 'dul 'dzin pa 'di gnyis dwags po rin po che'i dngos slob chos rje dus mkhyen gyi mched zla ste rjes su rje 'dir dad pa dbang med du thob nas zhabs la gtug pa yin la/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa byang chub dngos grub 'di ni/ dbon ston skyer — —sgang pa'i rnam thar du/ bla ma lho pa mdo dgon na dbang bci ra byed cing yod zer ba la kho bos rmi lam bzung nas ltar phyin pas bla ma bde mchog dngos su byas nas dbang bskur zhing 'dug ste bdag gis kyang thob/ da lta bod na bde mchog dngos su byas nas dbang bskur nus pa bla ma lho pa las mi 'dug go zhes bris snang ba de yin/ rje dus mkhyen zhing du gshegs shul mtshur phu'i gdan sa pa gnyis pa mdzad na se tshogs pa lo lnga drug tsam bskyangs 'bri gung gi 'jig rten gsum ma bon skyob pa rin chen dpal yang zhu stag lung gi thang pa rin po che bkra shis dpal rna phu'i gling chen ras pa pad+ma rdo rje ste rgya gar gyi chu bo gaṅgā tshun la rtogs pa mtho bar gras sa ra lung gi gtsang pa rgya ras ye shes rdo rje ste dang po ras pa dang rje dus mkhyen gyis gling ras par rna phu'i gdan sa btsun pas 'dzin zhes lung bsta na pa ltar rgya ras 'di phyis zhang rin po che las rab tu byung bas 62

༄༅ / /kurma pa sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mdzad rnam zhib bkod bzhugs so// ci sgo mtshan ye shes rdo rjer btags/ slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dus nas 'khor 'gyed lan gsum mdzad pas bya rgod po'i nyin lam bco brgyad tshun chad la dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan pas khyab/ dbon rgyud las rgya ras seng ge dgu tshar byung / rje dus mkhyen gyis lung bstan pa ltar ra lung du ci dgon pa bta ba man lung pa dran ston mtha' bral ste rdzu 'phrul gyis rje dus mkhyen mtshur sa ra mjal/ bla ma'i bka' ltar mtshur pu'i 'chogs par byin 3gyis rlobs pa'i zhal bzhes ri gong gi sangs rgyas mnyan ston/ rgya bo ba lung pa yon tan bzang po ste khong rang gi sku skye sngon ma'i ngos 'dzin kunang sogs dam pa'i chos kyis 'brel ba'i skyes chen no/ /zhes snang zhes rje dpa' bos gsungs shing / yang ra ru chos 'byung las ni/ rgya sgom ye shes 'od/ 2 nye gnas smonaX lam 'od mtha' mi tshul khrims 'od/ a bang shes rab 'od ste 'od bzhi/ yang yon tan 'od/ dbe 'dun 'od/ zhi ba 'od/ gling bu byang chub 'od ste 'od chung bzhi la sogs pa 'dren tshul mi mtshungs pa'i thog nas 'ga' zhig lhag por byung ba dang / (lha rje me mchod pa le smad du 'phar ra dgon pa btab/rong po khams gsum grags sog rong du byung / sngags pa'i tshul bzung ba zhig sngags mchog bal po gla li na rdza bkral rin chen sgang btab/ rma bya ras pa gtsang gi tshong 'dus mgur mo'i dgon pa dang nyang shab phyogs su bzhugs/dge bshes na bun pa na bun rdzong pa ste 'tshams gshes su dbon pa btab/ khams pa dbang rdor pha khang du dgon pa mdzad/ stag sgom ras pa/ dbon ston dar ma/ rdo rje brtson 'grus/ dar ma seng ge dbang phyug grags pa/ rin chen grags pa/ ston pa byang chub grags/ dge 'dun grags te grags pa bzhi/ shākya shes rab/ rdo rje 'bum/ dol pa stag del ba/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i bdag po dam pa bde gshegs taḥ thog pa chen po rje dus mkhyen las bde mchog gi dbang bskur sogs zab chos mang du gsan pa'i slo ba ma' mchog yin par snang /la sogs pa dang / si tu dge ba'i blo gros kyi deb dmar du bgrangs pa la slob ma byings rnams mtshungs par gsal yang / 'dzam gling skye ba gsum pa/ bla ma bsam yas pa/ dza ne sgom bzang / bla ma lha/ la stod khang gsar ba/ cham bu na ring / dbe bshes tshul khyims rgyal po/ dge bshes lha rje gsum pa rnams lhag por byung zhing / de rnams rje 'do'i zhabs la gtug ste gdams pa thob pa dang / so so nas bla ma de nyid rgyud sde ci rig pa'i yi dam la sogs par 63

༄༅ snye /rkarma pa sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ci rnam zhib bkod bzhugs so/ /mthong tshul byung ba'i skal ldan rnam thar du byung ba khag gcig kyang bsod pa mdzad 'dus pa bcas deb ther dang / chos 'byung / rnam thar/ gsung sgros zin bris su btab pa khag sogs kyi 'dren tshul mi 'dra ba las gsung las skyes pa'i zhal slob lha ga por thon pa'ang mang du mchis shing /lho rong chos 'byung las slob ma'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ni/ man lung pa dang / rgya bo na lung pa'o/ /zhes kyang byung zhing da dung gsung sgros dang / dam pa gzhan gyi rnam thar cha tshang ba dang 'thor bu mang dag las rje 'dis bka' drin gsum gyis rjes su pa'i zhal slob mcho po zhig gsal ba rnams la so so'i rnam thar sogs yig cha khungs ldan ma brnyes stabs 'ding ma smras so/ /de ltar rje 'di'i gsung las skyes pa'i bu slob phal mo che ni mdo sngags kyi lung las gsal ba'i skyes bu dam pa shes rab kyi rtsal gsum rdzogs pas mdo sngags kyi chos tshul mtha' dag la mkhas shing rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la grub pa thob pa'i 'gro ba'i 'dren pa ste gling phran ci rig pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams du ma dang / zhing khams rab 'byams su rje nyid dang yang yang 'brel ba yod pa'i gang zag las can sha stag yin pa dang / de yang lung gis zin kyang yon tan dang 'gro don med pa'i gang zag rang rgyud pa ma yin par mkhas pa'i tshul bstan pa rnams ni 'phags yul gyi shing rte chen po rnams dang rnam dbyer med pa/ grub pa'i tshul bzung ba rnams kyang lam rtags phyigs re la grub par rloms pa ma yin par/ dad mos drag pos rtsa ba'i bla ma pa gtsug tu bsten cing skyes sbyang gi yon tan mthar son te rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i go 'phang brnyes pa/ rtsa rlung thig le la rang dbang thob cing / bde gsal stong gsum gnyug ma rgyun chad med pa'i bskyed rdzogs la brtan pa thob nas zag med kyi mngon par shes pa mnga' ba/ lus me chu rlung gsum la sgyur nus pa sogs rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung ston par nus shing / rang nyid stong nyid chos kyi sku'i rgyal sa brnyes su zin kyang / gzhan don gdul bya'i 'gro ba rnams dmigs med snying rje chen pos rjes su 'dzin pa'i mdzad pa kho nar zhol ba sogs pha rjes bu yis zin pa sha stag grangs las 'das pa byung ba yin no/ /gsung las skyes rme de rnams so sor yang mdzad pa rnam thar ngo mtshar can dad gus spro gsum 'phel ba dag yi ge'i ris su rgyas bsdus ci rig su byas me re mjal rgyu 64

༄༅ / /dpal ma rma pa sku phreng gnyis pa na rma pa khri rnam thar bzhugs so//'byams su ngo 'phrod/ bka' brgyud kyi rgyud pa'i gdams pa yod tshad gnang / dag pa'i snang ba 'byams klas pa byung / srod la ras rkyang bzhes nas gtum mo sgom zhing rlung sems gnad kyi 'khor lo bsko ra bas/ sgom med kyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rin po che maḥ thog pa byams pa 'bum gyis mkhan po dang spyan snga mang phu bas slob dpon mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ sel lo'i brag na sgom tshe thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa dang rje btsun ba rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gros bskor rnab nos skyong sna tshogs kyi zhal gzigs/ sgo rig gi yul du byon skabs gzhi bdag rnams kyis bsu bar zhus/ khams stod 'bri rgyud kyi sa gnas rnams su brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad cing / nad pa dang dbang po skyon can sogs la phyag lcag gnang ba cam gyis sos pa byung / phul ba'i nor rnams 'phangs med du gzhan la bkyes/ grub thob kyi snyan grags phyogs med du khyab/ nam po gnas nang du bde mchog gi lha tshogs dang dus mkhyen gyis zhal gzigs/ sgo rig rngab pa yon btsun tshul rgyal gyi kha smyo skabs bon po rnams kyis brnyas bcos zhus par thugs 'khrugs nas/ gtor ma chen po mi bzhi yis ma theg pa phyag ya gcig bis 'phangs/ de dus chos skyong mgon po'i mthong snang la brten nas phyogs bcu mgon po'i bstod pa mdzad/ gam po dang nye ba'i sar yungs ri 'es pa'i sgrub gnas su phebs skabs 'byung po'i gnod 'tshe'i cho 'phrul rnams zil gyis mnan/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i sku bsod rgyas/ bu slob grwa lnga brgya tsam re tshogs par rgyags bkyes nas sgom bcol/ mgon lcam dral pho nya bcas lha srin sde brgyad bra na du bkol/ rgya 'jang yan chad la dras po'i 'phrin las dngos su bstan/ sgo rigs sol mtsho nag po de bstan pa la bcug pa dkar mo dung mtsho lta bur mdzad/rnya spungs rir bzhugs pa'i tshe zhing khams dpag med dang bka' brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs/ 'gro ba'i skye 'chi 'pho ba mkhyen/ dud 'gro kha 'thor ba'i skad gsan/ mi ma yin gyi slob ma mang po bsdus/spungs ri dgon pa bzhengs skabs mgon po'i ber rtses sa la ri mo bris pa ltar rmang bting / gyang btab pas mkhar las la dka' ngal ma byung / de dus sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams lta ba zhes pa'i bstan bcos mdzad/ lo ngo bcu gcig ring spungs ri kho dar bzhugs/ gnas nang bu 'bor 67

ci gyi༅ / /dpal ma rma pa sku phreng gnyis pa kurma pa khri rnam thar bzhugs so//wa wa ge go wa wa wa sgang gi lha 'dre yod tshad dbang du bsdus nas bka' bsgos/ rang btsan kha ba dkar po'i gangs ri ye shes dang 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi pho brang du gzigs/ skabs der kha ba dkar po'i la ma yig gcig mdzad/ kurma pa'i gdan sa be ris nyams pa byas te stong par bzhag khong gis der nyams gso ched sa stong nas yar byon tshe 'bri 'dan gnyis dang / lho lung chen bco brgyad kyi lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdug shing bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ mi rma pak+ṣi dgang lo zhe bzhi pa me lugar bas lo 5242/ phug lugs 2128 phyi lo 1247lor mtshur phur byon tshe sngags bdag gis nor bu rin po che phul/ sto phur sdo ngo drug bzhugs/ rje dug mkhyen gyi mtshan dang bstan pa phyogs du khyab par mdzad/ snyan pa'i — pā shin tu che bas/ la rma pa khri dgung lo zhe dgu pa chu byi/rabs lo 5247/ phus lugs 21 /3/ phyi lo 1 252)sdor chen po hor du mod gol han shan tsung gis hor gyi srid dbang brgyung rjes mtshur phur rnam thos sras mdung dmar can 'brug la bzhon pa 'khor gnod sbyin bye byā 'bum sde/ rta ljang la bzhon pa rnams kyis phyag gtsal te nga'i pho brang du7 'byon par zhu zhes sogs gso lta ba btab/ de dag hor gyi yul 5 phebs dgos pa'i brda du gzigs/ de nas ring por ma lon par hor gyi rgyal bu go pe la se chen han gyis mtha' khab kyi yul du chos kyi sgron me sgor ba la cis kyad 'byon par zhu zhes pa'i lung bcas gser yig pa mngags nas gdan 'dren zhus/ ci karma pak+ṣi dgung lo lnga bcu pa chu glang/rabs lo 524 8/ phug lugs 213ri phyi lo 1253lor hor rgyal se chen gyis 'jang la dmag drangs/ hor gyi gser yig btang nas kurma pak+ṣi gdan 'dren zhu skabs klu rgyal sngags bdag gis phrin las rgyas par 'gyur zer ba'i tshormās gzigs nas 'byon nga/ra zhal gyis bzhes/ byon lam khams phyogs su bstan pa'i 'gro don rgya cher spel/ yang khong dgung lo nga gnyis pa shing yos ( 1255)lor chen po hor yul du phyag btegs/ skabs der rgya bu go pe la sku ngo ma 'jang yul du dmag chen 'degs pa'i tshul gyis 'byon pa dang rong yul gser stod bya bar rin po che dang mjal 'phrad mdzad/ hor rgyal la sems bskyed gnang bas thugs nyams bzang po 'khrungs/ slar hor gyi pho brang 'u tor byon nas rgyal blon 'khor bcas kyis bsnyen bkur gzab cing rgyas 68

༄ / /dpal kurma pa sku phreng gnyis pa — pa khri rnam thar bzhugs so//pa zhus/ der yod kyi mu stegs pa dang / zin shing la sogs pa'i rtog be pa'i slob dpon rnams byin rlabs rdzu 'phrul gyis btul zhing pham par mdzad/ thams cad la sku bzhi ngo sprod dang dbang lung khrid bka' rgya cher bstsal te chos la bkod/ ka chur ( tsho)'jam dpal ser po phyag stong spyan stong zhal gzigs pa sku skye phyi ma gnyis kyis 'phrin las swākye brdar dgongs/ go pe las yon mchod 'phrod pas rtag tu 'u tor bzhugs par gsol ba btab kyang chos rje rin po ches 'byung 'gyur gyi bde dogs thams cad mngon par mkhyen cing / thugs rje chen pos kyang 'di na yun ring ma 'dug cig chags snang mang po 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes sogs lung bstan pa ltar zhal gyis par sngon rkarma pa lha legs par bkur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ba tshun gyi 'khor slob dang yon bdag mang po yul der skye ba blang pa'i don du mi nyag tu da lta nang sog dang mi nyag zhing chen gnyis 'brel ba'i sa mtshams yin khyon pas rgyal bu thugs cung ma rangs/ rnam sras dang chos skyong lha mgon gyis bskul te mi nyag ghar zhag brgya dang gcig la 'dzam gling na khyad du 'phags pa'i 'phrul snang sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po bzhengs/ mi nyag bi len lu pa tsho'i tsho /dang dzin su'i kram ye (lko 〉sogs la lha khang sum stong tsam zhigs gso dang gsar bzhengs mdzad/ da dung mkhas dga'i shog lte 888 893las/ rong yul gser stod ces bya bar rgyal bu dang mjal/ sems bskyed gnang / slar khong gi pho brang du byon mu stegs dang zin shin rdzu 'phrul gyis btul zhes pa dang / rgyal bus rtag tu bzhugs par gsol ba btab kyang ma 'ongs par phrag dogs 'byung ba mkhyen te zhal gyis ma bzhes pas cung zad yi chad/ mi nyag ghar byon/ zhag brgya dang gcig la 'phrul snang sprul pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ hor dang mi nyag mtshams su gdug byed sbrang bu'i 'jigs pa nyi ma 'grib pa byung ba rdo rje srin po lta stangs kyis btul/ sa dang bye ma rnams byin gyis brlab pas da lta yang sprang ma byung na bye ma gtor bas thub pa yod de thun mong gi grub rtags dang por grags/ byang phyogs li chu'i mkhar du rtog ge ba dang mu stegs du mas phrag dog byas pa rdzu 'phrul gyis btul zhes gsungs/ na rma pa khri dgung lo nga gsum pa me 'brug rabs lo5251/ phug lugs 2127/ phyi lo 1256/hor rgyal mong gol han ( / lo)gyis gsor yig spyan 'dren 'byor te/ byu pa khri 69

༄༅ / /dang/la kurma pa sku phreng gnyis pa ga rma pa khri rnam thar bzhugs so//hor ho ling (75)du phebs te rgyal po dang mjal kha mdzad/ byon lam du hor dang mi nyag bi ma/tshams su 'bu cha ga bas gnod pa tshabs chen byung bar lta stangs kyis skad cig la med par mdzad/ de'i sa dang bye ma thams cad kyis da lta yang 'bu sbrang gi gnod pa byung na thub ces grags/ de ni thun mong gi grub rtags 'go ma tsam yin gsungs/ de nas hor gyi rgyal sar chibs btegs pa'i la ma du li chu dang gam chu'i mkhar dang sa char lha srin sdug pa can gyis cho 'phrul byung ba rnams btul nas sa yi lha mo brtan mas gser gyi gter bum dang nor bu rin po che phul/ rgyal po'i pho brang dang nye ba'i 'ong ge(sgro4'i/sa char phebs dus sngon glang po che'i gzugs kyis mu stegs ( ) ci/smo)kyi rgyal ngo chen po brdzis nas btul/ rgyal po de phyis khams kyi kum po rdza lar bon po 'byor ldan zhig la skyes te/ rje ma rma pa la zhabs tog thams cad bsgrubs/ da lta rgyal po mong gol han dang dpon mo e jin ma dang / rgyal bu a ri bo ga blon po dang bcas par skye nas rgya mi nyag hor bod thams cad rgyal por gyur pas de 'dul ba'i dus la babs/da lta ma bzung na sngon mu stegs can gyi bag chags kyis er ka 'un (shā 〉〉gyi rdos lugs la zhugs na rgyal po 'di khyab khongs shin tu rgya che bas rgyal khams thams cad mu stegs can du 'gro ba yin/ dus mkhyen 'da' kha'i zhal chems su gdul bya gcig gi don du 'byung / zhes dze 'di yin/ lugs 'di ni bod kyi bon nag dang 'ad zhes deb dmar mchan 'grel 447 las gsungs/ de nas rkarma pa khri dgung lo 53me 'brug ste phyi lo 12456lor/ hor gyi rgyal sa'i pho brang chen po zir ra 'ur ngor byon nas hor gyi rgyal rgyud thams cad tshogs pa'i sar rgyal po mong gol han dang mchod yon mjal 'phrad mdzad/ rgyal po la bar chad chen po 'dug pas khyed kyi bar chad la sa smon dbang gis ngas min pa sus kyang zlog par mi nus/ bar chad zlog pa'i phyir gnam phyogs med du mchod/ bang mdzod dang yo byad thams cad kun la bkye/ btson thams cad thongs la hor gyi mi yur chen po chod/ ces pa'i bka' bsgos pa la rgyal po chen pos ji bzhin du rgyal khams su lung bsgrags te phyag len du btab/ rgyal po de sog po e rga 'un gyi lta grub 'dzin pa las ldog ste nang pa sangs rgyas par bsgyur/ rgyal po ‘ ci zhag du mar gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur zhing sku bzhi'i ngo sprod 70

༄༅ / /dpal na rma pa sku phreng gnyis pa kurma pa khri rnam thar bzhugs so// kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe rgyal po dpon mo 'khor bcas sems bzang 'dzin las grol/ chos nyid zab mo'i don rtogs/ mdzod dang bang ba thams cad phyogs med kyi gnam mchod pa dang 'bangs nyams thag rnams la bkye tshe nam mkha' las gtong ba che dang blo che ba zhes pa sogs kyi sgra chen po rlo ba sgrags pa kun gis thos/ ca nag chen btson khang sprug thengs gsum du zhus pas gnang / hor gyi mi yur zhes pa mi lo grangs yar bcad mar bcad byas te khyu 'ded kyis srog gcod pa'i lugs de mtshams bcad/ rgyal 'bangs thams cad zla ba 'byung ngo cog gi dus bzang bzhi la/ su la'ang tsa ra mi byed ci nga / sdog mi — / sha mi za ba'i khrims bcas/ gnam mchod pa kun la ( 25 41 /gnod 'tshe med cing rang rang gi chos lugs skyong du bcug ces pa la sogs pa'i brje rnam sa la mi 'tshe ba'i lung bstsal/ lo der ming yongs su grags pa'i kurma pa chen po hor gyi rgyal po mong rgol han shan sdong gyi snyi gtsug gi rgyan du mchod nas dbu blar dkur/ gser gyi tham ga chen po 'ja' zug ma dang dngul bre chen stong gis mgo byas hor rgyal —rabs kyi khyad nor dpag tu med pas 'bul bar phul/ rin po ches bla mchod kun la'ang gya nam pa bkye/ ma rma pak+ṣi nyid yon bdag dbon pa pa skye ba gsum nas lam rnal ma la 'god pa'i phyir du 'byon pa yin kyang zhar du skad rigs tha dad pa'i rgyal khams mang por phan thogs pa'i 'gro don rgya chen po byung gsungs/ hor rgyal pos yo byad btang ste ga ra gu rum du gtsug lag khang chen po 'jam gling na zla bral ba zhig kyang bzhings/ de ba'i na du hor mi nyag yu gur thams cad dgon gnas lha khang rnying gso gsar 'debs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lung dang yo byad bkye bar mdzad/ de'i dus su grub thob rin po ches grub rtags dang rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa la rgyal 'bangs thams cad dad pa rang dbang med par thob/ mu stegs pa dang mun pa can gyi sems can mang po yang dag be la ma du bkod/ de nas rgyal ngo chen pos thams cad khyed shes su chub ban de thams cad kyi khrims kyang legs par gyis gsungs pa la sogs pa'i lung chen po gnang yang / grub thob chen pos 'jig rten gyi lung rnams ma bzhes bla mas hor rgyal gcig pu btul ba'i zhor du skad rigs mi gcig pa'i mi mang4 po zhig gdul byar gyur cing chos dab bde la bstod do/ skam — — 71

༄༅ / /dang/'a ga rma pa sku phreng gnyis pa na rma pa khri rnam thar bzhugs so/ /—wa wa —pa khri dgung lo nga drug pa sa lugarabs lo 52 snes phug 'u gas 2 140/ phyi lo 1249lor hor rgyal mong sol tan sman rtse'i yul du gnam snye gshegs/ rgyal po sras blon rnams kyi sa ji gir gyi sras bdun pa a ri sbo ga rgyal sar bton/ rgya9lo bu sgo don sogs mi nyag na yod pa rnams kyis rab byung bzhi pa 'i lcags sprel ( 1260 )lo jing gir gyi sras bzhi pa go be la se chen han rgyal sar bton pa bcas skabs de ru mos pa tha dad pa'i rgyal po gnyis su chad/lo 'di nas grub rtags bar ma bstan pa'i dbu mugs/ sa chen gyi slob ma rga ras bya bas gnyis 'dzin gyis mthu byas te rgyal po a ri sbo ga bkrongs/ de nas bzung rgyal po gcig pu la se chen han kho na la nges pa yin/ skabs der gling phyogs ma/nga pos rgyal khams rnams cher 'khrugs/ rin po che so ga yul du bzhugs pa lha nub gcig mnal lam du na thub pa sku tshad gzhu 'daX bcu gsum tsam/ yod pa zhig byon nas khyed kyis bod du sku 'di tsam zhig bzhengs shig bar chad thams cad zhi zhing rgyal kha mas rnams bde bas 'gyur ro/ zhis 'u nga bstan byung bas nye gnas 'dan sgom pa can la gser drel rgyab bdun la sogs pa'i yo byad rnags bskur te sku rgyu ram pa zangs lung nas thon/ bzo bo phan yu la du pa khri bya ba yod pas de 'bod la sku — par bzhengs shig ces bkas mngags te rdzong bar — / 'dan sgom gyis sku rgyu dang bzo bo ji lta gsungs pa bzhin byung nas yo byad thams cad nam mkha' mdzod la dbang 'byor te mtshur phu'i gdan sar da lta'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa sku rgyu zangs rag la rin po che du ma bsres nas legs su blugs pa las lha chen po sku tshad gzhu 'dom bcu gsum byas pa dang / sku rgyu lhag ma la sa sems pa byams 'jam dbyangs/ rgyal ba rigs lnga/ spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho bcas lha chen gtso 'khor dgu dang / gtsang khang mdo khyams dad bcas pa la dbu rtser sngon rgya gar gyi gtsug lag khang chen po zhig hor dmag gis gtor ba'i gser zangs rgya phibs kyi bya 'dab rnams ga chur phyis sus kyang regs mi nus par lus pa rnams ltas ngan g.yang 'gug gis rje pak+ṣis klu rgyal la bka' bsgos te chu thog nas mtshur phur drangs bar grags pa'i bya 'dabs kyi rgya phibs dang / mtshur phu bya khung nas gter las bzhes pa'i gser bya che ba cha/ lha ra nor bu chu shel gyi tog bcas khyad par 'phags pa legs par grub pa la 72

༄ / /dpal na rma pa sku phreng gnyis pa cha pa khri rnam thar bzhugs so//ci pak+ṣi'i li ma lha chen 'dzam gling dpal 'bar zhes zhu ba dang gser zangs kyi rgya phibs gyo mo rnams chu dreg bis mdog nag por gyur nas yod pa la mtshur phu'i rgya thabs nag po zhes pa yongs grags bcas 'dzam gling na che ba'i li ma'i sku 'di dag bzhengs/ mkhas pa'i da cig 'a ston 9 02las/ rme gtso bo la de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bre gang shā / rje sgam po pa'i thugs ljags spyan gsum/ dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pu'i tshems/ rje mi la'i gsol zhal/ phyag mkhar/ skyer sgang pa'i snam sbyar/ nyan thos mchog zung si lhung bzed mkhar gsil snam sbyar/ gser dngul gyi bka' 'gyur po ti brgya dang lnga cu/ tshogs dung dkar so rgyang grags sogs mtha' yas par bzhugs gsungs/ de nas grub thob chen pos rgya hor du chos 4kyis gdul bya 'dul ba'i 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi kho na nas 'gro don snyan grags nam mkha'i mthar khyab pa ltar byung ba las gzhan srid kyi bya ba ye mi mdzad kyang /thog mar chos rje kurma pa'i snyad pa gsan nas hor yul du gdan 'dren zhu mkhan hor gyi rgyal bu go be la yin kyang / khong gi thugs re ltar pho brang 'u tor chos rje yun ring ma mi zhugs par byang phyogs hor gyi rgyal sa 'ong ger byon te rgyal po mong gol han gyi pho brang du dbu bla mdzad nas bzhugs pa la phugs ma rangs pa'i khar/ 'bri gung khri dpon rdo rje dpal gyis a ri sbo ga la brten te sa skya dang zlod pa'i don du rgyal po mong gol han la zhu gtugs byas/ go be la la gdong bsher dang ngo mchil btab pas rkyen byas sgo be las rgyal po mong gol han khu dbon la yang zhe nas mi dga' bar yod pa dang / grub thob chen pos rgyun du su zhig la'ang mi chos kyi ngo dga' mi mdzad pas go bo la 'es thad kur ming 'bod mdzad pa thugs la bzhag kyang zer/ dbang gral nas phags kyis phyir phyungs ba la zhal bskyengs kyang zer/ gtso cher skye bo mang —po'i phra ma la brten te rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags sprel lor rgyal po go be la se che ga han rgyal po'i khri la 'khod nas/ lcags bya rabs lo (256/ phug lugs 2142/ phyi lo 1261/lor grub thob chen po la 'byon dgos pa'i lung bcas pho nya mngags te gshed ma la gtad pas grub thob chen pos grub rtags bar pa bstan te gshed ma kha cig khrag bskyugs te shi/ me tshone cha rnams 0dum rbur 'thor pa si gyo lo po 4go ri bo la cas te se shed rma rnams bso da/ —rkub thob chen po mi li bsri gis pa dang chu — 7 )

ri༄༅ / /dpal kurma pa sku phreng gnyis pa ma rma pa khri rnam thar bzhugs so//la bsgyur ba/ mtshon dang dug la sogs pas sku la drag po'i khrims chad ci rigs par spyad kyang rin po che sku zil je rgyas kyis sku la nyam nga gang yang ma byung / skabs 'dir grub thob rin po che'i zhal tshom la thag pa btags chi te dpyang thag btang bas nga ma rma pak+ṣi'i og tshom chod/ khyod rgya nag rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud chod gsungs pas zhal tshom chad/ de'i bden tshig bis rgya'i rgyal rgyud kyang chad pa sogs lo rgyus du ma zhig ngag rgyun du gleng srol yod cing / skabs de grub chen kurma pak+ṣi la zhal tshom yod pa dang / phyis ra rma pa sku phreng rim byon la zhal tshom med pa ni rgyu mtshan de ltar yin par grags shing / kurma pa khri la ni zhal tshom drang pho zhig yod pā las 'al rgya med / zhal tshom yod dbos pa'i rgyu tshan yang / sngon rgya gar 3gyi rnal 'byor pa budha bo dhi zhes bya ba grub rtags mang po ston pa/ mu stegs pa mang po btul/ 'gro ba rnams skye ba med pa'i don la bkod pa de'i skye ba yin pa'i rtags yin/ zhes grub chen po nyid kyi zhal gyis mches pa yin/ de nas mthar rgya mtsho'i pha rol gyi rgya'i yul mtha' 'khob bye ma'i gling zhig tu lo gsum sgyugs pa na yul der bdud rtsi'i char yang yang babs/ shing tog dang snyo tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa du ma skyes te lha'i yul lta bur gyur ba sogs mtha' 'khob dgon dung gi 'gro ba rnams bde skyid dpag tu med pa'i dpal lu bkod/ de nas pak+ṣi'i grub rtags tha ma 'go btsugs te skabs der rgyal po 'khor bcas la chos skyong gi brtsub 'gyur cho 'phrul du ma'i mthong snang mi bzod pa ci rigs pa dang / rgyal khams rnams su rtsa 'then thog ser/ sha 'od rlung 'tshub/ sa gas ri nyil/ nad yams la sogs pa mi shis pa'i mtshan ngan blo yul las 'das pa drag tu brdol/ grub thob rin po cher sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong mang po nas zhal gzigs ra zla dang / lung bstan bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / gru ba thob rin po cher 'o rgyal byung ba'i dus su 'bri gung nas gcung rin po che dang / stag lung nas sangs rgyas yar byon sogs bka' rgyud bla ma grub thob mang po yang nam mkha' las gsal 'debs zhu bar byon pa sogs 'bri gung gser phreng las kyang gsal zhing / skabs der 'phags pa 'jam dpal yang yang zhal gzigs pa la 'jam dpal dang zhus len nyer snga pa sogs thugs rtsom ma/nga po yang mdzad/ de ltar grub thob chen pos rgya hor gyi yul 741

༄༅/ /dpal kurma pa sku phreng gnyis pa kurma pak+ṣi rnam tharabazhugasaso// du grub rtags chen po thog mtha' bar gsum gyis gtsos grub pa'i rtags bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ skabs zhig la gzungs zhugs grub nas lha chen g.yon du cung yo ba/ pakhri lha chen mdun du bzhugs te sku g.yon nas g.yas su bsrangs/ zla gcig la sgos dri dang me tog gi char rgyun ma chad /lha chen dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan zhes mtshan gsol/ yang / lam po gnas nang du sangs rgyas mar me mdzad sku thog tshad dang kurma dgon du rgyal ba bya mas pa'i sku sogs bzhengs mdzad/ gdul bya skal ba ldan min thams cad kyi mthong chos su bstan pa la sa skya'i gdung rabs ngo mtshar phreng ba las kyang / skyes mchog krarma pakhris grub rtags bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i dus su/ rang re'i bla ma 'phagacis pa de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mtha' yas gnyis snang mi yi gzugs su byon pa la rdzu 'phrul che chung bi dbye ba med na'ang 'phral snang gi rdzu 'phrul rtogs ldan rgya po 'di rang mtho ba 'dug cas se chen rgyal po'i zhal nas btsun mo blon po sogs kyi 'khor gyi nang du gsungs pa'i rkyen byas btsun mo cha bu mas bla ma 'phags pa rin po che'i snyen sngar byon te lo rgyus snyan du gsol/ bla mas kyang rdzu 'phrul ma bstan na rgyal po'i re ba yang mi khengs shing thugs la 'gyur ba yang byung dogs 'dug ces sogs bla ma 'phags par rdzu 'phrul ston par skul ma zhus lugs gsal ba bcas de lta bu'i rgya hor mi nyag yu gur la sogs pa skad rigs mi gcig pa'i mi rigs bgrang las 'das pa dang / lhag par chen po'i go 'phangs na dregs pas 'gyings pa'i rgyal po dang bcun mo blon 'khor rnams dang / tshig la 'chel zhing nus mthus rloms pa'i zin shing dang / ta'o si dang / en 'un la sogs pa'i rtog ge ba'i lta ngan log lta can gyi slob dpon rnams dang / zhe snangs phrag dogs kyi kun slangs bag ngan can thams cad marma pa'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs rdzu 'phrul la rab tu dad nas zhabs spyi bor khur te thams cad nang pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs/ rgyal po 'khor bcas nas 'gyod sems drag pos snying thag pa nas nongs bshags dang bzod gsol zhus pa la rten nas chos skyong ma mgon lcam bral dang sngags kyi bdag po pho nyam bkye 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang / sman bla'i ting 'dzin gyis 'od zer spros te ltas ngan dang nad yams/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad rang sar zhi bar mdzad/ rgyal 75

cho ༅/ /nga pa la /rma pa sku phreng gnyis pa na rma pa khri rnam thar bzhugs so//khams thams cad zhi 'jam bde skyid kyi ngang la bkod/ thams cad dam pa'i chos la bsgyur bas ma rma pa'i snyan pa je cher song / rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas rab tu dgyes pa'i dad gus chen ngo/'i sgo nas ming yongs su grags pa'i ma rma pa tā yon gong ma hu pe li se chen han gyi ti shri ste dbu blar bkur gong ma 'dis sa skya'i 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che dang / 7mi pa khri rin ngo che gnyis dus gcig tu dbu blar bzhis kyang rkarma pa khris srid kyi bya ba la zhal gyis ma bzhes/ 'gro —mgon rin po ches bod kyi srid kyi bya ba bzhes pa'i khyad par tsam las dbu bla tha mi dad par mdzad/ bkur sti zhabs tog gzab cing rgya che ba zhus te gsang sngags kyi dbang lung gdams khrid mang po zhus par dbang bka' rim pa so so dang / thog mtha' bar gsum gyi 'bul ba bcas gong ma'i bang mdzod kyi sgo 'phar yangs por phye ste 'dzam gling na dkon pa'i hor rgyal rabs kyi khyad nor dpas tu med pa phul nas chos rje rin po che thugs dgyes pa'i mchod sprin rgya cher spros/ rgyal po btsun mo gnyis kyang shes bya 'phel zhing thugs rgyud la rtogs pa bzang po 'khrungs/ rgyal thabs kyi bya ba thams cad dge ba'i mdzad spyod kyis bskyangs/ mchod yon 'phrod par byung nas slar yang / chos rje rin po che sman tse'i yul du 'byon dgos pa'i gong ma'i lung byung ba la/ dus gsum mkhyen pas lung bstan nas bod yul du 'gro bar nan gyis zhus pas mthar gong ma chen po khyed bod yul la sogs pa gang dgar bde bar chos spyod la nged la smon lam bzang po thob ces pa'i lung dang 'ja' sa tham ga sogs byin/ gong nas bkur gzod bdag rkyen bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang pho brang chen po co pa to mkhar nas/ rab byung bzhi pa'i shing byi rabs lo 5259/ phug lus sa 2145/ phyi lo 126ri lor bod kyi phyogs su phyag btegs/ phebs lam du can mkhar nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs dpon sde mang po 'dus nas rin po che mjal/ so sor dgon pa 'debs par zhus kyang ma gnang / shing kun mkhar dang nye bar rgya yul gyi lha 'dre mang pos bar chad brtsams pa la rta mgrin gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis thams cad zil gyis mnan pa bcas rgya hor mi nyag yu gur la sogs pa'i lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus nas bran du bkol ba la yi dam de bang gyur snang srid dbang du bsdus/ /sog po mu stegs rgyal po'i dregs pa btul/ /me chu dug ma tshon 'byung po'i nus pa bcom/ /ma rma pak+ṣi'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ ces 76

kho / /dpal kurma pa sku phreng gnyis pa kerma pak+ṣi rnam thar bzhugs so// tshigs su bcad pa'i gsol 'debs sho lo ka gcig gis kurma pak+ṣi'i skabs de'i mdzad pa rnams phyogs bsdoms rags tsam byas pa ltar ro/ /de nas phebs lam gyi skye bo bgrang las 'das pa rnams la zhal mjal phyag byin dang yis drug la so gas pa'i gdams khrid chos bka' du mas thar pa'i sa bon rgya chen pos smin grol la bkod nas 'dam lcog tse lar phebs dus dbus gtsang na yod pa'i hor bod kyi bla ma dpon chen/ zon 'u si'i mi dpon khri dpon sogs che dgu thams cad kyis phebs bsu ja 'dren bsnyen bkur la sogs pa gzab cing rgyas pa zhus/ rin po ches thams cad la dbu zhwa'i bshad pa dngu bka' chos gsungs pas thams cad shen tu dad par gyur/ de nas mtshur phu'i gdan sar phebs/ nye gnas kyis lha chen gtso 'khor legs par grub pa la/ gtso bor tshogs dung dkar mo rgyang grags kyis gtsos pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel sogs thams yas pa gzungs bzhugs su phul/ lha chen gyi dbu cung zad g.yon du yo bas bzo bos thabs med cing sems khong du chud pa la rin po ches lha chen gyi mdun du sbyil krung gis bzhugs/ rlung bum pa can bzung ste nyid kyi dbu g.yon nas g.yas su rim gyis bsrang pas tsheg sgra chen po dang bcas sku mgrin yo ba drang por bsrang / rtsa rlung bsgoms pa la yon tan 'di 'dra med na gosungs/ de nas byams pa'i bzhugs khri brtsigs te rgyal ba byams pa dang / rkarma pak+ṣi rnam pa mi 'dra ba gnyis sogs sku'i sprul pa gsum dus gcig tu bzhes nas lha chen la rab tu gnas pa dang / mchod pa 'bul ba/ bla g.yel du chos 'khor skor babacas dus gcig la mdzad pa ska bas de'i skye bo kun gyi mngon sum mig gi bdud rtsir gyur/ bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad bdud rigs thams cad rta mgrin rdo rje srin po'i ting 'dzin gyis btul/ sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam ḍā ki chos skyong gi zhal gzigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / mtshur phu'i gnas sa rdo ri brag thams cad la sku gzugs phyag mtshan yis 'bru sogs sangs rgyas sku gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du byin gyis rlabs/ 'khor bu slob gdul bya dpag tu med pa 'phel nas bstan pa rab zitu rgyas par mdzad/ rkarma pakhri dgung 'o 62 rab byung bzhi pa'i shing glang rabs lo 5260/ phus lugs 2146/ phyi lo 12(25/lor bod can che ba se chen gong me'i ti shri 'gro mgon 'phags 77

༄༅/ /dpal ma rma pa sku phreng gnyis pa kurma pa khri rnam thar bzhugs so//pa rin po che bod du phebs/ yar lam mtshur phur phebs te ma rma pa dang mjal 'phrad skabs phyag dang bzhugs gdan mnyam par bzhugs nas sngar nga mong gol rgyal po'i bla mchod du yod dus ngas khyed byung chub sems pa mthong na dga' ba btags pa e ma yin/ zhes sogs gsung gleng rmar ba zhib rgyas mdzad/ mtshur phu'i gdan sa nyams gso gsar 'debs dang rten gsum rgya cher bzhengs/ skal ldan gyi bu slob kyang mtha' yas pa bskyangs te thob bsam sgom pa'i sgro 'dogs phyogs med du bcad pa las bka' rgyud kyi rgyal sa zi na pa'i grub thob du ma byung / de tshe ma mgon lcam bral sngags bdag mkhar nag dang bcas pa'i 'khor lnga rjes 'brangs kyi chos skyong srung ma rnams dang / thang brtan la sogs pa'i bod kyi gzhi bdag thams cad kyis rkarma pa'i bstan pa srung zhing skyong bar dam bcas te rang rang gi srog snying phul/ dbe 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur skyong bran sogs bstan pa'i bya bar phyag rjes rgya chen po bzhag rgya bod hor gsum/ yu gur mi nyag 'jang la sogs pa'i yul gru skad rigs tha dad pa'i mi rigs mang po'i rgyal khams thams cad la chos rgya dkar po'i 'phrin las rgya chen po'i sgo nas 'gro don dpag tu med pa mdzad nas sku tshe 'di'i gi dul bya re zhig rdzogs par nye ba gzigs pa'i dus su gnam sa gnyis kyi ka ba lta bu grub thob chen po o rgyan pa rin chen dpal thugs rgyal cung zad dang bcas mtshur phur rkarma pa mjal du byung ba la dang por lta stangs mdzad pas khong dpon slob rnams bkrab pa dang / g.yo ba dang / 'phar ba sogs byung / de nas o rgyan pa'i dgongs tshul rnams sngon mkhyen thogs pa med pa mang po gsungs pas o rgyan pa rin po che'i khengs dregs kyi thugs spobs thams cad rtsa ba nas zhi/ ma 'ongs pa'i bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don dang rma rgyan pa rin po che'i gdul bya gar yod sogs lung bstan gsung gleng zhib rgyas su mdzad rjes bsre 'pho'i zhal gdams dang / sku gsum ngo sprod kyi phyag dpe/ dbu zhwa zhwa nag gcig bcas o rgyan rin po cher gtad de 'di rnams khyed kyis mgo 'don byed dgos pa zhig yong bas de la gtod/ nga dang myur du 'phrad do gsungs pa dang de rjes mi ring bar mang yul gangs zhur mo'i mdun phyogs kyi mi mang po lha sar jo mjal du 'ongs nas mtshur phur grub thob chen po mjol bar byung / de rnams la chos deng byin rlabs/ zas gos 78

༄༅ / /dpal kurma pa sku phreng gnyis pa na rma pa khri rnam thar bzhugs so// ci sogs gnang sbyin gya rnams pa gnang / de'i nang nas do ha dang rnying ma dang zhi byed rgyud phyi la mkhas pa'i ston pa chos dpal bya ba snyoms chung zhig yod pa la khyod cung zad sdod dang gsungs/ gnang sbyin bzang po gnang nas nged kyis khyod la gnas tshang zhig g.yor dbos pa 'dug pas de thong zhig gsungs/ khong gis go ba ma phogs par zhu spobs ma rnyes/ zla bo rnams la smras pas/ khyod rang gar sdod med pa la rin po cher gnas tshang ga nas glengs zer nas khong lu mi 'os pa'i rnam 'gyur bcas bzhad gad di rir song / de ltar —ma 'ongs par yang srid sprul pa'i sku 'byon rgyu'i sta bon ‘ sgodang zhal chem gsal bar gnang yang skabs 'phral tshang mas yid 'jog do snang cher ma byung / chu rta lo nas gshegs ltas kyang mang po byung bar — mkhyen/ bu slob rnams kyis brtan bzhugs ci brtan — stobs chen bsgrubs kyang / rtogs lhan rang byung rdo rje 'chi ba'i bye brag su zhig gis shes/ dper na mar me 'da' khar gsal ba bzhin/ mkhas pa 'dod pas the tshom dris/ grub pa 'dod pas bdar sha chod gsungs pa dang / chu lug lo zla ba dang po'i nang thang dpal mo dpal thang gi stod du rje btsun mi la ras chen thod par bdud rtsi gsol zhing 'od zer 'gyed pa dang / ma ci 'ongs pa na 'di nas 'phrin las 'byung ngo zhes sogs zhal gzigs dang lung bsta na byung bas der bsta na bcos kyang mdzad/ 'khor dge 'dun rnams la zhal ta dang / nyi ma do nub nub kyang sang 'char ba bzhin re zhig mi sna nga bar gyur kyang / gdul bya'i don du sprul pa'i sku shes bya kun la mkhas pa zhig gnam nas bye babs pa bzhin myur du 'ong ngo gsungs/ dbon rin po che la bdan sa gtad de dgung grangs brgyad cu pa rab byung lnga pa'i chu lug dgung lo 89pa zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gsum gyi snga dro rabs lo 65278/ phug lugs 2 1424/ phyi lo 1283/la dgongs pa chos dbyings su snyom par bzhugs so/ /tshes dgu la gdung sbyangs shing sku 'dad byas/ nyi ma nyis 'gyur gyis ring ba dang / me tog bi shar/ 'ja' dang 'od sogs rnam 'phrul du ma snang / gdung la lha sku ring bsrel sogs rten dpag med byon/ de rnams phal cher gdan sa gong 'og gi gdung rten rnams su bzhugs gsol/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i slob ma'i tshogs kyang shi ne tu mang bas blo me gzhal bar mi nus kyang / dngos su snod ldan kyi slob ma'i gtso bo rgyal po 79

ri rtse / /dpal la pa sku phreng gnyis pa na mi pak+ṣi rnam thar bzhugs so//—mo gol gan sku nyid dang spongs rtogs mnyam par byin gyis brlabs pa dang / sku nyid mnyam du me la bsregs kyang mi gnod pa ye shes dbang phyug dang / rin chen dpal/ rtsod tsho las phams te zhabs la 'dus pa tshad ma paṇ+ḍi ta/ g.yag ru ras pa/ rtogs ldan zhwa dmar ser khra gsum/ stag mgo ba/ gzig mgo do mu pa mgo spyan snga stag shod/ 'jam dbyangs blo gros seng ge dbon rin po che/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ gnam mtsho pa rdo/ /nga/ /sdu sbya dī /nya /sa /dre rdo ༷/ ༷ rdzu // rdo //rdo ༵ / /sdo ༵ rdo mkha/ bye/ ṭ+wāṃ ༵ sna /'a che rdos po kho kau yin/ pa rdo / ra/ sdibs kā gta/ // pa khyab byang chub rin chen sku skye ba snga phyi gnyis la chos thob pa'i grub thob chen po'i gshegs dus o rgyan ring po che mtshur phu'i gdan sar bkod/ de nas gnyan ras kyis cung zad ma dzad/ de nas bla ma gnas gnang pas mdzad/ gnyan ras pa gtogs pa gnyis kurma pak+ṣi'i dbon rgyud yin/ mkhas pa'i twe byeX/ /bye bye ༷/ // /phyi byeX /༷ ṭ+wāṃ ༵ ༷/ sdu ༷ bye ༷di ṭ+wāṃ ༷ ༷ cus bye/ ṭaṃ ༷ / // ༷༷ ༷༷ / ༷ sduX sdi / shī lta ngh+ru ྅ dro tre ༷ ṭ+wāṃ ༷/ ṭ+wāṃ /rdzu ji rnyi'i ni / zlob tha /ba kho che / gā dī //dī rdo/ ༵ ༵ drisa~X ༵༵༵/ shing sko spre/( // // //dī bye/sdu yod par gsungs so// 7 sku phreng gsum pa rang tshung dbyed go la ste0 80

༄ / /nam pa sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// ju ༄mya / /ga rma pa sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar//rang byung rdo rje ni/ rje nam pak+ṣi gshegs nas dga' ldan sogs zhing khams rnams la yud tsam byon/ de nas stod la lung 'phar tshang lcags ri thang phu zhes par du bu 'chi ma thag pa zhig la grong 'jug mdzad par ma des shi mig gson la lta ba mi legs zhes mig la khab gtsags byas te rten 'brel ma 'grigs/ de nas mnga' ris mang yul gung thang gangs zhur mo'i 'gram du 'dun pa btang ste/ rtsa phu rlung shod zer bar sngon kurma pa khri mjal skabs rjes su nga la gnas tshang g.yar dgos gsungs pa'i yab gsang sngags rnying ma dang / zhi byed brgyud phyi la mkhas pa ston pa tshul dpal dang / yum jo mo g.yang 'dren gyi sras su/ rab byung lnga pa'i shing sprel zla1tshes skor bas lo 5279/ sug lugs2165/ phyi lo128ri la sku 'khrungs/ 'khrungs ma thag phyag gis zhal snyis te gtsog pur bzhugs nas a ma tshes brgyad kyi zla bar 'dug ang gsungs yul la gsung byon/ dgung lo gsum bzhi nas rdo ba'i khri chung ngu la bzhugs nas byis pa dmangs la sku gsum ngo sprod sogs zab chos gsung ba dang / rgyu ma smig rgyu 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du/ /snang yang bden pas stong bar kho bos rtogs/ /ma rtogs byis pa khyed rnams snying re rje/ /zhes gsungs pa ni tshigs bcad gsungs pa'i thog mar grags/ yab yum la dgon pa dang nor longs spyod dpag tu med pa yod lugs ha cang gsal ba thengs mang gsungs/ dgung lo lnga ba rab byung lnga ba'i sa byi rabs lo5283/ phyi lo 1288/lo sngar nam pa khris don rgyud kyi bstan pa gtad phyag dpe dang zhwa nag sogs bstsal nas bkas mngags pa ltar grub thob chen po rma rgyan pa rin chen dpal la rin po che nam pa 'byo na pa la 'od kyi dra bas khengs pa sogs gzigs snang shin tu gsal ba mang po byung yang da dung nyams sad phyir stan mthon po bshams/ nang don du zhabs 'bring rnams la dung 'bus pa sogs bsu ba zhus gsungs/ khong rang nyid kyis gsang bdag gi ting 'dzin mdzad nas bzhugs pas byis pa de o rgyan pa'i drung du byung dus zil gyis ma non par bag tsha med par dril gdangs shig yod pa de dkrol/ stan mthon po'i thal gyis 'dzegs nas bzhugs/ khyod su yin gsungs pas phyas mdzub nam mkha' la sgrongs te nga ni ming — 81

༄༅ / /kurma pa sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//—wa sdi ge rdo wa—yongs su grags pa'i kurma pa'o gsungs/ sngon gyi mjal lugs shod gsungs pas thams cad tshigs bcad du gsungs/ nga'i zhwa nag dang dpe cha khyed la yod pa gsungs/ de bden zhes dbu zhwa phul bas ba zhes/ slar mar babs nas nga bla ma yin kyang da cha khyed kyis bskyang dgos pa 'dug gsungs nas phyag mdzad/ yab yum la gsungs tshul rnams zhal 'dzoms te dris pas phyogs thams cad nas rtags thon thams cad yid ches te kurma pak+ṣi'i tsho yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad/ nga'i bla ma'i gsang mtshan rang byung rdo rje yin pas mtshan yang de ga 'dogs so gsungs nas ma sgyur bar rang byung rdo rjer mtshan gsol/ yi ge 'bri klog thams cad sus kyang slo ba dgos par mkhyen/ mnga' dis khul gyi bla ma dge bshes rnams kyi gtsug rgyan mkhas btsun ser khang bas mjal nas gus pa dang bcas lo rgyus dri ba zhus pas bar do'i rnam thar la sogs pa mang po gsungs pa khong gis phyag bris su btab/ de nas mkhas grub o rgyan pas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang / 'khor 'o/ sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi dbang dang / ma phur gyi dbang sogs phul/ dgyes mdzad dang / rgyu 'phrul dra ba/ dus kyi 'khor lo dang / 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud la sogs gsungs/ gzhan yang ro rnyom sa skor drug dang / bsre 'pho dang / sku gsum ngo sprod/ khrid chen brgyad dang / rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ do ha/ lhan cig skyes sbyor/ gzhan yang chos bka' mtha' yas pa gsungs/ — karma pa rang byung rdo rje dgung lngo 7pa rab byung 6lhags pho stag lo rabs lo 5285/ phug lugs 2171/ phyi lo 1290/nas khro phu ba mkhan po kun ldan shes rab las rab tu byung ba dang dge tshul bsgrubs te 'dul ba ci rigs gsan/ mtshan sngon ma la4sa gsar spo ma mdzad par snang / de'i tshe mnga' ris kyis gtsos pas snyan grags kyi sa chen khyab/ la stod spu rangs su bzhugs pa la mtshur phur grub chen gnyan ras pa la thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa zhig gis skul ba dang / mgon po dang / sngags bdag gnyis la stod du byung nas mtshur phur myur du 'byon dgos zer/ de nas rang byung rdo rje dgung lo dgu pa rab byung lnga pa'i chu 'brug lo rabs lo ci(287/ pug lugs 2 173/ phyi lo 1292/lo gdan sa mtshur phur phyag btegs par lam du lha 'dre du mas bsu ba zhus/ mtshur phu'i gdan sar phebs pa na sngags bdag bis chu mig dwangs gtsang zhig phul/ skal dman 82

༄༅/ /ga mo pa sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//'ga' zhig gis da dung 'khrul bral yin min the tshom du yod pa la nga ma rma pak+ṣi'i skye ba yin na brag gdong skam po 'dir chu mig 'byung bar gyur cig ces gsungs pas de ma thag chu mig byung ba dang chu mig de'i 'gram du shing thur gzhogs phyed mes tshigs pa zhig phyag gis btsugs nas bden tshigs gsungs pas bden stobs kyis ljon shing yal ga lo 'dabs rgyas pa bcas byung ba phyis kyang sgrub chur grags pa dang ljon shing bcas yod/ mtshur phur phebs ma thag mgon rnams shin tu dgyes pa'i 'phrin las mdzad pa gzigs pas ma mgon gyi bstod pa mdzad/ gnyan ras las chos ji snyed zhus tshe rgyud pa'i bla ma mang pos bskor 'dug pa gzigs/ bkra shis gsar mar rab gnas gnang bar bka' rgyud kyi bla ma rnams byon/ bla ma shes rab dpal las sdud pa'i dka' 'grel dang pa: ka pad+ma can zhus/ dge ba'i gshes gnyen rgyal ba la dgyes rdor la sogs pa gsan/ yang gnyen ras dge 'dun 'bum la gsar rnying gi rgyud sgrub thabs man ngag shin tu mang ba gsan/ gnam mtsho pa mi bskyod rdo rje la ma gcig gi gcod yul la sogs mang po gsan/ sngar stod lung 'phar tshang du grong 'jug mdzad tshe spyan la sa 'debs mkhan ma de la mdzo mo zhig gnang / khyod kyis nga'i mig la ci tsug byas gsungs pas/ khab btsugs pa med sa zhig btab lags zer/ ma rma pa rang byung rdo rje dgung lo bcu gcig pa shing rta rabs lo 5289/ phug lugs2175/ phyi lo 129go lor sog se chen 'das/ sa g.yos mang du byung ba'i tshe lus kyi rtsa mdud grol zhing ye shes phyogs med du shar/yang dgung lo bco brgyad pa rab byung lnga pa'i lcags mo glang rabs lo 5296/ phug lugs 2182/ phyi lo130 1/lor tā dben gzhon nu seng ge'i slob ma mkhan po gzhon nu byang chub dang / slob dpon dge 'dun rin chen pa las bsnyen par rdzogs shing / lung sde bzhi la sogs pa dam chos 'dul ba'i skor rgya che gsan cing / sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs la sogs 'ga' yang gsan/ gsang phu gling smad kyi gdan sa pa shākya gzhon nu la dbu ma'i skor mang po dang / byams chos lnga/ mngon pa gong 'og dang / sa sde/ tshad ma la sogs mang du gsan/ de nas khams su thegs/ na rma pa rang byung rdo rje dgung lo nyi shu pa chu yos rabs lo 5296/ phug lugs 218sa phyi lo 1303/lor sne lha steng phya ga btab ste 'dus sde btsugs/ tsha ba sgang sogs mang por byon 8 3

ga / /ma rma pa sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//pas gzhi bdag rnams kyis bsu ba zhabs tog rgya chen po byas/ mi ma yin rnams bka' la btags pas kol ti'i 'khrug pa chen po yang zhi bar —mdzad/ der bī ma la mdzod spur thim par gzigs pas rdzogs pa chen po'i don thams cad rtogs shing rdzogs chen snying thig gi yig cha mdzad/ mnal lam du mdo sde'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad/ kun spyod kyi 'grel pa mdzad tshe mkha' 'gros mchod/ 'khor dang snyan grags mi bzod par sngags pa brgyad kyis phug par gshin rje bsgrub nas mthu byas pas dgra nag zhal gsum phyag drug gis sngags sgra sgrogs shing de'i rig sngags bzlog phug pa dibs te sngags pa thams cad shi 'ong btsan kha ba dkar por byon te gnas yig mdzad/ rtsa rir o rgyan rin po che dngos su mjal nas dbang lung rdzogs par gnang / khams phyogs su 'gro don rgya chen mdzad nas dbus su byon pa na bzhi bdag thams cad dang / khyad par thang lhas bsu ba rgya cher zhus/ lha sar jo bo la gser gyi gdugs phul tshe phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod pa sogs thugs snang bzang po shar/nam pa rang byung rdo rje dgung lo nyer drug pa sa bya rabs lo 530ga phug lugs2190/ phyi lo 1309/lor dpal o rgyan pa chen po'i dgongs pa rdzogs phyir snye mdo ba kun dga' don grub pa las dus 'khor gyi bshad pa zhig tu gsan cing rgyud dang 'grel pa gsar rnying dbang dang gdams pa bcas mang po dang / dam 'os dkon mchog rtsegs pa dang pad dkar sogs mdo'i lung mang dang / mngon pa gong 'og sogs rgya cher gsan/ sba ras las gso ba rig pa'i gzhung dang / tshul khrims rin chen la gsang 'dus phag skor la sogs gzhung mang po dang / gzhon nu 'bum pa las bstan srung gi bka' mang po dang / ro snyoms dang thub lnga sogs gsan tshwa na shrī la 'grel pa mtha' drug la sogs gas na/ rigs 'dzin ku mā ra rā dza la rdzogs chen snying thig dang / de gal sogs pa gsan pa dang / re khong ras pa las kyang gsan/ mdor na mdo rgyud bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog gsan bsam ma gnang ba med cing rig pa'i gnas lnga la shin tu mkhas pa sku gong ma 'da' ma'i zhal chems su gsungs pa ltar byung / gsan yig pod kho na deng dus skye bo'i blo la mi gshongs shing / sa ris mdzad pa la lcags snyugs bdun zad par gsung / bka' rgyud kyi bla ma gong ma phal cher mjal zhing chos thob 84

ga / /na rma pa sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//tshul sogs gzigs snang du byung ba ni brjod kyis mi lang / de nas sgam po dang / kong po/ rtswa ri g.yu mtsho sogs la yang
