thegs ngo mtshar gyi ltas su ma dang rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhes/ khrang dogs po'i chu la mkha' 'gros bye lam gtod pa la thams cad byon/ spyir kong por lo gsum bzhugs/ yul gru thams cad la byon/ kong por dgon gnas mang po phyag btab/ kong po brag dkar zhes pa brag ri rje btsun rdo rje snag mo'i rang byon gyi bha ga las bdud rtsi drangs te brag dkar lha chu'i gnas sgo phye/ na rma pa rang rdo dgung lo sum cu pa chu glang rabs lo 5308/ lhag lugs 219riphyi lo 1 313khor gu ru las — rtsal gyis lho brag nas snying thig gter las bton pa'i shog ser du la/ yang dgung lo so lnga ba rab byung lnga ba'i sa rta dbas lo thu31 da/ phug lugs 2199/ phyi lo1318/lor mtshur phu'i skung na bzhugs skabs phyi nang gi gza' skar dus sbyor thams cad gzigs te rtsis — kun las btus pa'i bstan bcos mdzad/rje 'dis dus 'khor gyi dgongs pa ji bzhin gzigs nas mdzad pa'i bstan rtsis ni dus 'khor ba gzhan rnams kyis 'dod pa'i lo grangs las/ lag pa 182gdengs can zla bas dman pa yin te/ mkhas grub o rgyan pa'i bstan rtsis dang phyogs mthun pa yin/de nas dgyes rdor brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa mdzad jojo gangs la sogs par dben gnas mdzad/ gzhu'i gru bzhir bzhugs tshe 'gro don gyi ltas gzigs nas mtshur phu'i phreng stod du bde chen gyi dbon pa btab/ zab mo nang don gyi gzhung chen ljags rtsom mdzad/ bde chen yang ri'i chu mig brgya rtsar khrid mdzad tshe 'od gsal rgyu lus nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu song ba'i sgom chen pa mang du byung / der bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba'i dgongs don bkral ba dang / dam tshig rgya mtsho'i rtsa 'grel brtsams/ rje'i sgrub phug gi nang du sku rgyab dang thog la dbu'i rjes steng du zhabs rjes sogs 'dam la brdzid pa ltar mang po mjal rgyu yod/ spyir bde chen yang rir dbu zhwa phur ba'i rjes sogs rang byon mang po dang / bu slob sgom chen bden pa mthong ba brgyu dang brgyad bcu lus ma spang bar mkha' spyod du gshegs shul rdza spyil dang / g.yam spyil grangs med yod cing / bde chen gyi gdan 'dzin mkhas grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa sha stag bsko 'ja' mi dzad/ seng ge lung du rtogs ldan grags song dang/ rin chen gling du khu por rtogs ldan cags bu slob rnams nas bskyang sa/ skabs 86

ri༄༅ / /mcho/ pa sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//der mkhas grub bzang la rags pa du ma byung ba'i rtags kyis zhal slob zhwa dmar rtogs ldan grags nga seng ge lta bur yang bde chen gyi gdan 'dzin sko ba ma mdzad pa snang / de nas jo mo gangs dang / g.yas ru shangs/ dpal ldan sa skya/ nyang stod smad bar gsum/ yar 'brog sogs la byon par sangs rgyas byang sems mang pos zhal gzigs lung bstan dang / dbang lung gdams ngag du ma dngos su gnang ba'i gzigs snang mtha' yas shing /gnas dgon 'dus sde mang por bsnyen bkur dang / nyams gso gsar 'des ba kyi mthun rkyen dang yo byad phyogs med du bkye/ yul 4nge de rnams kyi skye 'gro thams cad thar pa'i sa bon la bkod/ mtshur phur gzhal med khang phyis gzhal yas khang zer dang rgya phibs sogs gsar bzhengs mdzad/skyes rabs so bzhi'i cha lag ston pa'i skyes rabs brgya pa ljags rtsom mdzad/ mtshur phu lha lung gi sku 'bus zhig gso dang gser gsol mdzad tshe ma 'ongs par dge slong drung du gyur pas rgyal ba —byams pa'i mchod rten byed par mkhyen/ kong po'i rgyal khams kyi mi dngu mi ma yin thams cad kyis slar yang spyan tsho/ phebs lam du sgam por bla ma lha rje dpag med mjal/ rtsa ri yul stod bar byon ded chos gsungs pa'i bzhugs khri yod/ der phag mo'i phyag dpe rlung gis 'gyed nas ma 'dus pas 'dir nga'i chos kyi bstan pa 'byung gsungs pa la phag mo kur lugs ma gnas der dar/ rtsa ri gsar rnying du ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa du ma gzigs shing sngar mi gsal ba'i gnas dang rang byon du ma zhal phye/ rta bar rgyal 'dzin du gtsang po kha phyogs te tshal dang zhing mang po khyer nas mtshor gyur pa la bden tshig gis phyag nas 'thor bas gtsang po kha bsgyur te mi ser rnams sa zhing bkol cirung ba byung / rnam thos tshal du kong ral kha gsum gyi skye bo rnams 'dus pa la chos rgya dkar pos gnas ska bas dang mthar thug gi bde ba la bkod/nags mdar bzhugs dus nags phu'i sa dang lam gyi bkod pa thams cad gsungs nas nags phur sgrub sde btab/ dgun shin tu grang ba la sgrub chu mi 'khyag pa dang / dgu 'dren dus ba sur dang stag ma sogs la me tog bzhad par byin gyis rlabs pas da lta'ang de ltar du yod/ lo gcig gi nang tshud du dgon pa dang sgrub sde mang po phyag btab/ lkog phreng du zab mo nang don gyi rang 'grel mdzad/ shar las gshin gyi gnas rgya la seng gtam du 86

༄༅ / /kurma pa sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//gzigs te ngan 'gro dpag med drangs/ bang ram spang du tshad ma paṇ+ḍi ta'i re zhu ltar rtsa ri'i mkha' 'gro bu mo bco brgyad 'gug pa mdzad nas dngos su bstan phyag dbang dang dar mdud re rkarma nang so'i chibs pa gcig bcas gnang ste phyir dengs gsungs nas yal/ bon gyi chos 'byung las rab byung drug pa'i lcags rta rabs lo 5325/ phug lugs 2221/ phyi lo 1330/lor bon ri pa 'brug sras kyis kurma pa dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran pa la rje rang byung zhabs kyis bon ri'i gnas sgo phye te brag la nyi zla'i rang byon gyi rtags dang zhabs rjes mang po bzhag de nas mtshur phur phebs bstan pa'i chobya ba rgya chen po mdzad/ tshal pa'i drung chen smon lam rdo rjes gdan drangs nas bzhugs skabs g.yag sde paṇa chen gyis mjal du bcar nas phyag ma phu lta/ bdag dad na dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bstan pa lags pas zhag 'ga' zhabs phyir bsdad nas brtag par zhus pas mnyes bzhin gnang / rjes nyin bar dge bshes du mar mdo sngags kyi bshar chen rgya mtsho lta bu mang du gsungs/ mtshan mo dbang rjes gnang zab khrid dpag med gnang /bar rnams su skye bo dpag tu med pa la mjal kha dang / cig ser yig pa dpag med la ngo len zhal bkod/ tshol pa'i sku gsung thugs rten mang po dang khyad par tshal ba'i bka' bstan 'gyur mang po gsar bzhengs kyi 'bri zhus dag ther sogs la 'al bkod bcas rlabs chen gyi mdzad pa rgya mtsho lta bu mtha' dbus mi mngon pa rnags gcig go gcig gis mi 'gag cing mtshar du dngar ba la sku gsung thugs dal zhing lhod chags pa las kyang mi g.yo bar gzigs/ chos kyi dka' gnad rnams zhus pa la de tsam dka' ba ma yin te/ de las gzhan 'di dang lta bu'o zhes gsungs pa na sngon rna lam du ma gsan pa du ma gsan/ nyin re bzhin rje 'di mkhas pa dang grub pa'i mtha' rjes mi dpog par song bas khong bis de rnams blo'i ra ba las yongs su brgal te zhabs la spyi bos gtugs/ zla med pa'i sprul pa'i sku rin po che zhes rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog ༄tu 'dzin par mdzad/ gzhan yang thos pas dregs pa dang bsgoms pas dregs pa mang pos pa mjal ba na khong rang gi nga rgyal dang bstun te ming nas 'bod pa dang bsngags pa yang— mdzad/ sngon gyi khyed4spyod dang / 'a byung 'gyur sogs yi ger bkod de'ang sor gnang bas5sams cad nga rgyal zhi ste snod ldan gyi slob mar kasmir pa mang spu du byung / sko 87

༄: / /na rma pa sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//skestod lung nyan gyi phur chab stod lung chab mtshan la ljags reg ma thag 'di lta chu pal pa gsum gnyis dang sman gyi chu gsum cha gcig tu snang / shar nas skye ba'i chu dron mo shed med 'di chu phal pa ste gsum gnyis dang / nub nas babs pa'i chu grang mo shed can 'di sman gyi chu ste gsum cha gcig snang ngo gsungs pas mkhas pa shes rin yid ma ches/ de nas byin rlabs mdzad pas chu pal pa skye ba nub/ sman chu de cher 'phel bas yul yī rnams kyis sngon grang mo 'di gsum cha gcig tsam las med/ da res rje phebs nas gsum 'gyur du 'phel zhing sngar bas bsil la nus pa che ba lha dug zer bas/ngas de skad byas te dge —bshes 'dis nga'i tshig la yid mi ches par 'dug gsungs pas dge bshes zhum zhing dad par gyur te/ shin tu lkog 'gyur thams cad mkhyen pa'i yul/ — /mngon sum nyid du mjal bzhi blo ldan ming / /byol song phyugs kyi 0phyug ga dang rab mdzangs pa/8 /bdag blos ci no tshongs par gyur pa mthol zhing bshags/ /slan chad khyed kyi rnam shes tshogs drug 'di/ /bya ba sgrub dang so sor rtogs pa yi/ /ye shes dag pa dri mi tshod yin min gyi/ /the tshom gcod mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes ched du bstod pa byas so/ /rnam thos tshal du rgyal ba'i dzems bstan pa'i tshe lo tsā sgyur zhig gsungs pas/ dge bshes skad 'gag nas mi thon ma chi zhus par/ khyod rang sgyur zhig skad ngas shes gsungs nas byin gyis rlabs pas skad che zhing snyan pa byung/ lo tsā zhus tshar ba dang yang khong gi skad sngon ma ltar las ma byung bas shin tu mtshar nas bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa brjod/ khong tsa ri'i zhol du lo gsum sgrub pa bgyi bar byin gyis rlabs su gsol zhus tsa/ khyod la bar chad 'ong / dbus gtsang du'ang 'khrug pa chen po 'ong / nga'i phyag phyir khams phyogs su 'dong gsungs/ de ma thag tshal khams gnyis 'khrugs/ 'di lags sam zhus pas 'di ni mgo 'dzugs tsam yin rim par 'ong gsungs pas/ de nas sa skya'i bzhi thog dang dpon chen nang zhig sogs dbus gtsang kun ma bde/ hor dmag mang po 'grims pa sogs gsung ji lta ba bzhin 'byung bas/ yang dge bshes nas dus gsum 'a/ ni sgrib pa mi mnga' bas/ kun mkhyen sgrib med de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes sogs bstod pa mang du mdzad/ de ltar skyid shod dang dwags kong thams cad du chos 'khor bskor ba la chos khri g.yo ba dang 'ja' 'od ngo mtshar gyi 88

༄༅ / /kurma pa sku phreng sa sum pa rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//ltas du ma byung / slar khams kyi nam byon/ mar lam sog chu kha zhes pa'i chu chen du 'gro ba rnams bsgral par dka' zhing tshe srog la nyen kha che bar gzigs te rab byung drug pa'i sa sbrul lor sog lcags zam btsugs par mdzad/ de dang phyogs mtshungs u pa lar yang lcags zam 'dzugs par — mdzad de skye bo du ma 'gro 'ong gi bsgral bar dka' ba'i sdug bsngal las bskyabs/ na mer zhi lhag zung du chud pa'i bsam gtan pa shin tu mang ba byung zhing / der klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa ji gzhin rtogs nas chos dbyings bsnod pa'i rnam bshad mdzad/ dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal po'i gnas la sogs kyi chu la zam pa mang po btsugs/ mkha' 'gro'i brda ri las/ rgyud kyi bdag po 'bum pa'i don legs par dgongs te/ rnal 'byor gsum snying gi dgongs pa bkral/ der kun bzang gi spyod pa'i smon lam yang mdzad/ dgon gsar lhun grub steng du bzhugs/ phal chen zhing bkod kyi bstod ya mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas zhal gzigs dang lung bstan tshigs su bcad pa yang yang byung / bod du ma gcig gi gcod yul brgyud pa'i nang nas khyad par gyi bka' babs ni drung thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung zhabs la mnga' ba de las brgyud pa'i gcod rgyud zur mang lugs da lta'ang phyag len nyams bzhes dar rgyas su bzhugs pas 'di kho na byin rlabs gzhan las lhag par che bar grags so/ /gzhan yang rje 'dis mdo sngags bka' gter gyi chos thams cad dang / rig pa'i gnas gang yang gsan bsam ma mdzad pa med la thams cad dpyis phyin pa tha stag dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum ji ltar mdzad pa de re rer yang 'di kho nar sku tshe gcig la nyams bzhes mdzad par 'dug snyams pa kho na dang / sa cha yul ris phyogs med du byon te dben gnas sgom sgrub mdzad pa ni grangs kyis mi lang zhing zhabs kyi ma bcag pa'i sa dang sgrub pa ma mdzad pa'i gnas thed pa yul lung 'di dang / thab gnas 'di la rje rang byung zhabs kyis lo gsum dang lnga dang / bdun la sogs pa bzhugs zhes kun gyis gleng bar byed cing so sor phyag zhabs kyi rjes bcas mjal rgyu yod pa ltar sku tshe hril por sgrub pa kho na mdzad pa lta bu/ bstan bcos brtsams pa dang gnas tshodi ka ne phye gi bteb pa / rtene bzhengs mdzad pa4 la'ang di lta bu5 bo case 'phrin la se na me pa bzhi'i sgo nas the ston ri 'gro'i sna do no be+e ngo do me'i ri la rnam 89

༄༅ / /ma rma nga/ sku phreng gsu/ma pa rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//na na thar bsam gyis mi khyab cing snyigs 'gro'i blo'i ra ba las yongs su brgal bas na mi rnams gya tshom gyi gnas su lhungs bar yang 'gyur na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad 'phrin la ltems kyang med par nges shes brtan pos yi rangs byed dgos pa gnad dam pa'o/ de nas nam pa rang byung rdo rje dgung lo 48/ rab byung drug pa'i lcags lug rabs lo 5386/ phug lugs 2212/ phye lo 133 1/lor hor rgyal po'i mi rabs bcu pa thog the mur (2 gle khrasgo po)'ja' yan du rgyal go nas gser yi ga pa mgon po tshang tshing sogs la 'ja' sa dang sngon yi rma pak+ṣi ra mong gol rgya lo pos phul nas ma bzhes pa'i gser gyi tham ga 'ja' zer ma 'bul ba bcas spyan 'dren par dbus su 'byor te gong ma'i 'ja' sa ring mor/ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs kyis bsod nams chen po'i dpal la brten nas rgyal po nged kyi lung rang —byung rdo rje la gsol ba/ zhes pa sogs dad gdung chen pos ring ba'i stabs su 'phul ba'i lung dang / sa skya la sogs pa'i bod kyi bla dpon rnams la yang bka' shos bstsal ba la gser yig pa rnams dang lhan cho cig tu gyis la/ rin po che rkarma pa gar bzhugs su song na'ang khyed rnams kyis grogs dan gyis/ le lo dang 'dzol ba byung na nyes pa khyed rnams la len du 'ong / zhes pa sogs 'byor bas ti shri kun dga' rgyal mtshan 'di sa skya'i lha khang bla brang gi gdung rgyud gras rin chen dpal nas bzung hor rgyal rabs gsum gyi ti thi mdzad pa yin/la sogs pas 'ja' sa bsgrags te chos rje rin po cher nges par phebs grub pa'i zhu 'bul dang / phebs rdzong btegs/ de nas lug lo zla ba —bdun pa la hor yul du phyag btegs/ 'dam gzhung du phebs pa dang rgyal po'i sku tshe la bar chad yong bar 'dug da res song yang mi mjal bar 'dug gsungs nas mtshur phur phyir log mdzad pas hor yul du rgyal po 'ja' yan du 4zla ba brgyad pa la kyin jang hur sku gshegs/ slar yang gdan zhu'i gser yig pa byung ba ltar dgung lo 49 pa rabs lo 5372/ mtshur lugs 220( / phyi lo 1332/chu sprel zla2pa lo hor yul du chibs bsgyur/ rgya bod kyi phebs lam du 'gro don mtha' yas pa mdzad/ rgyal po gnam du gshegs sa kyin jang hur yin pa mkhyen te der phebs pa dang sgrib sbyang bi cho ga mdzad/ rgyal bu rat+na shīs rab tu dad pa'i sgo nas rtsa ba'i bla mar bkur te kyin jang hur ner sde'i dgon pa bzhengs/ lo de'i zla 10tshes 18la rgyal —90

༄༅ / /kurma pa sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// tsho po'i pho brang shang tor du pheb sa/ rgyal po rin chen dpal blon po dang bcas pas bsu ba dang bkur sti rgya chen pos mchod/ da dung —rgyal po rin chen —dpal yang sku tshe thung bar lung bstan nas dbang dang 'pho ba la sogs pas rjes su bzung ste zla ba gcig nas gshegs/ de'i gcen po tho gan the mur bya ba sman rtse'i yul zer ba'i rgya nag gi sung rgyal rabs gnas yul nan cing dang hang gro2 khul la zer/ rgya nag chen po na bzhugs pa rgyal sar bsko ba la rtsis pa —rnams dang chos rje rin po che'i lung gis zla ba drug 'then nas de'i ring ol the mur gyis srid bskyangs/ kurma rang byung rdo rje dgung lo 50pa rab byung drug pa'i chu mo bya zla1tshes 15rabs lo 5328/ phug lugs 2214/ phyi lo 1333/nyin rgyal po spyan 'dren pa'i( mi bye ba phrag mang po lam mi gshog pa'i dbus su rgyal po gur dkar chen po'i nang gser khri la bzhugs pa la skyangs ring nas rin po che'i sdun bsu bar byon te zhabs la spyi bos gtugs/ yon mchod lhan cig par pho brang shang tor du phebs/ rgyal po rgyal rgyud/ ol thi mur/ tha'i shi sogs dad pas 'dud cing thams cad dam pa'i chos cikyi las bzang por dkri bar mdzad/ tha'i shri dang mi dpon mang po'i bar 'khrug chen byung bar/ zhal ta gnang ste bsdums/ chu bya zla 6pa'i tshes 8la pho brang shang tor du hor rgyal po chen po tho gan the mur ge sar dbang bskur te chos rje rin po ches shis brjod kyang mdzad/ma gong ma'i lung gis rin po che'i nye gnas grags brtson las ka chen por spar/ rgyal po btsun mo sras dang bcas pa la dbu thog tu bum pa bzhag nas dbang bskur ba'i tshe khong rnams kyi so so'i rtogs pa gang shar ba mkhyen te lan btsal bas thams cad mngon par ma khyen pa la ha las te mi byed pa'i dad pa thob/ de nas thugs rje chen pos lung bstan pa dang / rgyal po chen po'i lung gis khyed chos kyi dbang phyug lags pas bdag la rigs 'dzin pad+ma'i tshe chu bstsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de lta na bod kyi bsam yas nas 'don dgos gsungs nas len cig bod du 'byon par chas pas/ gong ma chen pos chos thams cad stong nyi da du rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas na rma pa zhes pa'i mtshan gyi cho lo dang / shel gyi spel na gser yig sgor mo rnams 'ja' cisar phul/ nyid kyi zhal slob mdo khams na ting 'dzin ji bzang po/ tshal pa dgi sbyong chen sna po sogs la si tu'i dam ga dang la so ka che ba gnang ci/ khongs 91

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//gtogs tsa ri gsar rnying la sogs pa'i gnas dgon rnams la'ang gser bre la sogs pa'i sku 'khyos kyi yo byad che ba phul/ mtshur phur thog the mur 'ja' yan du gong ma'i yin thang 'dzugs rgyu dang / mtshur lung pa rnams dar rgan dar gan du phul/ rkarma pa rang byung rdo rje dgung lo 51pa shing byi zla 5tshes 15la rabs lo5329/ phyi lo 133ri phyag btegs te rgya nag gi ri bo rtse lnga ra byon/ gnas der 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi 'phrin las kyi bkod pa gzigs/ mi nyag 'gar lha khang dgon pa nyams gso dang chos kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa mang po bskos/ 'khrugs pa che chung mang po bsdums/ smar khams nas na rma brgyud 'gro don dpag med pa mdzad/ yang dgung lo nga gnyis pa shing mo phag zla5tshes 25nyin te la 'dam gzhung du phebs/ dbus gtsang na che ba thams cad kyis bsu ba ja 'dren bkur ste bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhus/ de nas gdan sa mtshur phur phebs/ dgun bsam yas mchims phur zla ba drug bzhugs nas mkhas btsun mang po'i sgrub sde btsugs mkhas btsun klong chen rab 'byams pha khrid pa dpon du bskos/ rin po che las bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog bzhengs te rab tu sa nas par mdzad/ gong ma'i sku tshe bsring ba'i ched du bsam yas phu nas rdzu 'phrul gyis tshe chu spyan drangs gong ma nas gdan 'dren gser yig pa yang yang byung na sa dgung lo 53me pho byi ba'i zla 8tshes 8spar yang hor yul du thengs gnyis pa phyag btegs/ phebs lam du 'gro don dpag med mdzad de gong ma'i pho brang du phebs/ mchod yon gnyis dang nang blon tha'i shri kho na las med sar gong ma la tshe dbang gnang ste tshe chu drangs/ de'i stobs kyis hor gyi rgyal sa mnan pa la rgyal po sku tshe ring shos 'di byung / de nas gyi mi shan du bzhugs skabs sa g.yos 'byung nyen 'dug gsungs pas gong ma mchod yon gzim gur la bzhugs/ na rma pa rang byung rdo rje dgung lo 54rab byung 6pa'i me mo glang lo'i rabs lo 5332/ phug lugs 2218/ phyi lo 1337/zla 8pa der gyim mi shan zhes pa'i pe cin nye 'khor du sa g.yos kyis mkhar grong mang po zhigs/ je la skyabs zhus pa thams cad la skyon ma byung / ska bas der rgya dang mdo smad pa'i ban+de ngan pa 'ga' zhig gi bya spyod la brten nas chos la mi dga' ba dang / mi dpon mang po'i bsgos phyogs kyis dgon pa rnams bshigs/ ban de mi gtsang ba thams cad khral dmag — 92

༄cu/ /kurma pa sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//'ul gsum bskul rgyu'i lung bsgrags pa la sus kyang zhu ngo ma 'drong / de'i tshe pho brang gi khrims ra 'u mon gdong gi tshogs chen sar rin po che phebs nas khri'u la bzhugs/ rgyal blon thams cad la rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa'i bka' bkyon pas thams cad dad cing bskrags nas/ de ma thag dgon gnas lha khang rnams gan nas gso ba dang / ban de thams cad gtsang mi gtsang med par dar gan du 'don pa'i 'ja' sa phyogs thams cad du bsgrags/ ta'i tu'u 'am rgya skad du hrang tu zer/shing kun la kur sde'i dgon pa bzhengs/ 'bri phag gi rin po che la shel gyi sbel ka dang / mtshur phu'i gdan sa pa la gser tham gnang / de nas gong ma'i gsung bis gzhan bla mchod thams cad nas sbyin bdag dang / dbang ris sa cha'i zhal ta zhu gi 'dug nyid la de lta bu gsung zhu med lags sam zhus par/ kho bo la'ang kong po'i rgyal khams mi khyim 'bum phrag tsam yod gsungs/ zho na de'i mi dpon la nged kyi gnang sbyin dang las ka chen po bye de zhus pas/ de rnams nged kyis thugs rje chen po la gsol ba btab nas chos kyis 'dul ba las mi dpon gyis 'dul mi nus gsungs/ las ka gnang sbyin ma bzhes/ de nas hwa ching sang zer ba so gas nag phyogs pa 'ga' nas gnam mchod pa rnams la gtser ba dang / rgyal blon rnams kyis bod du phebs su ma ster ba bcas kyis chos rje rin po che thugs chad/ kurma rang byung rdo rje dgung lo 55pa sa pho stag zla 3par rabs lo 5333/ phug lugs 2219/ phyi lo 1338/rgyal blon kun 'dzoms sar rnal 'byor nga ni nam mkha'i sprin dang 'dra/ gar 'gro mi shes pas chos don sgrub par 'dod pa rnams myur bar sgrubs shig gsungs/ de ma thag nam mkha' las 'gro mgon chos kyi rje mya ngan las 'das so/ /zhes pa'i sgra dang sa g.yos chen po byung / gong ma rgyal blon rnams la nyin bzhin du chos dang zhal lta mdzad/ zhal gdams tshigs bcad ma mang po yang gsungs/ kurma pa rang byung rdo rje dgung lo 56pa sa mo yos kyi zla 6tshes 8nyin rabs lo 5334 phug lugs 2220/ phyi lo 1339/lor cung zad bsnyun pa'i tshul bstan/ tshes 14nyin phyed dus rgyal blon kun gyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'i tshe 'dul 'dzin pa la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad byon 'dug mchod pa shogs shig gsungs/ ljags dbugs sngar las brel ba mthong nas blon po chen po rba yan tha'i shis ngus te bdag can rnams la thugs rjes — 93

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mdzad rnam zhib bkod bzhugs so//trewa wag rigs te mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs su gsol zhus par/ nga bod yul du 'gro snyams pa yin te khyed rgyal blon la ma grub nga'i bka' las 'das gsungs/ slar yang da res sku khams dwangs bar mdzad du gsol/ bod du spyan 'dren no zhus pa sa da snga par yang song zin/ de tsam du song nas zlog mi nus pas zhing gzhan du 'gro/ rgyal blon rnams la bstan pa dang rgyal khrims chos bzhin skyongs / rnal 'byor nga ni zhing khams gzhan du 'gro/ khyed rnams dam pa'i chos la brtson par gyis/ gsungs/ pho brang shang tor du mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan/ tshes 15nub mo zla ba shar ba'i tshe gong ma'i pho brang nang ma'i sgo srung res pas ran thi mur gyis zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du chos rje ri po che mchod rten nang na sku dngos su bzhugs pa mthong / grogs la sbran pas sgo sung bco brgyad kyis mthong / res dpon gyis gong ma la zhu ba thengs pas/ gong ma dpon blon phal che bas mjal de tshe pho brang gi steng nas dar 'phyar dung bus mchod rdzas dang bdug spos sgrengs te rgyal blon thams cad kyis phyag dang gsol ba smon lam btab/ gong ma'i lung gis de'i 'dra thang gnyis bzhengs su bcug gcig gong ma'i pho brang du bzhugs nas sku 'dra zla zhal ma /rdo/ sro/ ༵ /sa ri~X dī 'i ༵༵༵ /rdo na ga zlo/ ga ri sum ༵༷ chu bye doXn 'a ༵ dī rdod ba/ rgyu/ byon ༷mtho ༵ tshur bye ༷ zlo wa ra dī/ ༵/ la ༵ sdo dī hor zlo /byen ci g.yog gis mthong / de bzhin du rtse lngar seng ge chibs nas byon te dga' ldan du 'gro gsung ba sogs rang rang la dag pa'i snang ba du ma bstan/de nas zhag bcu bzhir rgyal po'i 'byor pa dpag tu med pas mchod de go shri dang mi chen thams/ cad kyis mdo li la spyan drangs te tshes nyer lnga la tsan dan a ga ru nag pos sangs rgyas dang 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gyi gdung lta ra sbya ngas// de'i tshe lta sa bzang bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / 'ja' tshon sna tshogs nam mkha' khyab pa'i gseb nas drung gi sku mang du snang ba phal cher gyis mjal/ nam mkha' nas ā li ka li'i sgra yang grags/ tshes 26nyin gdung zhal 'byed skabs ut+pal spungs 'dra'i sprin gyi dbus su chos rje rin po che bzhugs nas nub phyogs su byon pa dang / gnas () /

༄༅ / /ma rma pa sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so // ci//sna //rdzu /rdzu sna las dung /sdo // ༵༵ /zlo //la rgya ༵ ༵༵ ༵ / bod tsha/ bye/ //bye rdzu/ ༵༵nga bye dzī ba la sa ste mcho/da ༵ 'i ༵༵ /shā ༵ ra byes/ bla rno / / snye / sgo la / rnga / lda the skye / bye ma ga lha su ‘ gra / pa bye snye wa rdo sgyu ci 4 ji dzo ri |/ ༷ ༷ ༷ wa khro hūṃ wa/ wa ༷ bye — rdo ri ci tshal cha tshon zhu ༷ di spang rin po che/ mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal po/ dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan po rimakhas ba tsun pa/ kun ma khyen klong chen rab 'byams pa sogaso mkhas — grub dpag med dang / go'i shri kun dga' rgyal po/ tā de ben go'i shri dkon :sgo rin che ne/ si tu dbe sbyong chen ci po' me tshal me'i si tu dge ba'i blo ci gros/ bla ma ting 'dzin bzang po sogs rgya dbus khams kong gi gdan sa skyong ba mtha' yas/ shing thams cad brjod ྅nyes ci mi lang / rje 'di'i gsung rtsom yang pod grangs sum cu brgal ba bcas bzhugs so// skya lam pa sku phreng bzhi nga/ rol pa/'i ngo rje ni rab byung drug pa'i lcags 'brug rabs lo 5335/ phug lus sa bstan pa'i 'das lo'i 222 1/ phyi lo 1340 lor 'khrungs /sto— gye snar —mo'i chi cho9 5

༄༅ / /kurma pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//༄༅ / /ma rma pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje rnam thar/na rma pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje ni/ sngon pho brang shang to hrang tu'u ru sku'i bkod pa bsdus te zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nas 'dzam gling la gzigs/skad cig gis dga' ldan du byon/ bcom ldan 'das byams pas bskul te shel gyi skas las slar mi yul du gshegs pa'i cho 'phrul gyis yum gyi lhums su bzhugs nas chos rje rang byung rdo rje sku dngos slar byon pa ltar mdzad/ sku 'da' khar ta dben go shri dkon mchog rin chen gyis rin po che gang du skye ba bzhes pa kho bo yang der yong 'dod pas nges pa zhig gsung bar zhus pas/ khyod de tsam du mos na nga kong por 'ong gsungs pa dang zhal chems phyag bris bcas don mthun par kong po dang mdo khams kyi bar rngod a la rong gi brag ra go chen pre dkar gyi gnam rdzong deng skabs chab mdo /za/ /rdo rno //dī rgyan //dī la // byung zlo// pa'i cho~X /sa co/bru shā /du/ /tshe ༷nga8 bstuX /// /na sbyaXlu /༷2 /22)me sbya /rngo sdu 0la sku // sdus 'do gdung lha ldong /deb dmar du 'khrungs lo shing pho rta dang / gdung gcor sogs mjad yang 'dir phyogs mang po dang mthun pa ltar 'khrungs gler 'brug byas/rje btsun 'di rgya yul du sku gshegs te dga' ldan du bzhugs me la bcom ldan 'das byams pas yang dag par bskul nes yum gyi lhums su gshegs tshe mngal dag pa'i shel gyi pho brang du gyur ba sogs kyi mdzad pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab/ mngal du bzhus/sa pa'i tshe ma ṇi'i sgra grogs pa dang / 'phrul 'khor mdzad pas yum gyi lus 'phar zhing g.yo ba la sogs pa byung / sku bltams ma thag ma ṇi dang dbyangs gsal gyi gsung byung bas yab dogs pa skyes pas/ yum gyis nga la rmi lam bzang po mang po sgyeng bas the tshom mi dgos zhes rmis ltas gsudas pas dogs pa gsal bar gyur/ ngo mtshar gyi ltas mngon gsal can mang po byung / dgung lo gsum pa chu rta (5337/ 2223/ 1342/)la myang por byon/ de'i tshe yum la nga kurma pak+ṣi'i skye ba yin/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir nga'i gdul bya mang po 'ongs/ khyod ltos shig gsungs nas 'chi med 'phru lda 'khor mdzad/ da lha sar 'byon dgos zhus pas/ da la96

༄༅ / /rkarma pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so/ /'a sha ba la na rad e thon/ sngon la kong po'i zho kha dang / brag phyi/ nag phu rnams su phyin nas lta dgos pa 'dug kong yul gshin rje'i dong kha'i 'og na sto dmyal ba'i zangs kha yod pas de nas sems can mang po 'dren dgos pa yod/ nga'i zhal mthong bas ngan sdong du mi 'gro ba yin/ mtshur phu dang /rkarma dang / hor rgyal po'i pho grang sogs la'ang rim gyis 'gro/ rgyal po'i pho brang sogs la'ang nga'i gdul bya dpag tu me da pa yod pa yin gsungs/drung nyid nam pak+ṣi'i skye ba lags na chos rje rang byung rdo rje ma las sa bsam zhus pas/ de gnyis khyad med gsungs/ yum gyi mig la ling thog byung nas smre sngags bton pas/ khyed sems ma phams —ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro brgya rtsa brgyad kyi gcig yin/ sang phod da tsam khyed la phyag 'tshal ba yang mad po 'ong gsungs nas ljags mchil btab pas bsal/ nga ko nga po bu chu gser gyi lha khang bi rgyab tu gnas gsar pa gcig btab/ kurma pa rol rdo dgung lo drug pa shing bya rabs lo5340/ phug lugs2226/ phyi lo1345lor brag rgyal lha khang du phyogs nas dbu zhwa dang zhabs rjes la ngos 'dzin gnang / dgung lo bdun ri pa me khyi rabs lo5341/ phug lugs2227/ phyi lo1345lor nā ro chos drug bi khrid dang mgur mdzad/ dgung lo dgu pa sa byi ba'i rabs lo5343/ phug lugs2229/ phyi lo1348lo nas kho bo la gdul bya mang po 'ong ba yin gsungs/ de nas myang po dang kong po sogs yul lung mang por byon nas skye bo mang po la khyod 'di dang 'di yin/ khyod kyi khang pa 'di lta bu yod/ khyod kyis ra la 'di dang 'di 'bul bar phul myong ba sogs snga phyi dran pa mang po gsungs pas mi rnams shin tu dad par gyur nas chos kyang mang du gsungs khyed grub thob rin po che yin na grub rtags ston dgos zhus par mchod khang gi bya rgya'i steng du bzhugs pa sogs mdzad/ tshod bgam phyir dom gyi khar 'phags pas dom gyis gus pa'i rnam 'gyur kyang byas/ rta bar rgyal 'dzin du byon skabs la stod pa ba rtogs ldan mgon rgyal pas tshogs gral du me bus pa la tshad pa tsha bsil g.yab khyer shog gsungs/ bsil g.yab phul bas de g.yob cing rgya yu'/ dang 'dra ba 'dug rgya yul du bsil g.yab g.yob kyang tshu 'ub 'ub byed gsungs/ drung nas bde bar gshegs pa'i dus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor na bzhugs pa'i mi mang pos ma thong zer ba de ltar lags sam zhus pas/ de khong rang rnams 97

ri༄༅ / /la rma pa sku phreng ba'i pa rol/ pa'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//—wa wa kyi dad pa dang / nga'i snying rje la brten nas mthong ba yin/ nga la khong rnams kyis blta/sa nas 'di tsug byed cing 'dug gsu/ngas/ hor rgyal blon rnams kyis phyag byed pa sogs kyi lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyi lad mo mdzad/ de nas stan las bzhugs te zla ba dang / glang po che dang / seng ge la sogs par 'dug pa yang nga yin gsungs/ drung nas zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshes 14tho rangs rtogs ldan grags seng pa'i gzigs snang la/ drung ras dkar po'i ang rag bsnabs nas 'ja' 'od kyi klong du nam mkha' la bzhugs pa mthong ba la/ khong gis drung nas nges bu slob rnams la mi gzigs par bde bar gshegs pa ji ltar lags zhus pas/ nga la bsam pa bzad po yod kyang snyigs dus kyi se ma sa can gyi bsod nams las mi 'grub par 'dugasdig tu spyod pa grangs mang bas skyo ba skyes pa yin/ nga dga' lhan tsho du 'gro gsungs pa zhig khong gyi dag snang la byung 'dug drung nas de skad — ci gsungs pa lugs sam zhu sa pas/ de ltar yin de skyo ba skyes nas zhing du phyin pa yin de dze cang shes kyi rta dang / glang po dang / bya rgod la sogs pa sprul bsgyur mang po byas te phyin/ lar dga' ldan thag ring po na med gsungs/ de nas gzhan mang po yid ches pa'i phyir co 'dri ba 'ga' zhus te/dgazha ldan na chang 'di 'dra yod das zhus pas/ myos bye da 'di 'dra ba med/ bdud rtsi yod pa yin gsungs/ bdud rtsi kha dog nag po de bzang zer ba bden nam zhus par/ bdud rtsi kha dog mnag po de 4 zer ba bden nam zhus par ngas ma mthong / kha dog dkar ba la ro sna tshogs pa byas pa yod gsungs/ dga' ldan na tshal gung thang gi dar gdugs dad 'dra ba'i snyemachod rdzas 'di 'dra ba med pa 'dra zhus pas/ bla ma ba mi yul gyi mchod rdzas 'di 'dra ba g.yes chung / me tog re re la'ang kong po lkog phreng tsam pa yod gsungs/ yang dga' ldan na yar chab gtsang po 'dra ba'i chu yang med la/ kong po phrang dang / rta myog gi mkhar khang 'dra ba yang med zer/ rang re mi yul gyi skyed rdo ri mo can 'di 'dra'ang med pa 'dra zhus pas/ bla ma ba dga' ldan gyi chu thams cad bdud rtsi min/ mi yul gyi yar chab gtsang po 'dra ba'i chu med/ mi yul gyi sa rdo la sogs pa'i gses ma yang med/ lo rdo thams cad rin po che las grub pa yin/ bcom ldan 'das byams pa'i gzhal yas khang ngam/ byang chub sems pa blo gros rin chen (38

༄༅ / /ma rma pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//wa — gyi gzhal med khang ngam/ sum cu rtsa gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang la sogs pa thams cad rin po che sna tshogs 'ba' zhig las grub pa yin/ mi yul gyi mkhar khang ji lta'ang g.yes chung gsungs/ yang rta myog gi rta bzang po 'di rnams 'dra ba dga' ldan na yod dam zhus pas/ chos la dus tshod med na ban rgan 'chol bar 'gro gsungs/ de nas chos thams cad thugs su/ chud du zin kyang dpon slob kyi 'brel pa bstan pa'i phyir/ rtogs ldan mgon rgyal ba la nā ro'i chos drug dang sbyor drug la sogs bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa mang du gsan zhing / dbang yang mang po gsan/ de'i skabs so sor lha dang chos skyong la sogs pa mang du gzigs tshul rnams rnam thar mdzad pa pos zhib tu bkod snang yang / sangs rgyas kyis shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i phyir de rnams smros ci dgos/ gzigs snang rnam rol med du byas nas/ sems can gyi don mdzad tshul 'ga' zhig brjod par 'os so snyam mo/ des na sngon chos rje rang byung rdo rje sku nyid nas rnam thos tshal gyi chos/ khri'i rgyab tu shug pa'i yal ga skams po zhig btsugs nas/'di chos khri'i rgyab yol dang mnyam pa'i tshe kho bo 'dir 'ong ba yin gsungs pa bzhin rnam thos tshal gyi gnas su byon/ chos khri dang mnyam pa'i shug pa'i ljon pa la sku rgyab bsten te khri la bzhugs/ chos mang po gsungs nas kong ral kha gsu ma gyi skye 'gro mang por 'gro don rgya che mdzad/ nags phu gzim khang du byon nas rtogs ldan ye rgyal pa la mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud 'grel la sogs pa sngags gsar ma'i skor dang / mkha' 'gro'i snying thig dang bī ma la sogs rnying ma'i gdams pa mang du gsan/ bla ma rdza gshongs pa shes rab dpal la bka' 'gyur ro cog dang / bstan bcos mang po'i lung gsan/ slob dpon blo gros seng ge la byams chos ma lus pa gsan/ de nas snye bor phebs nas zhal ta la chu 'di'i pha rol tu mi 'gro bar chad 'ong gsungs bzhin du nan ma theg par byon pas zhal ta ltar bar chad cung zad byung / de nas khe nang du byon yang bar chad kyis ma bsdigs/de nas tsa rir byon bka' rgyud kyi bla ma dang / lha dang mkha' 'gro'i gzigs snang mang po byung ba dang / rtogs ldan mgon rgyal pa sogs pa'i don du mgur mang du gsungs/ tsa ri ston sngon bya ba las gu ru ku lbe'i sgrub thabs gsan/ rtogs ldan ma bon rgyal pa la sku gong ma dus ma yin par gshegs 9( /

tsho༅/ /ma rma pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//wa wadagos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / dga' ldan du byon pa/ gshegs dus kyi sku'i bkod pa bstan tshul/ dga' ldan nas mgon po byams pas bskul te slar mi lus du 'byon tshul sogs rgyas shing zhib pa de dus gsungs/ gzhan yang bu slo ba rnying pa rnams rim par mjal tshad kyis yar ma zhus par so sor mkhyen pa dang / sngon gyi rabs rnams gsungs pa dang / yi dam gzigs pa/ nyams rtogs dang dngos grub brnyes pa/ byin rlabs kyis nad gdon zhi ba/ 'phrin las kyis gdul bya btul ba/ dgon gnas btab pa/ 'khrugs chen bsdu mas pa/ mgur gsungs pa/ bstan bcos brtsams pa rmechos kyi bshad bka' gdams khrid mdzad nas smin grol la bsod tshul brir ma lang ste rgyas pa rnam thar dang mgur 'bum ngo mtshar can la lta bar bya'o/ de nas na rma pa rol rdo dgung lo dgu pa sa byi rabs lo5343/ phug lugs2229/ phyi lo1348/)lor mchog gi sprul sku'i snyan pa gsan nas tshal pa khri dpon kun dga' rdo rje'am si tu dge ba'i blo gros (1309 1364kyis zhu yig dang ja 'dren phul nas bzung mdo dbus kyi mi chen rnams kyis ja zhus dang 'bul ba phul/ yang dgung lo bcu pa glang lor zhwa dmar sku phreng dang po rtogs ldan grags seng gshegs pa mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa lcags stag lor mtshur phu nang pa'i gdan zhu ston 'khor 'byor/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa rab byung drug pa'i chu 'brug rabs lo5347/phug lugs 2233/ phyi lo1352/la dbus su phyag btegs/ yar lam yar lung du dbus gtsang gi bdag po tā si byang chub rgyal mtshun (1303 1371)gyis zhabs la spyi bos gtugs te phyag dang bkur sti bkur sti zhabs tog zab rgyas zhus tā sis bod khams yongs la dbang bsgyur ba'i lo bzhi pa yin/de nas 'on dang thel mkhar dmar bsam yas sogs su byon/ bsam yas pa mkhas grub nas dri ba zhus par/ 'di rnams sngon lha sa rkyang thang du la na btab tshar ba yin gsungs pas khong dad pa'i mchi ma byung / de nas tshal gung thang du si tu dbe ba'i blo gros kyis spyan drangs/ dpon slob gsar rnying mjal bas thams cad thugs 'dres shing tshims/ der sngon gyi skyes rabs rnams gsungs pas mchog tu dad par gyur/ de nas gnas nang du phebs/ bla ma dar rgyal pa la gzigs snang rnams gsungs/ spyil pu so so'i ba bo/da pa sngar 'di bzhin bya ba yod gsungs pa la sogs pas thams cad 100

༄༅/ /na rma pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so/ /ringes pa skyes par mdzad/ de nas 'og min mtshur phu'i gdan sar zhabs sor bkod/ der dgung lo bcu bzhi pa chu sbrul rabs lo5348/ phug lugs2230/ phyi lo1353/lor kha che paṇa chen gyi gdung rgyud gnas brtan chen po'i rnam sprul tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan chen don grub dpal pa dang / slob dpon bsod nams 'bum las rab tu byung ba'i tshul mdzad/ mtshan snyam khri rter chos kyi grags pa gsol/ mkhan po las dam chos 'dul ba'i skor mang du gsan/ sa skya'i chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan las 'jam dbyangs dmar po'i chos 'brel zhus/ rgyal ba g.yung ston pa rdo rje dpal dang mjal bar nye ba'i tshe zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor mang po gzigs/ g.yung ston dang mjal nas/ nga bla ma gong ma la mos gus yod nas 'ong ba yin/ drung pa gong ma rnams yin lugs shig gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ sngon kurma pak+ṣi ra gyur pa'i tshe rgya mtsho'i mthar thug par byon nas hor sogs lta ngan mang po btul ba'i lo rgyus gsungs pas khong rab tu dad nas mang du bshums/ der g.yung ston pa las rdo rje phreng ba dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ mdo sems/ sgyu 'phrul gyi dbang la sogs pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi dbang dang / rgyud dang man ngag rnams ma nga du gsan/ de nas la rma pa bzhi pa rol rdor dgung lo ba cu bzhi pa chu sbrul rabs lo5348/ phug lugs223sa phyi 'o 1353/'o der sa g.yos shing tu che ba bar ma chad par byung nas bod kyi mi nor sa khang la 'jigs tshabs shin tu che ba byung dus bod kyi lha mi'i mgo gtso rnams nas bla lha khag la skyabs zhus pas sus kyang bzlog ma nus/ de nas mchos si sprul pa'i sku ma rma par skyabs zhus te 'jigs pa rnams nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlabs nas bod kyi mi nor brog gsum mang po srog gi nyen kha las skyabs par mdzad/ de'i skor bod kyi rgyal rabs 'o/ rgyus deb ther kha cig las/ skabs der bod kyi bla ma bzang gsum rtogs ldan grub pa'i dbang phyug mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon gyi chos skyong khas bcas su la skyabs zhus kyang bzlog par ma nus pas/bod khams bde bar mdzad pa'i 'jigs skyabs kyi dam pa ni sangs rgyas na rma pa 'di kho na'o/ /zhes bsngags pa brjod pa'i yig cha'ang snang / 'di lo 'bru gung pas nang so skyor mo lung par dmag drangs/ rgya nag gi yig tshang du me sprel rol rdor dgung lo 17rabs lo 5351/ phug lugs2237/ phyi 101

༄༅ / /ma rma pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol nga/'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//lo1356/lor hor gong ma hrang the'am hrun ti ( rnye )tho tan thu mur gyis gdan zhus kyang brnyen par ma rdzogs pas ma phebs zer/ bod kyi yig tshang su kun dga' rdo rjes hor rgyal gong mar zhus pas/ hrang then phyag dang thal mo sbyar spyan chab bsil te/ gdan 'dren gyi 'ja' sa snyan ngag chen rma bod yig ma rten gsar 'bri gcig dngul bre gsum/ gos dar dgu tshan gsum/ dang bcas/ pa bkur nas dbon gyis mi dpon ding ju dpon dpon dang bar sde'i sde dpon dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ ti shri bsod nams shes rab bcas btang / de nas dgung lo bco brgyad pa me bya rabs lo5352/ phug lugs2238/ phyi lo1357/lo tsong kha sde khams su dpal blo bzang gras sa pa sku bltams pa'i lo der/ sngar gyi mkhan slob dang / dus bsgo ba slob dpon gzhon nu dpal gyis gsang ston mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs/'di 'bos lo dang nor ba'ang 'dug pas 'gos lo min/'dul ba'i bcas pa phra mo rnams kyang bsrung zhing / sha spu rtse tsam dang / chang gi dri tsam yang spyan lam du mi 'grim/ sku'i nye 'khor du glegs bam mang po bkod nas bzhag mnal lam du gzigs pas de thams cad kyi tshig don thugs su chud cing / yi ge'i rigs mi 'dra ba yang drug cu tsam mkhyen/ de nas se mo do/ mtsho mo ru khyung la sogs pa byang rnams su byon/ de nas bde chen phreng stod du byon slob dpon chen po rin chen dpal gu'i gung pa tā yon rgyal rabs skabs su bstsal ba'i cho lo ste/ rgyal po'i rigs su gtogs pa'i dpon rigs la sprod pa'i go gnas yin pa la pho brang ta'i tu'i bkod pa dang / mi'i grangs la sogs pa 'di 'dra yod gsungs nas yid gzung dang slar phyin dus nges par 'gyur la sogs pa gsungs/ de nas rim gnyis la rtse gcig tu zhol bas rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs kyi rdzu 'phrul du ma'i bkod pas grus pa'i rtags bsam gyis/ mi khyab pa bstan pa las gdul bya tshar gcod dang rjes 'dzin gyi 'phrin las la mnga' brnyed par gyur ba'i snyan grags kyi dbyar rnga phyogs bcur 'bog pa med par brdungs bar gyur/ der rje gong mas gsar du bzhengs pa'i gzhal yas khang gis/ gtsos pas mtshur phu'i rten brten pa rnams gsar 'debs lta bu'i nyams gso mdzad/ skyor mo rung par 'bri nang bi dmag btegs pa la skyid shod kyi lha sde mi sdes spyi zhus kyis chos rje sku gzhon nu lha sa rkyang thang du spyan drangs/ mi chen thams cad la /02

༄༅/ /na rma pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//wa wa ————bka' rin po che nan gyis gnang bas thams ced zil gyis non te dmag rang sar 'i/ che dgu thams cad kyis spyi bor bkur/ 'di lor gtsang phyogs su 'gro don la byon/ sa skya'i bla ma 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa dang mjal zhing phyag rtse sprod dang chos kyi gsung gleng 'phel bar mdzad/ snye thang brgya grong du dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su bla ma sa skya khu dbon dang chos rje pa bzhugs khri gsum gshibs nas gung la bzhugs/ khrom thams cad nas mjal ba tsam gyis dad gus kyis 'ur/ bla ma las chos 'brel bsan/ dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po sogs chen po thams cad gus pas 'dud/ slob dpon chen po bzhi thog pa dang mjal nas phyag rtse sprod mdzad/ de nas rgyal bu rat+na shris byang phyogs na yod pa'i rgyal bu rjes su rje la gos sku chen po 'bul mkhan de yin/chos rje sprul pa'i sku'i rnam thar thos nas li ji lag rtags 'bul ba chen po bcas bskur/ rgyal po chen po thog gan the mur nas kyang sprul sku byon tshul snga gong nas yang yang gsan yang the tshom ma chod pa las/ deng chung glang chung gong du slebs dus gong mas dri ba mdzad pas khong pas snyan grags chen po 'dug chal pa si tu chos rje gong ma'i slob ma dam tshig dang shes rab che bas khong bis chos rje gong ma yin nges su 'dug zer/ rtogs dpyod can thams cad kyis de ltar gtam gyin 'dus zhus pas/ bong ma phyag thal mo sbyar nas spyan chab byung / mdun gyi mi chen thams cad kyang de ltar gyur te hor rgyal pos bla ma'i mtshan gsan pas spyan chab byung ba 'di las med par grags/ de nas rgyal po chen po tho gan the myur sras dang bcas pas snyan pa gsan pa'i stobs kyis ding hu dben dpon dang / sde dpon dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i hor bod kyi gser yig pa dpon 'khor bod du mngags nas rgyal po'i 'ja' sa snyan ngag chen rma sogs/ 'u nga dang 'bul chen/ rgyal bu'i li ji lag rtags gnang sbyin rgya chen po bcas spyan 'dren par me bya lo mtshur phur 'byor/ ston po dbus/ gcang bdag po ta si byang chub rgyal mtshan nas gong du chibs sgyur zhabs skul phebs rdzong gi 'bul chen btegs/ kurma pa rol rdo dgung lo 192pa sa khyi rabs lo65353/ phug lugs2 839/ phyi lo1358/lo'i zla1po dang gnyis pa'i mtshams la/ lha sa'i gung thang du spyan drangs nas rdzongs pa byas/ zla bzhi pa 'i 20nyin mtshur phu nas sbrid la la brgyud/ kong 10 3

༄༅/ /ma rma pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//dgon dang sngags dgon la byon/ gad skyid bzhugs/ zla5tshes 11la lha'i lung po cher sgar btab/ cog tse la nas nag chu brgal/ zla 5tshes 29la rkyang ri rngog nas mgul du phebs/ der skye 'gro mang por chos gsung skabs 'ja' dang me tog bi char chen po byung / zla 6tshes 8la sog zam snar phebs/ zla 7bar gsar ma sgang du phebs/ sgom sde ras tshang pa'i bla mas gdan drangs/ zla8tshes 9nas tshes18bar 'gro don mdzad/ zla9tshes 12la cham la khar phebs/ tshes 18la na rma dgon du phebs/ zla10tshes 3la mdo khams kyi che rgu rnams spa ru khar tshogs pa khri phrag tsam byung / zla11tshes 6nyin chab mdo'i lha steng du byon/ tshes 15nyin kurma nas thegs/ tshes 16nyin gyim/ thang du sa skya 'i nye gnas dpal ldan bzang pos 'bul ba byas/ tshugs gnyis bar du sgar sa rnams kyis skyel thung byas/ tshes 18la sha hu la la byon nas zi dgon du zhag gnyis bzhugs/ tshes gyu 22nyin zi mda' ru a khros 'bul ba zhabs tog byas/ tshes 27la 'or du phebs/ zla 12tshes 1nyin ldan klong thang sgrol ma'i lha khang du phebs/ der rgya bza' kong jos gdan drangs pa'i sgrol ma mtho gang can de mjal/ gling tshang dang ldan/ sga/ 'bri sogs lha mi sde ba rnams la mjal kha btang / khams kyi 'bri chur brgal/ ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang byung / de nas kre la byon/ tshes 10nyin rag thag tu phebs/ mdo khams dpon chen gyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang chen por rab gnas mdzad/ tshes 14nyin nyi thag ri bur phebs/ tshes 26nyin kre phur phebs/ tshes 28nyin dpal ldan dgon du phebs/ byang lam brgyud 'dam dang snying drung sogs su thog ser thabs kyang mi phyugs la gnod pa gang yang ma byung ba rten 'brel bzang por dgongs/ de nas byang lam gyi skye bo du mas mjal ba rnams la phyag byin sogs thar pa'i sa bon rgya che bstsal/ phebs lam du bstan bcos mang po ljags rtsom mdzad de na rma'i gdan sar phebs/ mar lam gser yig pas sgar nga/ 'di tsam na 'ul lag skul bar zhus pas sems can la 'tshe pa ma byed/ khyed rnams kyang 'ul lag ma skul gsungs/ khal bzhon za ma ji dgos tham sa cad mtshur phu nang sa nas gnang bas 'ja' mo ba thams cad dga'/ rgya mtsho ya gsum dmag 'jam sogs 'jam che chung thams cad nas bsnyen bsku ra dang 'bul ba mtha' yas pa phul/ rje 'di'i sku 'khor 104

༄༅/ /na me pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so// — sne yang dge slong dag pa tshul ldan mang thos kyi bsam gtan pa rigs grol gyi spo bas pa dbe ba can 'ba' zhig dang / ngo lkog gang du yang sgar du sha chang mi 'grim pa'i bca' ba dam pas dus 'gro dpag tu med pa'i srog la 'tshe ba med pa'i skyabs sbyin mdzad pas thams cad du sangs rgyas dngos byon pa'i dad gus 'phel/ zla 12tshes 1nyin 'dan klong thang du phebs kyi bar/ ga re/ sgo ma sde nang chen/ ras tshang pa/ chab la kha/ kurma zi dgon sogs su mjal mi dang 'bul zhabs mtha' yas/ kurma ra tshogs pa khri phrag la chos gsungs tshe gser yig pa rnams la nam mkhar nyi zla'i bar na shel gyi mchod rten na drung bzhugs par ring zhig mthong ba sogs dag snang mang po byung / 'di'i skabs su glo bur du rgya gar gyi dzo ki lnga 'ongs te nged rnams rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga la 'gro/ 'di byang chub shing la 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis phyag brkos mdzod pa yin pas re zhig phyag tu 'chol/ nged rang lnga ga ma 'dzoms kyi bar du sa la'ang mi gtod par zhu zer nas jo bo rwa la phyag tu phul/ de rnams phyis gar song med pa la chos skyong gi sprul pa yin par gsungs/ de nas bzung rten 'di sgar chen gyi mchod yul gyi gtso bor mdzad/ khams phyogs kyi sde dpon rnams kyis bsu bskyel zhabs rtog bla na med pa zhus/ cha ga pa'i gnod 'tshe thams cad bzlogs/ nam pa rol rdo dgung lo nyi shu pa sa phag rabs lo535sa phug lugs2240/ phyi lo1359/lo'i zla1 tshes 1la kre maṇ+ḍal du phebs/ tshes 3nyin bde dgon pas gdan drangs/ chos kyi gtam dam pa dgyes pa'i sgron me'i bstabacos mdzad/ tshes 4nyin dbon shas gdan drangs/ tshes 25nyin rma chu gling khug gi gshar lam brgyud zla 2tshes 6nyin bya khar phebs/ de nas trer phebs/ nam chu ga chu 'am rkang chu'ang zer gling khug tu phebs/deng kun su'u zhing chen kha che'i rigs rang skyong khul gyi khong su sha tos sa yin/chos khri'i sar sngon chad sa phyogs der skye myongs med pa'i me tog rtsa ba gcig la sdong bu brgya/ sdong bu re re la'ang me tog brgya brgya/ me tog re re la yang 'dab ma ser po stong stong yod pa lte ba dmar po/ ge sar ser po byas pa gcig skyes pa de mthong zhing thos pa thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ 'ga' zhig gis ri mor bris te par du brkos nas dad pa'i rten du mchod pa byed pa mang du byung / yul der ltog nad dar che bas rtag tu mi phyugs kyi srog mang po 'phrogs pa la byin brlabs sna— 10 5

༄༅ / /ma rma pa sku phreng bzhi pa ro'/ pa'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//wa wa mdzad nas lo mang ring zhi bar mdzad/ de nas ga chur phebs dus gong ma'i gdan 'dren pa rnams 'byor yang / dus khams kyi 'gyur ldog yong bar gzigs te tsha phrang nag po'i yul brgyud mi nyag rab sgang du byon/ sgo ldong gi lo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar gyi 'khrugs pa gsar rnying thams cad chos dang zang zing gi sgo nas bsdums te zhi med du mdzad pa la rta nor dngos po'i gnang cha bsam las 'das/ 'ang 'ga' bo'i ri la bzhugs pa'i dus su slar yang gong nas lung dang 'bul ba rgya chen pos shes rab hu shri la sogs pa'i mi dpon mang po gdan 'dren la 'byor nas mdo smad du phebs pa la/ 'jam dbyangs gu shis 'ja' sa phul/ 'ja' sa'i nang du/ nges dang sems can mang po la phan pa'i phyir ci nas kyang 'byon pa slob dpon chen po rol pa'i rdo rje mkhyen ces pa la sogs pa thugs rings ba'i tshul mang po byung ma thag rab sgang nas btegs/ kurma pa bzhi pa rol rdo dgung lo 21pa lcags byi rabs lo5355/: phug lugs2241/ phyi lo1360/zla 7tshes 18la rag spang nas song du thegs shing kun mkhar du phebs/ a mdo sku 'bum dang nye ba shing kun shing kun du mkhan po dpal ldan mchog gis thog drangs skye bo grangs kyi mi lang bar chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad/de nas sa paṇa gyi bzhugs gnas sprul pa'i sder phebs/ der skad rigs mi gcig pa'i mi ris sa mang po 'dus pa la bzhugs khri'i g.yas su hor dang yu gur gyi lo tsā ba dang / g.yon du mi nyag dang rgya'i lo tsā mkhas pa bskos nas lo tsā rnams nas gsung so sor bsgyur te chos kyi rje'i gsung gcig gis gdul bya thams cad kyi rna lam du so sor phyin ci ma log par go bar mdzad/ zla 7 tshes 1 1nyin ga'o ra nas lho phyogs dang rgyal mo rong la phebs/ de ltar tshugs zhe bdun gyis mi nyag rab sgang du brtol/ mi nyag dbra 'dru gnyis/ sgo lding gnyis kyi 'khrug pa bsdums nas yig khrims —brgyad dang nyer bdun mdzad/ la las nyis brgyar nye zer/ 'di lo'i zla ba dgu pa nas lcags byi'i lo'i zla ba gnyis pa'i bar 'gor/ rab sgang stod du seng ge sgang zer ba btab/ hor gong mas lung dang gnang sbyin rgya chen por byas te/ shes rab gu'i shri sogs mi dbang rnams mdo smad du slebs pa mthos so/ 'di lo'i zla 12 tshes 19 nyin ta'i tu(mo'i ste ca)ma khas pa'i dga' ston las nge dus hor song ma/ po gan the nu ra rgyal sar bzhugs pa 'i lo 28pa yin gsungs/ pho /()()

༄༅ / /ma rma pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//ribrang chen por bsu ba'i bkod pa rim pa dang bcas phyag phebs/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa nas zhal mthong gsung thos pa tsam gyis rab tu dad par mdzad/ khyad par rgyal po yab sras la rnal 'byor ma'i dbang dang / rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang / thabs lam na ro'i chos drug la sogs pa gnang /rgyal po chen po la skyes rabs brgya rtsa/ rgyud bla rtsa 'grel/ mdo sde rgyan rtsa 'grel/ dus 'khor rtsa 'grel/ de'i cha lag rgya gzhung dang bcas pa thams cad kyi bshad pa gnang / gzhan yang rgyal rgyud dang zhing si mi dpon gyis thos drangs rgya hor dang / 5 yu gur dang mi nyag dang / ku'u li khra'o shan la sogs pa'i mi chen dang sde dpon sogs skye 'gro dpas tu med nga bla na med pa'i byang chen thar pa'i lam du 'bod par mdzad/ skabs der rgyal bu'i sras mi tri pa la 'khrungs/ chos kyi rje kurma rol pa'i rdo rje rgyal po chen po tho gan the myur gyi ti shri ste dbu blar bzhes/ chos rje rin po cher thu lu shri skya'o ta dben gu shri yi shel gyi dam kha bstsal/ der yod paṇ+ḍi ta dang bla ma rgyal rin sogs gu shri kun dang gnam mchod pa yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan du bkur/ gong ma yab sras nas gus pa dang gan che chung mang po nas 'bul zhabs dang bkur bsti bsam gyis mi khyab par mdzad/ yongs 'dzin mkhan chen don grub dpal pa'i che ba'i yon tan la bsngags pa dang hong tha'i tshe'i spel/ kha dang / tā hung gi cha ru bcas mtshur gdan du bskur/ nyes pa can spyir thar ba'i 'ja' sa dang / khyad par rgyal po chen pos brjes bong ma 'a/ phyag mi dbos par bkur ba la phyis rgyal rgyud dang mi chen gyis brje'i phyag blangs 'dug rgyal khams mi bde ba yang des lan/ da phyin de 'dra ma byed zer ba so/gas bstan pa shes skyed kyi 'ja' sa shel 'ja' chen rma rnams gnang / bod du sgrog pa la sde dgon dkon mchos rgyal mtshan dang chos rje nga/ nyid kyi bka' shog dang bcas zhabs 'bring dpon 'bo gsum bcas btang / rgyal po'i blon chen rnams nas rtag tu snya na gsol bar chos rje ma/ phebs bong du sman tse'i yul rgya nag chen po'i 'dab sgo lo dgu chad pas dngul bre chen re la 'bras ljag lnga re las med pa'i mu she byung ba dang / nad yams dang ngo log mang po langs nas phyi nang thams cad mi bde ba las/ drung gis thugs byams pa chen pos mi ma yin rnams dul bar mdzad pas ngo log pa thams cad ni nas so sor 'dud/ sman gyi bla'i /07

༄༅/ /la me pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//ci———————— ————thubs rje bskul bas nad yams thams cad kyang chad/ rnam thos bus 'phrin las bsgrubs pas phyogs kyi 'dab sgo rnams kyang byung bas dngul bre chen re la 'bras ljag lnga bcu'i bar 'phel bas mu ge'i rgyun chad/ sngon ma byung ba'i lo legs dang / rgyal khams zhod 'jags bde skyid kyi dpal la spyod thub pa byung bas rgyal blon 'bangs dang bcas pa dam pa'i chos la yid ches shing bla ma la dad pa/ rab tu 'phel/ rgyal po chen po dam pa'i chos kyi 'gongs pa bzhed pa bzhin 'grub/ ma' pa dang rtogs pa zla med par gyur te myo/khas pa dgyes nus pa'i bstan bcos du ma mdzad/ de nas slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pa ta yon gong ma rim pa nas na rma pa'i phyag mdzod la gnang ba'i cho lo ste hor gyi rgya za ris sa su gtogs pa zhig si go ming la rgyal po'i chab srid dang /gong ma chen po'i sku tshe la'ang 'gyur ldog gi mtshan ma cung zad shar/ yar phyogs 'di'i gdul bya 'dul 'os rnams kyang de tsam gyis thul/ nub phyogs na gdul bya shin tu mang bas da de 'degs pa'i bya ba byed dgos gsungs pas gong la zhu ba yang du mdzad pas gong ma yab sras kyis spyan chab 'phyungs shing nan gyis bzhugs par gsol ba btab/ la'o jang ching sang dang / zhi ra mu cing nga gnyis nas phyag dang thal mo sbyar te/ sngar bla ma ma phebs gong du rgya yul du lo nyes dang / ngo log nad yams mu ge sogs bkra mi shis pas rgal khams la bde skyid med/ bla ma phebs nas bzung rgyal khams lo legs shing skya rgyas/ ngo log dang / nad yams la sogs pa rang sar zhi bas rgyal khams thams cad kyis bkris pa'i lo zla dang bkra shis pa'i bla ma yin zhes zer ba'i dus bzang po shar ba'i skabs 'dir bla ma 'phags pa dang rgyal po go pe la'i lam ltar rgyal khams mchod yon lhan du skyangs te bzhugs par gsol ba nan gyis btab pa la/ chos rje'i zhal nas khrom che ba'i dus su rtsed mo 'phror bzhag na ngo mtshar ba yin/ nged la rgyal srid kyi bya bar gtogs pa'i shes sgo gang yang med/ ban de bya ba gar bde bar 'gro zhing bstan pa dang sems can la gang phan byed dgos pa de yin/ gang la 'dzi ma chags ma zhen pa zhig byung na chos pa bzang ba yin/ zhes gsungs pas mi dpon de gnyis nas gsung de rnams yi ger btab nas mos gus kyi rten du gzung ba yin zer nas khyer/ de nas nan gyis zhus pas ti shi'i bka' bzlog tu med par brten mthar re zhig thegs chog 108

༄༅/ /rkarma pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//pa'i lung dang 'bul ba/ 'ja' mo 'ul lag sogs kyi bka' shog dang bcas pa phul/ gzhan yang chos rje 'di'i bka' drin las/ gong ma'i lung las bstsal ba ni/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs la si tu dang / dar rgyal pa la skya'o su/ tu/ sgom rin la gu'i gung gi tham ga mtshur phu nang pa'am gdan sa pa la gu'i gung gi ming dang 'ja' sa/ gser tham/ shel gyi sbel kha bcas dang / la rma nang pa la ta'i si tu'i tham ga sngang na ma'i gdan sa mdzad dus ta'i si tu'i tham ga bstsal ba la da lta'i dpal sprungs kun ma' tā'i si tu zhu/dgon pa rnams bsrung ba'i bod yig gi 'ja' sa nyi shu rtsa gnyis bcas dang / rong dpon la zam du dben sha gags brtson gyi bu la klu da ru kha che/ tshal pa'i gzhon nu 'od la cha'o da'o bcas kyi lung las tham ga sogs bstsal/ tshal pa dar skugan lo gsum gyi 'ja' sa thon nas rjes su sngags pa dbang rgyal gdong chu yos zla8pa la bod du 'byor nas phyag tu phul ba bcas gong nas gzigs pa bla na med pa bstsal/ hor bod mchod yon dam tshigs rnam par dkar ba'i ngar gtsang snga ra gyi mu mthud de yug gcig tu sbrel bar mdzad pa las mi rigs kyi 'brel ba je zab tu song / nam pa dgung lo 22pa lcags glang rabs lo (3cho 6 / phug lus ba/2242/ phyi lo1361/lo'i zla 5tshes 7la ju jun zhes pa da lta khri grin nam sa dmar grong khyer du byon nas byar sa mdzad/ rgyal pos rbod ma brgya/ bzhon ma lnga bcu/ dbyar gyi dgos cha ci yin bskur nas zhabs zhu mi dpon gsum btang / dgun ta'i tur byon/ kurma pa dgung lo 23chu stag rabs lo5357/ phug lugs2242/ phyi lo13(32 /lo'i zla1tshes 12hong tha'i tshang skyes gdung kur sde byon/tshes 4nyin hor nas bod phyogs su phyag btegs/ phebs lam du nyes can mang po chad pa las bskyabs/ ho ya zi'i rgyal khams kyi 'khrugs chen rnams zhal ta mdzad pas 'jags/ zla4par sngar kurma pa khris phyag btab pa'i go ra dgon mo cher gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ der rang bzhan gyi ston pa'i khyad par gsal bar byed pa'i bstod pa yang mdzad/ mi nyag bi yul tha thal bya ba las lam brgyud nas byang ngos su phebs hor gyi rgyal sa rnying pa'i phyogs la byang ngos zer der byang ngos go ra dgon gyi mchod rten brgya rtsa dang nye ba'i lu 4ban shan du rgyal bu rat+na da de'i btsun mo puṇi dha ris bsnyen bkur bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod btsun mo ngu ṇi dha ris kho mo'i mi lam du ba dan yang dben gyi ri 'di dang mnyam — 109

༄༅ / /ma rma pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so// pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku zhig bzhengs dang 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes pa zhig byung bas de 'grub par byin gyis rlabs pa dang thabs kyang bka' bstsal du gsol zhus pas/ de lta bu'i sku che ba ni rgyu gos dar la byas nas grub pa gyis shig rgyu gang song gi rin bcu cha gcig nged nas sbyin pa yin gsungs/de lta bu'i sku ni bzo bo mkhas pa sus kyang khong du ma 'chud pa la// drung nyid nas ri ngos de la byon te rdo dkar sgrigs te sku'i bcad mdzad/ bzo bo mkhas pa rnams kyis de nyid du hor gos bzang po bka' cing dras te sku gser mdog na bza' tā hung sogs byas pa/ snyan g.yas nas g.yon gyi bar la 'dom bcu gcig yod pa'i sku tshad yongs su rdzogs pa la/ steng nas lha'i bu dang bu mos mchod rdzas thogs pa/ 'og tu pad gdan dang byi'u phrug khag mdzes shing / g.yas g.yon du byams pa dang 'jam dpal ldem gnyis bcas sku dngos la do chen po sum cu so gnyis dang / ldem gnyis la do brgyad re bcas khyon do chen bzhi bcu zhe brgyad yod pa rnams legs par grub/ rin gyi bcu char gser srang stong dang dgu bcu tham pa nang sa nas bstsal/ sku rnams cha tshad chu bzheng gab pa la byon gtsang 'dzam gling na zla med pa grub ste de nyid la bkram nas rab gnas mdzad tshe 'ja' tshon dad me tog gi char gyis sa gzhi dang bar snang thams cad yog pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung bas gos sku de drung nyid la dad pas phul/ yar lam mdzo khal nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rgyab cha byas te bod du drangs/ ldem gnyis stag lung dang 'bri gdan so sor gnang / sku dngos kong po zho khar bzhugs phyis sku stod kyi dos lnga ma tshang nas 'di zho khar me rkyon byung nas tshig par grags/rje chos grags rgya mtshos gso bar mdzad de rtse la sgang du bzhugs pa bcas khag gsum du zhal gyes pas kur bstan gyi rten 'brel cung 'phyugs/ rjes sor kong po'i mar srid phams nyes skabs rtsa med du song nas mjal rgyu med/ gos sku chen po thog mar bzhengs pa'i srol yang rje 'di'i sku dus nas dar bar grags so/ /nam chu dang nye ba'i ma gya si la sogs pa'i bzhugs mal rim par/ yu gur/ mi nyag bka' ma log hor/ sog po sogs skad rigs mi gcig pa'i mi rigs mang pos snyan pa thos nas zla lam gnyis gsum gyi sa nas rgum pa gsum la phyag re byed pa dang / gom pa bdun la phyag re byeng pa/ rgan rgon rnams rta dang rnga mong la bkal te —1 /0

༄byu / /ma rma pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so/ /— — 'ong ba'i skye bo mjal mi sa char mi shong ba ltar 'dus nas 'bul nod phul ba la phya ga byin mjal kha thugs dam med du bstsal/ dam pa'i chos bsta/na pas phyir mi ldog nas 4thar pa'i sa bon gyi bar du bzhag bskyar 'dab med pa'i khrims bcas te zhag bcu dgu'i bar ma jal kha phyag byin nam langs srod kyis de ltar mdzad kyang dad mjal skye bo rdzogs mtha' med par je mad dang / sku ngal tshul cung zad kyang mi mnya' bar 'gro don khur du bzod pa'i thug sa rtsol gyis thams cad byu 'brelu tshad don ldan mdu myang/ kurma pa dgung wo 24pa ༅yo — lo5858/ phrug lugs22rig phyi lo1363/zla 2par byang — nas tsong kha sde khams bco brgyad dang / be ri'i sa char phebs 'bul byung ba rnam las dbus ga tswang gi rdzas sde ris sed dzodage 'dun ci bcu ldod pa yan la sdang ja bdun re dbya 'bu' ba rnam gzhayi phyag 'gyed dang bcas pa bsnyen bkur sgrub pa la bla ma ri bo sgang pa btang nas bstan pa la zhabs tog mdzad/ jo thi drung du dngul bre chen bcu —gcig las brdungs pa'i kong bu/ mtshur phu'i lha chen du gser bre chen lnga las brdungs rtso sa'i gser shog skedang / dngul bre chen wo cu rtsa gcig las brdungs pa'i kong bu lnga/ dge 'dun r+sha nga pa la dngul bre gsum gyi kong bu la sogs dang /skyigazhan yang ga rma'i gdan sa la sogs pa'i mdo khams kyi gtsug lag khang rnams la dngul rkang dang / rgyun 'bar gyi kong rgyag la sogs pa dpag tu med pa sbyar gso mdzad/ tsong khar lha mi'i 'du tshogs thams cad kyis dad gus chen pos mjal ba la chos 'khor bskor/ dgon gnas chen po ba tab nas rtag tu bzhugs par ga4ba ba tab kyang ma gnang / der lta ba ngan sel gyi bstan ba cos kyang mdzad/ yul khams 'di phyi nas ri dwags kyis 'dzin bar 'gyur zhes lung bstan par mdzad pas rjes su de ltar du byung / dpal blo bzang grags pa yum sras mjal du byung nas rab byung zhus pa ra/ rten gzhon nur song dge bsnyen du bsgrub ste mtshan kun dga' snyi nga por gsol/ 'di 'phags pa'i gang zag yin pas dbus gtsang du song zhig par lung bstan/ yum la 'di'i lte ba'i khrag dron lhungs sa las ma 'ongs pa na ljon pa zhig 'khrungs te de'i lo 'dab dang grib bsil gyis kyang 'gro don dpog tu me da pa 'ongs/ gtsang sbo gyis gsungs/ ci phyis dbus gtsang gtso bor gyur pa'i sangs gyo gyi kyi bstan pa spel ji la ston pa gnyis 1 1 1

gyi༅/ /na rma pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so///de bye wa wapa lta bu 'di byung ba yin/ gzhan yang sa phyogs de thams cad du sngon gyi sprul pa 'i rgyal po dang skyes chen mang pos bzhengs pa'i lha khang bya 'dabs bdun pa dang dgu pa sogs ngo mtshar can sum stong bdun brgya yod pa de thams cad du nyams gso dang / mchod pa'i tshogs rgya chen po dang mar me'i rgyun dpag med btsugs/ lu ban shan du che li ci ci'i dmag gi 'jigs pa bskyabs/ gcan gzan ma rung bas 'tshe ba'i yul du bka' shog gnang bas zhi/ de nas byang dmar tsha sgang brgyud 'dan dang / rim gyis na rmar phebs te chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor/ rje gong mas lung bstan pa'i ri shod nying phug steng chen du gtsug lag khang chen bzhengs/ der bsdus don gyi bstan bcos ma dzad/ slar kong po'i rgyal khams su spyan —drangs/ kong po'i sa cha gang sar zhabs kyis bcag tsa rir gnas sgo ci rig phye/ khyad par snga ra skye bo su yang ma thar ba'i shar che mo gong gi la phyes te dpal mtsho dkar gnas sngon gyi snying por phebs/ rang byung gi mchod rten khyad par ba'i bang rim 'og ma la zhabs rjes bkod/ phyis gnas 'di skye bo mang pos mjal rgyu yod pa dang / bsam gtan pa mang po rtag tu gnas pa'i sgrub gnas chen por gyur/ de nas slob rom khrom nag gi gnas 'jigs su rung ba sngon ma bye ba'i gnas sgo phye ste rin spug gis nas su phebs/ der gzim khang mdzad bzhed la yar lha sham po'i sras sgam po lha rjes gshol nas da lta snga drag rjes su 'bul zhus pas rjes su zhwa dmar bzhi pa la phul bas rten 'brel 'grigs/ spo bor byon gre mo gru so'i chu chen la zam pa mdzad/gru chus khyer ba'i skye bo mang po'i srog bskyabs/ spo bo'i phur rma kur lung mkha' 'gro'i gnas kyi sgo phye/ rkarma pa bzhi ba rol rdo dgung lo 29pa sa sprel rabs lo5363/ phug lugs22go/ phyi lo1368/hor gong tho gan thu mur gyis rgyal sa shor nas hor yul du bros/ rgya mi kru'u yon krang ngam hung wu'u (72)yis nan cin rgyal sa bzung ste ming rabs btsugs/ sde srid phag gru dang bod kyi dpon bla khag gis rten 'brel zhus/ rgya nag rgyal pos bod kyi bla dpon rnams gdan zhus mdzad kyang kurma pa ma phe bas/ de nas slar yang kurma sogs ci rigs par byon te thams cad la zhal bkod mdzad/ nged dang myur du 'phrad par bgyi'o sogs gsungs pas thams cad the tshom du gyur/ kong po'i gdul bya rnams la mtha' ma'i 'phrin las mdzad nas shu — 112

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//ding thang gi thang stod du phebs nas chibs kha then mdzad de slob chod pon chen po gu'i gung pa rin chen dpal rin chen dpal ni rje rang byung zhabs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i bar na rim gsum gyi gu'i gung pa yin/la mkhyen rlabs shin tu che bas ga sdigs te myang 'dam la phyag mdzub gtad de sang da gzod ri pha gi'i pa/ dī // mi /// ༵ /shā/ /tsu/ dī bu //sdu/ ba/ go ༷/ hā/ // lha sdo ༵ dī pa/ snro/ ci po/ sgye/ rig // ༈/ga /rdo /nga gi las ba/sdu ba/ snang ༵ /ma che tsa na /spya // zlo nga kā dī sogaX bka 'ab/ sdu ༵ kāX lam / du lo sdub ༷sgyu ḍi /byed ltar ci dag pa dī gzi/wa zlo sna / // ༵ ༵ sa ༵ / tsho // bshid ༷sa /ga bsta ༵ bcos du ma mdzad pa dang / rdo rje'i mgur du ma gsung ba sogs ni brjod kyis mi lang / bstan bcos dang snyan ngag thams cad kyang tshig don bzang po nyams dang rnam 'gyur du ma can rje 'dis mdzad pa lta bu ni bod kyi thob khas pa gzhan su la'ang mi snang / de nas byang phyogs su rim gyis gshegs te sa shin tu dben pa'i ri zhig gi drung du phebs pa na ri 'di'i rtser dge slong gtsang ma zhig gi gdung sbyangs na bod du phyis rgya dmag gi 'jigs pa mi yong bar 'dug ces pa'ang zhar la gsungs/ de nas /rma pa bzhi ba rol ba'i rdo rje dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi bzhes pa rab byung drug pa'i chu phag (5378/ 226'go 1383/)lo zla 7tshes 3nyin nas sku khams cung zad ma snyoms pa'i tshul bstan pas sa yang yang du g.yos/ 'ja' tshon dang me tog gi char rgyun ma chad/ tshes 15mtshan mo rten rnams la skor ba lnga bcu rtsa gnyis mdzad de tho rengs byang sems nye sras rnams kyi mtshan nas yang yang smos te de dag dang gnyis su med par chos kyi dbyings chen por snyoms par bzhugs so/ /ri rtse der gdungs sbyangs/ pur khang gi sa rdo las mchod rten byas pa der deng sang yang ri dwags rnams kyis rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ de yang sngon rje rol pa'i rdo rje byang gi sha rkyang 'phyo ba'i yul du dgos pa chen pos sku gshegs —pa'i dus su gdul bya rnams la so sor snang ba du ma byung ba ste/ lha sar jo bo'i drung du dpon slob bdun mdzad de dngul sder gser gyis bkang pā 'thor zhing skor ba mdzad de nas mkha' la 'ja' tshon du yal ba dang / mtshur phur nam mkha' la byon nas kho bo dga' ldan du 'gro skye ba myur du 'ong gsungs te shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' la gshegs/ rnam par dang bkra shis sgang gi bar gyi thad nas 'ja' 'od du yal ba mang pos mthornga ba/ mon yul nas bya bral ba zhig byung bas zer na chos rje dpon slob brgyad cu tsam mon du byon nas rgyal po gsum rab tu byung ba la nā ro ne gu'i chos drug gsungs kyin yod zer/ slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pa sogs sgar pa rnams dang dbus su log byon dus steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa sgar mi yongs kyis mthong / kong po zho kha dang / rtse la sgang pa rnams so sor byon pa dang / zla6tshes 14nyin 'ja' 'od kyi steng na byon pa kong po'i khrom pa yongs kyis mthong / rgya la seng 'dam sogs su sgom chen 'ga' la mjal nas gdams pa bstsal ba dad / seng ge la chibs nas myang 'dam du bzhud pa dang / myang 'dam phyogs su nyin mang por 'ja' tshon 'khrigs te me tog bi char babs / dri bzang gis yul thams cad khyab pa/ 'khrungs sa'i khang pa la 'ja' rtag tu zugs pa sogs rtags bzang po bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba ni re re bzhin brjod kyis mi lang ba dang / sngon chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje kong po'i gdul bya rnams la mtha' ma'i 'phrin las mdzad de byang phyogs su 'byon dus kong po shu ding thang gi 'phrang stod du phebs pa cin chibs kha then mdzad de slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pa rin chen dpal la gzigs nas myang 'dam phyogs su phyag mdzub gtad de sang da gzod ri pha gi'i mgul nas mi grags pa can zhig 'ong ba yin zhes bka' chem go don can zhig kyang gsungs pa dang / myang 'dam gyi mi rnams la nyi ma shar ba dang / chos rje rin po che phebs pa sogs ni ltos bzang po yang yang byung ba bcas lhas bskul nas mi rnams kyi sa chos rje rin po che nged rang / 1 5

la mngon par bskul ba dang / bod yul rgya dmag gi 'jigs pa las skyobs pa'i dus su mkhyen nas kong ral kha gsum las myang po'i yul myang 'dam gyi sar yab sngags pa gu ru rin dang yum lha mo skyid gnyis la gzigs par mdzod de lhums su bzhugs/ de'i tshe yum la rmi lam bzang po ngo mtshar can sad mi bra ba dang / sad tshe sems la dga' yal le bar 'dug pa rtag tu byung / lhums nas yig drug dang / ā li kā li dang / o.ātsā sogs yang yang gsungs/bud med mang po lhan cig tu yum yur ma byed pa na de ltar gsungs pa thams cad kyis thos pas gang nas grags snyam g.yas g.yon du lta zhing nyen rna byas pas gsung cher bsgrags pas thams cad kyis thos nas sangs rgyas kyi rnam 'phrul zhig la 'di lta bu'i ngo mtshar che ba zer nas yum dang bcas par kun gyis phyag bas/ bdag nyid chen po 'di dag gi bsod nams kyi tshogs ni gzhal bar dka' bas/ nge'i mthu las sngar yab kyi 'u sa la nad gzhi zhig yod/ yab yum gnyis yo byad kyis phongs pa de ci 'dod pa 'bad med du byung / yul phyogs de dag sga nad 'khrug zhi zhing lo legs/ khyim de la rtag tu 'ja' zug cing 'od zer 'phros/ me tog gi char yang yang babs pas khyim de nyid du sku 'khrungs rgyu yin pa'ang thams cad kyis shes/yab yum gyis gsang gsum la 'gal rkyen bar chad 'byung bar dogs kyang rdzu 'phrul/ dang ltas bzang bsam gyis mi khyab pas rang bzhin du sangs brdol te snyan grags 'gog pa med par khyab pas gsang ba'i thabs kyang ma rnyed/ de ltar lhums su gnas pa'i mdzad pa kho nas skye 'gro yongs su mgu bar byas te/ rab byung drug pa'i shing byi zla 6tshes 18rabs kho/ 5379/ lus lugs 2265/ phyi lo 1384/lo sku bltams/ gdung sna nam zhang / sa cung zad g.yo ba dang / me tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od dang dri bzang gis yul khams khyab pa byung / yab la sngags pa phrag dog can 'ga' zhig gis rtag tu 'gran sol byed pa rnams kyang dad gus kyis 'bas la 'dus te zhabs tog byas / de ltar lhums su bzhugs pa de nyid nas cho rje gong ma sku dngos byusu byon par thams cad yid ches shing rtsod med du bkur ba las bltams ma thag tu yul mi skye bo tshang mas bkur bste blon du grags pa dpon ngo blo gros rgyal mtshan slob dpon chen po bu'i gung pa rin chen dpal gyi phyag phyi 'bral med du zhus/ slob dpon gshegs rjes gu'i spung pa mdzad nas sgar chen gyi 'phrin las sder bzhugs stan sogs phul nas bla ma shākya 'od dpon g.yog sku'i rim gro par bzhag khong rnams kyis yul rgyas 'bring la sogs pa zla re bzhin sku rim la 'bad/ zla ba dgu'i ring sku mtshams bcad de shākya 'od la slob dpon chen po bod nas 'ong bod ja 'dren la song gsungs te de ma thag phyin pas nyi zla thang du mjal/ slob dpon chen pos drung du mjal te 'bri gdan/ tshal pa sogs dbus gtsang gi bu slob dang yon bdag so so nas ja 'dren 'bul ba rnams phul te kong rtse lha sgang du byon/ drung nyid der bzhugs/ mtshur phu dang / na mi/ nags phu sogs phyogs 'di dang 'di na yod/ de rnams kyi tshul nam song zhus pas phyag mdzub gnyis brkyangs te zhag 'di na 'ong gsungs pa ltar khrigs se byung / zla ba bzhi bzhes dus 4drung na rim bzhi'i mtshan nas smos te de rnams gang na bzhugs zhus par/ phyag mdzub thugs kur gtad de 'di na gsungs/ khyed lags sam zhus pas yin yin gsungs nas bzhad/ slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pa ston 'khor rnams phebs nas mjal/ skabs der khri chung zhig yod pa de mtho bar gyis gsungs pas brtsigs/ thams cad la phyag 'tshol gsungs nas phyag dbang yang yang gnang ste bzhad/ rta bar rgyal —'dzin yon bdag a dpal gyis rta brgya 'bul byed pas 'byon par zhus pas yon bdag dpyal pa yin 'dug gsungs pa la sogs pa de lta bu'i mdzad pa ngo mtshar can ni grangs kyis mi lang / ma rma pa lnga ba de bzhan gshegs pa dgung lo bzhi pa me yos rabs lo5382/ zug lugs2268/ phyi lo1387/lor rtogs ldan rin po che zhwa dmar mkha' spyod dbang pos ( 1350 140 5)sprul sku mjal bar byon te 'bul ba dang sngon gyi dbu zhwa phul bas phyag gis blangs te dbu la bsnabs pas dbu la yangs dog gi skyon gang yang med par shin tu 'tshams par byung bas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ de nas tsa ri/ nags phu/ lkog 'phreng / rtse lha sgang rnams so sos spyan 'dren nan gyis zhus cipar/ thog mar nyang po dang nags phur 'gro gsungs/ gzhan yang dad ldan mang po so sos nye lam du spyan drangs shing bsod rin mas kyi tshogs rgya cher spel/ de nas mtshur phu nas slob dpon chen pos dbus pas sgar pa rnams kyang e thang du phebs/ der seng ge'i khri la spyan drangs te rim pas nags phu la sogs par byon zhing go sor sngon tshul mang po gsungs pas gdul bya'i mos blo dang 'tshams pa'i nges pa yongs su 'drongs/ gar byon du —bzhi nad dang glo bur ba'i nad gdon gyis gtses pa thams cad la phyag reg dang —/ zhal phu mdzad pa tsam gyis mngon gsal du zhi/ dgun sgang chen du gangs la chen por na bza' ras ༄༅ / /kurma pa sku phreng lnga pa chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so// wa wa la sku rtsed ltar du phyogs mang po nas phyag lcag btsugs pas phur bu'i shul lta bu byung ste la bye bar gses shig gsungs/ rtso de gses pa'i bar nas srog chags glo ba 'dra ba khyu gang tsam zhig la phyi srog chags nag po dang / nang du dkar po til 'bru tsam gyis thib ber gang nas gtums pa byung ste ljags mchil btab/ gting 'dzin gtad pa'i mod la shi nas 'ja' zug me tog bi char yang byung / ro de bsregs sbya du mdzad song / de'i rgyu zhus pas sku gong ma rol pe'i rdo rje'i dus yul 'di'i yas mas gshin gson gyi dkor za ba'i bla ma zhig gis ngan song las 'dren par zhus nas khas blangs pa de yin/ de'i srog chags nag po rnags khos gshin zas zos pa'i gshin po rnams dang / dkar po rnams gson dkor zos pa'i lan chags snyag pa'i phyir kho'i lus la za ba yin/ mchod yon de thams cad ngas 'dren par khas blangs pa ltar bde ba can du drangs pa yin zhes gsungs/ de'i pha bong phyed gshags kyi nang phan tshun na srog chags de'i gnas shul gsal por yod pa zhig da lta yang mngon sum du mthong rgyu yod/de nas zho khar byon nas 'phan chen chen po rje rol pa'i rdo rje nas rgyal bu rat+na'i btsun rma pu rje rda ri'i zhu ngor ljabs bkod gnang ste bzhengs pa'i gos sku/mjal zhing bkur bsti mdzad/ gnas bzhir bzhugs tshe dge bshes shākya rdor sogs kyis rtogs ldan rin po che mkha' spyod dbang po de ring 'byon zer ba snyan du yang yang gsol nas sgar pa rnams kyis rtab shur du grags byas pas de ring mi 'byon/ sang nged dang lam na 'phrad do gsungs pas de ltar byung bas shāka rdor la gzigs te nga e mi bden gsungs pas de phyin de ltar zhu ma spobs par gyur/ de nas shākya 'od la khyed kyis 'di ska da kyis gsungs pa ste/'gro ba'i don la bsam bzhin du/ /dge ba'i phyogs la 'god pa yin/ zhes pa yang yang gsungs te/ de nas bzung yul gru thams cad la rim par byon nas zhabs kyis bcag gar phebs thams cad du ri rgya klung rgya/ chos rgya dkar pos thamapa cad bde legs dang ldan nga/ srong btsan sgam po'i 'phrin las ltar mdzad/ rta bar rgyal 'dzin du yon bdag bis rta bzang brgya 'bul dang skye bo khri phrag mang po la sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i ston mo byas par de'i nyin nam mkha' nyi zla skar gsum 'dzoms pa dang / tha tog bi char kha ba'i 'dabs ma ltar du babs/ snye bor zhabs rjes du ma 1 19)

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng lnga pa chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so//wa wabyon/ gsang kha steng du chos skyong mang pos bsu ba gzigs te de'i tshul rnams mdzad/ dad ldan rnams kyis longs spyod rgya mtsho ltar 'phyur nas tshogs rlabs po che bsags/ de'i tshe slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pa la 'di skad du zlos shig gsu/ngas te/ 'gro rnams dge ba'i phyogs la 'god pa'i phyir/ /thams cad chos kyi phyogs su gtong ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa na slob dpon chen pos kyang dgongs pa mkhyen te phyi nang thams cad 7du sku rim la yo byad thams cad bkye nas don ldan gyi snying po lon par mdzad/ gar byon gar bzhugs su sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam chos srung gi gzigs snang byung ba grangs las 'das kyang cung zad de phyag phya rnam la bka' bstsal te de dag gi rnams 'gyur la sogs pa'ang gsungs/ skabs shig na a ma slebs byung sgo phye zhes lan 'ga' zhig gsungs pa'i mthar bsngo ba mdzad cing snang bas de dang dus mtshungs par yum gshegs par snang / ga rma pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgung lo drug pa sa sbrul rabs lo5384/ phug lugs2270/ phyi lo1389/lor lkog 'phreng na bzhugs skabs nye gnas shākya 'od la kurma phyogs nas mi mang po yong gin 'dug gsungs nas zhag 'gar si tu pa 'byon pa'i skad byung / ja 'dren la myur du song gsungs pa na 'o thang gru khar phebs pa dang 'grig de nas drung du mjal nas mchod sprin cher mdzad/ de ma thag 'bri gdan dang tshal pa sogs dbus gtsang gi bdag po che dgu thams cad kyis gdan 'dren 'bul ba so so dang mtshur phu 'i bo'i shri bzang po rin chen sogs/ byon/ der gong ma chen po'i ja 'dren dang / dbu zhwa/ chos gying gi phreng ba sogs 'bul nod rgya chen zhig bla ma lo tsā bas phul/ so so nas gdan 'dren gyi zhu ba nan 4drag tu phul ba'i tshe spyan 'dren pa kun 'dzoms sar nged sngon la ma rmar 'gro ba yin gsungs pa la/ dpon po bzang po rin grub pa na re/ sngon la mtshur phur 'byon dgos pas zhal bzhes mdzod/ mi mdzad na ngas khri thog tu sdod pa yin zer nas zhu phod byas pas/ khyed kyis cang mi shes nged gar 'gro ba la nga rang mkhas gsungs nas bka' bkyon dang phyag 'jug kyang mdzad pas thams cad 'jigs shing zhum nas drung nyid kyis ji ltar dgongs pa las snyad stabs su mi 'gro bar thugs shin tu sgam par yang go 'di phyin nas skye bo'i tshogs mtha' yas pa la rang rang gang 'dod pa'i /20

lugs mtha' dag sbyong tshul mdzad/ kong po nas dbus phyogs su byon skabs rgya nag gong ma tā ming rgyal pos gdan 'dren zhus par 'byon pa zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas mdo khams su thegs/ gon gyo 'am go 'jo dge slong bi las gral byung ba la 'di skabs bzang zhing mang bar grags/ so so'i phyag gi tshe bar bar du 'ja' li la sku brten pa'i ngal gso mdzad dgos pa byung / 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char babs/rje snya ga phu pa 'di ni nyid kyis 'phags pa'i gnas brtan ba ku lar zhal gyis bzhes shing / rje rol pa'i ngo rje la chos du ma gsan rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i bla ma yin yang thugs dad slob ma gzhan las che ste lhag bsam ma'i bstod pa yang mdzad/snga phyir mkhan slob las 'dul ba'i phyogs mtha' dag dang / jo gdan gyi chos skor rnams dang / gzhung lugs chen po du ma gsan/ slob dpon bka' bzhi pa las kyang gzhung lugs du ma gsan sbyong gi tshul mdzad/ na rma pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgung lo 2 1pa shing sprel lo'i rabs lo 5399/ phug lugs 2285/ phyi lo1404/zla8tshes 15la zho kha nas phyag btegs te khra shod/ ri bo che mngom rnams su skye bo mang po smin grol la bkod/ phyi lo shing bya lo zla1la ma rmar phebs/ skye 'gro mdza' yas pa chos kyis btul/ rke rags pa/ rga a nyan pa/ shar kya'i dpon dang / rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas/ mjal mi 'gas drung gi rnam thar zhig zhu zhus pa la/ skye 'chi med pa sems la dbang thob kyang / /dbang med 'khor ba'i 'gro ba sgrol slad du/ /snying rje'i dbang gi srid par nying mtshams sbyor/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mdzad pa rgyun mi chad/ de la gyis gsungs/ 'bom mtsho'i brgyud du char 'beb dang go gyo'i yul du cha ga pa'i gnod pa la bka' shog bsgrags pas chad/ pu 'bor ba'i spyan 'dren byung ba la phyis kyi zhal bzhes mdzad nas kong por phebs te bsnyen rdzogs dang 'gro don mang po mdzad/ de nas sngar hor gyi rgyal po tho gan thi mur gyis rgyal sa lo so lnga mdzad/ rje rol pa'i rdo rje spyan drangs/ ngo log sogs rgyal sa'i phyi nang gi gegs bar thams cad zhi 'jam du song yang / rje bod du phyir phebs nas lo lnga na rgya'i ngo log byung bas gong ma hor yul la
