pa'i lung dang gdan 'dren pa'i gser yig pa rnams kyi snga 'a par byung bas kong po nas dbus su yar phebs/ 'bri gad na dang sne'u pas zhabs tog che sdo zhus/ lha sa dang mtshur phur phebs/ 'di lo zhwa dmar gnyis pa mkha' spyod dbang po zhing la gshegs/ de nas kurma pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgung lo nyer gsum pa rab byung bdun pa'i me khyi zla7tshes 3nyin rabs lo5401/ phug lugs2287/ phyi lo2406/la mtshur phu nas phyag btegs te rim gyis byang lam brgyud nas zla7tshes 3nyin lha steng dang tshes 8la kurma'i gdan sar phebs/ der gong nas rgya'i mi chen khag gcig mngags pa rnams kyis mjal/ lung dang 'bul ba rnams bzhes/ rke stong dang / ker rgyang du bdag po chen po kun ting go'i shri dang / cha'u thob pa sogs mi chen rnams dang / smar khams kyi dge 'dun mtha' yas pa mjal mi thams cad rab tu dad par mdzad/ shar kha'i skye bo yang mang pos mjal/ de nas khams 'bri chu'i klong thang gi gru brgal/ gling tshang gis 'bul zhabs mtha' yas/ de nas ra rgya gru so/ khrom bu rong sogs la 'bul ba dang zhabs tog spangs mtho ba zhus/ khrom bu rong nas rta lnga brgya dus gcig tu phul/ de nas slar yang ta'i zhing chen po gdan 'dren la slebs/ ga chu dang / shing kun/ chu ma mkhar/ zam shing du rgyal bus mjal/ pan yang du rgyal bus mjal/ hung mang du dge 'dun mtha' yas pas mchod pa'i sprin spros/ chu kun pho brang gi rgyal bu gnyis kyis mjal ba bcas phebs lam shul ring ge 'jam tshugs so so dang phan tshun nas zla lam lhag pa'i yul lung gi skye bo'i rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pas mjal bar 'dus nas 'bul ba dang bsu bskyel sogs zhabs tog yod dgu zhus pa thams cad la mjal kha phyag byin chos rgya dkar pos tshim par mdzad de smin grol du bkod/ de nas gong ma'i pho brang gi mdun na chu chen snang ba la 124

༄cu / /na rma pa sku phreng lnga pa chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so// gru kha re na shan gsum stong re 'dug pa la drung nyid phebs/ gru'i nang du khang bsang rgyan can byas pa la bzhugs thog gom pa gsum brgya drug bcu la sa le dbar rer brtsi srol gyi tshos le dbar sum brgya dang brgyad cu'i tshod du grur bzhugs te/ chu'i pha rol tu byon/ glang po che sum brgya tsam la rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pā dang / dge 'dun khri phrag gis mtshar du dngar ba'i sgo nas bsu ba ser phreng zhus/ nas mkha' dwangs la 'ja' tshon 'khrigs pa sogs ltas bzang po byung ba kun gyis mthong / drung ston 'khor mtshur phu'i shegadan sa nas chibs btegs te phebs lam du zla ba drug dang nyin bcu bzhi song / na rma pa dgung lo 24rab byung bdun pa'i me phag lor gong ma khrir phebs nas lo lnga pa zla1tshes 2 1nyin la nan cin pho brang du phebs 'byor byung bar de nyin gong ma rjen po yang bsu ba zhu bar pho brang nas lcags ri phyi ma'i nad bar du byon/ mjal ma thag thog mar drung du gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong 'bar ba zhig mjal dar mnyam du phul nas pho brang gi mjal 'dzom khang gsar du byas pa la spyan drangs/ ga drung du ja zhal yang gong ma khong rang bzhengs nas mdzad cing / dpon slob thams cad la chab tsha gnang zhis mchod yon mjal 'dzoms kyi yig char 'khod cing / sgar gyi gsungs rgyun las/ gong mas mngon mkhyen yod na mjal dar gcig pa bsnoms yong ba yin dgongs te phyag shubs kyi nang nas dung dkar g.yas 'khyil zhig bton te mjal dar du phul bas chos rjes kyang sku phag nas dung dkar g.yas 'khyil zhig bton te mjal dar rtse sprod gnang bas gong ma thugs lhag par dad/ phyis gnyis ka la gser gshog sgron te sbran nas phul ba da lta 4 la'i mchod rdzas g.yas 'khyil mkhyid gang tsam pa cha de yin par gsungs/ cisang tshes 22kyi tho rangs gong nas phyag phyi ba thams cad la gos bzhi re dang lham re/ mi drag rnams la zhwa theb re bcas gnang / mchod yon bzhugs lugs ni/ gong ma chen po tshoms chen gyi phugs nas bzhugs/ rgya'i lugs su g.yon phyogs che bar byed pas drung g.yon nas tshur bzhugs/ gzhan bla ma rnam gsum dang / bla ma gsum ni/ 'brong bu go'i shri 'di gyar pa gangs pa'i dgon brgyud cig gis mar rkyang rdzong byukhongs gyar du 'brong bu'i dgon pa btab/ de'i dbon brgyud yin pas mtshan de ltar thogs/slob dpon dka' bzhi pa rin tshen dpal/ mkhan chen mgon blog 'dir rgya'i 125

dngo/na slob rnams mjal khang du bzhugs/ tshes 23 nyin gyi gzhogs/ci pā snga ba ra po brang du spyan 'dren si la ba su ba'i ser sbreng rgyan chas 'dra min can gyi las na gos dan dang gser g.yu'i khang ba zad / gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ 'phan/ ba dan/ phur na/ la sogs pā mchod pa'i bye bag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / ciglang po che dkar po gcig dang gzhan gnyis bcas gsum la gser gyi rgyan cha theg tshad re sprad pa/ gzhan glang po che gsus brgya skor la rang rang rgyan chas sna tshogs ba kal dang / dge 'dun snam sbyar can khri phrag lnga tsam gyi lag tu me tog gsol pa dang rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs pa bzung ba/ rgyal bu chen po rngo dgu ta'i zhing zhing chen yan tsho'i dgos ri sto stod tsho gsum gyis mgo byas las ka can gyi mi chen 'bum tsho gcigazhu la dmag dpung 'bumacho —tsho bcu gnyis dngul gos dar las byas pa'i nyi zla'i gzugs bzung ba bzhi stong tsam 'dug pa rnams gzab sgrengs byas te bsdad/ de nas gong ma chen po nyid pho brang gi rgyal sgo'i —bar du bsu ba la byon/ phyi na bsu ba'i bkod pa ji yod pa nang na yang chu tshang 'dug cing / khyad par gser gyi khrab rmog kho na gyon pa'i dmag mi nyis brgya tsam/ 'dug mjal 'dzom khang de sgo lho lta rim pā lnga yod pa'i nang ma gser 'ba' zhig gi gser thog gsod ka can la bod kyi ka ba sngo gnyis kyi mal 'a phyogs bzhi kur sgo gsurma ral re 'dug der spyan drangs te ma/chod yon bzhugs lugs sngon ma ltar mdzad/ drung gi ma tshad g.yon phyogs su bla ma rnam gsum dang grwa pa rnams bzhag te bzhugs gral mdzad sgo bzhi so sor bsrung bya gser khrab gyon pa'i dmag mi lnga bcu re g.yas sa yon du la nga na sa 'dug pa dang thong ma'i g.ya sa g.yon du gser khrab gyon cing phub khur mod 'a gzhu ba tags nga/ ba zhi bcu tsam re lang ste 'dug der0sa sna mtha' yas pas gung tshigs kyi gsol ston shin tu rgyas pa bshams/snye na de nas rnams rgya nas/ tu mchog tu byed pa9re rti'u dka ra te sngon po mas pa'i dkar po min pa rta dkar mang ste rti'u dkar dkon zer ba de yin/gser bre bdun/ dngul bre sum cu rtsa bdun/ gos yug brgya/ ja gsar sig su/ma cu/ gser gyi rdor dril bco lnga 'di gan dril zhes pa gser dmar po'i rdza ma la gser ser po'i rtse rngor blugs pa/ rdo rje pha 'a/ma gyi ra rtse dang ra los rnams/ la phra byas pa'i phyas dri' song ma 'ji'i skabs su ma sa rtogs rgya hor mi nyag gong ma gang gi skabs su'ang thon myong med pa snang /gser gyi bum pa gnyis/ dngul gyi bum pa lnga/ gser dngul gyi ting dang ma sgri cha/ gser dngul gyi pad sder lnga re/ gzhan yang mchod cha srid tshad/ gser dngul gyi gso/la zhal sder sogs dang/ga med phu ra ba rnams cha snyel ri /'bul ba 'o gas su yin pa'i lung byung / tshes 25la/ bla ma rnam gsu ma gyis 'go byas pa'i phyag phyi thams cad pho brang du bcar dgos/ nga 'i lung byung / pho brang gi khyam/sa su gong ma'i mjal kha btang / gong mar phyag re re la sa 'bul mi dgos pa'i lung byung / bla ma rnam pa gsum te/ 'brong bu bo shri/ slob dngo/na bka' bzhi pa rin chen mkhan chen dpal/ mgon blon nga/ tā dben go'i shri blo gros rin chen rnams so sor dngul bre phyed gsum re/ sa ser re rnams sa nang / grwa pa spyi la/ rab rer dngul bre chen re rgya srang lnga bcu re yod pa/cha'u brgyad brgya re/ phyi gos yug drug ༈/ nang dar yug drug re gnang / 'bring rer dngul bre gsum gnyis re/ gos dar so so nas yug drug re/ cha'u bzhi brgya re/ tha ma rnams la dngul bre phyed re/ gos dar so so yug bzhi re/ cha'u bzhi brgya re/ thams cad la phreng dkar re/ gos sbyor re/ rdo dril cha gnyis re bcas gnang / tshes 22gyi nang par slar yang gong ma chen po drung gi gzim khang du mjal bar byon te tsan dan dkar po las bzhengs pa'i spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong sku tshad brkyangs khru do yod pa gcig dang / de'i mchod cha dngul kong sogs dngul spyad dang shel gyi mchod cha mtha' yas pa phul/ de nas zla ba phyi ma'i yar tshes 1la lo gsar byed pa ste de ltar na hor zla2pa la rgya'i zla1po byed yod par snang / rgya'i lo gsar su gong ma mchod yon gyi rten 'brel mdzad sgo ni/ tho rengs nas drung gis dbu mdzad dpon slob thams cad pho brang gi shar sgo nas yar byon nas khyams shig tu bzhugs/ song ma chen po der drung du byon nas drung la ja zhal mdzad/ nam langs pa dang pho brang gi phyogs bzhi ka la dban chen po bkal ba'i khyams gyi nang nas gong ma chen por las ka can gyi mi chen 'bum phrag lnga tsam gyis phyag 'bul 'dug de nas stag gnyis/ bse lnga/ g.yi dkar gnyis/ glang chen brgya tsam bcas srog chags dang / sngar drung gi bsu ba la byung ba'i lag cha sna tshogs thogs pa rnams re rer yang stong phrag re re 'dus mdung bzung khyab gyon pa kho na 'bum tsho re re tsam 'dug gar pa nyis brgya tsam gyis 'go byas rtsed sna mi gcig pa stong tsam 'dug pa de rnams mchod yon gyi mdun bstar ba la yud tsam re gzigs pa btsas nas sdo brang du byon/ ston mo rgyas pa gnang / de phyin nas phyag phyi grwa pa rnams kyis gong mar phyag 'bul mi dgos pa'i lung bstsal/ slar yang rtsed sna rnams mchod yon gyi mdun du 'ong bcug ste rim pa ltar rtsed mo dang glu sar rol mo byed cing rim gyis song / dgongs mo phyir byon pa la gong ma chen pos sgo gsum pa bar du bskyel ma zhus/ de nas rgyal bu rnams kyis dgon par gdan drangs/ gong nas mi chen thams cad la ston mo gnang / yang tshes 128

༄zu/ /7/rma pa sku phreng lnga pa chos rje de bzhin sa shegs pa 'i rnam thar bzhugs so//15nang par dpon slo ba nyi shu skor zhig spyan drangs te rtsed sna dang ston mo sngar bzhin dang / nub rngo/ pho brang si khyams chen po der me'i shog sbag me tog dang / bkra shis rtags brgyad la sogs pa'i me rtsed kyi rigs/ mang po dang / rtsed sna rigs 'bum phra ga bzigs ngor bstar ba la gzigs nas srod tsam na dkon par phebs /ci gzim khang gi sgor yang de dang 'dra ba'i rtsed sna dang mchod pa'i rigs sna tshogs rnga/ bstar nas 'dug de nas nyin mo re bzhin gong ma chen po la chos gsungs/ tshes 25nyin dpon slob thams cad pho brang du spyan drangs/ dang po shar sgo nas gser khang du byon/de nas sngar gyi mjal 'phrad khang du byon/ der spyan gzigs bshams/ drung la dngul srang stong la dngul bre lnga byas pa dang 'bul ba mang du mdzad/rtsed mo sogs sngar yod rnams phal cher dang khyad par spra nag rkang thang dang / spra dkar rta pa sogs mang po 'dug pa la nub sgo nas gzigs mo mdzad/ de nas hor zla3tshes 5nas gong ma'i yab yum thar lam du 'dren pa'i sgrub chog gi dkyil 'khor phyi nang rnams kyi thig btab/ 'di la gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bcu gnyis kyi rdul tshon btab pa ste drung rin po che nas rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ rin po ches phur nga// bka' bzhi pas gsang 'dus/ dbon po bas mi tra bcas kyi dbu bzhugs dang / gzhan rnams kyis rdor dbyings/ chos dbyings gsang dbang dgyes rdor/ rje btsun ma/ kun rig sman bla/ sgrol chog thugs rje chen po'i gzungs sgrub sogs chos grwa khag bcu gnyis nas dkyil 'khor khag bcu gnyis so so'i sgrub chog mgo tshugs/ dbu 'dzugs la gong ma byon te drung du rnam gsum tshang ba'i 'bu' ba dang / bla ma rnams so sor bos phyi nang bzhi re/ byings dkyil 'khor re la gos phyi nang re re bcas gong ma'i phyag gis bzhes nas re re bzhin gnang / bong gsal tshes 5nas tshes 18bar bdun phrag gnyis ring cho ga mdzad pa la nyin ltar gong ma yab yum byon te drung nas dbang bskur re re mdzad/ gzhan rnams kyis sgrol ma'i cho ga mdzad/ tshes 14la 'ja'i gur phub/ gong ma mchod yon la gnas bcu zhal gzigs/ rgya'i mi dpon gsu ma gyis kyang mthong / shing sdong gcig gi mgo nas bdud rtsi babs/ shung/ sdong gcig la gser gyi me tog shar/ phyi zla2tshes 5nyin cho ga'i dbu tshugs pa nas tshes 18ma grol gyi bar du 'ja' 'od sna 12 9

༅༅/ /ma mo pa skya gre nga lnga pa chos rje de bzhin sa/shegs pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so//bye ge wa — ——wa —wa wa wa wa wa ———wa watshogs 'khrug pa dang / me tog gi char nyin gcis/ lta ra babs pa rgyal 'bangs thams/ cad kyis/ mngon su/rna du mthong ngo / tshes 19mtshan rma gong ma'i yum gyi mchan byang drung gis bzhu bar mdzad/ ga 'a/na bla spya rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon rnams/ rgya mtshor ga sgom rgyur 'dren pa'i tshe glang po che la rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dang dge 'dun bsam gyis mi khyab nga bcas kyis god ma drangs nas chab la bshams/ sla ra drung bi/sa gong ma chen po la bkra shis brjod/ gong ma nas drung rin po cher ga/ser bre dgu dang / dngul bre bco brgyang la do/gas pa'i 'bul brgya cher phul/ bla ma rnam gsum la gos phyi nang so so che dgu re/ dngul bre chen gsum re// cha'u stong re/ rta gsum/ re / dar yug lnga bcu re/ chos dbyings pa dang / rdor dbyings par dar khang 'a/ dar yug bdun cu re/ kun rig pa so/gas gzhan rnams la dar khang yug lnga bcu re/ chos grwa re re la dngul srang bcu gsum re/ gos yug bzhi re/ cha'u sum brgya lnga bcu re/ bcas kyi gnang cha bstsal/ yang tshes 20nyin nas pho brang du spyan drangs te dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas gong ma chen por tshe dpag med kyi dbang gnang / de nas zla3tshes da nyin nas gong ma la chos drug gi khrid gnang nas gong mas nyams bzhes mdzad/ phyag dpe rgya yig/ tu bsgyur nas phul/ gong ma 'dis nyams rtolas 'khrungs pa'i lta ba'i skor gyi nyams mgur sogs rje mi bskyo da zhabs kyis lung 'dren du mdzad pa'ang yod/de ltar chos rje kurma pa de bzhin ga/shegs pa 'di nyid tā ming gnam bskos gong ma chen po hre tsu'u kru'u tis yu nga lo mchog gi ti shri ste dbu blar yongs su bkur ba la gong ma chen po nas gzhu'u la'i tā ba'u h+pha wang gsi rgyan tā shan tsi tsa'i h+phu de bzhin gshegs nga/ rin po che chos kyi rgyal po nub phyogs kyi byams pa chen po zhi ba dbang phyus/ gi sangs rgyas zhes pa'i mchan gyi cho lo dang / gser srang brgya las brdungs pa'i 'ja' sa dang / 'ja' sa'i nang ban bying ku'i tsa lha hang // tsu'i khring / wan gyo/ dme 'u tsi/ tshe shan/ 'phu g.ying / g.yu'i gu'i/ yan kya'u/ bzhu'i la'i tā bsku/ pa wang / zi than/ ta'i shan/ tsi tsi/ h+phu zhes 'khod pa shel gyi phyag tham yid bzhin nor bu bcas du la/ na rma pa'i mtshan zhabs bla ma rnam gsum 'byong bu go'i shri/ no ba dpo na brka' ba 'a pa rin chen dpal/ mkhan chen ma bon blon pa ste mtshan dngos go'i shri blo gros rgyal mtshan la go'i shri chen ngo 'i la sa ka dang / gser gyi tham 7 she/'a/ gyi tho shu ri mo can gyi tham ga bcas gnang // nyes pa can gyi rgya ban 30

༄༅ / /ma rma pa/ sku phreng lnga nga/ chos rje de bzhin gzhags ༷'i rnam thar bzhugs so// wa wa stong phrag gnyis tsam dang / gzhan yang rgyal khams chen por snga rting du byung ba'i nas chen brtson du bzung ba srog la nyen can rnams kyi don du drung nas zhal ta yang yang mdzad pa la gong ma nas yangs pa'i lung shes byed/ ban bon zin shing la sogs chos lugs so so thams cad rang rang gi lugs tshul bzhin du gyes/ gnam mchod pa 'di thams cad la sus kyad btser ba ma byed/ ci byas na so so'i rgan pas nged la 'bral du btugs/ khrims lugs ji ltar byed pa nged kyis shes zhes sogs drung rin po che'i zhag ta'i don la gong ma chen pos bstan pa shed skyed kyi lung 'ja' sa rgyal khams bstims cad du gnang / bod du ni chos srid 'i sna khag la dbang lung thob pa yang phag gru sde srid na rim lnga pa dbang 4grags pa rgyal mtshan nas lnge ci srid dbang lo bzhi ba cu zhe ba dun bzud ci ba'i lngo bra zhi pa la ming rgyal rabs dang po (ming〉 tha'i tsu'u yon krang gis de snga rab byung ba dun pa'i sa 'brug ( 1388 )lor bstsal ba'i dbang gi go gnas dang /ci gser tham zhig yod kyang / rje 'di'i bka' drin las phyog gru grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bod kyi srid dbang bzung ba'i lo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ rab byung ba dun pa'i sa glang ( 140 9 /drung rgya la phebs nas lo gsum par phag gru pa la tā ming gong ma chen po nas slar yang hran tā wang bod skad du sprul pa spel bca'i rgyal bu 'es pa'i lung las ka dang / shel gyi tham ga bcas gnang / de bzhin 'bri gung pa rin chen dpal bzang por hran kya'u wang bstan pa spel ba'i rgyal bu gtsang stag tshang rgya yis tu si ta tsang la ma zer ba nam mal 'a legs pa la h+phu kya'u wang bstan pa skyong ba'i rgyal bu rgya bod yig tshang du de snga mdo smad man su'u dang mtsho sngon khul phyogs kha gcig gi bdag por gsal ba gling tshang pa la tsen shen wang dge la ston pa'i rgyal bu de snga mdo sto da chol kha gcig gi bdag ngo bon gyo pa la spyi kya'u wang bstan pa/ srung ba'i rgyal bu de snga sa skya pas chol kha gsum la dbang bsgyur skabs su gling tshang dang gon gyo/ shar la/ 'dan ma bcas ba'i ni gdan sa'i khams pa'i las tshan bzhi zhes pa chol kha re'i bdag po yin lugs myang chos 'byung du sa sa la zhes pa sogs kyi lung las ka du ma bstsal te bod khams bde bar mdzad/ da dung gong ma chen po'i lung gis/ bod du chos lugs mang bas phyin chas rtsod pa 'ong / chos spubs thams cad khyed rang gi lugs su dril la/ lo lo bzhin mdo 1 31

cho༅༅ / /yi cho/ pa sku phreng lnga pa chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so//wa cha she khams pa rnams rab sgang dang / dbus gtsang pa thams cad lha sar 'dud de chos 'khor chen ngo skor bar byed/ ces pa'i lung phebs pa la chos rje rin po che nas chos lugs gcig ṇa nas sems can mi thul bas so so'i mos bzhin byas na sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje 'jug pa yin/ de gas chog pa yin/ zhes pa sogs gsungs nas zhal gyis ma bzhes/ yang gong ma chen po'i lung gis/ bod kyi las tshan bsko bzhag bya sgyu gong ma nas ma gtogs gnang mi chog pa yin kyang rgya bod sa khas 'gyangs pas bod du bla chen dang / dpon chen rnams la ji ltar 'os pa'i go gnas bsko then dang / lung dang tham ga bstsal rgyu sogs nged —la bka' skor mi dgos par chos rje rin po che tā sbo h+pha wang ngam rin chen chos rgyal nyid nas gnang na 'thus par 'di nas rgyab gnon byed pa yin zhes pa'i lung bstsal rgya nag tā ming gong ma chen po 'di'i dus su bod kyi bla ma snyan grags can gyi che dgu la lung las ka 'jal sa tham ga sogs gnang ba ni/ san ta wa ngu dang / u ta wang zhes pa'i wang ngam dbang gi go sa che ba brgyad du dbye bar mdzad pa las che ba ni san tā r+shawang zhes pa bod kyi chos rje rnam pa gsum mam/ chos rgyal rnam pa gsum du 'bod pa ste gong ma chen po'i ti shri rnam pa gsum yin cing / de gsum gyi nang nas che ba kurma pa de bzhin gshegs pa la ta sbo h+pha wang rin rjen chos rgyal dang / de 'og sa skya pa 'khon bkra shis dpal te sa skya kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi tsha bo kun dga' bkra shis la theg chen chos rgyal gsum pa rje bdag nyid chen po'i sku tshab tu byon pa se ra byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes la byams chen chos rgyal bcas chos rgyal rnam gsum 'di rang che ba'i bkur bzod gzengs bstod bdag rkyen zla med pa zhig gnang ba yin/ spyir gong ma 'di'i yab ming gong ma dang po tha'i tsu'u yon krang hung u'i khri lor 'bod pa ni gong ma'i khri lo dang po yin/ bsod nams dpag tu med pa de'i dus su ta'i zhing chen po mngags nas dang por grub chen birlu pa spyan drangs/ gnyis par gnas brtan bcu drug spyan drangs/ gsum par rje de bzhin gshegs pa spyan 'dren par bzhed pa'i tshe gnam du gshegs/ de'i sras tā ming gong ma chen po hre tsu'u kru'u tis yung lo 'di nyid 'jam dpal gyi sku'i bkod pa dang / btsun mo dam pa sgrol ma'i sprul pa gnyis nas song ma'i yab yum gshegs pa'i thugs dbongs rdzogs dgos pa 1 32

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng lnga pa chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam bas 'i zhugs so//yang dgongs/ 'di dang gtan gyi bde ba sgrub pa'i ched du bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten te dam pa'i chos kyi bya ba byed dgos par yang bzhed kyang rgyal po'i bgyi ba chen pos g.yengs pa la btsun mo dam pas yang yang rab tu bskul nas chos rje rin po che spyan 'dren pa'ang mnyel gsos te kurma pa spyan 'dren pa la rtsol ba bskyed pa'i bsod nams dpa ga tu med pa ni nga'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsun mo dam pa 'di yin zhes rtag tu mngags pa mdzad pa'i don ltar gong ma chen pos chos rje kurma pa spyan 'dren pa'i gser yig pa rim par mngags pa ltar drung de bzhin gshegs pa rgya yul du chibs kha bsgyur ba nas bzung rgya'i yul du sngon ma grags pa'i ltas bzang ngo/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing / khyad par rgya nag gi yung lo khri lo lnga pa zla2tshes 5/ bod kyi rab byung bdun pa'i me phag (1407)nas nan cing ling gu si'i (593)dgon par tā ming gong ma chen po'i khrin tsang yab rgan hung lu'u la skye sgo ( r+sā)zhus pas/ dag pa'i zhing du 'dren pa dang / 'gro kun sdug bsngal las sgrol ba'i cho ga gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor chen po bcu gnyis la bsten nas cho ga dbu btsugs pa'i nyin nas bzung tshes 18bar cho ga dngos bzhi zhag bdun phrag gnyis kyi ring dang / gzhan yang zhag bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i bar du nyin re bzhin rgya'i yul du 'od kyi dra bas khengs pa dang / drung gi gzim khang du 'ja'i ka ba zugs pa/ 'ja' sprin gyi glang po che dang / seng ge la sogs pa'i gzugs brnyan dang / sbas ha'o zhes pa bya tshe ring dngos su byung ba/ me tog tha dad pa'i char yang yang babs pa/ sngon mthong ma myong ba'i rab byung du mas dkyil 'khor gyi gzhal yas khang la bskor ba byed cing de ma thag dgra bcom pa rnams sprin gyi steng na snang ba/ sprin gyi gseb nas sangs rgyas byang sems gnas brtan drang srong la sogs pa mtha' yas pa mngon sum du byon pa la lha'i bu dang bu mo mang pos mchod pa dngos su phul ba/ khyad par tshes 18 cho ga tha ma'i nyin nub phyogs nas gser gyi 'od chen po zhig byung nas rgya nag gi rgyal khams thams cad khyab par bde ba can nas sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi 'od zer du gzigs pa sogs ltas bzang dang rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas byung༄ ni skabs der rgya yul gyi rje 'bangs thams cad kyis mngon sum du mjal rgyu byung ba bcas spyir drung de bzhin gshegs pa 133

༄༅ / /ma rma pa sku phreng lnga pa chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so//wa rin po che chos kyi rgyal pos rgya nag tu mchog tu gyur pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi mdzad pa brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzhes shing / de yang zla2tshes ji nas tshes 18bar byi rdzu 'phrul gyi mdzad pa rnams gong ma'i lung gis rgya'i ri mo mkhan mkhas pa rnams nas nyin mo re re bzhin du ri mor bris pa dang / zla3tshes 3nas tshes 18bar du legs 'dems kyi ri mor bris pa'i yin thang ring mo zhig kyang bzhengs bcug par mdzad cing / thang ga de la ngo mtshar 'ja' sa gsi thar mar grags shing / mjal dus gzhogs g.yas nas g.yon phyogs su tshur zhal 'byed dgos pa'i phred thang ring mo'i nang nyin mo re bzhin gyi mdzad pa rnams so sor byas pa'i khyon rnam grangs ling rtse bzhi bcu zhe dgur dbye ste bris yod cing / ling rtse re re'i nang du ngo re bzhin nan cin rgyal sa'i yul bkod dang / g.yas phyogs su drung de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs yul ling gu si'i dbon pa gtsug lag khang thog brtsegs gsum pa la g.yu ba ci'i rgya phibs byas pa dang / hor gong ma'i dus nas na rma pa bzhugs yul du ched du bzhengs pa'i por snge'i dbon pa yin/g.yon phyogs su sgrub chog gnang sa'i cig 'al yas khang chen mo thog brtsegs bzhi pa la rgya phibs can/ khang chen thog brtsegs bzhi pa de'i rgyab tu da dung 'phar du thog brtsegs bzhi dang rgya phibs bcas mthong rgyu yod pa'i ring bsrel mchod rten du grags pa shin tu mtho ba rnams la 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim dang g.yas g.yon nas 'ja' glang chen mche ba gyen du zeng pa 'dra ba dang / 'ja'i ka ba zug pa/ nam mkhar 'ja' sprin sna tshogs 'khrigs pa la sogs gong gas la gyi rdzu 'phrul mdzad pa nyin dang gnyis so sor ling tse byas nas mu 'brel ri mo bkod pa bcas mtshar du dngar zhing gson nyams ldan pa'i phred thang bzhi dar shog 'dra ba glang ko'i srab mthug tsam pa/ dkyus la li'i rmid 66dang phred 'a/ ring tshad li'i mid 49 68yod pa/ 'di'i ring tshad bod kyi rgyal rabs deb ther la khru 2650zhes gsal yang kho bos dngos su mjal ba la 'di rang yi na/ling tse so so ngo re bzhin g.yas nas g.yon phyogs su rim par rgya/ sog mañdzu/ yu gur/ bod bod yig khams tshugs 'bru tsha'i gzugs 'dra ba/(brtag)bcas kyi yig rigs rnams rim nga/ra shan sbyar du bris pa'i mdzad byang dang / gsham du slar yang rgya bod shan sbyar gyi zhal byang re re bris pa/ rgyab tha gru ljang dang / rgya shing gru bzhi'i sgril shing sis lag g.yon nas g.yas phyogs su sgril dbos 1 rte 4

༄༅ / /yi rma pa sku phreng lnga pa chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so// 4wa ge go wa wa pa'i ngo mtshar 'ja' sa zhes pa yin thang dril kha la dar gyi na bza' dang gos khom rang 'grigs la phyi shubs rgya shing tsi ma nag po'i mdong gzugs zhal gcod bcas par mdzo dkri lcags shan 'byar ba bcas drung de bzhin gshegs pa la phul zhing 'dra gcig gong ma'i rten du thugs tshags gnang bar grags shing / da dung mtshur phu'i gdan sa'i 'du khang gi sgo thog tu 'bel rgyur chos kyi 'khor lo :rgya chen po skor ba'i sde zhes pa'i mthing shog steng grang gser byugs pa'i rgya yig 'bur brkos kyi dben bcas bstsal/ ngo mtshar 'ja' sa yin thang 'dir gru ljang gi steng du phyis sman tse yug gis rgyab snon byas te rgyal dbang lderma pa na rim bcu drug gi bar du mtshur phu'i gzim chung chos dbyings pho brang du bzhugs pa las bod du lo bcu'i zang zing skabs rang ljongs srid gzhung nas rig dngos rtsa che'i gras su myur skyob mdzad de deng dus nor gling rig dngos bdag gnyer do dag khongs kyi mdzod khang ka pa'i nang du bzhugs nas/ bla na med pa'i gces sprad gnang mus da dung chos rje rin po cher g.yang ṭi'i tham ga gru bzhi pa zhal ris mtha' 'khor gyi ring tshad la li'i mid 12 8mtho tshad li'i mid 8 3mthug tshad li'i mid 3 5khrid tshad khe 2165yod pa tham lung 'brug gnyis 'khril sbyor gyi mgo bo ltag sprod du byas pa la zhal ris de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo rin po rnge chos kyi rgyal po'i tham ga zhes pa rgya yig rnying ma don bsgyur byas te brkos pa bcas kyi tham ga'ang bstsal 'di'ang nor gling du bzhugs/rgya skad du la me ༅ ༅ 10〈rke khri47)bod skad du de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che chos kyi rgyal po nub phyogs kyi byams pa chen po zhi ba chen dbang phyug gi sangs rgyas zer/ gzhan yang skabs der drung rin po cher gong ma'i 'ja' sa shog bu sngo dmar ser gsum sprin ris yod pa la 'go brjod du tshe ring gnam gyi she mong zhes pa dang / bod kyi rab byung 7pa'i chu sbrul te rgya nag gi yung lo khri lo 1 1pa'i zla 5tshes la zhes par tham ga'i zhal ris rgya yig rnying pa byas pa khag mang du bstsal/ de nas yab yum gyi mchod rten gyi rgyu rkyen 'bras bu rnams la rab tu gnas par mdzad pas re rer ngo mtshar mang du byung / chos rje rin po che zla4nang pho brang nas ri bo rtse lngar byon te bzhugs ring 'jam dbyangs zhale gzigs te bgro gleng dngos su gnang / rin chen dmar po'i gter kha brdol/ skabs 135

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng lnga pa chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so//rer mchod rten du 'ja' 'od klongs nas sku gzugs kyi rnam pa sna tshogs ngo mtshar du ma byung ba rnams song mas lung gi zhu yig 'phral 'phral du phul be snga phyi bcu phrag lhag pa 'dug pa'i nang ngo mtshar brjod kyis mi lang ba 'dug ces mkhas pa'i dga' ston du gsal zhing / de skabs gong mas de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsor sku mtho gang tsam pa gzigs pa dang / ston pa'i tshem myo/che ba rgya sar na bzhugs pa ngo ma'ang gong ma'i 4phyag tu son pa bcas chos rje rin po che'i thugs rjer mkhyen te ston pa'i sku ji lta ba gser gyis bzhengs/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyi zhu ba'i lung dang bcas pa chos rje'i phyag tu phul ba bcas gong ma blon 'khor rgyal 'bangs thams cad nas chos rje rin po cher thugs thag pa nas mi phyed pa'i dad gus bla na med pa'i blo phug rtse gcig tu gtad de bka' ji gnang sgrub pa dang bkur bste zhabs tog tshad med pa mdzad/ de nas bod du 'byon dgos tshul gsungs pas/ gong ma chen pos/ lar 'dir byon pa sku drin che ste yun ring ma song / zhabs tog kyang cher ma thengs/ spyir bla ma rtag tu 'grogs kyang gsungs ma bsgrub na byin rlabs mi 'byung / bka' bzhin bsgrubs na byin rlabs la nye ring med pa ni ngas go ba yin/ hor gyi dus su rgyal pos dbang byed par 'dugakhyed nged kyi bla ma yin pas khyed dbang che ba yin na re zhig byon la nam gdan 'dren byung ba'i tshe 'byon pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad dgos zhes gsol btab/ spyir gong ma 'di'i dgongs par dmag gi sgo nas hor dus ltar bod khrims zhabs su 'jug sa hor ltar mchod yon srid gcig pas rgya bod sogs rgyal khams gnon par dgongs kyang chos rje rin po ches chos bzhin du bstan pas rgya dmag mdzad ma bde/ phyi nas chos rje rin po che'i drung du gong ma'i gser yig pa mngags pa khag gcig kyang 'bri gung si ru rong nas bcom 'phrogs byas pa'i don la bod du dmag dpung gtong rgyu gtan 'khel bar/ dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan ngo mas chos rje'i drung du phyag dang zhu ba dbu nan phul ba'i don bzhin gong la zhal ta yang yang gnang bas zhi ba sogs thugs byams pa chen pos ni khyab/ khe grags dang dbang che 'dod pa'i rnam par rtogs pa ni mi mnga'/ thams cad la phan bde 'ba' zhig dgos pa'i bal 'a rin ngo che ya nga yang du bstsal bas song ma chen ngo/sa kyang bla ma'i gsung spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkod nas rgyal thabs kyi —— 136

༄༅/ /ma rma pa sku phreng lnga pa chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so// bya ba gang ci dge zhing yang dag pa 'ba' zhig gi 'phrin las bskyangs pas rgya bod mi rigs mtha' yas pa thams cad la bde skyid dpag tu med pa ca thob ste rgya bod mi rigs dbar kyang spun zla lta bu'i mthun sgril gyi 'brel ba bzang po byung / mi rigs thams cad 'di phyi'i sdug bsngal las bskyabs pa'i chos srid gnyis thad nas bka' drin bla na med pa mdzad/ de ltar rgya nag tu mi rigs grangs kyis mi long ba'i gdul bya rnams mngon mtho dang —nges legs kyi sa la bkod de 'brel tshad don ldan gyi 'gro don dpag tu med pa mdzad nas/ /rma pa lnga ba de bzhin gshegs pa dgung lo 27pa rab byung bdun pa'i lcags stag rabs lo5405/ phug lugs229 1/ phyi lo1410/lo'i dbyar mjug tu rgya'i pho brang nas bod phyogs su chibs zhal bsgyur bas gong ma rgyal blon rje 'bangs thams cad nas thugs 'phring zhing 'bral mi phod pa'i dad gus brtse gsum gyi ngang nas gong ma yab sras kyis rgya mtsho'i 'gram bar du bskyel ma zhus te mchod yon zhal gyes/ de nas mi chen rnams kyis phebs gru sogs so so'i go rim ltar gyi srung bskyel zhus/ ga chu brgyud phebs lam du rgya hor yu gur mi nyag sogs skye bo mtha' yas pa rnams la zhal mjal phyag byin 'dod chos sogs 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad nas bar khams nar ma'i gdan sar phebs/ chos bka' du mas gdul bya rnams tshim par mdzad/ der rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur yang rin po che las bzhengs rim par byang gnam mtsho tshun gyi gdul bya mang po 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad nas 'dam gzhung cog tse lar phebs tshe/ rgya nag gi mnga' thang la bltos na skabs der bod rnams kun sdoms kyang rgya'i mi dpon chung bu'i 'byor pa tsam las med mod/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i che ba'i phyir/ sa skya/ dge ldan/ 'bri gung / stag lung sogs bod yul na so so'i lugs kyis kyi bdag po chen po rnams nas bsu ba ja 'dren 'bul nod sogs rgya cher bstar / rje tsong kha pa chen po nas jo bo'i thugs dam gyi rten li dmar gyi byams pa me brdugs su grags pa'i sku khru gang gis gtsos pas rten gsum maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i rnam grangs dang / sangs rgyas nyid du mngon par bstod bsngags kyi sgo nas/ zhabs la phyag bgyi bar spro yang lo gsum mtshams kyi dam bca' zhig bya sa pas sgrub par mchas gsungs pa la sogs pa'i zhi yig dang / kun ༄ mkhyen rong ston la sogs pa'i skabs de'i 137

༄༅ / /ma rma pa sku phreng lnga pa chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so//mkhas grub du ma nas sangs rgyas dngos kyi bsngags pa brjod pa'i zhu yig phul/ skabs der 'dam du sa g.yos cher byung bar chibs las gzhol te sa gnon mdzad nas bzhugs pas zhi/ de nas gdan sa mtshur phur zhabs so/ra bkod/ lha ldan du phebs nas jo bo rin po che la mu tig gi snam sbyar sogs mchod sprin dang / dbus gtsang gi sde dgon yongs rdzogs la mchod rdzas mang 'gyed rnam gzhag sogs mchod sbyin rgya cher spel/ bdag po dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis sne'u gdong pho brang du spyan drangs te bkur bsti tshad med pa zhus/ dbus phyogs kyi lha mi'i sde kun tshim par mdzad/mdo smad pa yongs kyi gdan 'dren dang / khyad par nyid kyi zhal slob mkhas pa mi lnga'i rab sgang mkhas pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa spyan 'dren du 'byor/ skabs der khong gis dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa rnams la brgal brtag 'phangs pas sus kyang len 'debs ma nus/ de nas kong po tsa ri sogs la 'gro don du byon te slar dbus su phebs/ lho kha dol tshal min du mkhan chen snyan phu nga/ dang lhan du 'dzoms/ sngar tshal pas rje rang byung zhabs la phul ba'i dol gyi chos gzhis rnams mkhan chen la phul des tshal min gyi gtsug lag khang khyad 'phags bzhengs/ mtshur phur zhig gsos dang gser gyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs/ de nas dbus gtsang gi bdag po sne'u gdong hran ha dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan nas lha sa po ta la bzhugs gnas su phul nas rtse la bzhugs/ tā ming gong ma chen po yung lo nas bla na med pa'i 'bul chen thengs gsum 'byor/ sngon pho brang du byon skabs gsol dkar du me tog gan dkar zhes pa phyi nang sgrib bral dar las srab pa'i rigs phul yang gsol dpon gyis phyis shugs ches pas 'thor skabs 'dir de las cung mthug pa'i khyad dkar du ma phul ba 'ga' re rje si tu chos 'byung sku na gzhon dus kyang mjal rgyu 'dug gsungs pa dang /gsol ja yang rgya mtsho'i pha rol pad+ma'i ge sar gyi gsol ja dang / slar yang gan dril gser dmar po'i rdza ma dang / gser ser po las mgo rdor blugs pa/ pha lam gyi rwa rtse dang / rwa logs su phra btab pa/ lha kim las byas pa'i dril bu sogs ga ser dngul gyi sku'i nyer spyad khyad nor bong che chung khri kha gdal la dngos po sne re re bzhin mi re'i phrag pa dang / lag tu bsgrengs te mi khri phrag bis lha sa'i gling skor lam la dam gyis bskor nas pho ta / 38

༄༅/ /yi rma pa sku phreng lnga pa chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so///—wa wa — lar mtshar du dngar ba'i sbang bsgrigs te chos kyi rje rin po che'i spyan sngar rim gyis bstar nas phul ba bcas mchod yon gyi dad dam 'brel ba rgyun mthud du mdzad/ gan dril 'di'i gras gong ma 'dis skabs 'dir ched du mdzad pa las song ma rgyal rabs gzhan su la'ang ma byung bar grags so/ /da dung si tu bstan pa'i nyin byed kyi dbus gtsang gnas yig tu rje 'dir gong mas phul ba'i tsan+dan sbrul rnying gi gnas brtan gyi sku brnyan brag ri ljon shing dang bcas pa'i yul bkod can gzhi thing gi steng du phra rtsis g.yog par gser thog bi rdzogs thum byas te sla ra yang rtsis mnan de'i steng tshon rtse dang / kha che sha skam/ grang gser gsol rnes gser ris kyi dod la khab ris byas shul grangs gser gyes bkangs pa sogs bzo khyad kyang shin tu ngo mtshar ba 'dug rgya yul du cing shing zer zhing / rgya ban rnams kyis/ mdo las bshad pa'i tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po yang 'di yin par bzhed ces gsal ba de yang skabs 'di tsam du phul bar snang / phyis long po rtse la sgang du bzhugs pa rgyalas kur srid nyams nyes skabs gzhung bzhes mdzad de 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi rten du yod pa las deng dus tshogs chen steng dngul gdung lha khang gi sbug tu bzhug 'dug mdor na bdag nyid chen po 'di ni gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i rmad byung gi mdzad pa ngo mchar ba 'ba' zhig sa ngas rgyas 'jig rten du dngos su byon pa — dang mi gnyis/ pa'i rgya bod hor gsu ma gyi gdul bya ris su ma chas pa mtha' dab la 'di phyi'i bde legs kyi skal ba bzang po zad mi shes par sbyin par mdzad pa'i bka' drin lha yi lam du mi gshong ba bskyangs/ skabs yis sgar pa jig nas mi srun pa'i spyod pa byung ba la/ rma se rtogs ldan nam drung rma se blo gros rin chen gyis 'di la bka' bkyon re tsam zhu zhus pas/ kho bo la zhe sdang skye ma myong bas khro mi shes par 'dug 'on kyang khyed kyi bsam pa gang ba zhig myur du bya zhes gsungs pa 'dis sku tshe'i phan pa btang bar ngag sgros las 'chad srol la gang ltar mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba thams cad la thar pa'i sa bon bzhag khong gis khams stod du zur mang gi chos rgyud spel bas/ zur mang bka' brgyud grags/ da lta'ang zur mang rnam rgyal rtse dang zur mang bdu da rtsi'i mthil dgon pa yod/ khams stod kyi lo rgyus las gsal/ de nas na rma pa de bzhin gshegs pa mdo 139

ci༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng lnga pa chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so//khams kyis gdan 'dren pa rnams la'ang myur du 'phrad par bya'o gsungs/ dgung 'o 32pa rab byung 7pa'i shing lug (5410/ 2297/ 1615/)lor rgyal ba sku phreng dang po dge 'dun grub pas rje bdag nyid chen po thog mar mjal ba'i lo zla 8par sku 'brum bzhengs pa'i tshul bstan pa na/ rtsobartan bzhugs phul kyang / mdo khams na rma'i nye logs su 'dun pa btang zin gsol ba thob thugs rjes 'dzin pa yin gsungs pa dang / gsol dpon la dpe mchod rten gsum rnams ma 'thor bar gyis bdag po zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs nas zla8tshes 15nyin rje spyan ras gzigs chos skyong ba'i rgyal po'i tshul bzung ba'i pho brang chen po po ta la'i rtse mo'i gzim khang du dgongs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan to/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po la sogs kyis mchod pa'i bya ba mdzad/ sku gdung rin po che bzhus pas thugs rje chen po dang / bde mchog dgyes rdor yab yum la sogs pa'i sku dang ring bsrel dpag med byon/ lha sa dang mtshur phur zla ba mang po'i ring 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char rgyun ma chad pa byung / dngul gdung dang snang brnyan rin po che/ nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i gser gyi bka' 'gyur rnams mtshur phu'i lha khang bkra shis gsar mar bzhugs so/ rje 'di'i zhal slob ni spyir rgya bod hor mi nyag sogs gang sar bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung yang snying po don brgyud 'dzin pa bka' bzhi pa rin chen bzang po/ go shri sangs rgyas rin chen/ go shri blo gros rgyal mtshan mgon blon yang zer/go shri rin chen dpal/ go shri don grub 'od zer na rma pak+ṣi'i mchod ya gtsug gtor skyabs kyi brgyud pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sras che ba thugs rab shin tu che bas 'jam dbyangs chen por mtshan gsol/ kon ting ta go thi'i las ka dang gser gyi tham ga ka bo ming dang bcas pa gnang / kun mkhyen rong pos kyang chos gsan/ mtshur phu'i gdan sa lo zhe gsum mdzad/go shri chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ go shri shākya bzang po sprul sku chos dpal ye shes/ ngom pa bya bral/ sgam po pa chos rgyan/ rma se rtogs ldan 'di mi nyag 'byor ldan zhig gi bu yin te rjes thugs rjes 'dzin pa las snyan brgyud kyi thugs dam la rtsal rdzogs pa'i 'gro mgon chen por gyur/ rab byung bdun pa'i chu yos (5418/ 14 23/)lor khams stod zur mang nam rgyal rtse phyag btab grwa sgrub khag gnyis su bskyangs/ zur mang snyan brgyud ces rkarma bka' rgyud las gyes pa'i ma lag gcig tu gyur/ khong thugs rje byin rlabs shin tu che bas 'gro don rgya che byung / slob ma yang rtogs ldan ya brgyad/ 'ja' mo mi gsum sogs thugs dam bzang zhing 'gro don nus pa'i rtogs ldan du ma byung ste rje'i snyan brgyud kyi bstan pa rgya cher spel bar mdzad do/mi nyag 'jam grags/ mi140

༄༅/ //rma pa sku phreng lnga pa chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar bzhugs —so/—/nyag rtogs ldan/ kong nag ral gri/ la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa grags kyis mi lang ba dang / tā ming gong ma chen po dang / btsun mo dam pa rnam gnyis kyang nyams rtogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i slob ma 'i thu bo dang / gzhan yang spyan snga bsod grags/ spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'bri gung don rgyal/ bla ma paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos rje shāka mang —/ jo dan dbu yon/ zha lu slob dpon tsan dra pa sogs chos kyi 'brel ba'i skyes chen rnams te mtha' yas so/ /de ltar bde bar gshegs sge porma pa'i/ /ngoX mtsharacho mdzad pa mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i chab/ /zegs ma tsam gyis yon tan 'bum 'jags na/ /chu gter tshad la gzhal bar ga la nus/ /'on te dam pa dgyes pa'i mchod sprin dang / /skal mnyam so skye'i ma rig ling tog mig /rab rib sel nas yang dag rnam 'dren zhal/ /mthong phyir mdzad pa'i cha shas dpe ru bstan/ /ces bar skabs 'dir 'og nas bsdu ba'i don cud zad ston pa'i skabs dbye ste/ srid zhi'i rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbaring po kurma pa chen po 'di nyid bsam bzhin gdul byu'i don du mchog gi nyelta ༄panyam skudzi rirme par byon pa bams las sku phreng re re'i gsang ba gsum gyi 'ephrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo nas mdzad pa rnam thar ba sam gyis mi khyab pa rgya rme ts+tsha chen po ltar mtha' yas shing gting dpog par mi nus pa de lta na/ gang gi skyes rabs kyi phreng ba bcu phrag gcig dang gser ri'i grangs kyi mdzad 'phrin mtha' dag re re bzhin rgyas par bskyar du spros nas smos rgyu ni skabs 'dir yi ges 'jigs shing ngal ba'i rgyu las lhag po'i don cher ma mchis pas/ des na gong du smos pa'i sku phreng lnga pa yan gyi mdzad 'phrin las rigs 'gre zhing 'og ma rnams shugs kyis bde blags su rtog par 'gyur gyi/ gal te deb ther khag rnams su'ang kurma pa'i mdzad rnam rags pa re ma bkod pa med cing / dper na/ tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes brtsams pa'i deb ther dmar por sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje'i bar dang / 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyi deb ther sngon por sku phreng drug pa mthong ba don ldan gyi bar/ mkhas grub dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i lho brag chos 'byung ngam/ mkhas pa'i dga' ston du sku phreng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i bar/ 'ab logyikamo tshe dbang kun khyab /kyi bka' rgyud 7chos 'argyung zla ba chu shel gyi phreng bar sku phreng bcu bzhi theg mchog rdo rje'i bar/ sman sdong 1811

༄༅ / /ma rma pa sku phreng lnga pa chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so// mtshams pa kurma nges don bstan rgyas kyis brtsams pa'i rnam thar dpag bsam 'khri shing la sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i bar dang / 'bras ljongs rum btegs gdan sa bshad sgrub chos 'khor gling nas gces/ btus phyogs bsgrigs mdzad pa'i mdzad rnam u dum bā ra'i chun por skru phreng bcu drug pa rig pa'i rdo rje'i bar bcas kyi mdzad pa rags rim tsam re gsal cib dang / da dung gzigs par spro rgyas pa sku phreng re re'i mdzad rnam gsung 'bum pod sus cu man rgyas bsdus ci rigs su yod pa rnams la gzigs na khyab bdag rgyal ba'i dbang po kurma pa'i thun ci ma yin pa'i sku ba'i yon tan dang / sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rnams ji bzhin thugs su chud pa yong rgyu/ da de 'di man sku phreng drug pa mthong ba don ldan nas/ sku phreng bcu drug bar ci kha'i zhal — phyag bris bka' rgya ma dang gsung bsgros bcas la smu gong mas 'og ma lung gis bstan te bstan 'gro'i don du bsam bzhin srid pa bzung ba'i mtshul rdzis yang srid mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rim par byon pa rnams kyi —4 ri pa'i yul dang / —༷ba dang / yum dad / rigs dang / 'khrungs 'ad sa kyi lo dus dang / mtshan gyi phreng ba rnams — rim pa mdo ldog 'god par bya/la 7 karma pa sku phreng drug pa ca ba don ldan rab byung bdun pa'i me sprel lor 'khrungs/ ci / ri (1 ri ri 85 mo ri ci 1 7/2

༄༅ / /na rma pa sku phreng drug pa mthong ba don ldan gyi rnam thar bzhugs so//go༄༅ / /ga rma pa sku phreng drug pa ma bong ba don ldan gyi rnam thar/ chi rkarma pa sku phreng drug pa mthong ba don ldan ni/ sku gong ma ti shri de bzhin gshes sa pa zhing du gshegs khar sku bcar go shri rnams nas brtan bzhugs 'bul skabs mdo khams kurma'i nye logs su 'dun pa btang zin/ der gsol ba thob dang thugs/ rjes 'dzin pa yin gsungs pa ltar mdo khams rkarma dang nye ba'i ngom zhes par yab sngags pa go 'jo bsam 'grub rdo rje dang / yum rnal 'byor ma'i rigs stod bza' pad+ma mtsho gnyis kyi sras su bye/ zlo ༵༵ sbyaX ༷༷/ rda~X sdu /sdu/sa/ // sdu /rdo| rdo/nga /rdo1 /rdoX/ ༷༷ ༷sa byeng dī /༷ rnying ༵'a/ ngo /gye dī rdo tshor ༵ /zlo rdzu // nga byo sna shri /// tsho lugs tshigs su bcad pa yang gsungs pas 'khrul pa yongs su bral te ngos/ 'dzin/ zhwa dmar chos dpal ye shes dang / 'jam dbyangs grags pa/—mkhan chen snyag phu ba bcas yongs 'dzin du bzhes/ mthar rtse lha sgang nas dben gnas bsa' phur phebs te rten sgam rnams phyag dam mdzad/ yum 'da' kha sngas su spyan drangs pa sa yu ma gyis drung pa a ma la thugs rjes zungs zhus pas/ a ma dga' ldan na 'phrad gsungs nas bsngo ba mdzad/de nas lha steng du spyan drangs/ tshur sgang dgon du sku mtshams bzhugs skabs yi dam dang chos skyong rnams kyis zhal gzigs/ dgung lo brgyad pa chu yos ( 1423)lor drung rma se rtogs ldan gyis khams stod rtsi chu'i lho rgyud du zur mang rnam rgyal rtse dgon btab/ mthong ba don ldan der phebs myong gsungs/ de nas kurma ra phebs/ der grub mtha' gzhan gyi sngags chos myo/nga du btsugs skabs/ bla mas 'di 'dra dgos pa ci yin gsungs/ rang lugs kyi yig cha mi 'dug zhus pas/ yig cha ngas brtsam chog gsu/ngas nas rdor dbyings kyi sgrub dkyil dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs sogs brtsams/ da lta de rnams bka' 'bum na bzhugs/ 'di lor mkhan chen bso da nams bzang po mdo li la spyan drangs nas dge tshul mdzad/chos grags dpal bzang po mtshan gsol/ gzhan yang zhwa dmar gsum pa tshosi dpa la/ ye shes( 1406 zhe 1452)dang / chos rje rong po pa la so gos 143

༄༄/ /kurma pa sku phreng drug pa mthong ba don ldan gyi rnam thar bzhugs so// wa wa wa wa pa mang du bsten nas thos bsam rgya cher mdzad/ de nas tsa ri dang bkra shis ljongs/ mtshur phu/ zur mang / rkarma spungs ri/ spang phug sogs su yi dam dang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi zhal gzigs mang du byung // lha sa ra jo bo'i drung du kun mkhyen rong ston smra ba'i seng ge sogs la chos gsungs/rong ston gyis kyang bstod pa brtsams shing / rong ston las gzhung lugs du ma gsan pas/ rong ston gyis nga la sangs rgyas slob ma yod ces bsgrags par mdzad/ stag lung du 'dus sder chos gsung ba'i tshe/ me tos/ bi char mngon sum babs/ lho rong du bstan 'gyur gos dar gyi thum can bzhengs/༷ rar gser gyi bka' 'gyur glegs shing glegs thag bcas bzhengs pa sogs mdo dbus khams gsum du chos dang zang zing gi mdzad pa bgrang gis mi long / rong po dang mi nyag gi 'khrug pa dang sgo sdong gi 'khrug chen sogs/ stod smad kyi 'khrug pa mang po bar mdzad/ sham bha la dang ma kha gnyis rtsod pa yod pas kho bo rigs ldan gyi grogs su 'gro dgos yod gsungs nas sku chos dang / dbu zhwa zhwa nag bsre 'pho'i zhal gdams zhal gdams 'di sngar nā ro mi tris kyang ma gsungs pa'i khyad 'phags kyi sa dmas pa zhig yin par gsungs/la sogs pa'i phyag dpe rnams rgo shri la gnang ste lung bstan zhal ༵༵༵ ༵༵༵༵ ༷dī dgoX/sa spya ci chos snaX dī ༵ thim ༷sdu su/ / ༵ /byi ༵ ༵ ma sbyir ༷༵ lta sa sbya ༵ /shā ༷ni /48thu//sdu ༵༵༵ sdu/ /ga/ma da nga ring bsrel chu shel mdog can du dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gyi rnam pa can du ma byon/ khong gi slob tshogs la go shri dpal 'byor don 'grub/ kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang po/ kun mkhyen rong ston/ stag lung zhabs drung sogs dpag med byon/7 karma pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho ni rab byung brgyad pa'i shing khyi lor 'khrungs/ laXzhi khroX — 8 ) re/༅ kho / /44

༄༅/ /la rma pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar bzhugs so// la༄ / /ga rma pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar/ na rma pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho ni/ drug pa mthong ba don ldan gyis rgyal tshab kyi shri dpal 'byor don 'grub la zhal chems lung bstan 4bka' brgya bcu gsum dang bcas pa'i gnang ba dgongs don dang mtshur phu 'jam dbyangs chen po don grub 'od zer dang / kun mkhyen ban sgar 'jam dpal bzang po sogs kyis gzigs snang yongs su mthun par gsa' phu'i byang rngod spyi mda' zhes par skyon ri khrod bya bar yab sngags spyod kyi grub thob pa'i skyes bu chen po rus chen ldong gi nang tshan dpal ya ste/ grags pa dpal grub dang / yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i sprul pa jo dar bza' lha mo skyid gnyis kyi sras su/ rab byung brgyad pa'i shing pho khyi rabs lo54ga/ phus/ lugs 2335/ phyi lo145sa lo'i hor zla dang po'i tshes bco lnga'i snga dror/ khams tre shod khang dmar zhes pa deng sang dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi khongs su sku 'khrungs/ 'khrungs ma thag a la la gsungs shing bzhad pa dang / sku la me tog gi ri mo mang po dang / dbu ltag tu rdo rje 'chang gi sku/ thugs mar a yig gsang gnas su chos 'byung dang 'khor lo/zhabs la 'khor lo bcas rang byon drug mngon pa/ yab kyis gsol ba 'debs phyir mi pham ma bon po dang / yum gyis sku tshe brtan phyir mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/ zhag bdun nas gsung mang du 'byon pa sogs byung / yab yum gyis gsang yang sku 'khrungs pa'i grags pa phyogs kun tu khyab nas snye bos da ra stong gi gdan sar spyan drangs/ chos dpal 'byor gyis mjal du phyin skabs / 'khrungs nas zhag bco lngar song ba'i thog ba 'ad cing dgyes tshul mdzad/ rje gong ma'i sku chas rnams phyag gis bzhes pa las gzhan ma bzhes/ zla ngo gsum bzhes tshe mi rnams kyis nyid mthong ba don ldan gyi sku skye yin na yid ches pa'i gsungs shig 'byon par zhu zhus pas/ nga ni ma rma ming can de/ nga 'dra'i gang zag dkon pa yin/ /nga dang 'brel ba gang yod pa/ /nga yis mi bslu smon lam yod/ /sogs gsungs/ zla ngo dgu bzhes pa na go shri rin po che dbus nas phebs te mjal bas phyag rten rnams bzhes/ sgar dung phyag tu bsnams te nga'i yin gsung pa sogs ngo mtshar bsam gyi mi khyab par dgongs te rang byung kun mkhyen —— 14ཿ) —

༄tsa/ /na me pa sku phrang bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar bzhugs so/ / wa ge ge wa wa wa —————chos kyi rgyal po ro mtshan gsol/ sgar chen 'dzam/ gling rgyan chen por song ge'i khri la bzhugs/ zla ngo bcu gcig bzhes pa na nags phu bas spyan drangs/nags mdar khrom chen por ā li kā li gsungs/ de nas kurma pa bdun pa chos gra/gas rgya mcho dgung lo lnga pa sa/ stag rabs lo543 / phug lugs2339/ phyi lo1458/lor sum mkhar rgyal pos rta brgya 'bul sogs 'bul nod rgya chen byas// skya ser dpas tu med pa mngon mtho dang nges legs la bkod/ 'di lo zla ba gsum pa'i ya tshes la tshe dpag med phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dbang dang gtor ma'i byin rlabs/ yig drug yi ge'i phyi mo rgya bod kyi dbyangs gsal rnams phul/ rdor dril bum pa sogs 'dzin lugs dbang gi rnam ba 'ag dpag dka' ba mang du gsungs/ dgung lo drug pa sa yos lor dus 'khor gyi dbang yogs rdzogs phul/ dgung lo bdun pa lcag/sa 'brug lor mdo khams kyi gdul bya rnams kyis spyan drangs par phyag btegahor zla gsum pa'i tshes lnga la rdzong gsar du phebs/ lho rong nang so go shri kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis 'bul ba rgya cher phul/ dgung lo brgyad pa lcags sbrul lo gsar rdzong gsar du mdzad/ zla ba drug/ pa tar tig stag g.yag la kha rdza stod da/pal 'bar dgon sogs su byon// tsha rag thang du ma rma dang lha steng pas ja 'dren zhus/ zla dgu'i nyer lnga'i dus mchod skabs bka' brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad byon nas byin gyis brlabs pa gzigs/ dgung kho/ dgu nga/ chu rta lo'i lo gas/ra mdzad nas nags shod du byon/ nags shod glang thang bkra shis steng sing thang go rdzong sogs su 'phrin las che/ zla ba lnga ba'i yar tshes nas na rma phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur/ mi nyag rab sgang bi 'brug mdo chos khri thang du bla chen zla ba rdo rje dang zhing gi mi chen zo' rtsoyi grags pa rgyal mtshan zhu dbon gtsos lha sde mi sdes ja 'dren zhus/ phebs pa'i lam zhor du lci stong bzhi mdo zhes pa'i deng gi khams stod bod rigs rang skyong khul rdza stod rdzong lci stod shog kha'i khongs la bslebs nas si tu sku phreng gnyis pa bkris rnam rgyal 5445 5497dgung lo bcu gsum steng dpon slob brgya lhag gis ja 'dren zhus/ mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ par stod gri gu sta ga snar/ sgom sde nang ya gnyis kyis khri rwa can gyi 'bul ba khrom khri phrag tshog/sa pa rnams phan bde la bko/da/ nang chen dang tshang gsar sa/nyis rtsod yu na ring bas thams cad sdug bsngal ba la 46

༄cu / /ga rma pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar bzhugs so//bka'i bdud rtsi bstsal bas gnyis la ga'i zhal ngo gdan sa pa phyag phyir 'brengs/ rtsod pa rang sar zhi/ sgom sde spun gnyis ces sgar du grags shing thugs mdza' bar gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ni mtsho sngon zhing chen khams stod bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi dad thog khul gtso'i 'gan —bzhes pa'i nang chen rgyal po bkra shis tshe dbang rdo rje ba'i mes po 'bri stag rgod nas mi rabs zhe bdun pa gung pa gi'u yi dus 'ba' rom lugs la dad nas chos — srid gnyis ka shin tu thod ra bas nang chen sgom sde ru khag bco brgyad ces dbyar rnga lta ra grags/ 'on te phyis su 'ba' rom pā nyag phra bas/ na rma pa sku phreng gsum tsho rang byung rdo rje dgung lo zhe gcig pu shing byi nas nang chen rgyal po'i spun mu ched bar nang chen dad tshang gsar khag gnyis su gyes pa da lha'ang lags pa lo rgyus thog thong myong ba'i gnas tshul dngos yin/ dus de nas bzung 'ba' rom pa'i sgom sde rnams kai tshang shugs che ba/ da lta 'i skyo brag dgon dang zur mang dgon la sa gsal/ phyogs de'i bstan pa'i gtso bo bka' brgyud bla mas bskor/ —de nas zla dgu'i tshes brgyad la —ka rma/ dgon la phebs/ tshes bcu bzhi nyin go shri rin po ches dge bsnyen gyi sdo ma pa gnang / zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin zur mang dgon nas zhwa dmar sku phreng bzhi ba dgung lo bcu par dang thog kurma pa dang mjal te gtsug phud phul/ mtshan la chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang por gsol/ zhwa dmar gyi cod pan dang tham ga gnang / de nas zhwa dmar nas gnyis kyis bstan nga mnyam du spel/ de nas yi rma pa chos grags rgya mtsho dgung lo bcu pa chu lug rabs lo5458/ phug lugs2344 phyi lo 14/(3/lo gsar la rmar mdzad nas zur mang dgon du phyag bteg bya shul lhun grub dgon du phebs/ der me tog gi nar babs / tshems mche ba g.yas pa brjes pa la a ཿ dkar po dang : gzhan la mi la'i sku dang / dung dkar g.yas 'khyil yi ge ha rnams dkar zhing gsal ba phyir ma 'bur ba me long la bzugs brnyan lta bu byon/ zhes gsungs pa ni deng gi khams stod 'dam dkar dgon yin/ de skabs dul mo bkris 'od zer bzhugs/ de nas la rma pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa shing bya rabs lo5460/ phyi lo1465/ lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ tsha sgang dang ngom stod smad sogs la phebs/ 'di lo'i sangs rgyas dus chen su ma 'dzoms sa ga'i nya'i nam longs skabs/ 1 /dzha 〉

ra༅༅ / /ma rma pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar bzhugs so//wa ma khan po rkarma ra kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang po dang go shri dpal 'byor don 'grub kyis las slob mdzad nas rab tu byung bar mdzad/ mtshan chos grags rgya mtsho dpal bzang por gsol/ mkhan po las 'dul ba'i mdo thams cad gsan/ de nas gnas sgo ba / sum 'bor ba/ shar dmar rdza sgang pa/ dar rtse mdo/ mi nyag rab sgang sogs su byon/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la ma rma nas phyag bteg tshe sa cung zad g.yos/ gling gi nang dme 'khrug rtsod pa sogs bsdums shing dben chen gsar du bskos/ mnga' 'bangs thams cad phan bder bkod/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa me khyi (546 1)lo gsar zur mang dgon du mdzad/ lha ba/ zur dgon/ lda kyin ma/ rnams su zhabs kyi bcags/ rdza yul zhi gong du rma se ba'i ja 'dren dang zhabs ba skul bla —ma kuḥ thog pa sogs la phebs pa zhal gyis bzhes/ lcags mo dang kre bor phebs/ rgya nag gi 'bul zhabs slebs/ dgung lo bcu bzhi pa me phag (5gi62)lo gsar mdzad rjes/ gling tshang can shing thar pa rgyal mtshan gyis gser khang du spyan drangs/ 'bul zhabs rgya chen gyis mchod cing 'bum 'dzam gling rgyan la phyag nas zhus/ de nas shal khog stod smad du phebs/ ban bon dang sde phan tshun bar gyi 'khrug rtsod bsdums/ ci stag rong du byon nas ar+ya gling sogs nas gzhan phan cher mdzad/ dgung lo bco lnga pa sa byi (5463)lor/ 'dzi ga lha mo dar thang du chos rje gzhon nu ba sogs kyis mchod cing phyi nang gi 'khrug rtsod rnams zhi zhing btson gro lnga mdzad/ a mdo ba phur tsha nang so/ hor ser gyi ri thang gnyis/ be ri'i seng ge mi log gi yon mchod sogs kyis gdan drangs/ rma stod ra rgod mthon po nyi shar du phyag phebs/ dgung lo bcu drug pa sa glang (5464lor a ri dgon dang wag shir seng ge dgon sogs la phebs/ de nas dar rtse mdo dang rgyal rong lcags zam/ rang grol mchod rten/nu 'og steng / rdza bkra dgon/ 'ba' ga dgon/ rag po kha bzhi/ byams sar/ yul gyung / stod ma go rin chen gling / gter byi rin chen steng rnams su byon/ 'jang nag ra bar slebs dus rgya nag gi yul lha rnams kyis bsu ba byas/ de nas mi nyag dang 'jang gi mtshams sgo ro yul du byon/'khrug chen rnams lo nyi shu rtsa lnga dang jag phran rkun ma so gsum thams cad dge la bkod/ der ras bud dang sha yul du dgung lo bcu bdun pa'i 148

gyi༅/ /na rma pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar bzhugs so//lcags stag (5465)lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ gzhi bdag sdo gzi 'dzo dgye bsnyen du bkod de rdo rje bod khams skyong du ming btags/ skya khring rma se la li sogs zhabs kyis bcags/ dzā lan dha ra/ ka bzhi/ rma se sogs mkhas pa mi lnga'i chos gra chen po rnams la chos 'khor bskor cing / chos khrims nyams pa rnams gsos te 'chad nyan gra skor sogs snga srol bzang po la bkod/ 'bru dang mi nyag rab stod tshar sgang / nyag rong ba/ mgo log ma khrom sogs kyi 'khrug pa bsdums nas 'ba' bde chen steng du phebs/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa lcags yos (5466)lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum la gdan sa gnas sgo'i la ka ri phug tu phebs/ chos 'byung steng gi pha bong zhig la zhabs rjes drug chos khri yod sar zhabs rjes gnyis/ rga lo phug gi lam bar du chibs pa lhun grub kyi zhabs rjes bcas gsal por cha/jal rgyu yod pa byung / (ra byar bzhugs mi/ma po gangs ra'i gnas nang byang 'bos su mdzad/ bel phur bsam gtan gling dang bde chen gling / 'bo de dgon/ rtsad bar yang dgon/ kha ba dkar po bcas la sgrub sde btsugs/ ru lon pa/ ngo khro/ 'bri chu brgyud pa'i lha sde mi rnams smin par mdzad/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa chu 'brug (5467)lo'i lo gsar sbyor sgang du mdzad/ 'gro mgon ras chen gyi slob brgyud bcu gnyis bskor pas tshem tsi dgon du spyan drangs/ gnas sgor phebs/ dbra 'dru gnyis kyi 'khrug pa bzlums/ rje dus mkhyen gyi sgrub gnas spang phus tu sku 'dra gsung byon la mchod/ der dbyar bzhugs mdzad/ zla ba gsum 'dag sbyar la bzhugs/ der 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i 'bul zhabs rgya cher phul/ mkhas pa'i dga' ston las rgya nag nas gong ma rgyal po chen po ching hwa'i (44thu) lung dbu zhwa/ zhwa nag khyad par can dang mu tig gi snam sbyar/ yol ba bla res sogs ma/chod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang gser bre chen gos dar khri phrag sogs kyi 'bul ba rgya chen/ kon ting go'i shri bsod nams rgya mtsho dang / du gang bkra shis bzang po/ gsol ja chub 'od zer rgya mtsho/ nyi ma 'od zer rnams kyis phul zhing gong ma sku tshe brtan pa'i smon lam gyi rgyun mdzad/ ces gsungs pa ni rgya nag gi yig tshang las/ rgya nag ming rgyal rabs — kyi rgyal po dgu pa zhon tsung ( lko)bi khreng hwa khri lo bzhi par sa byi (5463)chos grags rgya mtsho dgung lo bco lnga pa/ bod kyi bla chen rnams la rgyal bla cho— 149

༄༅/ /ma rma pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar bzhugs so//(77)dang rgyal bla chen mo sogs kyi cho lo phul yod zer bas de yin pa 'dra/ de lo khong gi chibs pa lhun grub 'das pa'i so la dung dkar byon pa dang / rus pa thams cad la ring bsrel dang a dkar po mang du thon skad/ de nas si tu gnyis pa bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis zhus pa ltar/ zla ba bcu ba'i nang kurma'i phyogs la phyag bteg mtsho khar phebaso/ ras 'bud du shing rta (5469 )lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ 'di lor khong dgung lo nyer gcig dang zhwa dmar bzhi ba dgung lo nyer gnyis/ si tu gnyis pa dgung lo nyer lnga/ rgyal ba dang po dge 'dun grub 'das pa'i lo yin/ shar kha'i yul nas zhwa dmar bzhi pa dang lhan du 'dzoms/ gsung chos rgya cher mdzad nas re zhig bzhugs/ de nas gling tsan shin wang dang gling bar tshang gi du si ting 'dzing ye shes kyis gdan sar spyan drangs/ nyi ldan steng du chos sde btab/ zur mang du phebs te bde chen rtser sgrub sde mdzad/ kurma pa chos grags rgya mtsho dgung lo nyer gnyis pa shing lug (5470)lo la kurma ra phebs/ dga' byed sgang du dbyar bzhugs bug sgo mdzad/ nang chen gyi par khar phebs/ sgom sde nang ya gnyis kyi 'dun ma sogs 'di phyi'i don mdzad/ kurma pa dgung lo nyer bzhi pa me bya (5477)lor skyo mdar spyan zloX dī/zhe/sa da // /ma la snang da ༵ ༵༵ ༵ ༵ /byed/ daXd /ca ༷dpa dzī ma dī /༷ spya ra dī dī da da/ /zlo /rma ༵ rdzubaXng te lha / chen na/zhe/ nga /ba/ji /go ༵ /bas la 'byams pas kurma thub chen gdan sa btab gsungs pa de 'dra/ kurma pa dgung lo nyer drug pa sa phag (5474)lor dbus phyogs su phyag btega'adam gzhung nas ri bo rgyal chen bco brgyad kyis sngon bsu mdzad skad/ 'dam gzhung du yor dgon btab/ 'ba' rom pa'i zhabs rjes bstan/ de nas mtshur phur phebs te lha chen 'dzom gling rgyan sa g.yos kyis cung zad gnod pa zhig gso dang rab gnas mdzad/ na rma pa dgung lo nyer bdun pa lcags byi (5475)lor dbus lha sar phyag bskyod/ dge bon khar sne'u rdzong pa sku mched dpon g.yog gis lha'i 'byor pa lta bus bsus/ tshe tan zhabs drung gi bstan rtsis kun btus las/ rin spungs don yod rdo rjes bka' brgyud pa'i 'en gyis dbe lugs sbyin bdag gtso bo sne'u gdong gi /da/—

༅༅ / /rkarma/ pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar bzhugs sa — — — ——4r+sha — — — ————— wa wa — srid nga bang 'phrogs/ zhes gsungs/ rin spungs pas dmag khri gcig lhag tsam 'khrid de sne'u rdzong sogs rdzong gzhis 'ga' zhig btsan bzung byas/dus der gtsang khul gyi rdzong gzhis mang che ba rin spungs pa'i dbang du 'dus/ tshes bco lnga nyin lha sa'i jo bor mu tig gi snam sbyar/ jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje la snam sbyar gser ma sogs mchod sprin mtha' yas mdzad/ de nas byang gnyan chen thang lha'i zhol gyi ldeb lung dgon phul zhing rab gnas mdzad pas 'phel/ hor zla bdun par 'u yug tu dung zhwa dmar ba sogs tshogs par mdo sde brgya pa sogs gnang / de'i tshe spyan snga tshes gnyis pa sne'u gdong gi khri thog mdzad pas spyan 'dren brgyud mar bslebs/ chu byang kha nas spyan snga rin po che sne gdong gi go sar phrebs pas spyan drangs te chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ rin spungs nang so mtsho skyes pa dang snol pa du dbon sha la sogs la so so'i 'dod chos gnang / hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gcig la khri ston gyi shis brjod mdzad/ chibs kha rim gyis lha sa nas brgyud/ ma mo grwa tshang bi bshad gra thog mar btsugs te/ mi nyag rab 'byams pa mgon po dpal klog pa'i slob dpon du bskos/ kurma pa dgung lo so gcig pa shing 'brug (5479 )lor/ zhwa dmar bzhi pa chos grags ye shes dgung lo so gnyis bzhes/ ban chen sangs rgyas gnyan pa dgung lo bzhi bcu bzhes pa'i dus bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa shin tu rgyas/ 'on te/zhwa dmar ba la bdud kyis bar chad byed grabs su/ sangs rgyas gnyan pa sogs kyis nyen kha zhi bar bsgyur/ rje zhwa nag pa'i bkas bskul ltar 'u yu ga phu dkar nas rje zhwa nag pa dang mjal/ bla mas sangs rgyas gnyan pa rang yul shog tu btang / 'di lor khams sga ba'i yul gyi a gro dang 'dan ma gnyis 'khrugs te gnyan pa'i sku mched a gro bas bkrongs/ spun zla bya bral ba sangs rgyas gnyan pa mthong ma thag 'e sdang gi rtsa ba zhi/ dang pa rang dbang med par skyes te ci yod thams cad phul/ ma rma pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i slob ma sangs rgyas gnyan pa zhes pa'i grags pa thob/ a gro dang 'dan yul du spyan drangs te rab byung brgyad pa'i me lug (5482)lor/ sa mtshams rma rgyan ri khrod du dgon pa btab/ de lo sa chen po g.yos/ gnyan pa thog rtse gi so zhig nas bla ma bya 'phur ba ltar byung bas gnyan pa grub thob ces kun tu grags/ dbon pa 'bri chu'i klung su spos nas byang chub 1 51

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar bzhugs so//gling btags/ da lta dkar mdzes khul dang khams stod sa khul gnyis kyi bar du yod pa'i rma 'bri byang chub dgon yin/ skabs der da chen stong gi yongs sgo sbyar te/ dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo ches bzang bar sbyar/ bla mas gnyan pa khyod kun spangs kyi brtul zhugs kyis mdo stod smad tha mas cad slong mo'i spyod pa gyis shig gsungs pa ltar bsgrubs nas/ zhwa nag pa la khri rwa can dang 'bum rwa can gyi 'bul ba lan bzhi lnga dang stong rwa can gyi 'bul ba grangs med mdzad/ 'di lor rtse lha sgang gi rnam thos tshal du bzhugs tshe/ sbyin bdag chen po bya khri dpon bkra shis dar rgyas dang sras go shri chos kyi grags pa sogs dpon g.yog bzhi brgya sum cu rtsa gsum gyis spyan 'dren/ gser zho stong phrag lhag pa byu ru'i rgyal mo lag ya khru tshad ma/ shel rkyen/ gur nyi ma lha khang la sogs pa gsum/ rta drel nyi shu rtsa gsum/ dar ras ches mang ba dang bcas pa phul/ glang gong bde chen steng du dgon pa thobs gsungs te phyag nas gtor/ de nas na rma pa chos༄gas rgya mtsho dgung lo so lnga pa sa sprel (5483)lor/ rgya nag gong ma bcu pa hung ṭi khrir 'khod/ sprul ba'i sku zhwa dmar bas dga' ldan ma mor gtsug lag khang gsar ma lha chen dang bcas pa bzhengs pa grub ste/ bla ma rab gnas la spyan drangs te rab gnas shin tu legs/ zhwa dmar nag gnyis kyis lha sde mi sde'i khrom khri phrag mang po la chos kyi dga' ston dang lugs gnyis kyi bka' drin rgya chen po mdzad/ rtse lha sgang du phebs te lo gsar smon lam mdzad/ glang khrod tshal du bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mdzad/ nya snga kha phyogs nas rlung 'tshub drag po g.yugs nas nyang kha'i shing sdong du ma bcag 'ur sgra sa g.yos pa tsam byung / rnam thos rir bzhugs tshe po rngod snyed gsum/ mdo stod/ mdo smad/ dbus gtsang / bya ba rnams so so nas spyan 'dren mi mang du bslebs/ spo bo'i bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa thams cad kyi bdag rkyen zhus/ lo bzhi no spo ba'i nar srid kyi ser 'du dang chos khrims spo kong gi mar srid gcig la gcig phan gyi bka' gnang / der shar mon gyi rgyal po jo 'bag dpon g.yog mang po mjal bar bslebs/ 'bul ba mtha' yas/ khong rang yang gtsug phud phul zhing bstan pa 'dzugs par zhus/ nyang kha'i phyogs brag dkar lha chur rdo rje phas rno/'i gnas sgo phyes/ de'i brag ngo mtho sar zhabs rjes dang / phyag mdzub kyis bras ngos su yi ge drug pa bris/ — 152

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar bzhugs so//'phags yul gyi ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje gdan sa chen pos rgya gar gyi phyogs su bstan pa spel bar phebs dgos pa'i spyan 'dren zhu yig dang / paṇ+ḍi ta sgra can zin gzhon nu dang ma ga dha'i rgyal po bcas kyis spyan 'den zhu yig phul/ spo bo'i phyogs su bre bo chu mdor rnam rgyal gling gi dgon pa btab/ bla tsa ma 'od zer rgyal mtshan bskos/ spo kong gi 'khrugs rtsod bsdums/ rje 'di nyid kyis dus rgyun 'jig rten gyi gtam mi gsung zhing chos kyi 'bek+ṣa/ gtam kho nas dus 'da' ba dang / phal cher thugs dam thun bcad mdzad pa las skyo sangs ri gzigs sogs mi mdzad/ sgar dpon rnams kyang tshong mi byed/ yo byad mi gsog bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len dang chos drug gi thugs dam bzung ba kho nar byung / bu tsha phyag g.yog rnams kyis kyang yi dam gyi bsnyen pa dung phyur gsum bzhi ma thebs na mi grangs su mi brtsi/ sgar nang du sha chang mi khyer ba sogs kyi khrims shin tu legs pas chos sgar chen po'i srol btsugs/ spo bo ye gong gi mar phu thang du dgon pa btab/ rgya nag gi ta ming dgu pa 'das pa'i gser yig pa 'byor nas gong ma gshegs pa'i smon lam dang khri thog phebs pa'i bkra shis mdzad/ tsho ba so dgu'i khyung po ri bo che dang nub chos lung gi yang dgon stag chos byang chub gling sogs su sgrub sde btsugs/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan sogs mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams la chos kyi zab gnad bkye bar mdzad/ de nas dbus su phyag bteg mon nas gter ston pad+ma gling pa dang / nub mon gyi rgyal po sogs mjal du phebs/ gter las drangs pa'i dam rdzas dang rgyal ba nyid kyi lung bstan gyi yi ge sogs phul/ gzhan yang kha che khri brtan rgyal po/ bal po khu spom rgyal po/ pu rang gangs kyi rgyal po/ gu ge'i g.ya'i rgyal po/ mang yul chab kyi rgyal po/ glo ba'i rgyal po/ la stod lho byang rgyal po/ gtsang stod rgyal po seng ge rtse/ rgyang mkhar rtse ba sogs kyis ja 'dren gser yig pa bslebs/ chos rje smon lam pa —dang mkhas pa legs chos pa sogs kyis gtsos pa'i ser 'bras dge gsum/ bde skyor zul gsum sogs da ge slong khri phrag du mas ser phreng gis bsus/ rnam thar rin chen phreng ba las/ rgyal ba byams pas lung bstan te/ jo bo shākya mu ne 'di nag grong gi dbus su bzhugs pa 'dis bstan 7pa nyams/ khyad par bod rdu nyams/ jo po'i sku 'khor du dge 'dun gtsang seng nge ba'i sde zhig grub na bstan — 153

༄༅/ /na rma pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar bzhugs so//pa sos par 'gyur gsungs pa lan gsum du gsan pas de lta bu zhig thugs kyi dbongs kyang gzhis rko snol pa kho rang chags pa nas bzung drung na rim gsum gyi sbyin bdag yin rung gzhan dbang gis bka' ma sgrub pas/ bar sko ra gyi phyir dge 'dun bzhugs pa ni ma grub/ 'on kyang byams pa'i bka' ma bcag pa tsam mdzad par dgongs nas na rma grwa tshang gi bzhugs gnas su chos sde btab pa na skyes bu gsum las gang rung gi lam rgyud la skyes nges kyi dam pa 'ga' zung yang so so na yod par gdon mi za mod kyi de dag la ni sus kyang nyan par mi spyod/ snyigs dus kyi chos byed zer nas dge sbyong dang bram ze zang zing kho nar 'du zhing khyim la 'phren pa 'ba' zhig pa de dag yid 'dus ris kyis mngon par dkrugs te rab byung gi rtags kyi phyi shun go mtshon ci rnyed bsdus pas gras kyi g.yul bshoms par rtsom pa na/ dad ldan du mas 'di ltar la lan dang / srung ba'i sta gon byed na sgar sa kho na nyis stong du nye ba zhig 'dug par phyag mdzod du 'bul ba'i gri khrab kyi dod bshig rin 'ang khengs pa 'dra bas ban dmag phyed dang lnga brgya tsam zhig lan gyis gzhi la bslebs/ bka'i gnang ba zhus kyang / 'o skol su la yang gnod pa khro byed pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ring lugs pa yin phyir/mtshams med kyi las kyis rgyal bstan la rma mi 'byin gyi khyod rang su yin yang nga yi 'khor yin na/ na co ge sdod cig gsungs te ji mi snyam par bzhugs/ nang par glo bur du ser dmag lnga brgya tsam bshams/ rmog med pa rnams lhung bzed mgor gyon/ rten khebs la mdung dar byas te 'ong /se ra ba sogs 'u lag mang du khrid de 'ong bas sgar pa sus kyang bka' las ma 'das shing g.yo 'gul ma byung bas sgar la gnod ma nus par/ chos sde mkhar las skyes bu re gnyis zin/ phal cher ma zin pa rnams bshigs bsreg byas/ 'di thob pas skye bo lha mi thams cad yid 'khrugs/ drung zhwa dmar ba'i sku 'khor lha 'bangs che shos rnams nas kyang 'di ltar btang snyoms su 'jog pa mi 'ong pas 'di'i khag khong rnams kho nas byed zhu ba dang / gzhan yang dad ldan gyi sbyin bdag du ma dang / bya sa khrid dpon sogs kyis bstan la tho ma tshams pa 'dir mngon sum du nyes chad 'bebs dgos par gdon mi za bas nged rnams nas thal bar bgyid ces dang / rkang po'i sbyin bdag thams cad kyis dmag 'cha' bar zhu ba dang / sa 1 54

༄༅/ /na rma pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar bzhugs so//skyong don yod pa dang / lcagasu mo 'od zer sogs kyis nged rang gi mnga' zhabs su 'di 'dra'i chos lugs gcig kyang mi 'jog pas gnang ba zhu ba bcas/ de thams cad la nged su la yang gang phan las gnod pa mi byed/ khyed grwa yon bdag gis kyang chos bzhin bstan pa ltar byas na nged kyi dgongs pa rdzogs/ nged la dmigs nas gzhan la gnod pa byas na nged kyi zhabs tog ma yin gsungs nas dam pa'i chos 'ba' zhig pa'i bka' nan gyis yang yang bsdams pas kha cig legs so phul zhing dad pa bla lhag par skyes/ zhwa dmar ba'i sku 'khor phyogs rnams dang / /bya sa khri dpon sogs nas/ khyed bstan pa'i bdag po rnams bstan pa mi srung na nged tsho la 'dra nyan chung zer ba'i thugs chad mtha' yas par mdzad/ phyis bya sa ci khri dpon gyis 'di thugs la mnag pa kho nas/ yar gong snel gsum dang srid bshig ste gtsang srid mdzad nas skyid shod du khri dmag gnyis gsum btegs pa'i tshe/ khong rnams ma bzod nas rje zhwa dmar ba la skyabs zhus kyang / drung nyid du zhus cig par bka' stsal/ drung rtse lha sgang du bzhugs pa der myur ba'i pho nya brtol te/ bka' shog nan can mdzad pas khri dpon pas 'dir yang zhu yig snga phyi dang / la rgyus mang bar gda' phyi bltas rje zhwa dmar bas skyabs pa 'dra yang ngo bo rje nyid kyis thugs rjes skyabs pa ste/ byed pa po de dag gi lus srog longs spyod rten gnas dang bcas la mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa bstsal te/ 'dzam bu gling gi skyes mchog ni/ nyes pa'i lan yang legs pa ldog zhes pa'i rnam thar mngon sum du bstan pa 'di la bsam gyin snying nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa mi skye ba su zhig ces gsungs pa ni tshe tan zhabs drung gi bstan rtsis las/ rab byung brgya da pa'i sa rta/phyi lo 1498lor gtsang rin spungs pas sne'u gdong bton nas lha sa'i smon lam la gsang phu ba dang kurma ba sogs bsdus nas se 'bras la gnod/ces gsungs pas 'di lor byung ba'i gnas tshul yin nam snyam/ de lo chos grags rgya mtsho dgung lo zhe lnga bzhes/ de nas dgung lo zhe dgu pa chu khyi (5497)lo'i lo gsar smon lam mdzad/ shar kha nas gangs pa bla ma dang 'dan ma grub thob sogs mdo khams kyi grwa rgyun rnams kyis ja sig chen stong phrag dang gser dngul sogs 'bul chen phul/ dpa' bo chos dbang3rna grub kyis kyang bka' bzhin dro bo lung du sgrub sde dang sras mkhar la 155

༄༅/ /7/me pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar bzhugs so//zhig gso mdzad pas khong gis skyong dgos pa'i bka' gnang / dgung lo lnga bcu pa chu phag (5498)lor dpa' bo 'das/ zhwa dmar bzhi bas yangs pa can dang lha sar thub bstan chos 'khor btab/ zla bdun pa la lha sar spyan drangs/ jo bo'i sku 'khor du dge 'dun gtsang hrug pa cig gnang bzhed kyang sde pa rang gi thugs bzhed kyis po ṭa la'i ri logs la chos sde 'debs par zhus pa btsan ches pa rang dgongs nas drung gis bkas ma gnang / lha sa'i shar du thub chen chos 'khor gyi chos sde'i rmang bting / de nas rim gyis dwags po'i gzhung nas brgyud/ kong por spyan drangs/ dgung lo nga gcig pa (5499)lo'i lo gsar rtse lha sgang du mdzad/ rgo shri sprul sku khams su bteg pa bkas ma gnang ste rgyal tshab tu bskos/— sku tshe ring zhing bsta na pa'i don du lo gsum la sku mtshams dam por bzhugs rgyu byas shing / gzims khang sgrom zhig mdzad nas bzhugs/ sde bdun la lha shākya rgyan sogs rgya 'grel du ji ltar bkral ba thams cad mdor bsdus pas brjod de chod ma'i legs bshad kyi chu bo kun 'das rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bod gzhung gang la yang ma ltos par rang stobs kyis mdzad/ ga 'an yung mngon rtogs rgyan 'grel 'jig rten gsum gyi sgron me/ 'dul ba gzhi gsum gyi cho ga gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i mngon rtogs/ bstod tshogs sna tshogs pa sogs bstan bcos khyad par can mang du mdzad/ sku mya ngan las 'da' khar/ chos grags rgya mtsho dgung lo nga gsum pa me stag (550 1)lo'i mjug tu kong po ba rnams kyis zhu nan ches pas zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gnyis nas nang mjal ci rigs pa dang / bcu bzhi pa la lha sde mi sde'i khrom chen po 'bum phrag tu longs pa tshogs pa'i khrom chen por chos khrir phebs te/ kho bo'i sprul sku bsdus zin/ 'di longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin gsungs nas/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha byad la mu tig gi dbu rgyan la sogs pa'i rgyan drug bzhes te thams cad la zhal mjal gnang / de'i dgong mor zhal chems phyag bris gsol cog steng bzhab gnang ste/ tho rengs dus sku mya ngan las 'das tshul bstan/ de'i tshe sa g.yo ba dang / 'ja' 'od me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang po byung / sku gdung zhugs la phul bas ring bsrel kha dog sna tshogs dang / lhag pa ra sku'i sga la tshigs dang sku rtsib sogs mi 'thor bar nya phyis kyi kha dog 156

gyi / /kurma pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar bzhugs so//ltar zhal bcu gcig dang / phyag gi ri mo bcas ches gsal ba'i spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi rnam pa ngo mtshar ba'i rten du byon pa rgyal tshab sprul pa'i skus rtse lha sgang du gser gdung rin po che bsgrubs par bzhugs su gsol/ 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i slob ma'i mchog rnams ni/ rgyal tshab spul sku bkris rnal rgyal/spyan snga rin po che zhwa dmar bzhi pa/gdan sa gnon pa'i skyes chen ban chen sangs rgyas gnyan pa sogs/sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi gdan sa khag lnga'i khri zur/ phag gru'i spyan snga tshes gnyis pa/ 'bri gung dbang rin po che/ 'bri gung chos rje kun dga' rin chen mched gsum/ sgam po'i spyan snga sne'u thang pa/ si tu gnyis pa bkra shis rnam rgyal/ rtogs pa don gyi bu slob/ rje btsun skya se rtogs ldan/grub chen chu 'khur ba/gzhag bla ma kun dga' dpal/'dan ma go shri bsod nams bkris/zur mang bya bral/ dul mo bkris 'od zer/rgya ston bya bral/ kun spangs pa/bla ma grags rgyal ba/paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya mchog ldan//mi nyag rab 'byams pa ma bo/na po dpal/ngo khro rab 'byams pa dbang phyug dpal/ smug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ nam phrin las chen po/ dwags po rab 'byams pa chos rgyal bstan pa/ dwags po rab 'byams pa gsung rab mang thos/sde bdun pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ dus zhabs pa shākya dbang phyug sgom sde nang ya gnyis kyi gdan sa pa la sogs las skal can gyi bla dpon chen po du ma/ rgyal rigs chen po'i mkhas grub mang po/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dang / khyim pa'i tshul can gyi rnal 'byor dbang phyug bcas grangs kyis mi langs par byon pa las sangs rgyas gnyan pa grub thob kyis don brgyud kyi gser phreng 'dzin pa'o//7 karma pa sku phreng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje ni bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho sku gshegs nas lo gnyis kyi thog rab byung dgu pa'i me yos 5502la 'khrungs/ri ri / / di ri ༷ ༷ 57

༄༅ / /ma rma pa sku phreng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//—————wa ———༄༅ / /ga rma pa sku phreng brgyad pa me bskyod rdo rje rnam thar/kurma pa sku phreng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje ni/ rje bdun pas drung si tu rin po cher sku 'da' kha'i snga gong nas ngom gyi gnas dngo / yab yum sogs yang srid sprul pa'i sku 'byon rgyu'i zhal chems phyag bris bka' rgya ma bstsal ba'i dgongs don ltar/ rab byung dgu pa 'go tshugs pa'i me yos rabs lo 5502/ phug lugs 2388/ phyi lo 1507/zla bcu gcig pa'i yar tshes ba'i 'i snga dor/ dpal ma rma'i gdan sa chen po dang nye bar ngom chu'i rgyud g.yas lung dkar ti phug bre brag sa tam gyi grong du/ yab a 'byams dang yum ldong mkha' spyod kyi dbon po ldong bza' bla ma sgron gnyis kyi sras su sku bltams/ lhums su zhugs skabs 'od kyi gong bu skar khung nas sil sgra dang bcas nang du song nas thams cad nyi ma shar ba ltar byung / yab yum dang yul sde la ngo mtshar ba'i rmi lam dang ltas dpag med byung / sku blta mas ma thag dri bzang gis khyab pa dang nga ni kurma pa'i zhes gsungs/ zhag bcu gsum thog yar bzhengs nas gar mdzad/ zla ngo bdun bzhes skabs chab mdo'i ri bo cher phebs// de nas bzung bslab ston gnang ba dang mngon mkhyen gsungs/ la lar yig drug gi dge skul mdzad pa sogs kyis skya ser thams cad dad pa thun mong ma yin pa skyes/ khams phyogs kyi yul mi thams cad kyis rgyal ba kurma pa'i sprul sku yin par thag bcad/ ma rma pa dgung lo bzhi pa lcags rta (5505)lor drung si tu pa rgyal sras bkra shis dpal 'byor pas rten sgam nas phyag bris bten te gzigs pas rgya tshab rin po che'i bka' dang mthun pas ngos 'dzin/ de nas gong ma'i na 4bza' gos chen zhig dang chu 'khur ba'i na bza' gos chen zhig gshibs pa/ na bza' de ngos 'dzin mdzad/ gtsug zhwa/ zhwa ser sgom zhwa rta mig ma zhig rnams drung du bzhag ste/ zhwa gang gsol zhus pas gtsug zhwa de bzhes nas gzhan gnyis phyir dor/ kurma pa dgung lo lnga pa'i lcags lug (5506)lor dbon po dga' bas a mdo bu kurma pa yin pa 'dra zhus pas// ga rma pa nga yin/ a mdo'i bu zur mang sku skye'i skye ba yin/ khong nga'i grwa pa yin gsungs/ kurma pa dgung lo drug pa chu sprel (5507/lor nyin zhis yum la ma rma na si tu pa 'das yod gsungs/ zhag bco lnga na drung pa 1 58

༄cu / /kurma pa sku phreng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//—cigashegs zer/ 'di lor zhwa dmar bzhi pa'i mdun du dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba rab tu byung / zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga la rdzong gsar nas bteg ste/ 'o ma'i lung gi sku 'dra la phyag nas mdzad/ nam zla dgun la khu byug dang 'brug skad lan gsum re grags/ kurma pa dgung lo bdun pa'i chu bya'i (5508)zla dang po'i tshes gcig la sgar du phebs/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin rgyal phur gyi 'grub sbyor la seng ge'i khri chen por phebs te bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol/ 'brug cher grags cing me tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od byung / sngar mthong ma myong ba'i bya ngo mtshar can rizhig byung nas re zhig bsdad/ sgar pa thams cad kyis thun mong ma yin pa'i dad pa skyes na sa gdan sa gong 'og kun tu gtam snyan gyi gser yig bkram/ bdag nyid chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mi bskyod rdo rje zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ sa ga'i tshes bcu gsum la rgyal tshab rin chen bkra shis rnam rgyal las theg pa chen po'i bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa gsan te/ chogs kyi grags pa dpal bzang po zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ rta nag lcags ral can gyi dbang phul/ de nas yi ge 'bri klog bslabs/ bla'i gcod par rab tu byung / rngogs du chos 'khor bkra shis gling btabs/ pha wang zhig la zhabs rjes bzhag de nas mdo khams shar phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur/ chab mdo'i ri bo che pas ja 'dren zhus/ de phyogs kyi kha mchu bsdums/ sa sgang gi gdan sar bstan pa rgyal mtshan dang ri ne dgon du dpal ldan bkra shis bskos/ 'og min ma rmar phebs/ sum pa'i sde ba zla gying thang dang ma rma pa'i 'khrug pa bsdums/ de nas mdo khams mchod rten ma thong grol du phebs/ so/ rub sogs kyis mjal/ ma rma pa dgung lo brgyad pa shing khyi (5509 )la nang chen zur mang du phebs/ zur mang bde chen rtse nas bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyis zhal gzigs/ de nas sman chung dgon dang rnying thang du phebs/ nang chen tshang gsar gu shri bkra shis rgya mtsho so gas kyis mjal/ lci byams rang byon rnams mjal/ zhabs rjes byon yang zur mang bdud rtsi dil dang ru dgon du phebs/ nang chen gu shri sangs rgyas grags pa dang gu shri bsod nams bzang po khu tshan gnyis byon te/ bla mas nang ya gnyis kyi kha mchu bsdums/ de nas bya shul skye sku mdo'i phyogs su phebs/ 'bri gung sgrol ma brag rtsar rje btsun sgrol ma'i lha tshogs kyis zhal 159

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//gzigs/ chu mtsho gshongs su skyu ra dge 'dun seng ge gis gdan drangs/ bya shul smad kyi sde dgu dgon nam 'dam dkar dgon du phebs/ der ban chen sangs rgyas mnyan pa (5440 —— 5514dang 'dam dkar dul mo bkra shis 'od zer rnam gnyis kyis mjal/ lcags ma nang so 'od zer yang phebs/ rje de dag la mi phyed pa'i dad pa 'khrungs nas rjes su 'dzin pa'i gsol ba btab der sga stag mgo'i ring bsrel gdan drangs par mjal/ rten 'di da lta'ang bzhugs/ de nas a gro rdzong dkar dang 'bom mkhar dgon/ 'dan dran thang du phebs/ ldan ma grub chen pas rma 'bri byang chub gling du spyan drangs te zhwa khra can stong tsam gyis bsus/ tre khang dmar dang nyag rong mtsho kha/ chos 'byung gong 'og sogs su phebs te 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ kurma pa mi bskyod rdo rje dgung lo bcu pa me byi (5511)sa ga'i tshes gsu/ma la 'brug grags/ ri thams cad ngur/ 'ja' 'od byu kyi dra ba bres/ me tog gi char babs glang po ches thag pa bcad nas sgar du phyin te bla mar phyag 'tshal ba sogs bzang ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / de nas 'jang ka bzhi gtso sa dmag khri tsho tsam gyis bsdus te 'jang rgyal du gdan drangs/ 'jang sa tham gyi pho brang gi nye logs su sgar babs/phyi nyin snga bar 'jang rgyal dang khong gi khu bo/ nu bo bcas kyi glang chen re zhon/ gzhan gyis rta zhon/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan/ rol mo sogs kyis bkod pa bsam las 'das/ bla ma'i gur sgor nas rgyal blon thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal/ la kha tsha smyon gyis lo tsā byas nas khams 'dri zhus/ 'bul ba phul/ de nas bla ma pho brang du spyan drangs te gsol ston rgyas par phul/ lo bcu gsum bar bod la dmag mi byed pa'i khas blangs/ zhag bdun la bzhugs/ 'jang rgyal gyis rgyal bstan spyi dang / khyad par du dkar bstan la dad/ bla ma phebs nyin la kha bar dmag gis bskyal/ bla mas lo bdun tsam nas slar phebs par zhal gyis bzhes/ de pa nas rgyal thang khang gsar du phebs nas dgon pa btab rim par stag lung pa'i dgon rdza khog dang dus mkhyen gyi sgrub gnas sbas phug tu phebs/ sku
