'dra gsung byon ma dang mjal/ der dus mkhyen gyis zhal gzigs/ byin gyis brlabs par mdzad/ de nas li thang / rab sgang / nyag rong / phag mo ri/ rje don ldan zhabs kyi gdan sa dza la ra/ mkhas pa mi lnga'i dgon bka' bzhir —— 160

༄cu/ /na rma pa sku phreng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so// phebs/ dge 'dun stong gis bsus/ de nas 'gro mgon chos 'phags kyis btabs pa'i sga'i rin chen gling du phebs/ ban chen sangs rgyas mnyan pas spyan drangs/ zla bcu gcig nang sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i drung du dge tshul bsgrubs/ 'dul ba'i skor rnams gsan/ shing rta'i srol 'gyed gnyis kyi sems bskyed zhus/ byang sa dang spyod 'jug sogs phyogs rnams gsan/ 'dus pa sdom pa sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang rgyud bshad nyan man ngag dang bcas pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor dang / nā ro chos drug gi zeb khri sogs gsan/ de nas be'u phyug dang khro mo khro/ byams gsar/ ta ti dga' ldan gling du phebs/ zhing gi tā rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis dar rtse mdor spyan drangs/ mi rigs sna tshogs khri phrag du mar chos 'brel gnang / dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sa stag (5513)lor si tu bsod nams rnam rgyal kurma'i gdan sar phebs/ gtsang pa'i dbang nyams nas se 'bras pa slar lha sa'i smon lam la tshogs rgyu byung / 7 rgyal ba sku phreng dang po dge 'dun rgya mtshos (5386ge5469)lha sa'i smon lam gyi tshogs dbu mdzad/ sne gdong mi dbang bkra shis grags pas 'bras spungs rdo khang sngon mo rgyal bar phul ba'i ming dga' ldan pho brang du bsgyur/ rje nyid kyi yongs 'dzin ban chen sangs rgyas mnyan pa mi lo lnga drug bar du phul nas don bdun lcags sbrul (5516)lor sku gshegs 'das lo la ngos 'dzin tshul sne gsum yod/ mnyan pa rin po che sku gshegs rjes/ mi bskyod rdo rje 'dam dkar dgon pa'i bla ma dul mo bkra shis 'od zer la bstan/ de nas kum po dpal rtsed kyis dar dkar phul/ rngu chu'i be+e ro tsa na'i gnas sgo phyes/ zhabs rjes kyang bzhag klu zhwa rta mgyogs su bshad grwa btsugs/ ngo khro rab 'byams pa slob dpon du bskos/ rgyal 'dzin stod smad kyi zhal lce rnams bsdums/ ban sgar nang so bstan pa rgya mtsho thub chen gyi 'dzin skyong la bskos/ rtse sgang gi ri khrod btab/ der 'jam dbyangs kyis zhal gzigs/nam pa brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje dgung lo bcu drug pa'i chu rta (5517)lor zur mang bya btang bas ma ṇi ril bu bsgrubs pa grub/ rgya nag ming rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po bcu gnyis pa gya jing ( )rgyal sar 'khod/ dgung lo nyi shu pa'i me khyi (5521)lor/ dge 'bri 'khrug langs skabs/ 'bri — — 161

༄༅ / /lam pa sku phreng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//gung nas kong po'i dmag dgos tshul gyi zhu yig 'byor yang rje 'dis bshol/ de nas ra phyi phag r+sha ra pas spyan drangs pas der rgyal tshab khong rnam gnyis phebs/ slob dpon chos mdzad la u rgyan bsnyen sgrub kyi khrid gnang / de'i skabs chos sde lnga zhes pa'i khrid yig dang / zab mo btun khung ma/rtogs ldan 'phrul sel sogs brtsams/ g.yor du phebs dus rgyal po mtshan ldan la bu gcig nged la phul gsungs/ bu chung zla ngo bco brgyad pa zhig yod pa'i tshul lugs rnams zhus pas 'dir khyer shog gsungs/ phru gu de sku mdun du khrid/ ming la dkon mchog yan lag btags/ dbu skra bzhes/ rnal 'byor dri med dpal da lta'i byis pa'i tshul du phebs byung gsungs/ nub gcig mchan phyed tsam na drung nyid rtog med du song bas/ sku 'khor rnams kyis sku ltem par go nas sku rim byas/ rtogs med de las sad pa'i tshe dbu ma'i skor mang po gsungs/ da lta'i don 'di la/ rngog lo/jo nang pa/ sa skya paṇa chen/ bu ston/ rong po rnams byon kyang mi 'jigs gsungs/ de nas bzung thal rang sngags rgyud/ lhag par gzhan stong dbu ma'i don thams cad thugs la shar/ phyag rtsom snga ma rnams dang / mngon rgyan yang gzhan stong du bkral ba'i khyi ka mdzad/ de nas rgyal po mtshan ldan phu bu'i skar du bos nas gzhan ngor ngos 'dzin sogs mdzad bcug nam mkha' dri ma med pa'i mthong nyid sogs kyi sprul sku'i tshul rnams phyag bris gnang / skabs der jo nang pa'i nges don rgya mtsho sogs dang / rma bya dang / shākya mchog gi dbu ma'i stong thun sogs gzigs/ kurma pa dgung lo nyer gcig pa'i me phag (5522)lo'i mgo zla'i tshes brgyad nyin rnam thos kyi ri bor mkhan po rwa hu la bha dra'i sprul pa bstan pa'i yan lag bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bcu phrag lhag lon cing / mkhas pa'i yan lag sde snod gsum la 'dzin mkhas gsal rig gi lnga tshan bzhi rdzogs pa dpal chos grub seng ge'i zhabs kyi mkhan po dang / kurma pa'i phrin pa chen po phyogs las rnam par rgyal bas/ las byed pa'i slob dpon mkhan po shākya bzang pos gsang ste ston pa grib tshod pa bla ma dpon yag pa bkra shis bzang po la sogs pa bdun gyi tshogs la bsnyen par rdzogs/ dge slong gi dngos po yang dag par nod cing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mtha' dag la de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang tha mi dad par gyur/ mtshan chos grub grags 162

༄༅ / /na rma pa sku phreng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//—pa dpal bzang por gsol/ de'i tshe mkhan bo las tshe dpag med grub rgyal lha ma/nga gi tshe dbang zhus rnam sras mdung dmar can chos skyong du phul — cing / khong ris bzhed par gzhan stong gi bshad pa mdzad nas lta ba 'di khyed kyis 'dzin dgos zhes zhus nas/ phyis su mkhan chen gyi dgongs bzhed skong bur shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi ye shes bden grub sogs gzhan stong du bkral zhing / mtshan yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs 'grel rje btsun ma/chog tu ngal gso ba yongs 'dus sa brtol gyi ljon pa zhes bya ba btags pa'i ṭīka chen brtsams te mkhan por phul/ 'di la ma legs pa yod pas dpyad pa dgos gsungs nas se ra rje btsun gyis dkar lan zhes bya ba zhig brtsams yod/ci pa brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje dgung lo nyer gcig pa (5522)lo'i lo mgo nas dgung lo nyer gsum pa'i sa glang (5524mi bar la rje phrin las zhabs las mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa don gsal/ byams chos bzhi'i tshad ma kun btus/ rnam 'grel/ rnam nges/ rig thig gyes pa'i bstan bcos bzhi/ mngon pa gong 'og 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ 'jug pa/ brtag gnyis/ rtsis kun bsdus pa sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen rnams/bod yul gyi rngog lo dang / phya gtsang gi yig cha/ sa paṇa gyi sdom rig la sogs mdor na gzhung chen nyer lnga'i tshig don thams cad gsan zhing bde blag tu khong du chud nga/ mdzad/ lo ngo gsum ring gsol ja bzhes pa'ang cung nyung / ma rma pa dgung lo 24lcags stag (5525)lo ra zur ri lhun sgrub pho brang btab/zur ri lhun sgrub ngo brang 'di nyid rje brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku dus su rab byung dgu pa'i lcags sta sa ( 168 80)lor thog mar phyag btab pa dang 'dus pa 'i sde bcugs rje nyid kyi zhal slob gnyus mar sa nas pa'i dge slong don grub rin chen zer ba'i skyes chen dam pa de snyed zur ri'i bla ma/ra zur bskos mdzad 'dug pa la phyis zur ri drung nga/ zhes pa cisgar chen gyi sgrub bla'i khongs nas sgrub pa /nyams rtogs tshad mthor son pa'i bla ma sa cis rgyar dbang la/rma pa nyid nas bsko ba 'gre sa nang srol dang / bla ma so so'i thugs blo 'khel zhing 'jon thangayod pa'i zur ri'i gnyer pa ser skya gang rung nas byas chog pa bcas bla gnyer gnyis dang / dbu mdzad dang chos khrims sbralas ma gcis dang mchod sa ldog gcig da se 'dun nyi shu skor bcas yod/ zur ri'i dge 'dun rnams chos bzhugs skabs sgar bla brang du snyan gseng zhus nas don smin byung mtshams sgar gyi grwa dmangs rnams la sgrigs ja phul nas chos bzhugs byed dgosi/ sgar chen gyi dgu phyag tshes gsum sogs sgrub mchod rgyas pa dang gar 'cham lag la ser tshos sa 'es dbe 'dun rnam sa sgar chen gyi 'du khang du tshos sa la phebs dgos pa las rnam kun 16 3

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//zla re bzhin zur ri'i sgrub chog logs su 'tshogs dgos pa dang dge 'dun rnams slar chos 'go ma thon na sgar gyi grwa dmangs/ spyi 'gre ltar gyi nyes chad sogs bla brang phyag khang nas thag gcod mdzad dgos/kurma pa dgung lo bcu pa me byi (5511)yan nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang thugs mnyam bzhag gi sgo nas thos bsam gtso bor mdzad cing / dgung lo nyer gsum pa sa glang (5524)phan chad la mthun mtshams mdzad myong / dgung lo nyer drug pa'i chu 'brug (5527)la zla ba lta bu'i lho brag dpa' bo dang zhal 'dzoms mdzad nyin nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis khengs me tog gi char babs/ drung nas nā ro cho drug la sogs pa'i khrid gnang / 'dul khri ka gi mchod brjod brtsams/ mngon pa'i rjika chen brtsams pa'i dbu tshugs/ mdo smad shar nas dom tshang dbon po'i bsngo zhus 'bul ba/ las zhwa gser gyi rigs lngas brgyan pa/ las gos nor bu stong ldan sogs phul/ mtshal khungs su bzhugs/ rkarma grwa tshang nas dge bshes bcu tsam bos nas mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa btsugs/ rtog ge 'phrul 'jam la zhu dag gnang / rje dpa' bo dang sde bdun rab 'byams pa ci dang phyogs glang sogs la/ bu ston rgyud sde spyi rnams kyi bshad pa dang / tshogs par rgyud sde lnga'i dbang dge tshul slong phyed dang nyin brgyar chogs pas dbyar khas blangs/ phrag mi rnams kyi dmag bsdus te kong lung ral gsum gyi dge dgon kun brlags par/ yon mchod gzhan thams cad kyis gros 'cham par drung nas dge ldan pa'i lha khang zhig gtor rgyu dang mgul ba breg pa khyad med kyi bka' phabs pa de bla mas bzlog par mdzad/ 'bri gung pa kun dga' rin chen gyi sku gdung rtse lha sgang nas gdan drangs pas 'bri gung du phebs/ sgar du smyung gnas kyi srol btsugs/ rdza yig tu rdo la zhabs rjes bzhag rje dpa' bo sgar bshad grwa'i zur chos la bskos/ de nas spo bor phebs/ kur dge'i 'khrug pa bsdums nas chab srid gcig tu mdzad/ myang kha ral gsum gyi lha sde mi sde'i re ba bkang ste 'bri gung du phebs/ stag lung du phebs nas thang pa'i sku sogs kyi gnas mjal/ brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje dgung lo so gcig pa'i me bya (5532)lo'i mgo zla'i nya la 'og min mtshur phur du phebs/ 'bri gung bas 'od sna dang klung shod sogs sde bco brgyad ri ci dge ldan pas srogs/ dbus gtsang dus 'khrug la bar chings kyi bka' shog gnang / de nas gtsang phyogs su chibs bsgyur/—— 164

༄cu/ /kurma pa sku phreng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so// —gra ma gru bzhir phebs/ sku 'dra rin po che mjal/ dga' ldan pho brang du rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i dbu thod mjal/ sde pa zil gnon pa bsnyen par rdzogs nas kurma 'bangs zhes btags/ de nas bkras lhun dang zha lu/ ngor chu mig khro phu/ snar thang bcas mjal/ yangs pa can zhwa dmar lnga ba dkon mchog 'bangs sam dkon mchog yan lag (5521— 5578)khri la bkod de shis pa brjod/ de'i skabs dus zing langs pas chos rje 'dzam gling pa skyabs zhur bslebs/ bla ma'i ma yum gshegs nas spur bzhus pas 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char babs/ chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston ltar na bya lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyi shu nas mdo khams shar phyogs su bteg rgyal mo rngul chu brgal/ ri bo che pas zhabs tog cher mdzad/sa sgang gi gdan sar bstan pa rgyal mtshan dang re sne dgon du dpal ldan bkra shis bskos/ na rma dang rim gyis li thang du phebs te 'bul nod mtha'o yas shing / gzhi bdag mkha' 'gro mas mdun ri'i rtser spyan drangs/ der dad pa'i rten du zhabs rjes bzhag dus der go shri rin po che zhing gzhan gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs rgya cher gnang / mtshur phur thub chen gyi gser thog rgyur ja brgya mdzo lnga bcu/ gser zho stong phyag gcig zangs dos bcu bzhi sogs dbus su brdzangs/ 'dob spang phug tu bla ma nang so bskos shing sgrub sde gsar du mdzad/ dung lung mgo dang 'gam sgang du phebs/ rim da' lung rab stong tshar skang gi gzhi bdag gzhag rwa lha rtses srog snying phul/ nyag rong gru khar khong mchod yon rna rdzas kyis gru kha phan tshun gyi gzhi ma lag phul/ mkhas pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i sgrub gnas dz+wa la rar zhig gso'i zhal bkod gnang / rab sgang gi grub thob rnam gsum dang mkhas pa mi lnga/ dgon chen bka' bzhi/ stong mgo'i rin po che'i gling / byams gsar ta ti dga' ldan glid rnams dang / zhing gi mi chen gyis spyan drangs te dar rtse mdor phebs/ pho brang shin tu ho/ 'gag jus/ lo jus/ 'go thum sogs kyi skye bo bgrang las 'das par chos 'brel mdzad/slar ta tir phebs/ rab 'byams pa smon lam dpal bla mar bskos/ tshe tan zhabs drung gi bstan rtsis las/ rje 'di'i dgung 'o so gnyis pa'i sa khyi (5533)lo ro phar phyin gyi 'grel bshad ser 'bras su bskur ba 'byor ba dang / dgung lo so dgu pa'i shing sbrul (5540)lor khong gi bu slob — — 165

༄༅ / /ma mo pa sku phreng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//wa wadapa' bo gnyis pa gtsug lag phreng bas chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston rtsom 'bo tshugs gsungs/ de nas ma rma pa sho bor dbyar gnas mdzad/ mol dam tshang nas rim gyis ya 'brog gshag rtse/ dga' ri/ zul phu/ bu shang rdo'i gnas rnams mjal/ de skabs 'bras spungs pas dmag bsdus nas sgar pa bkag jo bo mjal la 'byon ma bcug karma pa dgung lo bzhi bcu pa me rta (56541 )lor mtshal stag bi gtsug lag khang la me gnod byung / tre chung pa myur du shog gsungs la skabs der phebs rgyu ma byung bas myur du gshegs/ ga rma pas sku 'khor rnams la rgyas 'grel dri med 'od kyi ljags bshad zla drug la gnang / gangs ri thod dkar gyi gnas gzigs gnang / der rdo la zhabs rjes mang du byon/ zul phul dgon 'dabs su chibs pa'i rjes gnang / de nas khams 'jang gnyis nas 'bul skyel bslebs/ dgung lo zhe gcig pa me lug (5542)lo'i smon lam chen po grub pa dang/ rje nyid zhing khams su byon pa'i gsungs byon pa na/ zhwa dmar/ dpa' bo/ gtsug phreng sogs so sos brtan bzhugs phul bas dgung lo zhe brgyad bzhugs pa zhal gyis bzhes/ 'di lo'i dgun smad tshes bcu gsum la gung thang gi gtsug lag khang la me shor/ de nas gye re nas chu shul brgyud ldegs bshad gling du phebs/ chu bzang gi bong der dbyar gnas mdzad/ rin spungs pas rgyal rtser dmag bshams par bka' shog gnang kyang nyan ma 'dod/ gnam khog dang mtshur phur phebs nas mkhar las kyi zhig gso tshugs/ zhig gso grub nas btsang phyogs su phebs/ lam du 'bri gung zur pa — 'phrad du phebs/ thob rgyal dgra 'dul gling du sku gsum ngo sprod kyi khrid yig grub/ rje zhwa dmar sgar du phebs/ sku gsung thugs rten sku chas grwa pa/ chibs sga sogs gnang / bzhugs khri 'dra mnyam mdzad/ de nas mdo khams kyi ban chen sangs rgyas mnyan pa sku skye dang si tu rin po che phebs/ gsung rab gling gi grwa tshang btsugs/ dge ldan dge bshes 'ga' phebs par rje tsong kha'i dbu ma'i bzhed srol gsungs pas khong rnams shin tu mos/ de nas chab mdo'i lcags zam kha la bzhugs/ gtsug lag khang gi rmang bting / dus 'khor sogs kyi gar nyin gsum mdzad/ yul pa rnams kyis rang rang gi bro gzhas phul/la de nas tsa rir phebs grwa pa/ mang por bsnyen rdzogs gnang / sgo bkra shis sgar du rje dpa' bo 166

༄cu / /kurma pa sku phreng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//phebs nas zhal rgyas mdzad/ 'du khang du grwa pa rnams la zhal bkod mang du gnang / mtsho dkar du gzim khang bzhengs nas bzhugs/ rim gro pas khang pa 'di cung che la mtho 'dug zhus pas/ mi lto bdag sku gshegs pa byed bsam pa yin/ri mi mang po 'du yong bas che dgos gsungs/ de nas zla dgu bar sku dpung g.yas cung bsnyungs shing / sku 'khor rnams la/ da ni nga yang tshe'i rting pa yin pas dri mol yod na gyis gsungs/ bdag 'das pa'i rjes su khams phrug zhig ma rma par bdag rkyen byed yong zhes dang / da lta nga'i zhal ltos/ spur thal yin zhes thal ba 'bo me dgos pa yong gsungs/ na rma pa brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje dgung lo zhe brgyad pa'i shing stog (5549 )lo gsar sngar bzhin mdzad/ rje zhwa dmar pa'ang rkyen med par thugs sdi bde ba dang mnal lam du tshems bud pa rmis gsungs/ de skabs na rma pas thugs brtsam khag gi mjug rnams bsdus/ dga' ston du e ka dza ṭir phebs shing tshogs 'khor mdzad/ de skabs long dmag dwags por slebs nas/ rje zhwa dmar rin po che dwags kong gi 'dum la phebs dgos byung bas/ rje dpa' bo kurma pa'i sku mdun du spyan drangs/ sku 'khor rnams kyis nus pas tsa rir phebs/ tsa ri'i gong la nas mdo khams phur tsha'i 'bul chen dang rin spungs sde pa rin chen rnam rgyal gshegs pa'i bsngo rten 'byor/ de nas bla ma sa phyag sgam gyi dbye ba mdzad/ 'di dang 'di ni bdag gi mchod sbyin rgyu yin sogs gsungs/ de nas mdzad pa'i mtha' mar byar stod smad kyi mtshams jo bo bi'u ra'i lha khang mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi rten jo bo'i li sku gcig bzhugs/ byar stod smad gnyis kyis sman bla'i rdo sku zhig rnyed pas jo khang du bzhugs su gsol/ de'i nye skor du klu bdud gdug pa can yod par phog thug song bas der 'gro tshad kyi ba dang nad rims kyis lam bcad nga sa spyan 'dren zhus pa bzhin der phebs/ khong gis klu gnas pa'i snyi khar kurma lha khang btab/ rten thub pa gangs chen mtsho zhi bzhings/ thugs kur kurma pak+ṣi'i li sku bzhugs/ klu bdud kyi yan lag bzhi la mchod rten nag po bzhi bzhengs/ nying lag bzhi la rang 'thag bzhis mnan/ klu nad lhag ma rje nyid kyis bzhes nas nad rims kyi 'phro bcad par mdzad/ 'do li de da lta mtsho kur lha na yod/ de la gsol ba btab tshad klu nad las grol ba yongs su grags/ bla ma bsnyungs nas — 167

༄༅/ /ga me pa sku phreng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje rnam thar bzhugs so//sman pa bzhis sman phul/ zla brgyad pa'i nang cung lhod pas gsang gling nas 'do lir spyan drangs/ dbu la srog zhu dang rin po che'i phreng ba sogs longs sku'i rgyan gyis brgyan nas mjal kha gnang / de nas sku skye phyi ma'i lung bstan du/ nga skye ba 'di yi 'og rol du/ shar tre shod gangs kyi ra ba'i stod/ ces pa'i phyag bris gsal bo gnang / 'di lo'i khrums zla 8pa'i nyer gsum gyi nyi ma gung du sprul sku'i dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i tshul bstan to/ /'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char babs/ phyogs kun tu sgra chen po grags pa sogs rtags mtshan sna tshogs byung / gdung rus kyi dngul gdung chen mo bzhengs/ khong gi bu slob la zhwa dmar lnga pa dkon mchog yan lag dpa' bo gnyis pa gtsug lag phreng ba/ rtogs ldan kun tu bzang po sogs bgrang gis mi lang ba byon pa las gser phreng 'dzin pa zhwa dmar ba nyid do/ /mkhas btsun bzang pos gsung 'bum pu ste nyi shu'i skor bzhugs gsungs yod/ rje zhwa dmar lnga ba'i gsung las/ nor can sku rabs chos mdzad mas rgyu rkyen gyi nyer len kyang bgyis te gser rkyang gi bka' 'bum pu sti sum cu/ zhes gsal ba bzhin dag par snang ngo // 7 karma pa sku phreng dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje rab byung dgu pa'i me 'brug (5551)la 'khrungs/ ci — — 168

༄༅/ /na rma pa sku phreng dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// ༄༅ / /ga rma pa sku phreng dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje rnam bar/kurma pa sku phreng dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje ni/ rje brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhal chems lung bstan las/ nga skye ba 'di yi 'og rol du/ shar tre shod gangs kyi ra ba'i stod/ dpa' 'jin rten dbang phyug rang byon drung / chu sgra bcas dam chos nyan sa yod/ sa de dang ha cang mi ring bar/ der skye ba len pa'i mtshan ma mthongs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rab byung dgu pa'i me pho 'brug rabs lo5551 phug lugs2437/ phyi lo1556/lo gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes 7gyi nyi shar la/ mdo khams tre bo'i yul gyi sa stod jo bo thugs rje chen po'i rang byon dang ha cang mi ring ba/ tre smad kha ba gling ri'i zhol stag bzang zhes bya bar/ yab 'bri rigs a rdor dang yum gling bza' a lod gnyis la sku 'khrungs/ lhums su zhugs skabs/ yab yum gnyis kur rmi ltas ngo mtshar ba dang grong nang du 'ja' dang me tog gi char bab pa/ khang pa'i phyi nang du yig drug dang rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra grags pa sogs/ nye 'khor ba rnams kyis dngos su thos pa byung / sku bltams ma thag phyag gnyis kyis zhal lan gsum phyis nas nga ni na rma pa yin no gsungs zhag gsum bar skyil krung gis bzhugs/ zhal nas oṃ āḥ / dang ā li kā li sogs gsungs/ zhag bcu lon pa na nam mkha' rgyal po zhes yum gyis mtshan gsol/zhag bco brgyad nas byon bzhugs thub par byung / zla ba drug nas tshems gsal por 'khrungs/ gzhan yang dag pa'i gzigs snang dang rje gong —ma'i phyag chas ngos 'dzin gnang ba bcas mngon mkhyen dang rdzu 'phrul ston pa sogs mdzad/ na rma pa dgung lo bzhi pa'i sa mo lug (5554)lor cha gar gyi dmag la na bza' dang thal mo deb par mdzad pas dmag bzlogs/ zla ba drug par rdo la zhabs rjes thog ma bzhag dgung lo drug pa lcags bya (5556)lo'i zla gnyis par sgar chen lhun rtser phebs pa gzigs nas mnyes mnyes mdzad/ phyi nyin dge slong dbu ma rig nas/ nga sgar la nam gdan 'dren rgyu yin gsungs/ de nas tshes bcu gnyis dus chen dge bar sgar chen 'dzam gling rgyan du spyan drangs te/ sngon gyi seng khrir mnga' gsol/ rje zhwa dmar 5 dkon mchog yan lag (5520 5578)gis gtsug phud bzhes nas/ dpal ldan mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug ces ——— 169 ———

4༄༅ / /na rma pa sku phreng dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//gsol/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang smon 'jug sems bskyed kyi sdom pa bzhes/ tshes bco lnga la tre shod du phebs pa dang si tu rin po che gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs 'bul skyel ba byon/ dgun lhun rtse'i gzims khang dang bzhugs sgar res mos su bzhugs/ de nas 'dzom thang dang shel khogasnye rol 'dzi ka thang / rta'u brgyud dar rtse mdo ru phebs nas mi chen gyis bsu pa dang dngos 'bul rgya cher phul/ la mo rtse'i sgrub sde'i gsol thengs gnang ba dang zhabs kyis bcags/ slar yang mgo log brgyud nam po gnas nang du phebs/ ra rma pa dgu ba dbang phyug rdo rje dgung lo dgu pa shing byi (5559 )lor rje gong ma'i bu slob dpa' —bo gtsug lag phreng bas chos 'byung rdzogs par brtsams grub/ smon lam grol rjes rje zhwa dmar pa'i drung nas bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi ljags lung dbu tshugs/ chos 'byung steng du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog ljang gu rgyan mang po yod pa 'khor mkha' 'gro ma brgyad cu rtsa brgyad kyis bskor ba zhal gzigs/ 'di lo'i zla ba bcu gcig par dbus phyogs su phebs lam du gling tshang gi mgu zi la spyan 'dren zhabs tog drang dran thang brgyud ma rmar phebs/ chab mdor zhal thang la phyag nas gnang bas zug pa dang / gang du khyer yang mi 'dril bar byung / lha steng dang zur mang phyogs su phebs/ 'bul zhabs bsnyen bkur byung / kurma pa dgung lo bcu pa shing glang (5560 )zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer bdun la yangs pa can du phebs nas cung zhig bzhugs/ der rje zhwa dmar bas sprul sku khri phebs kyi dga' ston brgya 'bul dang / dbu zhwa 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag bzhes nas tshogs par thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung gnang zhing tshes bco lnga'i nyin dwags po chos bzhi'i chos 'brel kyang gnang bas thams cad tshim par gyur/ kurma pa dgung lo bcu gcig pa'i me stag (5561)lor lho brag phyogs su phyag btegazla gsum pa'i yar tshes la sras mkhar dgyes rdor pho brang du phebs/ tshes bcu dgu gza' skar legs pa la bstan pa'i gtso bo sku li ma khyad 'phags du ma bzhugs pa'i drung du/ zhwa dmar lnga pa dkon cog yan lag gis mkhan po dang / rje dpa' bos slob dpon gyi bya ba mdzad nas dge 'dun grangs mang gi dbus su rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan dpal ldan mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug rdo rje gar dbang phyogs las rnam par rgyal 170

༄༅ / /na rma pa sku phreng dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so/ /gyiba'i snying po khyab bdag bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes gsol/ sde pa rin spungs pas ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa bshams nas spyan 'dren zhus/ sde pa rin spungs pa khri thog bzhis mi lo tshig brgya sum cu (5430 5560 )ring bod kyi srid dbang bzung / de nas rje dpa' bos sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang gis thogs drangs nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha lnga'i dbang dang / nā ro chos drug sogs chos skyes mtha' yas pa 'bul ba gnang / rje zhwa dmar ba'i drung nas dus 'khor 'grel chen gyi lung sogs mang du gsan/ snye de nas zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu dgu la phyag bteg rim gyis dpal mtshur phur phebs/ dgon gyi las sne sogs bsko stsal grub nas gtsang phyogs su bteg lha phur phebs nas zab lung gnas gzigs dang / rin gling du phebs pa na/ rje dpa' bo gtsug lan phreng ba zhi bar gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrubs/ 'di lor si tu nor bu bsam 'phel 'khrungs/ rin spungs pa'i dbang cha thob pa'i zhing shags pa tshe brtan rdo rjes 'bul bsnyen dpag med bgyis shing dgung lo bcu gnyis dus gsung rab gling du rab byung bcu pa'i thog ma me yos (5562) lo'i lo gsar gnang / de nas rin spungs su gdan drangs/ sha ra glu la nas sa skyong ngag dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug dpon blon 'khor 'bangs sde dgon dang bcas pas bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen pos spyan drangs te/ kha ru steng klu sdings su gdan phab/ pho brang tshoms chen du rigs ldan zhing khams rgya mtsho'i gos yol bre ba sogs rgyal po'i dpal 'byor gyi bkod pa ngo mtshar ba bshams te spyan drangs/ li dmar las rgya gar yul dbus kyi bzo bos bsgrubs pa'i thub pa khyad chos gsum ldan dang bkra this pa'i rdzas su dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil bas thog drangs pa'i 'bul chen dpag med mdzad/ zla ngo gsum tsam gyi bar du chos dang bkur bsti mtha' yas nga/sa gus pas ri mor bgyis/ sgar chen dpon slob nas kyang dpon zhang bar sogs bde 'jags kyi bka' khyab gnang / dus zing bde 'jags ched dbus/ phyogs su chibs bteg ste/ dmag thog gi sde dpon mi dmangs dang bcas pa mjal/ yab sras bka' bgros te dbus gzhung bde 'jags kyi bka' khyab gnang bas kun gyis spyi bor nod de chings dan la 'khod/ de nas khra 'brug phebs bzhugs skabs/ mkhar thog nas yum sras kyi dgongs rdzogs dge rgyun la/ chags kyi mchod gzhis kyadza phul/ snyi171

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//de skabs dbu 'jug dang spyod 'jug gi bshad lung gsan/ 'phyong rgyas sde pa hor bsod nams dar rgyas kyis gdan drangs shing 'bul zhabs dpag med spros/ thel du spyan snga rin po ches gong ma dang khyad med kyi dad gus kyi chos 'brel zhus/ bsam yas dang mchims phu'i gnas mjal mdzad nas la brgyud 'bri gung pas bsu ba ser sprengs rgyas par mdzad de spyan drangs/ chos rje rin chen rnam rgyal dang / chos rje khri thog pa dang zur pa'i dbon chos rgyal phun tshogs kyis thog mar mjal/ thams cad thugs mi 'phrogs pa'i dad gus chen pos bsten zhing zab mo nang don gyi ljags lung la sogs pa'i bka' chos gsan/ khang thog rtse sgrel gyis zla ba gsum tsam gyi zhabs tog mdzad cing / thel gyi gnas mjal kyang mdzad/ de nas stag lung du gdan drangs nas chos rje rtse pa dang / grog kha pa mched kyis rim pas bka' chos gsan/ grwa mang khams bod kun gyis kyang rtse gcig dad pas mjal zhing 'bul zhebs sgom cher zhus/ 'di lor rgya nag gi ming rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po bcu gsum pa lu ching ( ma)khrir 'khod/ bla ma gdan sa thel du phebs nas spyan snga'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrubs/ kurma pa dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje dgung lo bcu drug pa lcags lug (5566)lor mkhas dbang slob dpon rnam rgyal grags pa las phar tshad mngon pa sogs mdo phyogs gsan/ kong po dang tsa rir phebs/ tsa ri mtsho dkar du mchod rten bkra shis 'od 'bar gzigs skabs/ 'ja' tshon las grub pa'i bya 'brug gi gzugs sogs kyis bskor ba dang me tog gi char bcas kun gyis mthong bar gyur/ phyir kong yul du bya rgod yod mi dar ba la rje nyid phebs skabs nam mkha' la bya rgod lding ba kun gyis mthong / tsa ri'i gnas mjal mdzad skabs sgrol ma la nas dag pa shel ri'i gzigs snang dang / g.yu mtsho'i khar zhabs rjes bzhag pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang dpag med byung / sgo rab brtan gyi gtsug lag khang dang thar gling grwa tshang gi gtsug lag khang sogs/ rten dang brten pa bcas pa gsar bzhengs mdzad/ gzhan yang kong long ral gsum gyi ser skya mi mangs khrom tshogs dpag tu med pa 'dus par nyin bzhin zhal mjal dang chos 'brel smon lam sogs gnang bas thams cad dga' spros dus 'da' bar gyur/ yi rma pa dgu ba dbang phyug rdo rje dgung lo nyi shu pa shing phag ( — 172 ——

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// ru5570)lor 'jang (cha so yo po 47)gi 'bul skyel dang phyag phreng rgyal thang pa sogs kyi grwa rgyun gtos che ba'ang 'byor/ rtse sgang du phebs nas na rma stod smad kyi yon bdag rnams la bka' khyab dang / sgrub sde gong du rab rgyas kun gling gi grwa tshang 'jog pa gnang / lo smad la sku rab bkra shis sgang du phebs/ rje bla ma yang der phebs nas zhal rgyas/ sku rab khu dbon gyis gser kha gsar rdol gyis gser phud zho stong dang brgyas gtsos pa'i d+ngha'abul chen zhus/ der bzhugs ring snyan ngag me long ma'i bshad pa gsan cing rtsom rgyugs kyang phul/ de nas dwags po bshad sgrub gling du phebs/na rma pa dgung lo nyer gcig pa me byi (5571)lo'i lo gsar smon lam dang bco lnga'i nyin ston pa grong khyer ma'i sku brnyan la/ gnas brtan bcu drug dge bsnyen dharma tā hwa shang rgyal chen bzhis bskor ba'i zlos gar dge 'dun ga'i sa byes kyi ser sbreng dang bcas pa'i shis brjod rgyas par mdzad/ rab gling gtsug lag khang rten brten par bcas pa grub pa'i rab gnas dang dge 'dun rnams kyis smon lam bcas mdzad/ chos grwa rtse thang gi phyi nang zhal 'dzin sgar chen nas gnang dgos pa'i zhu bcar bzhin mgron gnyer rnams mi snar mngags/ khrom sar yab sras zhal rgyas/ mdzo ṭīka thugs rtsom gyi dbu tshugs/ der 'bras spungs sprul pa'i sku dang sde pa sku rab mchod yon gyis rtse dang 'phyong rgyas bar sogs kyi cings 'jags la yar klung du spyan 'dren byung ba dang bstun/ btsan thang du phebs nas 'bras spu ngas pa rma chod yon dang sgar chen yab sras bka' bgros te/ rtse dang 'phyong rgyas bar gyi cings dang / de zhor dbus phyogs tshang mar lo gsum gyi chings lugs bsdam pa'i bka' khra gnang / 'bras spungs nas dpon slob rnams kyis bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba rgya cher mdzad cing / phar yang gnang skyes/ bzang po bstsal/dgu pa dbang rdor nyer gnyis pa me glang (5572)lor dge lugs pa'i bstan pa shin tu rgyas pas/ bong sa sku phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho (5538 5583)sog ngo/ al thal gser gyi rgyal pos sog yul du spyan drangs te/ tā la'i bla ma'am rgya mtsho'i bla ma zhes pa'i bstod pa'i mtshan phul sgom pa rin chen brtson 'grub kyis a mdo'i tsong chu 'gram du byams sku rten brten nga bzhengs/ de nas bzung sku 'bum byams pa gling du grags/ po rma pa dgung lo nyer ci 173

༄༅/ /ma rma pa sku phreng dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//bzhi pa sa yos (5574shi lor rje zhwa dmar pa lnga pa dkon mchog yan lag dang rgyal tshab grags pa dpal 'byor/ mkhan slob rnam gnyis las bsnyen 3 cipar rdzogs/ 'di lor rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga 'i mchod rten dkar po bzhengs/ dus 'di tsam la 'jang bi rgyal pos bka' 'gyur gsar bzhengs bgyis sa la phyag nas gnang bar pho brang du phebs pas/ rgyal blon 'bangs bcas mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang dga' spro dpag med skyes/ dgung lo nyer drug par lcags sbrul (5576)lor sgrub sde skyid mtsho gling gsar 'dings dang kurma pa'i gzim spyil yang mdzad nas bzhugs/ mtshan bsam gtan yid 'ong gling du 'dogs gnang mdzad/ rjes su rje bcu bzhi pa theg mcho ga rdo rje mchog gis gzim spyil dang brang khang 'du khang sogs gsar 'debs mdzad nas lo gsum sku mtshams su bzhugs/ sgrub grwar bzhugs mkhan rnams la khams sger sna dgon gyi sgrub dpon sga tsha legs ldan zhes pa thog mar bsko bzhag gnang thog bca' khrims sogs sgrigs bkod dwangs gtsang mig dper 'os pa zhig mdzad pa nas bzung rje na rma pa sku phreng mang por sgrub bla rim thon byung ba zhig yin 'dug rje zhwa dmar lnga pa dkon mchog yan lag sku khams ma bde bas/ rab byung bcu ba'i chu lug (5578)lor sku gshegs/ sku gdung rin po cher bkur bste dang phyag ma chod mdzad/ gsang khog nas yangs pa can du phebs/ dgung lo nyer dgu pa shing sprel (5579)lor zhwa dmar drug pa 'bri gung skyur ra'i gdung rgyud la 'khrungs te/ mtshan daXl gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug gsol/ de nas mdo khams/ byang dwags kong sogs kyi 'gro ba'i don du ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin phyag bteg ste/ 'gro don bla na med par mdzad nas slar sku mtshams la bzhugs/ zla ba dgu par mtshams grol te drag zhan kun —gyis yig drug nyin stong ma tshan stong cha gos med 'don dgos pa'i bka' khyab gnang / spo bo khe thang du dkar sde gsar 'dzugs kyi don chos yang ri nas dge slong bcu gnyis rdzongs brda gnang / dgon par na rma bstan 'phel rab bstan gling zhes 'dogs pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo sum cu pa shing mo bya (5580)lor dgung gsar grub nas/ kong smad du chibs bsgyur skabs rin spungs pas skyong ngag dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs 'dzul mi 'byor/ 'di lor yum gshegs/ si tu bzhi ba — ——— 174

༄rgya/ /kurma pa sku phreng dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// mi 'khrugs chos kyi go cha zur mang du 'khrungs/ ka rabs ci dgu bas dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi dgon sde bskyar bzhengs nyams gso dpe/ dbang khrid gdams ngag gnang ba/ 'khon rtsod bsdum pa so gas 'gro don mtha' yas pa mdzad/ khams bod kyi sde dpon rnams kyis zhabs tog 'bul nod dpag med dang / 'jang / sog bal po/ rgya dkar nag sogs nas kyang bstod bsngags 'bul zhabs chos zhu sogs bgrang las 'das pa byung ba dang / bshad sgrub kyi grwa gsar 'dzugs dang gso skyong gnang ba tshad ma/ mngon mdzod dang dbu 'jug sogs kyi 'grel ba ljags rtsom gyi gsung 'bum pod bcu skor bzhugs pa sogs mdzad phrin zla med kyi dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / kurma pa dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje dgung lo zhe brgyad pa chu yos (5598)lo'i zla dang po'i tshes nyer brgyad kyi tho rengs khar dgongs pa chos dbyings su snyoms par bzhugs so/ /re shig gsang khog nas sku gdung rin po che mtshur phur gdan drangs/ ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul gyi bkod pa ni brjod kyis mi lang pa'o/ /khong gi bu slob ni/ snying po don gyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i rje btsun tā ra nā tha/ si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtsho sogs khri gdan zur rnams dang / tre ho na rma lhag bsam rgya mtsho/ zur mang kurma legs bshad sgra dbyangs sogs lung rtogs yon tan gyis phyug pa bcas bu slob bgrang las 'das pa byon pa las rī gser phreng 'dzin pa zhwa dmar drug pa chos kyi dbang cho phyug (5579 5630)yin/ 7 karma pa sku phreng bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje rab byung bcu pa'i shing 'brug (5599)la 'khrungs/༄dun 4 7 waratrī1bad

sto༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng bcu pa chos dbyings do rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// wa wa wa wa wa wa wa ༄༅/ /ga rma pa sku phreng bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje'i rnam bar/kurma pa sku phreng bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje ni/rje gong ma dbang phyug rdo rjes gsung rab gling du lung bstan pa dang /rje zhwa dam ra gar dbang thams cad mkhyen rnga/ la mchog gi sprul sku gang du 'byon rgyu'i skor bka' shog zhib rgyas shig go/nang ba ltar/mdo khams rol chen bco brgyad las smad rol mgo log tu grags pa'i kum zi thang zer yar/ gdung rus sbi tsha/yab khyi gu thar dang / yum a mtsho sa/nyis kyi sras gsum gyi chung shos la/ rab byung bcu pa'i shing 'brug rabs lo5599/ phug lugs2485 / phyi lo160rin ga zla'i nyer brgyad kyi nyi shar dus su yum la gnod pa med par sku 'khrungs/ yum/ gyis gzigs snang ltar o rgyan skya bas zhes pa'i mtshan gso la/gcen po a 'bum la nga ni la rma pa yin zhes gsungs 'byon/skabs 'dir kurma pa mgo/ log gi yul du 'khrungs zhes phyogs thams cad nas grags/ de nas lcags mo bas sa yo sgyu'i bya byed sna tshogs kyis rje nyid bzhugs bde min gyis skad gnyis smra ba yu gur gyi yul du phebs/ dgung lo lnga pa sa sprel 5603lor/ lcag/sa mo bas za 'dod bsnyad 'tshol gyis ched du rma chu khar spyan drangs te/ dkor rdzas 'dod nas re zhig bzhugs su bcug/ sog po tsho drug dang / yong shol bu/ thu med sogs kyis mjal phyag 'bul chen phul/lca gas mo lhun po rtser phebs/lcags mo khu dbon rnams kyis dkor rdzas rnams phab thob byas/sprul pa'i sku khang steng du gdan drangs/yab yum sogs khang 'og tu bskrad pa yab kyis zhus pas lhan rgyas tsam chog pa byung /skabs 'dir kurma pa'i sprul sku 'bri gung phag mo'i zhal ngor 'khrungs che/sa pa'i sbir gti la yid gtad nas/ lcags mo bas ngeng rang gi khang steng gi phru gu pha ma bu 'di rnam/sa khong rang tsho gang dgar song zhig zer nas/lcags mo bla ma sogs dbus su chas/khong yab yum rnams lha sar phebs kyang rdza khog nas phyir log dgos pa byung /zhwa dmar drug pa gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug 557 5630tsa ri mtsho dkar du bzhugs skabs / gzims dpon mngon dga' dpon slob rnams gsang khog nang mangs/sa te/ rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs bskyed smon lam gyi zhes so gas brtan bzhug/sa dang //o rgyan chen pos rdo rje'i tshig gis btsal ba'i chos 76

—ci ༅/ /ma rma pa sku phreng bcu mi chos dbyangs rtso rje'i rnam thar ba zhugs so/ /—wa wa dbyings rdo rje zhes pa'i ma tshan dang stan dkar sogs dang / sku rim sogs kyi phyag bres gnang / skabs der lcags mos bdag tu bzung ba ya nga med/rje gar dbang zhwa dmar bas ngos 'dzin gnang ba de nas bzung kun gyis bkur cing mchod pa'i sprin gtibs pa rtogs brjod las/ skye bo yul gzhan lhung ba de/ /nges par lhung ba de ltar min/ /sa sogs gsu/ngas pa lta ra ro/ /de nas dbus nes dge 'dun ya nga ri ba dang / 'jang sa dam rgyal po'i ja 'dren pa rgyal rigs zol thu ba sogs mang po dang / dbus gtsang sogs kyi lha sde mi sogs kyis longs spyod kyi 'byor pa rgya chen po yang bstabs par byas/ dgung lo bdun pa lcags khyi (5605)lo'i mgo zlar dbe 'dun yang ri ba'i tshogs gur du phebs/ 'di lor zhing shag pa'i sras bka' brgyud na rma phun chogs rnal rgyal gyis rang nyid kyi gnyen tshan yar rgyab pa bdud 'dul grags par dmag drangs nas yar rgyab bzung / dbus gtsang sogs su chibs kha bsgyur skabs pha wang rog gtam zhes pa la zhabs rjes byon pa dang / 'bri chu 'gram gyi rma 'bri byang chub dgon du 'bri chu'i gnod pa bzlogs par mdzad/ dge rgyas su bzhugs/ khri'i mdun rdo la zhabs rjes byon/ sogs tsan dan dgon du mkhar nag dang dam can gyis rang gzugs bstan nas bka' bzhin sgrub par khas blangs/ 'ba' rom brag tu zhal thang 'od zer ma gzigs pa'i tshe sgra dang 'od zer byung / zhal thang las ring bsrel mang du 'khrungs/ thang lha'i gong zhol du phebs tshe thang lhas khye'u'i lus su sprul nas mchod pa phul ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa mtha' yas/ de nas ri drung pa shag rog pa zhes me tos gi sa zhu can dbe slong du brdzus pa de sogs kyi mchod 'bul shis brjod kyi khur de rnam sa byas / rgyas nya'i tshes bcu bzhir rgyal ba zhwa dmar ba'i sgar chen zur lcog nyin byed gling pa rnams dbe 'dun sum stong lhag bcas der phebs nas bco lnga rgyal phur nyin nga ba sras lhan rgyas myo/dzad/ dgung lo brgyad nga/ lca gas phyog (5605)gsar bzhad kyi nyer gsum nyin rgyal ba gar gyi dbang po nyid kyis spos 'jin mdzad de sgar chen gyi gzims gur chen mor seng ge'i khri la mnga' gsol/ shis pa brjod/ zhwa nag gser sa dong / tham po dbu gdugs sogs nyer spyad rnams dang ཿ dar zab rin ngo/ che so gas kyi mchod sprin dang / sgar gyi drung skor rnams dang chos sde 177

ri༄༅ / /lam/ pa sku phreng bcu pa chos dbyings/ rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs go/ — ——— —————— —— ————khag so so nas dngos chas/ kyi mchod nga/ rgya cher phul/ rje nyid kyis dbu zhwa mthong ba don ldan du ma dzad/ 'di lor bstan 'dzin tā 'a/'i han rgyal por bskos/ de nas yang ri ba dang lcags/ mo 'dod mnyam kyis sprul ba'i sku zhwa dmar drug pa chos kyi dbang phyug gtad na zang zing gi rnyed pa rang dbang du mi 'gyur dogs nas lcags mo lhun po rtser gtan bzhus sa 'dod par rje gar gyi dbang pos sprul pa'i sku'i yab yum gnyis la sprul pa'i sku nged la 7 'bul dgos tshul dang yab yum gnyis sogs la bdag rkyen yo/da tshul sogs gsungs par sprul pa'i sku yab yum gnyis bcas nas de lta ra 'dod mod/ lcags mo ba'i 'dod dbang la gzigs nas lcags mo ba'i bla ma sogs la dngos po bdog pa gnang cha bcas lhug par bstsal kyang / dngos su ma blangs nas skabs der rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi tshe dbang brgya rtsa phul ba tsam las 'phral yun gyi rten 'byung gi sgo thams cad phyin ka log tu gyur nas kur bstan la nyams chag chen po 'di byung ba yin no/ gdan sa bar nas si tu rin po che 'bul zhabs rgya chen bcas nas phebs rung / yang lcags gnyis kyis zhal mjal du ma bcug thu me sogs dpon g.yog mang po dang 'ba' jom chos rje sogs bslebs nyin dang po zhwa dmar nag lhan rgyas kyi mjal kha gnang / phyi nyin nas lhan rgyas sog yul la spyan 'dren par rig nas/ rgyal ba'i dbang po mjal kha ma gnang nas/ dam can gyi lung bstan yin par brdzus te nang rtags phyir bud pa'i sog po dang / sgar pa gnyis kyis rgyal ba'i dbang po phrog rgyu yin 'dug zer ba'i zol gyis bon dgon du 'bros thabs su spyan drangs/ de nas bzung yab sras lhan rgyas su phebs pa'i 'brel (spam bcad/ zhwa dmar gar dbang thams cad mkhyen pa/ rje si tu rin po che/ dge 'dun zur cog sde rnams thu med rgyal po kho lo jis spyan drangs par phebs/ chos dbyings rdo rje sku na ma son pas yang lcags gnyis kyi ngan gshom ltar yab yum dbon bcas yul der gyi na'i ngang bzhugs/ yang gnas nang chos 'byung steng du re zhig bzhugs/ de nas maṇ+ḍal thang dang / lhun po rtser phebs/ der rje dus mkhyen dang / mi la zhal gzigs pa phyag bris gnang / sog yul nas che chen dbon po rmesogs spyan 'dren la bslebs pas sog yul du chibs bsgyur gnang / de phyogs kyi skya ser thams cad la srog gcod spangs pa'i sdom pa la bkod/ — — 178 —

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// 'di skabs yab sras mjal ba'i rten 'byung gi sgo gnyis pa de'ang yang lcags gnyis kyis bkag karma pa dgung lo bcu gcig pa shing stag (5609)lo'i mchu zla'i tshes bcu bzhi la dbus phyogs su thegs/ gtsang pa sa skyong na rma bsta na skyong gis khrims yig zhal lce bco lnga na sa dpa' rdar gyi zhal lce gnyis dor nas zhal lce bcu gsum du gtan la phab pa'i phyi lor rgyal rtser spyan drangs nas 'byor pa rgya chen po'i mchod sdi dang / dge 'dun tshogs pa rgya tshe'i dbus su smon lam gyi mdzad sgo gnang / rim gyis khams stod kyi shor phu 'ba' rom dgon dang skyo brag dgon/ zur mang ‘dgon/ sde dge'i gling tshang / ldan rnam rgyal gling / gling mgo zi dgon sogs su phebs nas dad sbyin khag gi re 'dun bsgrubs/ 'di tsam nas ma ṇi dung phyur ljags bzlas mdzad pa'i dbu btsugs/ lhag pa'i lha spyan ras gzigs kho na mdzad/ de nas bsu bkod rgya chen dang bcas yangs/ pa can du phebs/ zhwa dmar rim byon gyi sku gdung rnams la mchod 'bul sogs gnang nas mtshur phur phebs/ na rma pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa shing yos (5610)lor rten ༷ la'i drung du rje dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtsho las gtsug phud mchod de yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen du bsgrubs/ dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren pa sku bzhi lhun grub chos dbyings kun du khyab pa'i 'phrin las rtag pa'i rdo rje 'gyur med yid bzhin snying po rgyas pa zla med mngon par mtho ba'i dpal zhes mtshan gsol/ brtan bzhugs dang sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang gis thog drangs nas rang lugs kyi mdo sngags yo ngas su rdzogs pa'i dbang lung khrid yongs su rdzogs pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du lebs par phul/ dang la ldan sa skya'i bdag chen shar par mjal nas ro gcig si bka' drin bstsal/ gtsang sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal dpon blon gyis rin chen rgyan spros sogs bkod pa rgya chen pos mdun bsu sa te/ tre ho sprul sku bcas bas ma 'grub rtse'i klu lding du phebs/ gtsang pa rgyal pos /'bul chen bsta bas/ dbu zhwa mthong ba don ldan bzhes/ yon bsngo ba sogs mdzad cing / rgyal ngo rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i cho sa mdzad/ gser tham/ las zhwa/ las gos sogs gnang / 'on kyang gos ding dang / las zhwa las thos bcem par bkra yis pa'i rdzas rtags kyi ri mo rmams/ mgo mjug ldog pa sogs mi shis pa'i mtshan ma ma nga ngo 1 79

༄༅/ /ka/rma nga sku phreng bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//wa ge she —wa —wa wa wa wa zang/de ——wa wa —mngon sum gsungs 'dug de nas pho brang chen po bsam 'grub rtser/rin spungs pa'i rigs ldan yol ba bkram ste gser khrir yab sras lhan rgyas bzhugs su gso la/ rgyal sras ma rma bstan skyong dbang pos thog mar mjal/mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ rje nas 7/ lbi si 'i mdo thugs 'dzin mdzad ri mo bsla bas pa ga/nang /rje 'di snyan ngag gi ljags rtsom/ la skyes thob kyis mkhas par bzhugs mod// snyan ngag me long bi gzhung rje dbon nam mkha' thugs 'dzin gsan pa tsam gyis tshig don thug/sa la 'jags/de nas sa nams su phebs/ ma rma pa dgung lo bcu bzhi pa me sbrul 5612 lo'i lo gsar dang smo na lam chen mo mdzad/ rgyal yab khyi gu thar gyis chang bzhes pa'i rkyen gyes/ rgyal ba'i yum gnyis dang dbon gnyis rnams yang lcag/sa gnyis kyi sde srid gtsang par phra mang po zhus te sgar nas dbyung bar byas/la stod byang nas bdag po rin po chen dpon slob/spo bo rak+ṣi'i gter ston ka nam sde ba/ri bo che rnams mjal 'bul la bslebs/kong po'i tshong dpon mang pos mjal/de rnams kyis dngos po'i bdog po du mas mchod/ rkarma pa dgung lo bco lnga pa sa rta 5613gnam lo gsar tshes kyi smo na lam chen mo gnang / sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal ba lho brag/ tu phebs pa'i phebs skyel la sa nams su phebs par tshe dbang grub rgyal ma lha sa/cig bum gcag bi/ rjes gnang sogs gnang / yab sras lhan rgyas lho brag tu chibs bskyod gnang /sbrul mtsho pad+ma gling gi gnas mjal/ dro bo 'u/nga dang / gnya' gnya'i mar me phug dang mgar tshang sogs su phebs shing mags 'khor mdzad/lha sar skyid sog dmag bslebs pa dgongs gtad gnang bas dmag ldog sa/nas der bcad rgya'i khongs nas tha snya da kyi gsan sbyangs/mdo sngags kyi khrid sogs gsan bsam gyis dus 'da' ba zla lnga ring bzhugs/sa rta mgo zlar pho brang sne'u gdong rtser bsu ba ser sbreng gi bkod pa rgya chen po bcas te phebs/ tshal du bzhugs sgar phab/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i gser yi ga pa dang /ri bo bya rkang gi ha shang dgon pa brgya'i bla ma// si'u tsha'/ wo zo zhes pa'i rgya nag dpon g.yog mang po 'byor/ rgya 'jang bi khyad nor mang po phul/ sne'u ga/dong rtse'i pho brang du phebs//sa skyong khri pas gsar bzhengs kyi thang mar rab gnas sa/nang /'di lor ma rma bstan skyong dbang ngo/sa dngu/nga dmag khri lhag tsam khrid de dbus 8

༄༅/ /ka/rma pa sku phreng bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// wa wa wa wa wa wa wa dgophyogs kyi grong sde gal che ba mang po blangs/hor zla bdun par ser 'bras gling log ser dmag dang dbus dmag zung sbrel te ma rma bsta na skyong dbang po'i dmag dpung dang g.yul bkyes mthar pham nas ser 'bras kyi grwa pa mang che ba yul phyogs gzhan la bros byol du 'gro dgos byung / yang lo 'dir phag gru'i srid dbang rdzogs nas kurma pa'i srid dbang tshugs/ de nas kurma pa bcu ba chos grags rdo rje dgung lo bcu drug pa sa lug 5614lo'i smon lam chen mo gnang /yang lcags gnyis kyi ngan spyod rnams rje dpa' bos ngan mtshang bltol bas/gtsang pa dang sku rab bka' bgros nas sgar pa'i khur 'dzin lcags mo sku mdun pa dang / ya nga ri drung pa dang / shag ram pa gnyis so so'i khang par mtshams la bcug lcags mo ba rnams yul du brdzangs te/ sgar chen gyi gegs tshogs rna myo/sa rgyang bsrings/ ma rma pa dgung lo bcu bdun pa lcags sprel 5615lor lhun po sgang du lo gsar dang smon lam chen mo gnang / 'di lor rgya nag gi ming rgyal rabs bco lnga pa tha'e khra/nga rgyal po sgra ) khrir 'khod/ rkarma bstan skyong dbang pos bod yongs kyi srid dbang bdag gir bzung / yang lcags gnyis kyi rgyu mtshan zhu mi sde pa spel dmar nas brdzangs pa// sde srid gtsang pas btson du bzung / sku rab par dmag dpung bteg skabs der tre hor sprul sku bsta na 'dzin dar rgyas la rgo shrī'i las ke 'u nga ling ji'i las rtags/ sogs gnang / dpa' bo rin po che nyid la'ang dngos chas du ma phul// de skabs rgyal ba'i dbang pos gar dbang thams cad ji par/ myur du mjal ba'i skal bzang stsol ba'i slad/chibs kyi kha lo 'dir bsgyur ba dang /sku rab pa'i sde pa 'bangs bcas nyes pa ma mchis pa 'di rnams 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i bka' drin stsal du gsol/zhes zhus pa ltar/rje zhwa dmar tham sa cad mkhyen pa lhun po sgang du phebs/zhwa dmar nag dpa' bo/ kre ho bstan 'dzin dar rgyas bcas zhal lhan rgyas kyi legs tshog/sa 'grigs/ la/rma pa'i yab yum dang dbon po gnyis kyang sgar gyi dkyil 'khor du tshud pa byung / gtsang skur gnyis la lhan rgyas nas bka' bkod nan cher bstsal kyang sa/tsang pa nas rtsi 'jog ma gnang nas yar stod lhun po sgang /sku rab rnyang khung sogag thams cad blangs nas/skabs der gtsang sde srid byus kyi 'gro khyab les/sa pa tsam byung yang bla ma'i bka' la ma 8

༄༅/ /na rma pa sku phreng bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//—brtsis pas/ phun tshogs rnam rgyal yar lam 'brum nad kyis grongs/ yab sras gsum gtsang du gdan drangs kyang ma gsan par lho brag du phebs pas gtsang sde'i sku tshab rnams kyis ngan bshad tshig rtsub mang po phul/ de nas zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa khrom par phebs nas yab sras lhan rgyas mdzad/ rje zhwa dmar bas sku chas sgar gzhis grwa 'khor tshang ma rgyal ba'i dbang por phul/ de nas sras mkhar du phebs cing rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku ngos 'dzin gnang / zhwa dmar nag dpa' bo rgyal tshab si tu bcas bsam grub rtser phebs te skyed tshal du sgar phab/ sde srid dgongs rdzogs rjes sgrub kyi mchod sprin rgya cher bstabs cing / bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa lcags bya (5616)lor rgya nag gi ming rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po bcu drug pa then chi (lko tshe)khrir 'khod/ bod kyi phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan dang sog po lha btsun chung ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin sogs dpon dmag nyis stong lhag tsam lha sar 'byor/ rkyang thang sgang du gtsang dmag dang g.yul bkyes sar gtsang dmag rnams pham ste lcog po rir bros /dgung lo nyer gcig pa shing byi (5619)lor zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pas mkhan po dang dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtshos slob dpon/ si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis gsang ston sogs grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ rgyal tshab sprul ba'i sku yang mkhan po de las rab tu byung / —'di lor rgyal dbang lnga rib blo bzang rgya mtsho 'khrungs nas dgung lo brgyad zin par dge tshul bsgrubs/ de nas zhwa dmar bal yul gnas gzigs rīgrub nas rim gyis rgya gar la phebs pa'i springs yig 'byor bas/ rje nyid thugs skyo ba'i spyan chab bsil/ de nas spro bde bkra shis sgang du yab sras zhal rgyas/ dgung lo nyer bdun pa lcags rta /5625)lor zhwa dmar gar dbang dang dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtsho 'das nas thugs shin tu skyo bar gyur/ de nas ding ri dang chu ba/ ma dros mtsho/ ti si'i gnas/ tsa ri sogs la phebs/ dkar mdzes nas bris pa'i bka' brgyud lo rgyus las/ sa tham rgyal blon gyis spyan drangs pa ltar phebs nas zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor/ sa tham khri skor bcu gnyis kyi skye bo ma lus pa smin par mdzad/ gzhan yang spo 'bor dang rab sgang / rgyal rong / dar mdo sogs su phebs nas gdul bya smin grol la bkod zer/ dgung lo so bzhi pa me glang — 182

༄༅/ /na rma pa sku phreng bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// — ske5632)lo'i mdzad sgo la/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug dgra bcom pa khri dang drug stong bzhi brgyas bskor ba'i sku brnyan se'u las grub pa bzhengs pa'i phyag bris/ bzo ba bcu phrag rwa gcig gi las grwa btsugs/ skabs su chos 'chad pa dang / nyams thag rnams la zas nor gyis tshim par mdzad pa dang / bsha' lug khyu chen po rnams nyos nas tshe thar btang / ri khrod 'grim par khas len zhu mi rnams la mi la ras pa'i sku re dang / yig drug dung phyur re 'don pa'i khas len pa rnams la spyan ras gzigs kyi sku thang phyag bris re gnang / na chu pa bcu pa chos rdor dgung lo so lnga pā sa stag (5633)lor/ sog gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi dmag dpung gtsang phyogs su bslebs par paṇa chen rin po che brgyud nas rgyal ba lnga pa chen po'i drung du bcar chog par zhus/ paṇa chen gyis rgyal ba'i dbang por mar dge'i don la thugs khag med pa/ kho bos khag theg kyang mar lugs pa 'di rnams mdzad pa ma mkhas pas lan sogs kyi bkod khyab bcas gnang / rtso/nga du zhu 'byor gnang bas kur lugs pa rang sar 'jog chog pa'i bka' tham phebs kyang g.yul 'khrug chen po'i mgo tshugs/ skabs der ga tsang pa nas rkang dmag skul mkhan rnams byung zhing / gtsang pa nas dkrugs pas sgar pa nang zhig mi bsad byed mkhan rnams yar 'brog tu bkag po la don sna dkar rtse pa'i rta khyu ded nas kong dmag 'ded nga/ra song / der na rma pa nyid kyang gtsang pa la thugs log dgos pa byung / dus der kong dmag tshan gcig bslebs byung bar mi sna dang bka' shog gnang ste/ khyed rnams sngar yang sdod ma nus pas 'di byung / da sdod thub par gyis la phyir log cig gal te mi nyan na stod lung mtshur phu gtsos gdan sa gong 'og kur bstan gyi khag khyed rang tshos khur/ nged rgyal ba lnga ba blo bzang rgya mtshor mgo 'dogs pa yin byas pas/ kur lugs kyi mi la las khong par 'dre 'khyams zhugs song zer/ de nas rje nyid khams phyogs brgyud 'jang yul kun dga' la thog tu phebs/ ri bo bya rkang gsal bar gzigs pas thugs mnyes/ zhabs rjes kyang byon/ 'jang dgon khag bcu gsum btab/ kurma'i chos lugs rgya cher spel/ de skabs lnga ba blo bzang rgya mtshos kur dge bde 'jags dgos pa'i sprengs yig gnang ba la/ drang po'i lan gyi zhu lan sogs phul/ 'di lor lnga ba chen po dgung lo nyer 183

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//gnyis thog gzim khang gong ma'i sprul sku dang lhan du pa ṇa chen rin po che las smad 'dul brgyud lta ra bsnyen par rdzogs/ kurma pa chos dbyings rdo rje dgung lo so dgu pa'i chu rta (5637)lor/ sog gu shrī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis thog mar mdo khams bzung / rim bzhin gtsang pa sde srid rjes ri'abrangs dang bcas pa cham la phab/ bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi srid dbang rgyal mchog lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor phul/ gnam bskos dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang dngos su btsugs/ kurma pa dgung lo bzhi bcu pa'i chu lug (5638)lo'i cho 'phrul gyi tshes brgyad la zangs phug tu phebs nas rgyal tshab na rim lnga pa grags pa mchog dbyangs bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad de rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol/ dpa' bo sprul sku rab tu dzebyung / rgyal ba lnga bas deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs brtsams/ ma/do khams dar rtse mdo nas le'u rtse dmag 'khrug byung / rgya nag gi tā ming rgyal rabs mjug rdzogs/ /rma pa dgung lo zhe gcig pa shing sprel (5639)lo'i hor zla drug nga/'i tshes bcur stag lung bkra shis dpal grub phebs par zhal 'dzom mdzad/ de nas gzhung sa mchod yon nas/ da phyin dkar lugs kyis dge lugs phyogs la log pa mi byed pa'i dbu rtsi gnang dgos phebs par/ rgyal ba'i dbang po nas de byed mi dgos/ sngar dkar dge'i 'gal ba'i las nged kyis log pa byas re'i mna' byed gsungs pa'i 'phrin yig mchod yon gyi dpung chen khams mda' na bzhugs par zhu 'bul du btang bas/ sngar log nga byas ma byas brtags mi dgos da phyin mi byed pa'i rtse kha mi gnang ba de sa/zhung mi mdzad pa'i dgongs par 'dug gsungs nas/ gzhung gyes/ dpung ༷ nga tshur thegs grabs mdzad 'dug don du ni rgyal ba'i dbang po'i dkar dge'i bar la 'o ga pa ma mdzad par ma zad/ gtsang sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi skabs nas/ sku rab pa'i don la yon mchod gzhung ma 'gris sa pa dang / de ska bas gtsang ba dang / dkar lu gas pa'i sgar gzhis rnams thugs snyer dod ma gcig yin nges can yin 'dug pas rgyal ba'i dbang pos/ slad nas dge lugs par log par mi byed pa ma zang/ sngar nga na yang lob pa ma byas par dbu bsnyung gnang chog sa sungs pa la/ myo/chod yon nas thugs go log gnang ba yin 'dus go /de nas dam/ zla mis sgar chen bskor kyang / rje nyid ni bag tsha ba gtan nas /ti ri

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so/ gyi—wa wa mi mnga' bar bzhugs/ sgar pa byings lha mo dbyangs can ma'i pi wang sga khog pas bsrungs pa yin gsungs pas nyin zhag mang por dmag gi ma ma/thong ba dang / dmag mi rnams kyang la las dad pa dang / la las sdang ba sogs 'dod pa mi mthun par gyur cing / nam pa nyid dmas mi 'ga' zhig gis sha bar mthong / 'as/'a zhig gis bya rgod du mthong nas rjes su brgyugs/ rgyal ba'i dbang po gcig po dang / rim gro ba kun tu bzang po tshoganyis zhabs thang du mkhan pa ljongs su phebs/ zhag bcu gnyis la lto bos med mod/ o rgyan chen pos bdud rtsi gnang ba sogs dag pa'i snang ba kho na byung / dgu 'dren pa'i skabs yin yang sku la nye zho cung zad kyang ma byung / sga ra chen ni dmas gis gtor/ grwa pa phal cher bros/ 'ga' re rmas/ 'ga' re bzung ba dang / bas da pa sogs byas ska bas der yang dpon slob lnga bsam yas su phebs pa dang / lha sar phebs pa kong smad rgod tshang brag tu phebs pa'i mthong snang kyang mang du byung nas dmag mis mang du btsal skad snang / 'di lor rgya nag nas li tsi khreng gis 'go khrid pa'i zhing pa'i gyen langs dmag dpung rgya nag pe cin du 'byor nas ming rgyal rabs kyi rgyal sa blangs/ ming rgyal rabs kyi song ma khrung kran ti bros kyang ma thar bas/ cin hran ri bo'i steng du rang srog lcebs/ bod kyi rgyal paṇa rnam gnyis kyis man ju gong ma shun ji khrir 'khod par 'tshams zhu'i mi sna btang / nam pa bcu pa chos rdor dgung lo zhe gnyis pa shing bya (5640)cho 'phrul gyi tshes bcu gsum la lho brag nas thegs sman thang bzhugs/ yang 'tsher du zhag bdun bzhugs/ de nas dkyil skyes dgon dang tsa ri gnas nang brgyud/ glo ma khyim bdun pa'i nye skor rnams su/ phebs/ mtshon dkar dang khyung rdzong / kong smad rong chu mdo brgyud/ 'di lor zla bzhi'i tshes gcig la rtse pho brang dkar po'i rmang bzhi bting / lam pa dgung lo zhe gsum pa me khyi (5641)lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes gsu ma la ka nam se ba sgang dang spu stod du phebs/ yul dgon gong 'og zhabs kyi bcags/ 'di lor gu shri bstan 'dzin dang rgyal ba lnga bas nang chen rgyal po a nyog la cho lo gnang / kurma pa dgung lo zhe bzhi pa me phag (5642)sa ga'i nang den bye phu gnas nang dang mtsho nor bu'i gnas gzigs gnang / der zhabs rjes kyang byon/ de nas mdo khams su chibs kha bsgyur/ lho smad 185

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//sar chu gsum mdor phebs/ cha lugs tha mal yin yang ngo shes na 'bul chen mang / dngul phu phun tshogs dge 'phel gling du zla ba dgu ba'i tshes gsum la phebs/ der 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i spyan 'dren pa 'byor/ yang 'ben du phebs nas rje zhwa dmar pa'i rtogs brjod 'dod 'jo'i ba mo sgrub par mdzad/ de nas kha ba dkar po dang dgon sde khag la rim par phebs nas so so'i re 'dod bskangs/ na rma pa dgung lo zhe lnga pa sa byi ( ri 5643)lo gsar la 'jang rgyal po na rma 'chi med lha dbang yab sras btsun mo bcas kyis lo gsar mched 'bul dang / phyogs kyi skye bos kyang lamachod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ de nas sa tham rgyal po sogs rgyal po rgyal phran rnams kyi tsho bkur bstod 'bul ba sogs ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig snadang / rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'ang de dang mtshungs par brjod kyis mi lang pa 'brel tshad don ldan chen por mdzad nas lcags ta dgon dang / a khro dgon sogs su phebs nas nags la me shor ba la phyag nas gtor bas zhi bar mdzad pa dang / gangs dkar phyed gsum du phebs nas thugs rje chen po'i lha khang bzhengs pa dang / sgrub sde thams cad la dbang khrid man ngag gnang ba/ rgyal thang khang gsar dgon du dbyar gnas mdzad pa/ gnas bcu'i zhal thang phyag bris gnang ba sogs kyi rten bzhengs ni brjod du med pa gnang / gnas dkon rnams la phyag mchod bsnyen bkur bzhebacas rgyas par riganang / de nas zhwa dmar bdun pa ye shes snying po (5626 5689)ngos 'dzin pa'i ched du/ rje nyid mu to ba'i cha lugs bzhes te chu shing gi 'khar ba zhig phyag tu bsnams/ gcig pur rta zhig la nyer mkho bkal nas byang mgo log phyogs su phebs/ chu chen po dang ri mthon po brgal/ jag rkun mang po bzlog nas zhwa dmar bdun pa ngos 'dzin gnang / ga rma pa dgung lo zhe dgu pa chu 'brug ga(5647)la rgyal dbang lnga ba dgung lo so drug thog rgya nag tu phebs pa'i lor/ zhwa nag bcu ba 'bo gangs dkar du lo gsar dang smon lam chen mo gnang / 'di lo'i tha skar can gyi tshes gcig nyin/ zhwa dmar bdun pa'i gtsug phud bzhes/ mtshan ye shes snying po gsol/ na rma pa dgung lo lnga bcu pa chu sbrul (5648)lor/ rgyal ba lnga ba rgya nag pe cin du 'byor steng rgya nag gong ma shun tsis (blo/lko)karma pa gdan 'dren zhus kyang phebs rgyu ma byung / ma rma pa dgung lo nga — —— 186 ——

༄༅/ /na rma pa sku phreng bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//gcig pa shing rta'i (5649)lo gsar mdzad sgor ra spang du phebs/ skabs der si tu dpon slob phebs nas mjal 'bul cher zhus/ der nags la me shor ba la ljags chab gtor bas zhi/ kurma pa dgung lo nga gsum pa me sprel (5651)lo gsar dga' ston nas 'jang yul du chibs bteg pad 'byung sprul pa 'jang gi phyogs su 'byung gsungs pa de 'o skol yin 'dug gsungs/ lo der 'jang zhabs kyi grwa ba stong tsam la rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs gnang / bon gyi dmar mchod thams cad rgyun bcad/ 'jang sa tham rgyal pos spyan drangs nas legs mdo'i pho brang du zhal 'dzoms/rgyal 'bangs kun la chos drug sogs chos 'khor bla na med pa bskor/ kurma pa dgung lo nga bzhi pa me bya'i (5652)cho 'phrul smon lam dang brten bzhengs mang du mdzad/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po nam phun tshogs la bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs gnang / rgyal tshab drug pa gu shri grags pa mchog dbyangs (5612ge5653)gshegs/ dpar mkhyen nas dgongs rdzogs la de khul gyi grwa pa stong tsam la mang 'gyed sogs rgya cher mdzad/ na rma pa dgung lo ba lnga sa khyi (5653)lor/ si tu drug pa chos rgyal mi pham phrin las rab brtan (5653 5677)'khrungs/ dus der bod kyi gnas tshul ha cang rnyog 'dzing che bas rgyal dbang lnga pa sku dngos kyis lugs gnyis kyi 'gan yongs su bzhes/ rkarma pa dgung lo nga bdun pa lcags byi (5655)lo gsar bzhad la kurma pa zhwa dmar nag gnyis dang si tu/ phag mo zhabs drung / rtse lha sku skye/ zhwa sgom sku skye sogs la rim gro pas lo gsar gsol ston rgyas par zhus/ yul der rgya dmag gis gshig gtor btang ba'i sde thams cad gsos/ 'di lor dbo zla'i tshes bcu gcig nyin rgyal thang gi khyim bdag zhig la rgyal tshab drug pa nor bu bzang po sku 'khrungs/ zhwa dmar mchog sprul gyis gtsos skye bo mang por chos mang du gsungs/ rgyal ba'i bal 'a 'gyur rin po che mtshal dpar rgya lugs su bzhengs/ sa tham rgyal po'i sras chung ba kurma mi pham bstan pa'i nyi ma rab tu byung / rgyal thang rigs lnga lha khang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i las grwa btsugs/ kurma pa dgung lo nga dgu pa chu stag (5657)lor paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang rgya nag gi 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po thabs skyong rgyal po ste shun tsi bde bar gshegs/ de'i sras khang shis sam bde skyid rgyal po ( ṭha)mi ——— 187 ——

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// ra jigs gser gyi khri la mnga' gsol/ rgya' dbang lnga pas bod du 'byor dgos pa'i bka' ltar/ kurma pa bcu pa chos rdor dgung lo bdun cu pa chu — glang ((8668)lo'i zla tshes bcu gcig la lha ldan phyogs su chibs bteg nas lam bar du mjal ba'i rten gsum rnams la mchod 'bul dang / ser skya thams cad chos dang zang zing gnyis mas tshim par byed bzhin du nas zla'am hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gsum la lha ldan du phebs/ po ta lar rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po blo bzang rgya mtsho'i (5612 she 5677)zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal/ lam bar sogs kyi gsung 'phros lhug par bstsal pa la/ nyid sku na bgres shing snyan thag ring bas bka' lan ji lta ba 'bul tshod ma mkhyen nas/ rim gro par bka' lan phul cig gsung pa ltar bka' lan rnams phul/ chos kyi dri bshad kyang mang du gnang / gsol ston gnang sbyin bzang po mdzad/ mtshur phur rgyun bzhugs chog pa sogs zhus/ de khul gyi gan me thoms cad mjal zhing mchod sprin phug/ de nas sgrags mchog la phebs dgos gsung pa ltar phebs/ de'i nyin nas mgul cham la brten sku nyog pa byung / sngags grar phebs nas nged rang tsho 'dir yun ring sdod mi dgos gsungs nas zur shag tu bzhugs/chi mas dgu nas bsnyun gzhi lod du so nga sku rim rgya cher byas rung / tshes bcu gcig nyin gzims khang thams cad 'od dkar pos khengs shing kurma pa bcu pa chos rdor dgung lo don gcig tu phebs pa/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing stag dbo zla'i tshes bco lnga'i (5669)tho rangs su gsol ja dang bzhes thug drangs pa bzhes te/ chos dbyings zhi ba'i dbyings su sku thim pa'i tshul bstan/ sku gdung rin po che mtshur phur spyan drangs/ dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa rnams rim gro ba kun tu bzang pos legs par mdzad/ rje 'di'i rgyud 'dzin slob ma'i gtso bo zhwa dmar dang rgyal tshab/ dpa' bo/ si tu/ gnas mdo kurma chags med/ khyeb bdag grub mchog dbang po/ kha reg sprul sku kurma bstan srung sogs/ bu slo/ba mtha' yas pa byon no// 7 karma pa sku phreng bcu gcig pa ye shes rdo rje rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me 'brug (5671)la 'khrungs/ me sbrul (5672)zer mkhan yang yo da// — 188 —

༄༅ / /ga rma pa sku phreng bcu gcig pa ye shes rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// sto༅ / /lde me pa sku phreng bcu gcig pa ye shes rdo rje'i rnam thar/ kurma pa sku phreng bcu gcig pa ye shes rdo rje ni/ dpag bsam 'khri shing 189las/ de yang rtsod dus snyigs ma lnga cib do ba'i snying po don gyi bstan pa ches nyams dma' ba'i skabs su snyigs 'gro nyams thag rnams la snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang gis gzigs pa rnam pa lngas bsam bzhin du srid pa ra skyo ba bzhes pa'i yul mdo smad smar khams kyi sa char/ yab yum rigs ldan pa'i sras su rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me 'brug rabs lo 5671/ phug cilugs bstan pa'i tshugs lo 2557/ phyi lo 1676/)rin chen dpal bzang lags kyis mdzad pa'i mtshur phu dgon gyi dkar chag la phyi lo 1678lo khris pa nor song / lor sku bltams/zhes gsungs/ sde dges bsgrigs pa'i ka rabs lo rgyus las me sbrul (5672)lor 'khrungs zer/ de'i tshe nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis khengs pa dang / yi dam lha tshogs mang pos zhal gzigs shing / dus gsum gang la'ang thogs pa med pa'i mngon shes gsungs pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam pa ci yang bstan pas/ rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rjes gtsos/ mi dang mi min kun gyis chos rje na rma pa'i mchog chi gi sprul pa'i sku 'khrungs so zhes phyogs med du bsgrags pa'i sgras thams cad du khyab/ de nas zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bdun pa ye shes snying po cha(5626 6 5689 )dang / myal tshab nor bu bzang po sogs kyis dbus phyogs su spyan drangs te/ phebs lam gyi skye 'gro thams cad yongs su smin par mdzad nas/ rta thab kyi bsu ba dang / ser byung bcas bde chen yangs pa can gyi gtsug lag khang chen por phebs/ yab sras gser zhal 'dzoms te lhan rgyas pas rten 'byung mchog tu 'grigs/ de nas mi ring bar bsu ba ser phreng bcas 'jig rten dbang phyug rim byon gyi bste gnas 'og min mtshur phu'i pho brang du phebs/gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang po la seng khri chen por mnga' gsol dang shis pa brjod/ mthon mthing gser gyi mdong can gyi cod pan dbu la bzhes te snying po don brgyud kyi bstan pa'i bdag po chen por bzhugs/ zhwa dmar las phyag rgya chen po dang nā ro chos drug sogs rang lugs kyi dbang lung khrid gsum dang / khyad par du slob dpon che no po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i rdo rje'i bsung gis ye she me rdo rje zhe me pa 'i mtshan gsol/ rig 'dzin mi ske 189

༄༅/ /rkarma pa sku phreng bcu gcig pa ye shes rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//'gyur rdo rje'i zab gter dang / stag sham nus ldan rdo rje'i zab gter dzims cad du chos kyi bdag por lung bstan pa lta ra rnying lugs kyi dbang lung man ngag mang po gsan bsam mthar phyin mdzad/ gzhan yang mkhan po kurma phrin las gsum pa dang rgyal tshab sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du sda yongs 'dzin du bzhes nas mdo rgyud man ngag gi dbang lung sogs gsan pa rgya cher mdzad/ bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i sgo nas bstan pa'i sgron me spar/ na rma pa bcu gcig ye shes rdo rje dgung lo bco lnga pa lcags rta (5685)lor sde srid sangs rgyas pas po ta la'i pho brang dmar po bzhengs 'go tshugs/ — pa dgung lo bcu dgu pa shing khyi (5689)lor/ zhwa dmar bdun pa gar dbang rin po che dgung grangs re bzhi bzhes pa shing khyi dbo zla tshes nyer bdun la bde bar gshegs pa'i tshe dgongs rdzogs kyi mchod 'bul dang sku gdung mchod rten bzhengs/ rab gnas mdzad/ gdan sa nyams gsos/ gzhan yang sku gsung thugs rten du ma gsar bzhengs mdzad/ tre ho rin po che na rma bstan 'dzin dar rgyas/ 7 gong sa lnga pa chen po rgyal ba blo bzang rgya mtshos gzigs pa che zhing zhabs phyir po ṭa lar bzhugs pa/ lnga pa chen po gshegs kyang / chos rgyal sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dbu blar bzhugs dgos byung ba/ sa stag lor dgongs pa khrol nas mtshur phur phebs/ na rma pa mjal/ bka' chos kyang ci rigs pa zhus/ ci rgyal tshab gshegs par thugs dam gsal 'debs mdzad/ gnas nang du rje dpa' bo phrin las rgya mtsho mjal/ slar mtshur phur byon skabs/ nam pas sku chas phyag rdzas tshang ma gnang ste phyag nas mdzad de 'thor mi nyan gsungs pas bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ rje dpa' bo dgung lo lnga bcu pa sa yos lor zhi bar gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrubs/ 'di gong shing phag lor gas dbang brgyad pa zhwa dmar pa bal yul du 'khrungs nas/ zhwa dmar pa'i sprul sku yin tshul sa cha yul ris kyi ming sogs sngon gnas rjes dran du ma gsungs/ de skabs zag med kyi mngon par mkhyen pa la dbang 'byor ba chos rje kurma pas/ zhwa dmar pa'i yang srid sku 'khrungs ༷'i sa yul gyi bkod pa shog khra phyag ris mdzad de bang mi'i lag tu sprad nas mngags pas/ bal yul yol mo gangs rar sprul pa'i sku 'khrul med du ngos zin pas/ bal yul rgyal po man+t+ra seng ha ma lhas 'phrog thabs su yam —— 190 ———
