༄༅ / /na me pa oṃ phreng bcu gcig pa ye shes rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//gi nang du mi tig mig med rdog gcig bcug pa dang / so 'brang 'khor lo/ phyag mdud bcas bskur ba gnang / phyis bstan rtsis kyi re'u mig si tu nyid kyis gzigs skabs/ 'phags chen rnams kyi dus gsum gyi bye brag skad cig la ma 'dres par sgrib med du gzigs pa yin pa'i phyir tha shal kho bo lta bu'ang 'khor bar 'phyan pa'i gnas skabs thams cad du gzigs pa dus las mi yol lo snyam pa'i dga' ba thug med du 'phel/ zhes kun mkhyen si tu nyid kyis gsungs/ gzhan yang zag med kyi mngon mkhyen pa la chags thogs mi mnga' bas/ rje dpa' bo'i sku skye gzug lag don 'grub sogs sprul pa'i sku du ma ngos 'dzin mdzad/ deng ri'i par sgrub chen 'gyur med rnam rgyal spyan gnyis long ba la zhal chab btab pas de ma thag shin tu gsal bar gyur/ shog shing gi srir yu la phyag mdud mdzad nas slar gong bur sgril ba gnang / dus gcig la gzims chung rer sku'i bkod pa re sprul nas bzhugs pa sogs grub pa'i cho 'phrul mtha' yas/ gangs can mkhas spub kun gyis gus pas mchod/ mchog dman bar ma'i skye rgu ma lus pa theg pa gsum gyi byang chub tu smin pa dang grol bar mdzad/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa dpal chen chos kyi don 'grub rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol te snying po don gyi bstan pa gtad/ sprul pa'i sku phyi ma gang du byon pa lung bstan nas/ rtag 'dzin can gyi gdul bya rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir dgung lo nyi shu rtsa drug pa dang rang lo nyer bdun/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu rta (5697)zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la sprul pa'i bkod pa phyogs gcig bsdu bar mdzad/ de skabs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'ja' sprin gyis bskor ba'i dbus su sku'i bkod pa gtso 'khor gsuyo gyi rnam par bstan pa skal ldan kun gyis mthong ba byung / zhwa dmar dang tre bos dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul dang / na rma pa ye shes rdo rje'i sku gdung rin po che 'od bzhu mchod sdong bzhongs shing / bde mchog lha lnga'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pur mdzad do/ rje de'i zhal slob ni/ gtso bor don brgyud bstan ri mnga' bdag zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa dpal chen chos kyi don 'grub dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug tre bo na rma bstan 'dzin dar rgyas/ mkhan chen kurma don yod snying po sogs mang du byon mod kyang rje 'di'i rnam thar rgyas pa de sngon bdag gi sa ma mjal bas/ 'di ni zhwa dmar thams cad — — 192

༄ / /kurma pa sku phreng bcu gcig pa ye shes rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i rnam thar gsol 'debs kyi dngos bstan rnams gzhir bzhag shugs bstan cung zad kyis mtshams sbyar/ gzhan nas phran tshegs gsal ba rnams kyis kha bkang pa'o zhes sa rma nges don gyis gsungs 'dug na da dus 'dir ni smos ci ma dgos so snyam ste ngal ba dor bar byas so/ zhes gsungs/ 7 karma pa sku phreng bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu lug (569 8)la 'khrungs/cici tsho ri ri ci pha — — 1 93 ——

——— ———— 8༅/ /kurma pa sku phrang bcu gnyas pa byang chub rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//༄༅ / /dmi pa sku sbreng bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje'i rnam thar/ kurma pa sku phreng bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje ni/ rje ye shes rdo rje zhing du gshegs khar bar khams sde dge'i sa phyogs tsam la sprul sku 'byon pa'i zhal bzhes gnang ba bzhin/ sde dge dbon stod kyi sa cha chu bo gser ldan gdan gyi 'gram ngogs dkyil le tsag tor zhes par bod chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud 'khrul med grub chen kurma pak+ṣi'i dbon rgyud btsad po la las btsang po zhes bris 'dug po dbu'i rigs/ yab kurma tshe brtan dang yum seng nge bza' dkar mo skyid gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu lug rabs lo 5698/ phug lugs bstan pa'i 'das lo 258ri phyilo17 03/lo la sku bltams/ gdung rigs ni bod chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud ste/ de yang sad na legs mjing yon la khri sde btsad po yang zer/ de la sras lnga/ 1 khri dar/ 2 lu dum btsan/ 3 lha rje/ 4 lhun grub/ 5 khri chen po bcas yin/ lnga tshigs stag nam mkha'i lha bzung ni/ slob dpon pad+ma/ bi ma la nam mkha'i snying po sogs kyi slob ma/ na bza' nyi zer la 'gyel ba dang / 'ja' 'od phyag gis bzung nas nam mkha' la 'gro thub pa byung / rgyal rabs dpag bsam ljon shing las stag nam mkha'i lha bzung gis pho brang phying nga stag rtse bzung / de'i sras la 'od skyid 'bar/ de la sras bdun byung / gcan/ gangs/ rje/ tsha/ khri/ lte/ dmar ro/ gcung tshangs tsha spun drug ni/ nyis spyan/ g.yu spyan gnyis/ dar dang / lhun po gnyis/ 'od btsan/ lhun po gnyis/ 'od btsan/ gung btsan gnyis te drug 'di dag gis bya sa'i lha chen bzhengs/ gangs/ rje/ tsha/ khri/ nye/ dmar gyi sras drug las g.yu thog pa'i rgyud/ sna mo ba/ phying nga ba don mkhar ba/ thang mkhar ba rnams byung / de las lha ston kur po'i rgyud byi chu ba rnams yin/ gtsang tsha spun drug las/ lhas spyan gdung chad/ dar ra/ lhun po/ 'od btsan/ gung btsan rnams kyi brgyud pa la khra 'brug pa dang / bying pa/byar sa/ chu mig thog so ba rnams byung / de rnams kyi mi brgyud la tsha drug byung ba ni/ 1 mtshur cha ba seng ge dpal ldan/ 2 rgya tsha bla ma bsod dpal/ 3 'phrad tsha bla ma brtson 'grus seng ge 4 dbye tsha chos mchog dpal/ 5 ga tsha chos rdor ba chos rgyal/ 6 'bam tsha chos blo ba paṇ+ḍi ta —— 194 —

gyi / /nam pa sku phreng bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// ci —wa ——wa bsod dpal te drug las/ mtshur tsha/ shes rab seng ge'am/ rgyal dbang sprang thar la sras bzhi/ 1 thugs rje dpal ni skam pa yin/ 2 a dbang ka 2 ye shes dbang phyug 4 chos rgyal bzhi'o/ chos rgyal gyi sras/ 1 snga rta shod pa/ 2 dben skyabs/ na sa thar gsum byung / ༈ //kā sdu/sa 3 sras/tha/ ༷ja / /rdzu /nga / /sngo/ga spya ba // zlo shun/7 | a dī // sbya dī zlo /sa ḍi/ dpo/ ༵ /sbya /sdu /sdu/ la/ /ra /sdu kā sbyi ching gis shel gyi nyi shan byin/ / mi thar gyi sras sngags skyabs/ sngags skyabs kyi sras gnyis kyi sgang pa kun dga' rin chen la hor rgyal po sbyi ching gi shel gyi nyi shan dang 'ja' sa phebs/ gcung tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la gu'i gung gi las ka gnang / 'dis kurma'i gdan sa mdzad skabs rang byung /༷༷ /ba// /bye / /// //sa shā /'am si ༵ / dho ḍi /sdo /lha la// /dro ༵༵ ༷༷sdu sdo da /snye bon/ sta/ /phe ༷du /nga kyi ba snas /zhi /bo/ rno sta/ kya 'phel gyi sras/ si tu bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa/ si tu tshul khrims rgyal mtshan pa'am ti tu ārla pa'ang zer/ hor rgyal pos dngul tham dang 'ja' sa byin/ a tsa ra bdun gyi rten gi dho la phul/ 'dis kurma'i gdan sa mdzad skabs rje rol pa'i rdo rje phebs/ mi chos pa rgyal bzang dang / sku mched gsus byung / rgyal bzang gi sras si tu bkra shis rgyal mtshan pa'am dbu shes rab me lce dang / thugs rje rgya hob gnyis byung / 'di skabs dbon po ru bzhi'i gdung rgyud rnams nang zhig byung / dbu thugs rje rgya hob kyi sras/ si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / dbon dkon mchob kha rgyal mtshan gnyis/ dbon dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi sras si tu shākya bzang po/ dbon grags pa dbang phyug gnyis/ dbon grags pa dbang phyug gi sras si tu bkra shis rnam rgyal/ bu gsar gnyis/ / bu gsar gyis sras/ 1 si tu bkra shes dpal 'byor dang / 2 bkra shis don grub/ na si tu dpal ldan bkra shis/ 4 dbon a thar dang bzhi/ ༈ de'i sus/ 1 bu gcod 'bum/ 2 bkra shis don grub pa'i sras/ si tu bsod nams rnam rgyal/ 'di wa 195 ——

༄༅ / /kurma pa sku phreng bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//wa wa mthu nus che/ 'di skabs rje mi bskyod rdo rje phebs/ drung rdo rje gzhon nu gnyis byung / lha a thar gyi sras/ a sngon dang / legs pa gnyis byung / de'i mi rgyud la/ dbon stod pa'i dbon tshan zhig byung / lebs pa yi bu rgyud la/ 'dul 'dzin jo pho ba/ de'i mched ya las gyes pa than pa rgyal ju mtshan/ byang chub rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ spungs ri ba'i zhal ngo rnams so/ ཿ si tu bkra shis dpal 'byor ba'i skye ba khams stod tsi rgyud du 'khrungs pa mi 'khrugs chos kyi go cha'o/ /de lta ra yab bod chos rgyal gdung rgyud grub thob chen po kurma sa khri'i dbon rgyud btsad po dbu'i — cirigs kurma tshe brtan zhu/ de yi snga lo tsam du yab de nyid rdza ma 'tshong bar song bas rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje dang skya ka mdor mjal nas gter ci ston na sa khri mthon po zhig brtsegs pa'i steng du bzhag khyod kyi rdza ma 'tshong mi dgos gsungs te// rdza ma thams cad bcag nas mngags pa'i phyi lo tsam du rgyal ba'i dbang po sku 'khrungs pa yin 'dug sku 'khrungs nas tshe rgyu bla ma 'dul ba zhes pa der phebs skabs sprul pa'i sku khrus cig phul bas/bla ma de yi mig la na tsha tshabs chen zhig byung bar gter ston la cis phan zhus pas/ khyod kyis rgyal ba na rma pa la khrus byas pas dpal lha mo khros nas mig nang du tshwa dang thal ba btab pa yin gsungs nas ngos 'dzin mdzad/ sku gong ma ye shes rdo rje mya ngan las 'da' khar yang phyogs der sprul pa'i sku ston par zhal bzhes gnang ba yin 'dug cing / zla ba gnyis tsam song skabs kurma pa yin zhes gsungs/ dbus nas sgar gyi mgron gnyer phan bde rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sprul sku ngos 'dzin la brdzangs pa lha thog nang du gter ston mi 'gyur rdo rje dang mjal nas kurma pa'i mchog sprul yod pa'i sa cha yab yum gyi ming bcas ston par mdzad/ drug pa'i tshes gcig la sa dkar du bslebs/ de nyin nub ngos nas 'ja' shar/ tshes bzhin sprul sku mjal bas gong ma'i phur mdud ngos 'dzin dang / phyi nyin phyag mdud ngos 'dzin dang / sku 'dra ngos 'dzin mdzad/ tshes brgyad la sku srung phul / phyag phreng yang ngos 'dzin/ me khyi tha skar gyi tshes gcig nyin mgron gnyer phan bde sogs kyis zhwa dmar brgyad pa chos kyi don 'grub ( 569 0)kyis bstsal ba'i mtshan dang zhabs brtan smon la me sogs phul/ dpo zla'i tshes bcur si tu rin po che phebs te lhan rgyas zhal 'a dzoms —— 196

ga / /kurma pa sku phreng bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// —4gnang / sga khra leb nyi ma 'gyur med/ zur mang gar dbang / ban chen sangs rgyas mnyan pa sprul sku bcas kyis mjal/ na rma pa sku phreng bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje dgung lo drug pa sa byi (5703)snron zla'i bcu bdun la sgom brag chos khri thang du sgar bzhugs/ spom brag dang go ser phug tu phebs/ gro bzhin can gyi tshes brgyad la sde dge bla ma bsod nams dang mjal 'dzoms gnang / khrums zla'i bcu bdun la jo phor phebs/ tha skar can gyi tshes nyer lngar gter ston mi 'gyur rdo rje sku gshegs pa'i mgyogs bsngo 'byor/ mgo zla'i tshes lngar si tu rin po che dang / zur mang che tshang sprul skus mjal/ jo po'i gnas gsar rnying thams cad gzigs/ skabs der tsa gtor phebs/ na rma pak+ṣi'i gzims khang gi rdo brtsegs la smon lam mdzad/ tha kur can gyi tshes gnyis la bcad brgyar bzhugs/ dgung lo brgyad pa lcags stag (5705)gsar tshes kyi nang der gzims sar sad 'ga' re mdzad pas/ nyer lngar sde dge sku chen 'das pa'i bsngo rten byung / chu stod kyi nyer bdun la gter ston chos rje gling pa'i bang mi zhu shog 'byor/ khrums zla'i bcu bdun la dge rgyas dpon rno sa ma/jal / rta nyer lnga sogs phul/ dgung lo dgu pa lcags yos (5706)las ra bzhad kyi lo gas ra tshes bdun la a lor phebs pa'i skar 'dzin mdzad nas bcu bdun nyin chibs bteg si tu rin po ches chibs bsu bcas dgon rtser phebs te/ zhag lnga bzhugs phyogs kyi mjal mi mang pos mjal/ nyer drug nyin ser sbreng bcas dpal 'byor du phebs par 'bul chen bstabs/ si tu rin po che'i lhag lha rta mgrin dang srung ma zhing skyong yin par lung bstan/ tshes bzhir chibs bteg dbo zla'i tshes drug la lcags ra rdzong du spyan drangs/ brgyad la sde dge'i dgon chen du phebs/ tshes bcu gsum la mdzes su phebs/ tshes nyer dgur sting chen du si tu sprul sku dang mjal/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes lngar dbus nas mgron gnyer ye shes bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal dang / tre bo'i sgrub pa ba bcas spyan 'dren la bslebs/ dgu ba'i mar ngo'i tshes bcur rgyal sras bsod nams lde'u btsan phebs pas mjal/ dgung lo bcu pa chu 'brug (5707)sa ga'i tshes gsum la 'gu ra nang du phebs/ snren zla'i tshes bcu gsum nyid dbus nas/ yangs lon mkhan wa na me rnam grol dang sde ba bstan dar sogs sgar khag so so'i sku tshab bcas — 197

cu byu/ /kurma pa sku phreng bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// — bslebs/ chu stod kyi nyer gcig la lha lung phug tu phebs/ sde dge bla ma bsod nams phun tshogs kyis mjal/ sde dge'i gur chen du mchod yon zhal 'dzoms mdzad/ nyer gnyis la gsol ston dang / nyer brgyad la sku rdzong sogs phul/ gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes gcig la lha phug nas bzhugs sgar bteg khrums zla'i tshes gcig la gter ston khyung grags rdo rjes mjal/ tshes bdun la 'og min —na rmar phebs/ bcu drug la kurma dgon du 'byor/smin drug can gyi tshes bcu gnyis la rje gar dbang brgyad pa dang zhal 'dzom gyi legs tshogs su gyur/ phyi nyin yas sras lhan rgyas/ si tu rin po che bcas kyis 'ba' rom gyi gnas gzigs gnang / bcu bzhi nyin bzhugs sgar bteg nyer gcig nyin gnam gyi bye lung mdar phebs/ lam zhor du nang chen rgyal po'i sgar du spyan 'dren 'bul zhabs zhus/ kurma pa byang chub rdo rje dgung lo bcu gcig pa chu sbrul (5708)lor paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes la rgya nag gong ma bde skyid rgyal pos/ paṇa chen er ti ni zhes pa'i go gnas dang 'ja' sa tham ga gnang bas dga' ston rten 'brel zhus/ kurma pa dgung lo bcu gsum pa shing lug (5710)lor rgya nag rtogs ldan byang chub 'phags dbang gis khams stod seng ze'i grong du grags pa can gyi rgya nag ma ṇi bzhengs/ de skabs bod 'brug sa mtshams skor 'khrug pa byung bas sa skya'i bdag chen dang / pan chen sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang ye shes kyis bar 'dum mdzad/ byang chub rdo rje gdan sar phebs nas zhwa dmar pa nyid bla mar bsten/ phal cher kurma pa dgung lo bco lnga pa me bya (5712)lor yab sras lhan rgyas/ si tu rin po che dang bcas bal yul du phebs/ bal po'i rgyal blon rnams kyis bsnyen bkur byas/ bal yul rang byung mchod rten sogs gzigs/ kurma pa dgung lo bcu drug pa sa khyi (5713)lor sog po jun gar ( lo)ba'i dmag gis bod du yod pa'i rnying dgon smin gling / rdo rje brag rnam rgyal grwa tshang sogs mang che ba gtor/ dge 'dun khag la zhib bsher byas/ rgya nag gong ma bde skyid dam khang shi'i dmag dpung bod du jun gar ba 'dul bar 'ongs/ nag chur dmag 'thab pas gong ma'i dmag dpung la pham nyes tshabs chen byung /lo chen dharma shrī dang rig 'dzin pad ma phrin las/ pad ma 'gyur med rgya ma tsho rnams jun gar bas bkrongs/ rje yab sras rnams kyis thabs dang —— 198

༄cu/ /nam pa sku phreng bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//shes rab kyi sgo nas jun gan bar rgol ba byas/ kurma pa dgung lo bcu bdun pa sa phag (5714)lor rgya nag gong ma'i dmag dpung thengs gnyis pa btang bas/ jun gar ba'i dmag dpung mnga' ris brgyud de bros/ lam bar dmag 'thab pas pham nyes tshabs chen byung / na rma pa dgung lo bco brgyad pa lcags byi (5715)lor sog jun gar pa'i dmag dpung yongs rdzogs bod nas bskrad/ re zhig yul lung bde 'jags su gnas/ gong ma bde skyid rgyal po'i sras cang cun mngags te/ mtsho sngon dpon rigs rnams kyis tā la'i bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho (5703 4 5752) dbus su gdan drangs te/ zla ba dgu'i tshes bco lnga nyin pho brang po tā lar mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khrir mnga' gsol/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos gser yig dang gser dam bstsal/ kurma pa zhwa dmar nag gnyis ka tshogs par phebs/ gong ma'i sras cang cun dang gung tshe dbang nor bu/ don 'grub wang / bstan 'dzin wang ngam blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ i sis pi li/ nga phod rdo rje rgyal po/ gung lum pa bkra shis rgyal po sogs rgya bod tshogs 'du chen pos lo gcig ring bod kyi srid bskyangs/ jun gar bas sde ba stag rtse ba sde srid du bskos pa gong ma'i khrims kyis bkrongs/ gtsang khang chen po ( glo )rgyal sar bzhag mkhas btsun bzang pos mdzad pa'i bod kyi rnam thar mdzod las/ gter chen rol pa'i rdo rje 'das te dgongs rdzogs rgyas par mdzad gsungs/ rkarma pa byang chub rdo rje dgung lo bcu dgu pa lcags glang (5716/)lo la si tu brgyad pa dbus su phebs nas bka' brgyud pa rnams lhan 'dzoms byung / hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bdun nyin gong ma bde skyid rgyal pos rgyal sa lo drug cu re gcig bzung nas 'das/ kurma pa dgung lo nyer gcig pa chu yos (5718)lor gong ma bde skyid 'das te gong ma gnam skyong rgyal po 'am yung kreng ( 1)gser khrir mnga' gsol/ go shrī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud chin wang blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis mdzi'i gong mar ngo log pa mdzi'i dmag dpung gis snying 'jags su btang / bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa cung dar ba'i khams stod dpon mgo don dgu pa'i nang gses/ tsho ba so dgu bod ljongs kyis gnas snabs su gzigs rgyu byas/ don chus nyer lnga mtsho sngon la dbang bya byas/ kurma pa dgung lo nyer lnga pa me lug (5722/—— 199 ——

༄cu/ /kurma pa sku phreng bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//1727/)lor si tu chos 'byung gis sde dge dpal srungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling btab pa'i phyag 'phrin 'byor/ hor zla dgu'i tshes bcu dgu nyin lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi gzhung sgo'i thog kha'i tshoms chen khams gsum du/ nga lum sbyar gsum gyis da'i ching sba dur bsod nams rgyal por ral gri bsnun te bkrongs pa dang btsun mo rgan gzhon/ zhabs 'bring gtso bo rnams kyang dmar gsod btang ba'i bsngo zhu 'byor/ pho lha pa gtsang du bros pa sogs dbus gtsang dus zing gi rkyen du rim gro rgya chen mdzad/ bod du 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i sku tshab am ban seng ge mngal gtong 'go tshugs nas/ rje zhwa dmar nag gnyis rgya nag pe cin du gdan zhus mdzad pas phebs grabs mdzad/ rkarma pa dgung lo nyer drug pa sa sprel (5723/ 1728/)lo'i mjug tu pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyal tha'i ji dang gong ma'i dmag dpung gis nga phod rdo rje rgyal po dang / gung lum pa bkra shis rgyal po/ sbyar ra ba blo gros rgyal po sogs khrims la sbyar te dmar gsod btang / rgyal yab dang nga lum sbyar gsum 'brel ba che bas gong ma chen po'i bka' bzhin/ rgyal ba bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho dang rgyal yab bsod nams dar rgyas dkar mdzes khul mgar thar du chibs kha bsgyur/der lo bdun bzhugs/ jun wang pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyal gyis bod rgyal byas pa'i dus zing gis pe cin du phebs rgyu ma byung / nam pa dgung lo nyer bdun pa sa bya (572ri 1729/)lor si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis sum rtags 'brel chen rtsom 'go tshugs/ bar khams sde dge'i rgyal po zhe gnyis pa chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring gis sde dge'i par khang dang bka' 'gyur mtshal par gsar bzhengs dbu btsuge sa pa'i 'phrin 'byor/ de'i phyogs su thugs khur dpag med mdzad/ rkarma pa dgung lo nyer brgyad pa lcags khyi (5725/ 1730/)lo ra tre bor sku phreng gsum pa kurma bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyi (1652 — 1730)dgongs rdzogs bsgrubs/ khams stod dge rgyas rdza stod dpon tshang la khams sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma (1730 4 1779)'khrungs/ 'di lor bod 'brug bar gyi 'khrug pa langs/ rdo ring gung gi a khu khang chen 'das tshab la jo jo rnam rgyal tshe brtan la tha'i ji go gnas sprad/ gong ma dbyang kring gis slar gser yig 'byor nas/ rkarma pa zhwa dmar nag gnyis rgya nag pe cin du gdan — 200 ———

༄cu/ /na rma pa sku phreng bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// zhus mdzad/ ma rma pa dgung lo nyer dgu pa lcags phag (5726/ 173 1/)lo'i gnam stong nyin zhwa dmar nag gnyis rgya nag pe cin du chibs bsgyur rdza stod dge rgyas rdza dkar nag sum mdo nas ngor mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong ( 1702 1759)dang mjal/ lam zhor du sde dger phebs/ si tu brgyad pas sde dge'i bka' 'gyur zhu dag mdzad/ sde dge'i bstan pa tshe ring gis ngor mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong la dgu tshan phul/ de skabs bod kyi mkhas pa'i dbang poXrnams sde dger 'dzoms/ de nas bod rgya'i yig tshang las rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu glang lo ste phyi lo 1733lor/ na rma pa dgung lo so gcig dang zhwa dmar brgyad pa dpal 0chen chos kyi don grub (1695 1733)dgung lo so brgyad par lha 'bum dkar po bzhes nas dus gcig tu rgya nag bkra shis khri sgor dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs par grags/ sog chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar las/ zhwa dmar nag 'di gnyis/ rnying ma la dga' ba'i lha sra sa bcu bdun pas gdan drangs pa thu'u bkan chos kyi rgya mtshos mngon spyod mdzad par gcig zi ling dang gcig zhi nan nas grongs gsungs/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i bod kyi rnam thar mdzod las/ de nas zur ri drung pa sogs zhabs phyi rnams kyis sku gdung rin po che zhugs su phul nas gdung thal rus sogs mtshur phur spyan drangs te/ lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi drung du zhwa dmar nag so so'i dngul gdung bzhengs te/ rgyal tshab dang / si tu rin po ches rab tu gnas par mdzad pa'o/ de ltar gar dbang thams —bye/ /mi dī jiX /kā dī //༷ rdon do /gyi kyi ba // /gru /ta /nga ci/nga sdu na tsha /ma tu ba /baXnyi /skur/ brdong ku /bgo rdo ga rdo /dī / dī ṭ+wāṃ dī 'i sdu/dī ṭ+wāṃ di tso ༵ dang sa ra ba dang phul tu gyur pa thams cad mkhyen pa tā'i si tu rin po che chos kyi 'byung gnas dang / dpa' bo sprul pa'i sku gong ma gtsug lag don 'grub dang / lkegatsug lag dga' ba'i dbang po sku gong 'og gnyis/ tre bor sprul sku bstan 'dzin dar rgyas te yab sras rnam pa bzhi dang / 'brug thams cad mkhyen pa'i mchog sprul bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta/ yongs 'dzin rin po che kurma thub bstan ngag dbang / sding po che'i sprul pa'i sku/ rje btsun — ———— 201 wa

༄༅/ /mcho/ pa sku phreng bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//chos mgon sprul pa'i sku sogs skyes chen dam pa rnams so/ zhes gsungs/ dus skabs 'di la dbus gtsang du dus zing byung ba dang rgyal ba na rma pa zhwa dmar nag gnyis ka dus gcig tu rgya nag la 'das pa ni yid skyo ba'i gnas su mchis/ gnam 'og zhi bder brtson pa'i skyes chen dam pa zhig dus zin skabs su 'das pa ni gyong gud chen po yin la/ gnyis 'das pa ni de bas kyang ci smos/ lo 'di ni bka' brgyud par byung ba'i rkyen ngan tshabs chen zhig yin la/ mthar gtugs na bod yongs dang mes rgyal la gyong gud tshabs chen byung ba yin/ dge'o// 7 karma pa sku phreng bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu glang 5728dang shing stag5729/la 'khrungs par bzhed pa'i srol gnyis mchis/ ngosaXwa pho —202—

gyi / /na rma pa sku phreng bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// ༄༅ / /na rma pa sku phreng bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje'i rnam thar/kurma pa sku phreng bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje 'khrungs pa'i skor la chu glang (5728/ 1733/nodang shing stag (5729/ 173ri)gnyis la ngos bzung tshul yod/ 'dir mkhas btsun bzang po'i bod kyi rnam thar mdzod ltar/ bod kyi rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu glang khrums zla'i hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu drug nas brgyad pa'i bco lnga'i bar/yar tshe4 45 chos rje gong ma byang chub rdo rjes lung bstan zhal chems phyag bris gu ru dharma la bstsal ba dang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus mtshur phu'i ri khrod pad+ma khyung rdzong du bzhugs skabs o rgyan rin po ches lung bstan tshigs su bcad pa drug dngos su gsungs pa dang / slar yang / dge ri gzhung ri dang nye ba'i phyogs na khyim bdag 'byor pas cher dben cing / rigs rus rnam dag dge la brtson zhing de na kerma ka zhes sogs lung bstan pa ltar/ bod yul dbus ljongs kyi lho phyogs snyen lca ba grong zhes par rigs rus rnam par deg pa'i yab yum las sku bltams/ ljags la skye med kyi yi ge a mtshan pa ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab/ kurma pa dgung lo gnyis pa shing stag (5729/ 173sa)gnam lo gsar bzhad skabs kun bzang 'jigs bral sogs kyis sprul sku ngos 'dzin spyi babs ltar byas pas 'khrul pa mi mnga' bar ma zad/ sngon gnas rjes dran du ma gsungs pas thams cad kyis rgyal ba rkarma pa'i mchog gi sprul sku yin min the tshom bral ba'i nges pa rnyed pas snyan pa phyogs med du bsgrags/ sku la mi 'gyur ba'i brda rtags thugs skar sme ba dbang gi mdog can dang / ljags la a yig dkar po rang byon mnga'/de skabs rdo'i ril bu zhig brnyes pa la ring bsrel mang du 'phel/ sku chung ngu'i dus ngo lamatshar can gyi gzigs snang sna tshogs dang / sngon gnas rjes — rke dran mang du gsungs pa rnams bla ma tre rā dzā sa phyag bris su bkod par gsal/ pha yul bdud kyi btson ra ltar gzigs shing stod lung mtshur phur 'byon pa la thugs ring che ba'i tshul mdzad/ ces gsungs/ na rma pa dgung lo gsum pa shing yos (5730/ 1735/)lor ma gong ma chen pos rmu tu'u thung dru hra'u sogs dpon dmag lnga brgya tsam sku srung du btang ste tā li skal bzang rgya mtsho bod du gdan drangs/ gong ma yung kreng bde bar — 203 ———

ci ༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//gshegs/ de'i sras bzhi pa lha skyong ngam chan lung (7 )mi 'jigs gser gyi khri la mnga' gsol/ kurma pa dgung lo bzhi pa me 'brug (5731/ 1736/)rgyal zla'i hor zla12pa gza' skar bzang por rgyal tshab dkon mchog 'od zer dang gra zur slob dpon/ sngon gyi gsol dpon gzims mgron gyi gtsos phebs bsur 'byor bas shin tu mnyes pa'i tshul mdzad/ rgyal rir lo gsar dga' ston bcas rgyal ba dang po la rta thabs kyi chibs bsu ser byung bcas 'og min mtshur phur byon/ 7 thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho (1708 1757)dang / mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal dang / bka' brgyud yas sras rnams kyis dbu byas/ bla dpon chen rgu dang / lha sde mi sde rnams kyis gus pas mchod sprin bcas seng khri chen por mnga' gsol/ dpal ldan 'jigs med bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rje phyogs kyi go cha mi shigs snying po'i dbang phyug nges don bstan pa'i rtsa lag phrin la sa rgyas pa'i dpag bsam mngon par mtho ba'i sde tshes pa'i mtshan gyi sgra dbyangs 'og min gyi bar du grags par gyur/ mkha' 'gro 'bum zhu'i cod pan bzhes shing 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad/ de rjes nges par thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po si tu bstan pa'i nyin byed kyang sngon dmar nag cod pan 'dzin pa zung gis snying po don gyi bstan pa gtad pa sogs kyi bka' lung rjes su bsgrub phyir mdo smad sde dge'i phyogs nas rim par byon/ dgung lo brgyad pa lcags sprel (5735)lor zhwa dmar dgu pa dbon mchog dge ba'i 'byung gnas dgung lo brgyad steng bar chad kyis sku sa shegs/ la las lcags byar (1741)lor 'dod/ kurma pa dgung lo bcu pa chu khyi (5737)lor zhwa dmar bcu pa chu khyi (1742) lor zhwa dmar bcu pa mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho gtsang bkra shis rtser/ sde pa thang lha dang yum la dwags rgyal po'i sras mo nyi zla dbang mo gnyis la 'khrungs te/ paṇa chen sku sra nga drug pa dpal ldan ye shes dang drung pa ho thog thu'i gcung / bsam sding rdo rje 'phags mo'i ming po yin/ rkarma pa dgung lo bcu gcig pa chu phag (5738/ 1743/)lor bod du skar ma dung phod chen ngo shar/ rkarma pa dgung lo bcu gsum pa shing glang (5740/ 1745/)lo ra mtshur phur phebs te yab sras si tu brgyad pa zhal rgyas pas rten 'brel legs tshobs 'grigs/ dngos po'i mchod sprin dpag —— 204

ga / /ba pa sku zeng bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//— — tu med pas khri khol bcas mthon ri gi cod pan sgron/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi bsngags pa yan lag bdun pa dang shis brjod rgya ra mdzad pas/ rgyal ཿbstan spyi dang bye brag sgrub brgyud snying po'i bstan pa dkar po'i snang bas khyab par gyur/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lngar lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan gyi drung du kun ngu si tu rin po che las rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes pas/ thog drangs mdo rgyud gsar rnying gi dbang lung khrid gsum zab rgyas mtha' dag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan nas rigs kyi bdag por bzhes/ gter ston rol ba'i rdo rje'i chos skor gsan skabs bla ma kun ma' rta mgrin mar gad mdog can du gzigs/ gsang mtshan dbang chen rdo rje zhi ba rtsal zhes gsol/ gzhan yang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta/ dpa' bo gtsug lag dga' ba sogs mkhas shing grub pa'i yongs 'dzin lha rdzu ༵༵ / //sdu /baXr rgya ༷dza ༵/ khri lo nyi ༵ ḍi /sdo /sdo /sbyang rdo ༷sa ༵ /rdoX2 pa/ 'i /༷rdo hūṃ/ 'a // kā nga // ra zlo // stu/ ༵ rdzo gas byis / rda gzhon pa 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyis srid bzung / na rma pa cadagung lo bcu bdun pa sa sbrul (574sde 1slog /)lor dwa 'u stod smad gnyis mi mthun pas zi ling rgya dpon la gtugs/ lab mda'i bka' 'gyur lha khang bzhengs/ — sa dgung lo brdo brgyad pa lcags rta (5145/ 1750/)lor sne la'i pā thur gong ma'i khrims lha sbyar/ dga' bzhi gung paṇ+ḍi tas re zhig bod rgyal byas/ rgyal bar brod rgyal gyi tham ga phul/ kurma pa dgung lo 1 7 // 〉kā / kā/ sdu//5 ṭā/ /pa/ sdu // cho/sa bye/ /rdos brtso rlo tshi /rdo ni da/ bu/ zlo sdu // ༵ shā nyer lhag ṭ+wāṃ // /dro //swā /sto tu/ kho pa dang mjal/ na me pa dgung lo nyer bzhi pa me byi (5751 / 1756/)lo'i lo gsar rnying mtshams su bod khul dang nags tshang du sa g.yos byung /ku pa dgung lo nyer lnga pa me glang (5752)lo'i zla gnyis pa'i tshe sa gsum nyin rgyal dbang bdun pa skal bzang gyi mtshong bya lnga bcur son te — 205 ———

༄༅ / /ma rma pa sku phreng bcu sa su ma pa bdud 'dul rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//dgongs pa rdzogs pas dgongs rdzogs rgyas par mdzad/ kurma pa dgung lo nyer drug pa sa stag (5753/ 1758/)lo'i zla drug pa'i tshes gnyis nyin rgyal ba brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho 'khrungs/ kurma pa dgung lo nyer bdun pa sa yos (575sa 1759 /)lor na rma bdud 'dul grags pa rdo rje dang ngor mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong 'das/ kurma pa dgung lo sum cu pa chu rta (5757/ 1762/)lo'i lo gsar dang zur mang drung pa'i bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bdun nyin tā la brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dgung lo lnga sngar mnyes thang bde ba can nas gdan drangs te/ tshes bcu nyin mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khri la mnga'i gsol bas lhag bsam3)sa byed sgo gnang / kurma pa dgung lo so gnyis pa shing sprel (5759/ 176ri)lor mdzi srid gzhung dang rgyal rong mi nub rgyas po'i bar da ca4 ba rgyar khrug byung bar bzlogs/ kurma pa dgung lo so bdun pa sa glang (5767 1269 /)lor/ bal yul du gor kha rigs kyi rgyal rabs gsar du btsugs pa'i phyag 'phrin 'byon/ kurma pa dgung lo so brgyad pa lcags stag (5765 / 1770/)lor 'brug khams sprul gyis snyan ngag 'brel ba dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho yongs su brtsams grub/ kurma pa ca dgung lo so dgu pa lcags yos (5766/ 1771/〉 lor bar khams sde dge'i phyogs su byon/ kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyin byed dgon slob rnams phebs bsur byon/ rgyal ba'i dbang pos dbu ma'i lta ba dang thugs dam nyin mtshan khor yug 'da' ba'i rtogs 'bul mdzad/ dpal spungs su byon nas gzim myung yid dga' chos 'dzin du bzhugs/ sa dbang sde dge'i 'gul chen sogs dngos 'bul mtha' yas/ mdo khams kyi gdul bya thams rbad 'grel tshad don ldan du mdzad nas yar byon pa na/ kun mkhyen si tu rin po ts+tsha mi nyid phebs skyel du byon/ rgyal ba'i dbang pos bla ma sangs rgyas tredangos su gzigs nas dad gus drag pos sku'i dkyil 'khor la dab ngo bzhi brgya rtsa legs par mdzad/ phan tshun thugs yid 'phreng ba'i rnam 'gyur cidang gsung gleng sna tshogs kyi mthar/ dar gyi g.yab sa yug sogs rten 'byung phun sum tshogs par mdzad/ byon lam gyi gdul bya thams cad bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis tshim par mdzad nas/ na me pa dgung lo zhe gcig pa chu 'brug (5 768/ 1772/)lor yar byon pa na/ kun mkhyen si tu — 206 — —

cig / /— pa sku phreng bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//rin po che nyid phebs skyel du byon/ rgyal ba'i dbang pos bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su gzigs nas dad gus grag pos sku'i dkyil 'khor la dbang bzhi brgya rtsa len pa mdzad/ phan tshun thugs yid 'phreng ba'i rnam 'gyur 'bral mi phod pa tsam dang / thugs gshin pa'i gsung gleng sna tshogs kyi mthar —dar gyi g.yab g.yug sogs rten 'byung phun tshogs par mdzad nas 'byon lam gyi gdul bya thams cad bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis tshim par mdzad nas rim par mtshur phur phyag phebs/ gsan bsam yang rgya chen mdzad med/ gtso chen sgom byung gi mkhyen gnyis la mnga' dbang 'byor bas shes bya thams cad thugs su chud/ gdul bya dbang rab rnams nas rdo rje thog pa'i skyed rdzogs kyi gnad gsang sogs zab pa dang / dbu phar 'dul mdzod kyi shes bya sogs rgya che ba gang dang gang nas dogs gcod zhus kyang the tshom gyi dra ba gcod pa'i gsung lan thams cad dpe la ma nyos par thogs ched du shar shar gsungs pas mkhas pa rnams nga rgyal bral zhing som nyi zad/ daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung sogs rang bzhin brjod pa dang / dpe dang / gzugs can sogs don rgyan sum cu rtsa lnga sogs snyan dngags sdeb sbyor la mnga' brnyes kyang gsung rtsom zhal gdams thams cad gdul bya mchog dman kun la smin pa'i thugs bskyed kyi tshig rna bad snyan zhing don go bde ba kho na gsungs/ gser dang gsog ma ro mnyam pa sogs 'khor 'das kyi dngos snang thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur nges par mngon du gzigs pas/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi dri ma gtan nas mi mnga'/ na bza' gsol chos gang dag kyang gang byung gis chog shes mdzad cing / lha sa'i jo bo rin po che la gser zho lnga brgya las grub pa'i ting bdun dang / lha chen la dngul srang nyis brgya lnga bcu las bzos pa'i ting bdun maṇ+ḍal rdo tshad drug cu las mthong grol lha khang bde gshegs mchod rten rnam brgyad rin po che las grub pa dang / gser zho lnga brgya las grub pa'i ston pa'i sku brnyan/ gser dngul srang grangs stong phrag du mas chos rje bcu pas bzhengs pa sogs sku gsung thugs rten dang / slong ba po la nyid kyi sku la bzhes pa'i mnab gzan gser ljangs brdungs kyi mgul srung dag kyang sbyin par mdzad nas dngos po gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ sprang po rnams la gser zho lon pa yad yang stsal ba'i lo rgyus bka' 'bum tu gsal/ srid zhi yongs kyi — 207 ———

sku rgyu 7mo pa sku pheng brtsa gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//—gtsug rgyan khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por gyur kyang khengs pa dang che ba rdul tsam mi mnga' zhing / sems can mchog dman thams cad la ma gcig pa'i bu ltar thugs byams brtse chen pos bcos min du khyab pas sku drung gi byi la dang byi'u rnams ma bu'i tshul0 du nyi ma 'de zhing sdod/ longs sprang mu lto ba nyams thag gzhan dag gis brnyas shing khyad du gsod pa rnams kyi gnas su zhabs kyi pad+mo bkod nas byams pa'i spyan gyis gzigs te snyan pa'i gsung gis sku rtsed dang nyams mtshar gyi lo rgyus sogs thabs mkhas sna tshogs kyis de dag gi rgyud la thar pa'i sa bon 'debs par mdzad pa dang /skabs shig mi gnyis sku drung du byung nas gcig gis sna ba g.yas pa bcad de maṇ+ḍal du phul ba dang / gcig gis gser sder ma gang gtor zhing / bka' chos zhur byung ba'i tshe 'di gnyis chos kyi skal ba yod pa yin 'dra dgongs pa'i tshe nam mkha' nas pa'i ta'i cha byad can gcig gis 'di —gnyis theg chen gyi snod ldan min par gsungs pas skyabs sems dang yig drug gi lung gnang / paṇ+ḍita de zla grags kyi slob ma gu pho iṇ+ḍa yin par gsungs shing de las gso stong gi —gdams pa'ang gsan/ de rjes bra ba zhig rtsa chun khyer nas chos zhu tshul dang / yang chu stod zla ba'i tshes bco lnga 'ga' zhig la dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang mdzod nas gzims chung nyi 'od du bzhugs skabs/ ldum ra'i me tog la stag phye ma lheb dang / gser sbrang g.yu sbrang mang po 'khor zhing / skad snyan sgrog skabs sprung slong pha ma bu bzhi byung ba la chos bshad ci rigs mdzad tshul sogs grags/ de nas rī kurma'i gdan sar rab gnas mdzad skabs/ da lam rab gnas 'di'i sbyin bdag zla nang nas gyis gsungs pas/ zla nang sde pas kyang yon bdag zhus te gser dngul spel ba'i bum pa sogs dngos po'i mchod sprin spros/ phyi nyin char chen po babs pa'i thigs chu gzims chung gi bla bre'i steng du 'khyil ba zla nang gis 'phul ba'i bum pa des gzhal bas bum pa bcu bzhi byung ba rten 'brel legs gsungs/tsho 'o bo da lan kurma ra yun ring sdod rgyu ma byung pas slad nas yun ring sdod rgyu yod pa byed ces dang / zla nang sde pas mjal phyag zhus skabs/ rang re gnyis mi ring bar 'phrad cing zhib cha byung bas yid 'jags gyis gsungs/ de ltar sprul pa'i snang brnyan de'i gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin grol la bkod pa'i 'phrin las re zhig rin nas — 208 —
