༄༅ /kurma pa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa theg mchog rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//si tu pad+ma kun bzang / rgyal tshab ye shes bzang po/ chos dbang sprul sku/ don grub sprul sku/ nges don bstan pa rab rgyas/ chags sprul gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ klu 'bum dge bshes sogs grub mtha' gzhan gyi skyes bu dam pa'ang mang du byung ngo / 7 karma pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje rab byung bco lnga'i lcags lug (5866/ 1871/)la 'khrungs/ —— 9 669 3 )༄༄ge

gcu/ /kurma pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//ci ༄༅ / /gza pa sku phreng bco lnga pa ma mi' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar/cha pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje ni/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po u rgyan mchog gyur gling pa'i lung bstan las/ theg mchog mya ngan 'das 'og dgod pa'i mtshan bde ba'i bdag nyid rig pa'i rdor rje dang o rgyan phrin las bsam gtan la sogs 'byung zhib par mdo byang gud sbas lung bzhin laḥ nga yi sprul pa na rma'i bstan pa ni bskal bzang bstan pa rdzogs par mi rdzogs soḥ zhes dang / bco lnga pa la bsod nams snyan grags 'byung zhes dang / mchog dbyangs sprul pa sngags rig 'dzinaḥ rta'am lug gi lo pa ni mkha' la mkha' yis rgyas thebs naḥ tshe 'phrang gsum sel bstan srog 'dzin bod khams bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel zhes sogs o rgyan rdo rje 'chang gi gter lung rnams dang / grub chen chos kyi bla ma na rma pa khris ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur la bstsa la ba'i lung byang dang mthun par bsam bzhin sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul nye bar bstan pa'i yul/ /gangs can bod yul g.yas ru gtsang gi char/ /mya nga stod shel dkar rgyal rtser zhes grags pa/ /yul gyi dge bcu tshang ba'i sa yi theg ler/ /dran ma spel gsar byang du 'bod pa na/ /sngon dus chos skyong rgyal blon mkhas pa dang / /grub pa chen po'i sa la bzhugs pa yi/ /'phags chen skyes bu rgyun mi chad byung ba/ / lha gzigs ral pa'i gdub las chad pa yin/ zhes sogs lung du gsal bar bstan pa'i yab rnam 'byor gyi dbang phyug skad gtong grub chen he ru ka dam pa snyan grags dbang pos gtsos sku mched lnga la/ yum rang bzhin gyi dge ba la goms shing bud med kyi yon tan tshang ba/ rus bya nyang / mtshan skal bzang sgrol ma bya ba'i sras lcam sku mched drug gi tha chung skyabs mgon rin po che 'di nyid/ sku gong ma sa 'brug lor 'das nas lo gsum song ba/rab byung bco lnga'i lcags lug rabs lo5866/ phug lugs2752/ phyi lo1871/rin chen dpal bzang gis phyi lo 1870lor 'khrungs gsungs par nor/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcur sku bltams/ de yang thog mar yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa nas yab yum gyi rmi 2ltas la rgyal chen bzhi dang rtag tu 'grogs shing dung 'bud ba dang / dpa' pos kha' 'gro'i rol mo'i dang bcas te gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa khang steng du bab pa sogs me thong snangs da par can dang /ge 213 —— —

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//———— ———— ————yab rje grub dbang nyid kyi gzigs sna nga la brten/ rang re la slob dpon chen po'i sprul pa zhig yong bar 'dug ces gsungs shing / sku bltam sa pa'i tshe yang yu ma la gnod pa med par 'ja' dang / me tog gi char sogs dge zhing shis pa'i mtshan lta sa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / sku bltams ma thag tu spyan gnyis nam mkha' la hrig ser gzigs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i khyad chos du ma lda na 'ing / yab yum gyis mtshan don 'grub rdo rjer gso la/ zla re bzhin byis pa gzhan las skyed che zhing / smin mtshams su mdzod spu dkar po'i mtshan bzang lda na pa/ byams snying rje thugs rgyud la ldan skyes 'byongs ba/ sems can la gnod pa phra mo tsam yang mi gnang zhing / skabs su sngon gnas rjes dran gyi gtam dang / lkog gyur legs nyes mngon sum du gzigs pa'i gsung gleng sogs chos dregs sdig po che rnams kyang rang shugs kyis dad cing ngo mtshar bskyid nus par mdzad/ skabs shig rtse chen dgon du 'tsham gzigs la gdan drangs te/ lam bar khrom mang rab cig dang lhan cig phebs pa na mun rub nye bar kham 'og gtsang 'gram du ban hrul sprang chas khre sa po khur ba gsum bzhi tsam dang / lam gong gad pa zhig la klung ka lta bu bya nag mang po 'ur gyis tshogs par gzigs shing / yar tsam byon pa dang mun rub ste lam yang mi mngon par gyur/ sngo dmar gyi me chen po yul lung gsal snyam byed pa zhig gis rjes ded nas byung ba na/ der yod tshang mas 'dre byung zhes 'jigs skrag bis bros pa'i skabs skyes bu chen po 'di ni sku na phra yang bag tsha ba med par byams pa'i spyan gyis gzigs stangs mdzad pa tsam gyis me de nyid skar ma bzhin thang chen po sang bar gram zhing / mthar je chung ngu yal song / 'di ni skyes bu chen po'i thugs rjes khrom tshogs de rnams kyi mi rta su la'ang glags ma nus nga/ra mngon/ la rma pa dgung lo lnga pa shing phag (5870/ 2752/ 1875/)lor skyes thob kyi shes rab 'gran zla med pas 'don klog mkhas pa dang / ma bsla/bas par yang dpe cha 'di rigs la go rgyu zhig yo/da gsungs shing / go ba thar thor rnyed pa sogs skyes bu dam pa'i rang mtshan mngon sum du gsal bar mdzad/ 'di lo'i zla gsum pa'i tshes nyi shu nyin tā la sku phreng bcu gnyis pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho dgung lo nyi shur son te dgongs pa rdzogs/ na rma pa dgung lo drug pa me byi (5871/ 2753 / — 214

ga / /kurma pa sku phreng bco lnga ༈ mkha' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// 1876/)lor 'jam mgon rnam gnyis dang / gter chen mchog gyur gling pa/ rje btsun dpa' bo rin po che sogs lkog gyur go zigs pa'i ye shes sgrib par med pa rnams kyi dgongs nyams gcig mthun thog skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa 'brug chen mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal pos/ mchog nga gi sprul sku'i gnas yul khyim sgo rigs rus skyed byed bcas mngon sum bzhin gsal bar ngos 'dzin mdzad de re zhig gsang rgya dgos pa'i bkas bsdams kyang 'jig rten dbang phyug mchog gi zla zhal gtsang gi phyogs su 'char bar gyur to zhes grags pas khyab/ 'di lo'i zla lnga ba'i tshes lnga nyin/ gnas —chen dwags lha sgom po'i dbu rtser nyi ma shar ba dang dus mtshungs tā la sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho sku bltams/ kurma pa dgung lo bdun pa me glang (5872/ 275ri 1877/)lor rje dbon don grub sprul sku dpon slob rnams na bza' mtshan gsol gdan zhus su phebs/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes bdun nyin yab gzhis nye skor du bzhugs sgar mdzad/ tshes brgyad gza' skar sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i snga char/ khang steng du rgyal mtshan btsugs/ lha bsangs dang / khrus gsol bcas na bza' phul/ bzhugs khri'i steng du bzhugs te tshe ril phyag gis bzhes pa dang dus mtshungs par nyi 'od dang / kha char 'dres ma babs shing / dbyar rnga ldir ba sos sa ngo mtshar ba'i rten 'brel shin tu legs par byung / tshes dgu la phebs byams su gdan 'dren zhus te bzhugs sgar du khri ston mdor bsdus bcas spyan drangs/ tshes bco lnga nyin 'od dkar po shas che ba'i 'ja' tshon kha dog sna tshogs mig mang ris bkra bas gar byon sngon rjes kun tu gang ba dang / me tog gi char babs pa sogs kun gyis mthong snang du gyur/ zla ba lnga ba'i tshes gsum la skyabs mgon 'brug chen rin po che dang yid na 'dzin rje chos dbang sprul sku 'jang drung pa sprul sku sogs/ bla sprul dge 'dun rī'adus pa rgya mtsho chibs bsu ser phreng lha mi'i mchod pa'i rnam grangs mtha' yas pa bcas gdan sa chen po 'og min mtshur mdo'i gtsug lag khang gi chos kyi khri chen por zhabs zung bkod thog shis brjod mnga' gsol gyi legs dbul btegs pa dang 'brel o rgyan mchog gyur gling pa'i gter lung las 'di man ka rabs bzhi pa'i mtshan byang lung du bstan pa las/ theg mchog mya ngan 'das 'og dgos pa'i mtshanaḥ bde ba'i bdag nyid rig ——— 215 ——

༄༅/ /ga rma pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//pa'i rdo rje dngaḥ spyon phrin las bsam gtan la sogs 'byungaḥ zhes gsal ba ltar gyi don dang mi 'gal bar mtshan dpal ldan kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma chen po phrin las mkha' khyab rdo rje phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes dang / 7 gong sa skyabs mgon yas phyin nas rtse shod sku tshab dang 'brel blo bzang don gnyis lhun grub mkha' khyab rdo rje mkhyen rab kun gyi 'byung gnas bstan pa'i sgron me phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha zhes mtshan gyi dril bsgrags gnang / mthong grol cod )ne 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag dbu la bzhes pa na/ che chung snyoms pa rang 'grigs su byung zhing / sku'i zil dang gzi byin lta bas mi ngom pa bcas gdul bya mtha' dag skal bzang gi dga' ston la rol/ zla drug pa'i tshes tsho gnyis nyin lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan gcig mdun du mchod sprin gzab rgyas bcas mkhan po 'brug chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ las slob bde chen yongs 'dzin shes bya kun mkhyen/ dus go ba mkhan/ chen rin chen dar rgyas/ kha stong rje dbon rnam gnyis/ gcud sprul sogs las kyi dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su rab tu byung ba'i bslab pa bzhes pa'i mtshan du dpal ldan chos kyi nyi ma phrin las snang a mkha' khyab rdo rje phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes gsol/ rim pas rgyud sde sogs sdog dpe thugs 'dzin dang / phyag bris gzab gshar 'khyu wartu/ 'bru tsha sogs phul bas tshegs chung dus byang chub par mdzed/ na rma pa dgung lo brgyad pa sa stag (5873/ 2755/ 1878/)zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig la chos dbang sprul sku rin po ches mdzod nag rten gtor nyams gso'i skabs rab gnas dang mgon por phrin bcol thugs thog nas gnang zhing rten rdzas snyan shal la 'dod gsol ljags rtsom mdzad/ lo de'i zla lnga ba'i tshes bco lnga la rab gnas ser sbreng phebs skabs phyag nas zangs thal du byon cing / rten kha shas kyi thugs kur len pa dang / nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa las me tog gi char dang / sa gzhi la rol mo'i sgra grags pa sogs byin chen phebs pa'i mngon rtags ya mtshan par byung zhing gdul bya gang la gang 'tshams kyi 'gro don dang / bar mtshams kun tu gzhung 'grel/ rig gnas skor gsan bsam dang / ris med rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi smin grol rgyab rten bcas chos kyi bdud rtsi bar med rdu gsol bas mkhyen rab kyi rtsal rdzogs/ kurma pa dgung lo bcu pa 216

༄༅/ /na rma pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//lcags 'brug (5875/ 2757/ 1880/)lor naḥ thog si tu chos kyi rgyal po 'khrungs/ kurma pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa chu rta (5877/ci 2759/ 1882/)zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad la lha sar gong sa chen po sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho'i zhabs pad drung bcar bas/ ngag dbang chos kyi 'byung gnas mkha' khyab ti nga 'dzin rdo rje zhes mtshan dang shes brjod kyi legs skyes rgya cher spel ba'i gzengs bstod gnang / bstan srung chen po rdo rje drag ldan gyis kyang / rten mdung phyag tu phul zhing gus pas btsug tu bkur/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu nas mkhan chen bkra shis 'od zer gyi mdun nas bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi lung dang / dpa' bo rin chen gtsug lag nyin byed lag 'ja' tshon pod drug gi dbang lung /sngags grwa rig 'dzin chen po las si tu kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi bka' 'bum sogs gsan bzhes mdzad/ bar mtshams su bka' brgyad bde 'dus skor sman sgrub mdzad cing / dad mos can rnams la smin dbang khrid lung gnang ba ma zad/ gsol 'debs zhal gdams bsangs gsol sogs gsung rtsom yang gnang bar mdzad/ gnas nang nyams gso la rab gnas gzigs skyong gnang / — pa dgung lo bcu gsum pa chu lug ( 5878/ 2760/ 1883/)lo'i zla drug par paṇa chen brgyad pa bstan pa'i nyi ma zhi bar gshegs te/ dgu ba chos kyi nyi ma (1883 ge 1937)dwags por sku bltams/ gser gling gi nye 'gram gyi me ri zhig 'gas gtor chen po byung bar brten/ mtsho gru sna tshogs khri phrag tsam mtsho gting du byings/ mi sum khri drug stong tsam shi zhes bshad/ kerma pa dgung lo bcu bzhi pa shing sprel (5879/ 2761/ 188ri)lor li thang spang phug dgon pa'i gtsug lag khang nyams gsos gsar bsgrun la rab gnas dgongs4 gtad dus tshod bsgrigs te rtags thon dgos zhes zhus par/ zhal bzhes kyis dus thog khel nyin mtshur phu'i lha chen rgya phibs 'og nas/ zhol shar gzigs pa'i dgon de'i dpe ris la sku rtsed lta bu'i 'bras dkar dri bzang gis sbags pa 'thor bar mdzad skabs/ spang phug dgon du kun gyis mchod sprin gzab rgyas skabs su sprin dkar gseb nas 'bras ser gyi char phyi nang khyab pa'i rtags mtshan byung bar/ der 'dus mi rnams kyis dad pa tshad med skyes/ rkarma pa dgung lo bco lnga pa shid bya (5880)lor — 217 ba

༄༅/ /rkarma pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//si tu pad+ma kun bzang (1854 — 1885)'das mchod ma dzad/ kurma pa dgung lo bcu drug pa me khyi (5881)lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes brgyad nyin si tu pad+ma dbang mchog 'khrungs/ mkha' khyab rdo rje mdo smad du chibs bteg lam bar dad 'dus rnams kyi 'dod pa bskangs te/ zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin sde dge'i dpal spungs su phyag phebs/ 'di lor rgya phu ling gis bod la btsan 'dzul thengs dang po byed 'go tshugs/kurma pa dgung lo bcu bdun pa me phag (5882/ 276'a/ 1887/)zla dang po'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin dpal spungs yang khrod du rje 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i mdun sar phebs te zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gnyis bar/ rang lugs rtsa gsum spyi dang bka' brgyud sngags mdzod //kā na /sdu/ /kā di/ po gri zlo/ /byen pa / hūṃ sdo dri ma~X/ kyi/na ngan sdu //nga/ sab ༷dī sa /la le hūṃ /ra/'o/ sdu/ // dī mthoX / // ldan rnyiX mdza da sdu/rdzu dī dī sdu/ zlo// kyaX ༷ /// bri/ /la le //bye zlo / //dro bye// zlo / ri na dī ༵༵ /dī kā ṭā /rdos skoXg da/// dī rta sna /rdo k+ṣiṃ ༵༵la shā sdus ba dī tshe sa nyi shu la dbyar khang du 'jam mgon rin po che'i bka' bzhin pak+ṣi'i phyag bris thugs dam mgon sku zhal phyes pas ser drag dang sbrags ra chen skor du thog gsum tsam lhung nas 'tshubs lhong gi rnam pa phran tsam byung / zla drug pa'i tshes nyi shur nyo dge'i rdzong gsar du phebs/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang mjal 'phrad gnang / tshes bcu gcig la thog ma'i chos kyi sgo 'byed dkar po rnam gsum gyi dbang lung gsan/ de nas rdzong shod du 'jam mgon rin po che dang lhan rgyas phebs/ rtsa gsum tshogs skong / khrom la smin dbang / yul lhar bsangs dang gser skyems sogs kyis der 'dus lha mi'i 'gro ba rnams don ldan du mdzad/ gnas gzigs ri skor phebs skabs gu ru yab yum gyi sgrub phug na rma pa'i gzims phug sogs phug pa mang por ming 'dogs mdzad/ dad sbyin rnams kyis zhus ngor hor rong tsha brgyud/ li thang spang phug dgon du phebs/ de'i phyogs kyi —— 218 ——

— ༅ / /la/rma pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mab 'a khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// brag ngos shig las rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku rang byon snga na med pa zhal phyes pa dang / brug skam po las tshe chu 'o ma dog lta bu lhung lhung du 'bab pa sogs kyis kun kyang ngo mtshar skyes/ de nas rim bzhin phebs lam gtsang 'gram grong du bkra ma shis pa mi rabs brgyud mar yod pa 'phror bcad pa dang / dad 'dus mang po'i don mdzad nas dpal spungs su phebs/ skyabs rje 'brug chen rin po che'i yang srid rgyal dbang mchog gi dgongs brtags pa dang / bod nas gser bum rtse mthun byung bar brten/ 'ji sgar rin cho che dang / gsang gling pā bcas kyis zhabs bskul zhus bzhin phebs te/ 'brug chen mchog gi sprul skur na bza' gsol/ rten 'brel mjal dar rten gsu/ma ra bul tshan bcas gnang sbyin mdzad/ 'di lor rdza tsho da pa lnga sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po 'das/ kurma pa dgung lo bco brgyad pa sa byi (5883/ 2765/ 1888/)zla dang po'i tshes nyer bdun la yang khrod 'jam mgon rin po che'i mdun nas rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i dbang dang lung khrid kyi sta gon nas brtsams te zhus par skabs su sgrub chen dang / dpal spungs dbon gyi lha bci ra/ gzims chung steng cod so gas su rab gnas gnang / dbyar khang du 'jam mgon rin po che las/ sgra/ rtsis / sman/ snyan ngag sogs rig gnas la 'brel 'jog dang / shes bya kun khyab/ mngon pa mdzod/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ mngon rgyan/ rgyud bla/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ gsang 'dus/ dri med 'od/ sgyu 'phrul sa sang ba snying po rnams kyi bshad khrid gsan/ lhag bsam du snyan ngag phul bas dpe brjod mdzad de 'jam mgon rin po cher gzigs phul mdzad/ na rma pas mdzad pa'i snyan ngag la 'jig rten dbang phyug mkhyen nga 'i do ra na/ shes bya'i chos kun ma sgrib gsal/ ler 'char/ slob dngo na ma khas pa'i zhal sgor brgyud tsam gyis / kun ma khyen gzigs pa'i gom stabs gcig gis bgrod/ ces bsngags brjod gnang / bum sgru ba tshes bcu rnams kyi tshogs dbur phebs char shin tu che bas tshes bcu'i gar 'cham nyin gnyis la byas pas/ tshes bcu nyin rgyal dbang rin po ches sa 'dul byin 'bebs / gser skyems rnams la char 'bebs kyis byin rlabs gnang / tshes bcu gcig nyin gtum rngam jil gnon zhabs 'cham sa nang skabs 'ja' dang / me togs char bab pa sogs byung / zla ba bdun pa'i nang 'jam — ——— 219

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//mgon rin po che'i mdun du zhabs brtan dngos 'bul gzab spros bcas chos mtshams kyis/ phyogs kyi 'dod skong du tshab tsha/ ban chen/ 'dan gzhung rnams su chibs bskyod/ 'di lor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bdun nyin rgya phu ling gis dpon dmag lnga brgya tsam gyis glo bur du lung thur la gnams nas tshur rgol byas/ bod dmag gis mda' dang gri/ mdung sogs gna' bo'i mtshon chas rgol bas phu dmag phyir bros/ khams phyogs kyi dpung dmag ser skya lnga brgya nyi shu tsam 'bras ljongs su bskyod/ yang brag g.yab kyi dmag mi chi ga stong dang / go 'jo/ kong po/ spo bo sogs kyi dmag mi lha sar 'byor skabs rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtshos mjal 'phrad dang / srung ba phyag tsha/ na gza' sogs yid tshim pa gnang ste/ pas rgol gdug pa can mthar skyod dgos lugs skor bslab bya sku lnga ma yang yang mdzad/ na rma pa dgung lo bcu dgu pa sa glang (588ri 2766/ 1889/)zla dang po'i (7tshes brgyad la dpal spungs nas rdzong gsar du phebs/ si tu 'khrungs yul li thang gi lung pa/ mdun ri/ chu dang zam pa yod lugs/ khang pa'i thog brtsegs sgo dang skar khung yod phyogs dang bcas shog khrar ri mo 'god mdzad pa bzhin rtsad bcad du spung sprul 'brong bla bstan 'dzin chos rgyal li thang tsho gsum 'ja' sa grong du mngags pas thugs brtags bzhin rtsad chod/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i mdun nas sgrub btus dbang khrid lung / gdams ngag chu bo gcig sgril phar tshur gnang / slar yang dpal spungs dgon du 'jam mgon rin po che'i mdun nas bar gseng du shangs chos lke skor dang / sgrol ma'i rnal 'byor/ gter mdzod bka' rgya'i skor/ rang lugs chos sung bka' gtad srog dbang sogs nyin mtshan bar med kyis gsan bsam mdzad/ zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu la si tu'i yang srid bsu ba ser steng bcas mjal 'phrad mdzad/ tshes bcu gcig la dbu skra gtsug phud bzhes te mtshan gsol/ khri 'don mnga' gsol gnang / dgon phyi nang gi bca' khrims dang yongs 'dzin bsko bzhag mdzad/ rgyal mchog phan tshun thun min nyams bzhes bka' bslab gnang res dang thugs 'phreng dang bkra shis smon lam bcas lho khog brgyud don chus nyer lnga'i zur mang rnam rgyal rtse dang ku mo'i gdan sar phebs te/ bstan 'gro'i spyi rim lung don bzhin phur sgrub rgyun 'dzugs kyi yo byad gnang sbyin dang / sgrub chen sman —— 220 ——

༄༅/ /ga rma pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// sgrub spel ma'i rdo rje rgyal por mdzad de khrom la dbang dang myong grol sman 'gyed bcas gnang / mkhan bla ma bkra shis 'od zer las 'gro don bar mtshams rnams su khrid lung du ma gsan/ zla drug pa'i tshes gcig nas khams stod nang chen khab du phebs/ rgyal bo dbang grags tshe ring lha rgyal gyis bsu ba rgya chen mdzad/ ge cag tshang dbyangs rgya mtsho/ lho chag med/ ban chen sangs rgyas mnyan sprul sogs la bka' brgyud sngags mdzod kyi nga bang lung gnang / nang chen gyi dil yag brgyud 'brong pa stod du mkha' 'gro gtor chen phul ba na/ yul lha gter srung chen pos g.yu dmar rin thang bral ba phyag tu phul de nas lha ldan rgyal khab chen po/ 7skyabs mgon rtse dang srid skyong bcas par sger 'jal mdzad/ jo shāka rnam gnyis sogs gnas chen rnams mjal te rten 'brel thugs smon zab rgyas gnang bzhin gsang gling du phebs/ 'brug chen yang srid gser khrir mnga' gsol legs 'bul rgya chen dang / kur 'brug bstan la gcig dril sngar srol bzhin nyams med bka' slab kyis bskyangs/ kurma pa dgung lo nyi shu pa ——lcags stag (5885/ 2767/ 1890/)lor bod dang rgya gar gyi sa mtshams skor la ka li ka tar hrin tha'i am ban dang / dbyin tshab mo lug lar bcas bod dbyin chings yi ge don tshan brgyad bzhag karma pa dgung lo nyer gcig pa lcags yos (5886/ 2768/ 189 1/)zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis la dpon slob nyung bsdus bcas dpal gyi tsa ri tra yi gnas kyi snying po mtsho dkar sprul pa'i pho brang du phebs/ gnas gzigs mtsho bskor rgyas pa dang na bde mchog yab yum gyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i 'du ba khyad par can mdzad/ dag pa'i gzigs snang mtha' yas par byung /e ka dza ṭa'i gnas gzigs su phebs nas 'byung bzhi rang dbang 'byor ba'i mngon rtags su/ ri brag la zangs thal du phebs pa sogs rdzu 'phrul bkod pa mthong chos su bstan cing / phebs lam 'ja' tshon gyis sbrel/ lha yi me tog dkar po 'dab ma brgyad nas bcu drug dag gi char bab de'i tshe rtsa gsum sgrub thabs kyi brda' byang ma hā gu ru'i sku tshab yum lha khrim las grub pa/ gnam lcags rdo rje/ lha lcam pad+ma gsal gyi gdung bcas myong grol skor phyag tu son/ dus rgyun du nga lta bu rmongs brtul 'chal sred 'dod gdung can gyis ci yang mi shes/ dus ngan gyi bla gzugs las ngan —— 221 —

༄༅/ /ma mo pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//wa geb wa ge she ———wa wa wa wa bdag 'dras ci yang mi shes ma byung pa'i tshul kho nar gsungs shing dman sa 'dzin/thob dang cham dpyod ngom pa'i cheb dang /tshul 'chos sogs med pa'i 'phags pa'i rnam thar bla na med pa mchis/de nas ca ri'i gnas rnams brgyud lha ldan sa zhung sa'i brtan la brabs/'di skabs bstan 'gro'i don du gsang lugs la ḍā kri bces nas nye rgyu'i spyod pa'i sa lam cig car du bgrod dgos tshul bstan kyang / gzhan ngor 'byol nyog gi spyod pas bstan pa rin po cher mig ltos mi legs par dgongs nas ma bzhes stabs/phyi yi 'byung ba cha ma snyoms/nang gi zla nyi'i khams ma gcig gsang ba ḍā ki'i lung dang 'gal bas/zhing 'di'i mdzad pa bsdur nye ba na /bla slob grwa 'bangs kun gyis lha blar lung zhus dang 'brel zhabs pad brtan pa'i thabs gzhan ma mchis pas rten 'brel phyag rgya bzhes pa kho nas bar chad la sa grol bar byung ngo / kurma pa dgung lo nyer bzhi pa shing rta 5889/ 2771/ 1894lor ma tshur phur dge 'dun zur ri'i 'du khang gsar rgyag dang / pho brang nyams gso bcas mdzad/ rin chen mang sbyo ra chen mo dang dbang ril shel dkar mchod rten sogs kyi sbyor ba mdzad/ lha sa'i gtsug lag khang du tshe ring ma/ched lnga'i rten dang skong gsol rgyun 'dzugs mdzad/slar yang 'jam mgon rin po che'i mdun khams su phebs bzhed kyis zla drug/ pa'i tshes nyer bdun nyin chibs bteg zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer bdun la dpal spungs mgron sa/nyer bsu la phebs/ lo 'dir krung go dang nyi hang bar dmag 'khrug byung / kurma pa dgung lo nyer lnga pa shing lug 5890/2772/ 1895/lor rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho dgung lo nyi shur phebs te dge slong gi sdom pa dang /zla brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad nyin chos srid bzhes pa 'i mdzad sgo tshugs / zi ling sogs sa khul kha shas su ma zhu'i rgyal khab la ngo rgol gyi 'os langs byung / na rma pa dgung lo nyer drug pa me sprel 5891/ 2773/ 1896/zla dang ngo/'i tshes lnga la tsa 'dri ⑫/nga /brod du 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po'i mdun du phebs/dkon spyi'i tshe dbang dang tshogs 'khor bcas go/nang /tshes brgyad nyin 'jam mgon rin po cher zhabs brtan phul/rje bla ma'i mdun nas bla ma dgongs 'dus dbang chen yongs rdzogs ga/dmas mdzod dang /rin sa/ter kha sko nga bi/ dbang lung 'jaca mgon rang gi zab sa/ter gsang 222

༄shi/ /ga rma pa sku phreng bco 2lnga nga mkha' khya/ba rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//mdzod dang bka' 'bum yo ngas rdzogs / nang brtag rgyud gsum sogs dbang lung khrid/ sadams ngas/ mtha' yas pa rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul gyis rdzogs par gsan te/ don brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa'i bdag por gdod nas grub pa bzhin/ slar yang ye shes dgongs brgyud 'pho ba'i byin rlabs kyis yab sras dgongs pa dbyer med kyi don brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i bsta na pa rin po che phyag tu gtad cing dngos grub rnam gnyis nyams 'og tu tshud pa'i ye sheg chen por dbang 'byor bas/ chos kyi rgyal po nges par don gyi sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po sa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i slob dpon chen po'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa nyid do/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu gsum la dpal spungs nas chibs bteg 'dzi sgar lha thog brgyud na mi dgon du phebs / zla tshes dgur mgon gsol rgyas pa gsungs shing / mgon nag shod zhal phyes na/ dag pa'i gzigs snang mtha' klas pa dang / las mgon gyi rten kri dngos su phyag tu phul/ de nas gnas nang dang don lnga'i zur ma/nga dgon/ skyo brag dgon bcas la phebs/ 'bab rom gyi chos bar rgyud 'dzin pa'i bla ma gsal bstan dung gsu ma gyi gtsug phud blangs te khri 'don mdzad/ de nas ldong rgyud rag shul dpon tshang du phebs/ sga khog sangs rgyas mnyan pas btabs pa'i ban chen dgon dang / skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sga khra 'gu dgon/ 'ba' tsha rtag dul gyis btabs pa'i sga 'dam dkar dbon sogs la phebs/ nam pa dgung lo nyer bdun pa me bya (ri 5892/ 2794/ 1897//lo'i zla dang po'i tshes bcu gsum la dpal spungs su 'khod/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu bdun nyin gdan sa chen po mtshur mdo'i gcan la med khang du phyag phebs/ ban chen sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i sku phreng dgu pa ma rma bskyod sgrub bsta na pa 'i nyi ma (1897 rtse 1962/'khrungs/ kurma pa dgung lo nyer dgu pa sa phag (5894 2776/ 18( lho lo ra khams kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho (18 13 189 (/ )'das mchod mdzad/ kurma pa dgung lo sum cu pa lcags byi (1900)lor 'jam ma gon kong spru'/ 'das pa'i gdung mchod zab rgyas nyin gsum mdzad/rgya nag pe cin gyi ston ga'i tshems bzhugs pa'i mchod rten 'o jig dus/ hwa shang 'ig gis bdag byas te tshems de da lta pe cin du bzhugs/ kurma — 223

༄༅/ /ma rma pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//pa dgung lo so bzhi pa shing 'brug (5899/ 2781/ 190ri)lor kong sprul gnyis pa dpal ldan mkhyen brtse 'od zer (1904ge 1983) nyid kyi sras su 'khrungs/ rgya phu ling gis bod kyi rgyal rtse bzung ste/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes bco lnga la rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho sog yul du byon/ de'i ring dga' ldan khri pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan rgyal tshab bskos/ rgya phu ling btsan 'dzul dmag lha sar 'byor nas lha sa'i chings yig ces pa don tshan bcu bzhag karma pa dgung lo so lnga pa shing sbrul (5900/ 278 2/ 1905/)lor pan chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma dbyin ji pas rgya gar du btsan khrid byas/ mdo smad pa dge 'dun chos 'phel 'khrungs/ kurma pa dgung lo so brgyad pa sa sprel (5903/ 2785/ 1908/)zla ba dang por rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho sku 'khor rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar phebs/ zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin kurma pa/ sku tshab bcu gsum spyan drangs pa'i spyan sngar gsang 'dus le'u brgyad ma dang / gsang thig bla sgrub bcas kyi tshogs mchod rgyas par phul/ rin po che gter mdzod chen mo'i par gsar brko'i kyi nyer bsdogs mdzad/ zla brgyad pa'i tshes gsum nyin rgyal ba thub stan rgya mtsho mañdzu gong ma'i rgyal sa pe cin du 'byor/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyer gcig rgya nag rgyal po srid gsal lam thung zhu 'das/ tshes nyer gnyis nyis la rgyal mo tshi'u shi 'das pas na rma pas thugs smon dang sgrib sbyong mdzad/ zla bcu par gong ma mtha' ma shon thung gser khri la mnga' gsol/ nang chen sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin (1908 1929) 'khrungs/ kurma pa dgung lo so dgu pa sa bya (590ri 2786/ 1909/)zla gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la nyi ma'i byang ngos su nyi gur 'dra ba'i 'ja' bkrag med phyes pa zhig yun ring shar zhing nyi ma yang kha dog dmar zhad can du byung bas/ skyabs rje mchog gi sku tshe'i bar chad phran bu dang / bod 'dir dus zing gi rtags su gzigs/ tshes nyer lnga la sku khams nyob pas snga bar dus mchod dang / gsang thig yum bka'i tshogs mchod bshags bzang rgyas pa btang / rten 'brel gso byed gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa phyogs 'bus dang / bod yul bde ba'i rten 'brel smon lam bcas gnang ba na/kha ba bab cing shar phyogs nas 'brug skad dal snyan ldir bas rten 'brel cung zad sor tshud par mngon/ bar mtshams kun tu rtsa gsum ljags wa 224 —— ci

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//cibasnyen/ 'dod skong dbang lung 'chad spel khor yug tu gnang / hor zla bcu'i tshes sum cur rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho sku 'khor lha sar phebs bod bzhugs am ban dang 'gal ba shugs chen byung / zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu gcig la gong sa chen po'i chibs bsu mjal phyag la chibs btegazla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig nyin khra tshang la khar zhal mjal phyag 'bul zhus/ tshes gsum la nag chu dbu gur du gong sa chen po pho brang du phebs 'phral dgyes ston la zhabs bcar dang / tshes drug nyin mdzad chen grub 'phral gzims chung du dang mjal zhus pas bdag rkyen legs par bka' yi dbugs dbyung bcas bka' drin bstsal/ tshes brgyad nyin snga bar bteg ste zla ba dgu ba'i tshes drug la mtshur phur phebs/ yar mar lam 'khod kyi skye 'gro rnams la 'gro don chos sbyin gyis yid tshim par mdzad/ gzhung sa'i bka' 'brel dgon gyi bslab sdom zhib phra —dang / bca' khrims bcas cidagon zhol rnams la dam bsgrags tsha nan gnang / zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyer gcig la dpa' bo rin po che dgongs pa zhi dbyings su mnal bas mtshams tho bsdus te nyung bsdus kyis phebs/ thugs dam gsal 'debs dgongs rdzogs kyi skor dang / snga lam gzims chung nang rten phyag dpe khang sogs tho bkod the 'dzugs kyi don dam gnang / tshes nyer lnga la sku gdung zhugs 'bul zhus pa'i ljags ma tshigs par byon/ tshes nyer bdun la yar phebs/ sngar 'phrod ljags bsnyen la bzhugs bar du gzhung gi zhabs rim bka' brgyad bzlog pa dang / de nas zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu drug nas gong sa chen po pho brang du phebs pa'i dga' ston mdzad/ na rma pa dgung lo bzhi bcu pa lcags khyi (5905/ 2787/ 19 10/)lor rnga —'cham yongs rdzogs kyi 'cham gos bzhi bcu zhe gsum gsar 'tshem dang / rin gter zhu dag zur mang gter ston 'jam mgon rin po che'i bka' bzhin tshad mar bzhag pa las log lta byed ma myong / zi khron gyi dmag shed can kra'o we gleng (4 64)si/sa kha dan la ma gnas par bod dmag brgya lhag bsad/ da dung rgya rigs chen po ring lugs kyi bsam pa 'dzin pas bod kyi ming dang khyad chos bzang bo rnams btsan shed kyi bsgyur bas/ bod kyi spyi dgra zhig tu gyur/ hor zla dang po'i tshes gsum nyin nam phyed tsam du rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho rtse pho brang nas nor bu gling khar phebs/ sde —— 225 ——

༄bya/ /kurma pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so/ /—————— ————srid bka' blon dang bcas pa rgya gar du byol pa ṇa chen dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma lha sar 'byor thog rgya bod bar zhi mthun yong ba'i bka' mol mdzad/kurma pa dgung lo zhe gcig pa lcags phag (5906/ 2788/ 1(2 11/)lor bka' brgyud rnam tshang sngar ltar bzhugs / rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho ka sbug tu phebs nas 'bras ljongs rgyal po'i spro khang du bzhugs/ rgya nag si mañdzu gong ma'i rgyal rabs kyi mjug rdzogs te rgya nag gi krung hwa dmangs rgyal tshugs/ de la lcags phag lo'i gsar brje zhes grags/ khams stod nang chen rgyal ngo bkru shis tshe dbang rdo rje 'khrungs/ kurma pa dgung lo zhe gnyis pa chu byi (5907/ 2789/ 19 12/)lo gsar nas gzhan rdon 'chad rtsams/ bla brang gi gzigs skyong thugs dam nyams bzhes/ sprang ston spam mtho da se/ rtsar 'gyur nges gnang / hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu drug nyin gangs can mgon pyo rgya gar nas chibs bsgyur kyis rtse pho brang du zhabs sor 'khod/ rgya bod bar gyi da ca/ga mtshams chod nas zi khron gyi dpung lhag rnams rgya gar brgyud phyir log sde dge'i 'ju mi pham rnam rgyal 'das pa'i bsngo smon slebs/ rgya nag gi grong khyer nan cin du rgyal dmangs kyi tshos sa pa'i sri de gzhung btsugs/ spyi khab pa sun krung hran zhus 7)spyi khyab pa la bdams/ kurma pa dgung lo zhe gsum pa chu glang (5908/ 2790/ 19 13/)lo'i zla ba lnga ba'i tshes bcu drug nas rig gter smin dbang gi dbu btsugs/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu la mtha' rten mnga' dbang / tshe dbang bcas grub par mdzad/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes dgu la mkha' 'gro dgyes byed kyi rten 'brel zhig brtsams pas don chen grub na legs tshogs kyi gzigs nyams byung 'dug pa bsod nams dbang gis phyag len du thebs pa ma byung rung / thugs dam bcad rgya'i khongs su bzhugs/ gnas skabs de nas dam grib dbang gis 'tshubs gegs kyi rnam par byung zhing / rgya pa zla bshol ba phyi ma'i tshes nyi shu nas zhabs rim rten 'brel la nyas sa bsos su mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi slong chog mdzad/zla ba bcu'i tshes bcu ba/sum nyin/ sim la'i gros tshogs 'go tshugs / khams stod kyi don chus nyer lnga'i don du zi khron zhing chen dang mtsho sngon zhing chen dbar rtsod pa byung / rgya nag rgyal po yon hre khes (4yi'i)nang chen nyer lnga zi khron gyi khongs su ga rtos sa/ yul shul nyer lnga ma tsho sngon khongs — 226

༄༅/ /mcho/ pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so// —ཿgtogs zer nas byis gtam rgod bro ba bshad/ na rma pa dgung lo zhe bzhi pa shing sta ga (5949/ 279 1/ 19 1ri)zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu bdun la thugs nyams su dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul gzigs nas 'jig rten mi yul du yun ring mi bzhugs pa'i ci lung bstan/ sras mo zhig 'khrungs yod pa de skabs zhing du gshegs/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer dgu nyin si tu rin po che'i rjogs phebs mdzad/zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes drug la skar 'dzin gyis si tu rin po che mdun nas bla ma dgongs 'dus gzhung pod yongs rdzogs kyi ljags lung gsan/ 'brug nas bstan pa spyi bye'i rkyen sel zhabs brten yon sbyo ra bzhin yab sras lhan rgyas nas red phur sgrub chen khongs su dpal mdos bcas tshugs par mdzad/ dpa' bo rin po che'i mchog sprul ngos 'dzin gsal pos kun kyang yid sa nyis bral bar gyur/ tshes bcu gsum la ga dung sras 'jam mgon mchog sprul rin po che khri 'don gyis bka' brgyud yab sras drug las si tu dang che nyams mnga' gsol 'ja' sa tham ka bcas gnang zhing /de bzhin phyogs kyi bla sprul dgon khag bcas pas brtsi srung dang / sku nar ma son par ri khrod bla brang bcas pa'i phyi nang gzigs skyong dbu 'dom che bkur zhabs zhus rigs rang dngos dang mi gnyis pa'i khur bzhes gnang dgos zhes si tu rin po che la sger bcar zhal bsgos dang / de 'brel phyag mdzod sogs mdun 'dug rnams la'ang bslab ston bka' nan bcas gnang tshes nyi shu la rgyal tho bcas nyin bcu yi khongs su bka' brgyad sgrub chen sman sgrub bcas legs lam du gyur/ zla lnga'i tshes bcu gnyis la si tu rin po cher legs 'bul dang / 'jam mgon mchog sprul rin po cher sku 〉 la bcas phul / tshes bcu dgu la si tu rin po che ston 'khor chibs bteg phebs skyel sogs sngar la ma ltar gnang / tshes nyer lnga phyi ma'i nyin 'jam mgon mchog sprul rin po che khams phebs chibs bskyod kyis tshulas sa'i bar yab sras lhan rgyas kyis zhag bzhugs mdzad/ tshes nyer bdun la bkra shis smon lam bcas chibs skyel gnang / zla ba drug pa'i tshes drug la gnas nang du phebs/ rje btsun dpa' bo rin po che'i sprul sku khri 'don dang legs 'bu' sogs mdzad/ zla ba dgu ba'i tshes nyer gsum 'di'i nub tho rengs phyi ma'i snang tshul brda ru shar bzhin yi ger btab par mdzad/——— 227

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//wa wa phyis rten 'brel gyis 'di nyid sor gnas ma byung bas med par bcol/ 'di lor 'dzam gling 'khrugs chen dang po langs/ na rma pa dgung lo zhe brgyad pa sa rta (59 13/ 2795/ 19 18/)lo'i zla ba dgu'i tshes gcig la zur mang gar dbang zhal 'jal du lhags pa mtshur mdor slebs/ tso/gron gnyer brgyud dar btang / thab bsu thog rol bcas gnang / tshes nyer lngar kuḥ thog si tu rin po che phebs pa dang mjal 'phrad mdzad/ 'di lo'i dgun khar 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po mjug karma pa dgung lo zhe dgu pa sa lug (59 1go 2796/ 19 19/)zla gnyis pa'i tshes bdun nyin sku lus gzhan la sprul/ tshes bcu drug nas zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig bar la sku mtshams bzhugs/ zla lnga pa'i tshes gsum la zhabs drung tre bo rin po che zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs thugs smon mdzad/ kurma pa dgung lo nga gcig pa lcags khye (59 16/ 2798/ 1921/)lor paṇa chen byang lam brgyud rgya nag tu byol/ 'di lo'i dbyar khar rgya nag gi grong khyer hrang ter du krung go'i gzhung sgrub tshogs pa'i ma ri gung khran tang btsugs/ kurma pa dgung lo nga gnyis pa chu khyi (59 17/ 2799/ 1922/)lo'i tshes 1la tho rengs snyan gsan rgya gling sogs kha shar phyogs su bskor te gtong bcos mdzad/ de skabs sku lams bde mo ma byung kyang thun bzhi chag med mdzad/ mtshams 'og tu yod pa'i mdun 'dug skor na dar btang ba sogs byas/ dge slong 'jam tshul la zhal chems phyag bris bka' rgya bcas gnang / tshes ldanas thor thun srod sdin/ snga gong thun gnyis rnams la bka' rgya can gyi ljags bsnyen gsungs/ bsnyun gzhi 'phar ba'i rnam pa bstan cing sman pa rnams kyis sman phul rung phan skyed med par nam phyed char zhabs skyil krung gi sku g.yas phyogs yol tsam rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu khyi (59 1go 2796/ 1922/)nag zla'i tshes —nyer gnyis nyin dgongs pa chos dbyings su gshes sa/ de ltar zhag gsum bcos med du bzhag de nas thugs dam grol te ngo mtshar gyi cho 'phrul mas kun gyi yid la dad pa'i sa bon legs par bskrun par byas so/ dam pa 'di'i rjes su bzung ba'i slob ma'i mchog ni/ si tu/ rgyal tshab/ dpa' bo/ tre bo/ 'jam mgon mchog sprul rin po che sogs chos brgyud 'di nyid kyi yab sras/ chos rgyud gcig pa'i dgon sde che phran rnams su —— 228

༄༅/ /na rma pa sku phreng bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//bzhugs pa'i zur mang gar dbang /ras chung /sga khra leb skyabs mgon/ban chen sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i sprul sku/zur mang bya btang pa sogs bla sprul che phran rigs ma lus pa med par lta bu dang bka' brgyud bstan pa'i chu mgo dwags lha sgom po'i mchog sbrul/'brug chen/yongs 'dzin chos mgon/cog grwa sogs dpal ldan 'brug pa'i gdan sa phan tshun gyi bstan 'dzin skyes mchog du ma/gsang chen rnying ma'i bstan gzhi chen po smin gling /naḥthog sogs nas snga 'gyur bka' gter gyi brgyud 'dzin mkhan slob dang /sngags rig 'dzin pa'i slob tshogs 'dus pa brjod kyis mi lang ba bcas so/ mdor na mnga' ris/dbus gtsang / 'bras ljongs/ lho mon/ spu kong / byang 'brog khams stod/bar khams/ smad khams/rgya 'jang /hor sogs tshun la gsung gi bdud ci'i smin grol du gyur pa brjod mi nus shing /gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag skabs der bsdu gsog ma thub kyang /phyis dam pa gong gi sku'i mdun na 'don pa gser rong lha rtse'i dge slong 'jam dpal tshul khrims kyis mi phyed dad pas kun nas slangs te bka'i bsdu gso mdzad pas/sku gzhon nu'i dus kyi bka' brtsams dbyar gyi ni'u seng sil ma'i skor dang bstod tshogs/ rnam thar sogs pod bcu skor bzhugs yod/dge'o//7 karma pa sku phreng bcu drug pa rig pa'i rdo rje rab byung bco lnga'i shing byi 5919/ 2801/ 192gol 'khrungs/ ༷zirdo ba tre khu thorngo rtse la ci ji sgroX//rni/kau /5 /rnal na sugade—229—

ri ༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng bcu drug pa rig pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//༄༅ / /ga rma pa sku phreng bcu drug pa rig pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar/rkarma pa sku phreng bcu drug pa rig pa'i rdo rje ni/ sku gong ma zhing du gshegs khar zhal chems phyag bris zhal shin tu gsal ba 'jog gnang mdzad pa ji bzhin zhal chems ngos nyadzin las/ 'di nas shar phyogs gser ldan chu yi 'gramaḥ mda' bci na dpa' bos bzung ba'i ljongs kyi charaḥ lhan chags seng ge 'gying pa'i 'phangs pa ruḥ dpal gyi ri la a dang thub kyis brgyanaḥ sa yi khyim du chos dkar rje'u'i rigasaḥ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i lhums su gnas mal mthong: glang gi nya'am byi ba lo pa zhigaḥ a ti khyab gdal kun bzang mkha' dbyings lasaḥ snang rigs zung 'jug ye shes sgron me cheḥ rang byung khyab bdag rig pa'i rdo rje 'bodaḥ ces bod shar phyogs bar khams sde dge'i char gtogs pa ldan nam 'dan khog gi bye brag chu bo gser ldan 'bab pa'i 'gram/ gling ge 'brug sa nyis kyi dus mda' bsnun dpa' bo sde gling 'dan mas bzung ba'i ljongs 'dan khog ri bo lhun chags seng ge gnam rdzong gi 'phang pa gtsang zhing dben pa'i sa nas su/ dang ngo ma'i lhums su zhugs pa'i dus su yig drug gsungs pa/ yum gyis gsan pa sogs ngo ma tshar ci yang snang ba/ de yang rigs ni sger a thub chos dkar rje'u'i rigs su yab rje tshe dbang phun tshogs dang / yum rgya mkhar skal bzang chos sgron zhes 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ma de gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing byi lo'i (59 19/ 2801/ 192ri)zla drug pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge bar/ bar snang nas lha'i rol mo 'i sgra snyan par sgrogs pa dang / gzims gur 'od dkar pos khyab pa/ yab gzhis kyi chu snod thams cad 'o mas sang ba la sogs ngo ma tshar ba'i ltas dpag tu med pa dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ de'i sngon nas rdzogs chen rin po che lnga ba thub bstan chos kyi rdo rjes byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa ra lung bstan pa dang tā si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal pos rje gong ma'i yang srid 'khrul bral yin la mngon sum mkhyen cing gzigs 'phral rje nyid dang / 'jam mgon kong sprul mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer bcas ched gnyer gyis sku khrus gsol/ na bza' dang dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phul ba sogs grub rjes/ rje gong ma'i 'da' kha'i zhal chems zheb — — 230 ——

༄:/ /kurma nga/ sku phreng bcu drug pa rig pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//ba ci gsal de dag phyag son mchis par dad sbyin 'brel yod thams cad ngo mtshar dang / yid ches kyi rgyab snon bla med du gyur/ 'di'i lor paṇa chen —dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma khams stod skye mdo brgyud rgya nag pe cin du phebs/ naḥ thog si tu chos kyi rgya mtsho 'das/ kurma pa dgung lo bzhi pā me mos lor rtsorab byung bcu drug pa'i mgo tshugs/ kurma pa dgung lo lnga pa sa 'brug lor rgyal dmangs tshogs pa'am go min tang srid gzhung gis bod sog u yon lhan 'dzoms mnyam tshogs kyi lhan khang btsugs/ na rma pa dgung lo brgyad pa lcags lug (19 3 1)zla dang po'i tshes nyer bdun gyi snga dror slar yang mkhyen brtse rin po che dang / mtshur phu'i gzims tshab sogs kyis/ na bza' dang / dbu zhwa sogs phul/ de nas zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nyin gza'o skar 'byung 'phrod phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin/ dpal spungs si tu rin po che/ kun ma' pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po dang / rgyal sras gzhon nu gtsos yab yum sogs sku 'khor rnams dpal spungs gdan sa chen por gdan drangs skabs/ lam bar sde dge chos rgyal tshe dbang bdud 'dul blon 'bangs rnams kyis chibs bsu'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas dpal lhun grub steng du spyan drangs nas/ mchod yon mjal 'phrad kyi byin rlabs dga' sto na ngoms par bstsal/ de nas zla gnyis pa 'i tshes brgyad nyin dpal spungs su phyag phebs pa na/ ngur smig rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa stong phrag mang pos bsu ba ser stengs kyis mdun bdar te zhabs pad bkod/ de'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi gtsug lag khang chen por seng ges btegs pa'i khrir mnga' gsol mdzad/ khams phyogs kyi bka' brgyud bla sprul/ dad sbyin rgyal blon dra ma'i tshogs kyis khri 'bul rgya cher phul ba sogs/ bkra shis bde legs kyis mtha' brgyan par byas/ zla bzhi ba'i tshes nyer gnyis si tu rin po che dang lhan rgyas/ dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing mchog gdal ba der chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba dang lam bar sde dgon rnams la sku'i zhabs kyis bcags/— gsung gi 'od zer bkyes/ thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs te mthong thos dran grol gyi mdzad pas dus 'da' bzhin phebs pas/ khams kha nang chen rgyal po'i mnga' khongs su phebs/ rdza stod kyi 'brong pa bar ma'i 'ba' rom bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa/ lci yi spe'u snag dgon du sgar chen gyi phebs bsu 'byor/ zla drug pa'i tshes bcu — — 231 — —

༄༅/ /ma me pa sku phreng bcu drug pa rig pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//gsum nyin dbu zhwa mthong grol gyi thog ma'i mjal kha'i skabs/ dad 'dun kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsir byas pa dang / nam mkhar 'ja' sprin gyis khyab cing me tog gi char babs pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi snang ba 'byams su klas/ zla bdun pa'i tshes nyer dgu nyin gnyan chen thang lha'i mdun du rten rdzas rgya chen po dang / lha g.yag dkar po zhig phul bas mis khrid pa ltar thang lha'i mdun du shar gyis song bas/ thang lhas dngos su bzhes pa'i rtags mtshan ngo mtshar ba byung / de nas 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer/ dpa' bo gtsug lag smra ba/ rgyal tshab grags pa rgya mtsho sogs kyis phebs bsu dang bcas mtshur mdo ba'i lung gi sne la chen por zhabs kyi pad+mo legs par bkod/ ༈ de nas lha ldan du 7gong sa skyabs mgon rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa thub bstan rgya mtshos (1876 1933)gtsug phud bzhes/ 'di skabs gong sa mchog gi gzigs snang la rang byang gi dbu zhwa dang bcos ma'i dbu zhwa nyis brtsegs lta bur gzigs/ de min khrom tshogs kyis kyang mthong snang 'dra min byung / de nas gdan sa chen por phyag phebs te/ gong ma rim byon gyi gna' lugs ma nyams par khri 'phang mthon por mnga' gsol ba'i rim pa rnams zab cing rgyas par zhus te/ 'jam mgon si tu rin po che dang / skyabs mgon 'brug chen mi pham chos kyi dbang po sogs skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis mnga' dbang zab mo phul ba dang /shis brjod kyi me tog 'thor ba sogs kyi mdzad pa dang bstun/ dgon ma lag dang dad sbyin rnams kyis khri 'bul sogs phun sum tshogs pa'i mdzad sgo rnams grub pa dang / lo bzhi'i ring dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gangs dkar paṇ+ḍi ta'i mdun/ phyi nang gi rig gzhung rgya mtsho lta bu thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgro 'dogs legs par bcad de sa lam gyi rim pa mtha' dag grol pa'i tshul bstan/ 'di skabs sngon gnas rjes dran ngo mtshar can du ma gangs dkar rin po che la gsungs pa mang du yod/ kurma pa dgung lo dgu pa chu sprel lo'i phyi zla dang po'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin 'jar pan gyis rgya nag tu btsan 'dzul byas/ khams stod kyi don chus nyer lnga'i don du mtsho sngon dang bod ljongs bar 'khrug pa byung / phyi zla bcu ba'i tshes bcu dgu nyin rgyal dmangs tshogs pas dmag 'khrug mi chog pa'i bka' btang / kurma pa dgung lo bcu pa chu bya lo'i zla 4ba'i tshos 10nyin bod ljongs —— 232 ——

༄ / /kurma pa sku phreng bcu drug pa rig pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//dang mtsho sngon bar chings yig don tshan brgyad bzhag khams stod zur mang dga' ldan dgon gyi chos las thad mtsho sngon (gyis jus gtogs mi chog pa dang rgyal bas btang ba'i mkhan pos srid don mi 'dzin zer nas zla ba lnga lhag bod ljongs dang mtsho sngon bar gyi dmag 'khrug gi mjug bsdus so/hor zla bcu pa'i tshes sum cu'i nyin rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho brgang bya nga brgyad la phebs te/ mya ngan las 'das/ bod yongs rdzogs sdug bsngal gyi gnas su lhung / bdun gsum gyi ring la mi yi rgyan dang rta yi rgyan khang ba'i rgyan sogs spras med pas skye rgu mtha' dag gyon chas khra khra sil sil gyon mi med/ se 'bras dga' gsum dang mtshur phu sogs sa dge ka rnying thams cad kyis zhabs rim legs par bsgrubs/ gdung mjal bsnyeng rjes ’gser gdung gi zhal 'debs kyang phul/ na rma pa dgung lo bcu gcig pa'i shing khyi lo'i zla bzhi bar rgyal dmangs tshogs pa'i srid gzhung gis hong rma'o su bod du btang / rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtshor hu go hwang hwa tshe phu yon tā hri zhes pa'i 'ded phul cho lo dang / g.yang ṭi'i dam kha 'ja' sa bcas gnang / kurma pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa shing phag lo'i zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum nyin/ mdo khams su chibs bsgyur/ blo rong du byon skabs phebs byams kyi sgo phyes gsungs nas pha gi la ltos dang / ngo mtshar can mang po yul lha rta rdzis phebs bsur btang 'dug gsungs/ yang rta rdzi'i yul dgun khar sbrul med kyang / sbrul mang po byung bar mgul dang sku pang du bzhes te nga klu rgyal mkhar nag yin gsungs sku rtsed mdzad pa dang /spyi tsha ru sngar med chu mgo zhig gsar du byung bar phyis tshe chu zhes ming du thogs/ tshes nyer bzhi nyin thang lha'i rten mkhar mdun du phebs skabs sngar phul ba'i lha g.yag dkar po de thang lha'i rdza nang nas tshur thon te ngur sgra dang bcas sgar thad du byung zhing slar mi mngon par gyur/ de skabs sku rtsed kyis gri mdud dang / chu ra zhabs rjes sogs bzhag par mdzad/ khams stod don chus nyer lnga'i 'brong pa ri ba bar ma'i dgon du gro lod gtor bzlog skabs med dpung dmar po shar re song / 'brong pa stod kyi sa mtshams mtsho 'bur zhes par 'khyags pa'i steng du zhabs rjes bzhag pa slar 'khyags pa zhu rung chur zhabs rjes gsal bar yod/ nang chen rta rna dgon gyi gling ge 'brug gnyis kyi rten rnams mjal nas dpal rta rna'i — 233 —4

༄༅/ /kurma pa sku phreng bcu drug pa rig pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//gnas yig brtsams/ spyan gzigs gna' bas rdo la rmis rjes bzhag de nas shar byang gi rkya mi nyin gcig lam gyi lci chu'i ra rtsa rdzong mgor phebs/gnas der sa chen bla ma zhig gi gdung 'bum yod/ nang chen rgyal po'i spro g.yeng byed sa yin/ brag mgor chu dkon pas/ bla ma bsam gtan rgya mtshos sa chu yi dngos grub zhus pas/ sku khrus gsol ba dang char zim bur babs pa/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur phudza pa dang bcas sngar med pa'i chu rgyun gsar du byung ba phyis kyang chad med yod/ de nas gdan sa bar ma rkarma'i chos khrir phebs/ la rma pa dgung lo bcu gsum pa me byi lor dpal spungs dang rdzong gsar du phebs/ rdzong gsar mkhyen brtse chos kyi blo gros kyis dbu zhwa mthong grol rin po che dbu la khru gang tsam gyi nam mkhar 'phags pa dang rje dus mkhyen gyis dngos su mjal/ 'di lor rgya dmar kyis dkar mdzes sa khul gyi mi ser la bod pa'i srid gzhung 'dzugs rogs byas/ kurma pa dgung lo bcu bzhi pa me glang lo'i zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin/ grwa ṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma bgrang bya nga bzhir phebs te/ sga skye rgu don 'grub gling pa'i rgya nag kun gsal pho brang du bde bar gshegs/ kurma pa dgung lo bco lnga pa sa stag (1938)lor spang phug tu dus mkhyen gsung byon ma'i lha khang gi ka ba g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi ka gdan rdo ba'i steng du skyabs mchog dang / si tu rnam gnyis kyis zhabs rjes re bzhag de nas si tu dang mkhyen brtse sogs las dbang khrid mang du gsan/ si tu rin po che las dge tshul gyi sdom pa ba'es/ 'di lor paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa sna nga mtha'i sgyu 'phrul chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang 'bri gung rtogs sprul rnam gnyis/ 'khrungs/ kurma pa dgung lo bcu drug pa'i sa yos (19 tshon9) lor/ khams dkar mdzes ཿyul du khams pa'i zhing chen dngos su tshugs / 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa langs/ na rma pas mngo stod smad kyi 'phrin las grub nas bod du chibs bsgyur/ kurma pa dgung lo bcu bdun pa lcags 'brug (1940)lor sde dge rgyal po tshe dbang stobs ldan 'das/ sras o dga' dgung lo gsum yin pas/ dgon khag lngas gros byas nas btsum mo 'jam dbyangs dpal mor dbang sprad/ skye rgya'i don 'grub gling nas nga/ṇa chen dgu pa'i sku gdung bod du gdan drangs/ zla dgu ba'i tshes bco lnga nyin kurma nga/ dbus phyogs su chibs bsgyur ba 'i lam thor 2 8 1 — —

du rgyal chen bco brgyad kyi ya gyal 'dam a mye 'bum rgya~X gyis mig med pa'i gzi khyad par can zhig phul/ zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin gdan sar zhabs bkod nas gsan sbyangs gnang ba dang / gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i ar las rgya cher mdzad/ sbrags dang bsam yas sogs gnas mjal rgya cher phebs skabs/ gro mo lung la gong ma rnam gsum gyi zhal gzigs/ 'brug rgyal gnyis pa 'jigs med dbang phyug gis gdan drangs pa bzhin/ kurma pa dgung lo nyer gcig pa shing sprel (1944lo'i zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nyin 'brug la bteg sku rjes dang byams pa lha khang sogs su gnas mjal dang / yul mi rnam sa chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ 'brug rgyal mchog gis dbu zhwa mthong grol mjal ba na gzigs snang mi 'dra ba byung gsungs/ sku rjes lha khang gi gu ru thog tshad gnyis yod par snyan dar phul bas dbu'i mdzod spus bzhes pa da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod/ phyogs der bstan dang 'gro ba'i don rgya cher mdzad pas 'brug rgyal mchog dang mchod yon 'bral mi phod pa lta bu'i ngang nas bod phyogs su phyag bteg karma pa dgung lo nyer gnyis pa shing bya (1945)lor 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i mjug bsgril/ ma rma pa dgung lo nyer gsum pa'i me khyi (1946)lor slar yang kun mkhyen si tu mkhan slob dang bcas nas bsnyen par rdzobs pa dge slong gi dngos po yang dag pa bzhes/ zhwa dmar bcu gcig pa 'jam dbyangs rin po che (1892—— 1946)'das te dgongs rdzogs mdzad/ na rma pa dgung lo nyer bzhi pa me phag (1947)zla bzhi ba'i tshes nyer gnyis nyin stod phyogs su chibs bteg nas sman gdong / 'bur dkar sogs dgon gnas rnams su zhabs kyis bcags/ rim gyis rgya bal 'bras ljongs sogs kyi gnas mjal la phyag bteg ste/ rten gnas rnams la mchod 'bul thugs smon sogs dang 'brel can rnams don ldan du mdzad pa sogs rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa rlabs chen mdzad nas/ rim gyis mtsho pad+ma dang / khu nu/ spu rong / gangs rin po che'i gnas mjal sogs legs grub zin nas zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun nyin mtshur mdo bo lung gi gdan sa chen por phyag 'khor/ de 'phral gling khar dar — — 23mi kyi

༄༄/ /kurma pa sku phreng bcu drug pa rig pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs so//ji —— rgyas chos gling gsar bzhengs gnang / gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i rin chen gter gyi mdzod chen pos gtsos gdams pa thams cad gsan bsam mthar phyin par mdzad/ zhar du phyag chen nges don rgya mtsho dang zab lam nā ro chos drug sogs gsan bzhes mdzad nas don brgyud kyi bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol mdzad/ kurma pas si tu rin po che mchog rigs kyi bdag por 'dzin/ na rma pa dgung lo nyer ri drug pa'i sa glang (1949) lo'i phyi zla bcu'i tshes gcig nyin krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs/ nam pa dgung lo nyer bdun pa lcags stag (1950)zla bdun pa'i tshes nyer bzhi'i nyin dkar mdzes dge stag sprul sku chab mdor phebs nas bod la zhi ba'i bcings dgrol dgos tshul bstan pas/ rgya phur ling gi gsang nyul h+phu thes dug btang nas bgrongs/ chab mdo'i bod dmag lnga stong bdun brgya so brgyad mtshan 'og tu song / phyi zla drug pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin srid gzhung gi sku tshab/ dmag dpon chen po krang cin u pe cin nas bod du thon/ spyi zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu bdun nyin gro mor rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang mjal phrad mdzad/ spyi zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la bcings 'grol dmag gi dpung sde khag gcig lha sar 'byor/ na rma pa dgung lo nyer dgu pa chu 'brug (1952)spyi zla dang po'i tshes bcu nyin bod las don u yon lhan khang btsugs/ hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes nyer dgur na rma pa byang 'brog gdul ba'i skal ba babs par dgongs te phyag bteg ste/ 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad/ kurma pa dgung lo sum cu pa chu sbru la (1953)lo'i zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyer bzhir rgyal ba rin po che pe cin du bca' sdod don gcod khang btsugs/ hor zla bzhi'i tshes bco brgyad la lha ldan du gong sa thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po'i zhal snga nas dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i smin grol gyi bdud rtsi myong bar phebs/zla brgyad pa'i zas nyer lnga la gdan sar phyag 'khor nas/ smin gling khri chen gcung rin po che las mchog gling gter chos yongs rdzogs kyi dbang khrid risgolung bcas gsan grub nas bka' brgyad smin sgrub kyi mtha' brgyan pa bcas bkra shis bde legs su bstsal/ kurma pa dgung lo so gcig pa shing rta (1954lo'i zla drug pa'i tshes bcu bdun nyin rgyal ba rin po che nang logs tu 'thus mi'i zhor du gzigs skor la phebs/ ma rma pa pe cin du — — 236 —

gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i sku tshab tu mdo khams shar lho'i ris med dgon khag mang por zhabs sor bkod de so so'i 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad pa dang / gang spyi'i bka' slob sogs zab nan bstsal te/ skya ser khri phrag mang po'i 'di phyi'i don rlabs chen mdzad/ zhor du dpa la spungs su zhabs sor bkod de/si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po'i yang srid pad+ma don yod nyin byed dpal spungs gdan sar mnga' gsol gnang / gzhan yang 'brel can ji yod don ldan du mdzad nas slar/ 7 gong sa chen po mchog dang lhan cig lha ldan du phebs so/ na rma pa dgung lo so gnyis pa shing lug 〉〉 4ba ba lnga ba'i tshes bcu bdun la rgyal ba rin po che dang lhan du mtshur phur phebs/ 'di lor gzim chung phun tshogs dga' 'khyil gsar bzhengs gnang nas/tshes bcu'i gar 'cham dang sgar chen la gzigs zhib gnang / de rjes spyan ras gzigs kyi bka' dbang bstsal ba dang dbu zhwa mthong grol kyang sgron gnang gis thugs dgyes brtse'i ngang nas phyir phebs gnang / spyi zla bzhi ba'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin paṇa chen er ti ni mchog dang sku 'khor zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa lha sar 'byor/ de nas bod du dus zing gi rkyen la brten/ na rma pa dgung lo so gsum pa'i me sprel (1956)zla bdun pa'i tshes nyer dgur bka' blon nga phod dang / spam mda' stobs rgyal gnyis dang lhan du chab mdor chibs bteg nas/ zhi bde dgos pa'i 'bod skul nan tan du gnang / dad mjal shing tu mang bar nyin ma/tshan bar med kyis 'dod pa'i re skong legs par gnang nas slar lha ldan du bteg ste/ gdan sa mtshur phur zhabs sor 'khod/ mkhas btsun bzang pos/ bde chos chos mgon rin po ches gdan zhu dang chabs cig rgya gar gnas mjal la dgung lo so gcig pa'i me sprel (1956)lo'i zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyer dgu nyin chibs bteg bde chen chos 'khor du rten rnams la khrus gsol dang / tshogs mchod rgya che mdzad/ de nas gro mo bka' brgyud dgon dang / sgang tog tu phebs nas chos rgyal bkra shis rnam rgyal yab sras rnams mjal 'phrad gnang / de nas rdo rje gdan/ wā rwa ṇa sri/ rtswa mchog grong / lum bi ni sogs la mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya cher gnang
